local C = Color3.fromRGB
local themes = {
    Midnight = {Background=C(10,11,15), Sidebar=C(13,14,19), Panel=C(17,18,24), Hover=C(24,26,34), Stroke=C(36,38,48), Text=C(236,237,243), Muted=C(131,135,151), Accent=C(239,77,105)},
    Obsidian = {Background=C(12,12,12), Sidebar=C(16,16,16), Panel=C(22,22,22), Hover=C(30,30,30), Stroke=C(43,43,43), Text=C(240,240,240), Muted=C(145,145,145), Accent=C(160,126,255)},
    Light = {Background=C(241,243,248), Sidebar=C(250,251,254), Panel=C(255,255,255), Hover=C(232,235,244), Stroke=C(216,220,232), Text=C(30,34,48), Muted=C(91,99,119), Accent=C(111,85,229)},
    Ocean = {Background=C(8,16,25), Sidebar=C(10,21,33), Panel=C(14,27,42), Hover=C(21,40,58), Stroke=C(35,59,79), Text=C(230,243,251), Muted=C(147,177,198), Accent=C(38,186,221)},
    Emerald = {Background=C(9,18,16), Sidebar=C(12,23,20), Panel=C(17,32,27), Hover=C(25,46,38), Stroke=C(39,66,54), Text=C(233,246,238), Muted=C(151,181,164), Accent=C(58,189,136)},
    Rose = {Background=C(22,13,20), Sidebar=C(29,17,26), Panel=C(38,23,34), Hover=C(53,33,47), Stroke=C(77,46,66), Text=C(251,235,244), Muted=C(192,154,177), Accent=C(230,115,166)},
    Gold = {Background=C(19,18,15), Sidebar=C(25,23,19), Panel=C(33,30,24), Hover=C(47,43,33), Stroke=C(66,59,44), Text=C(246,240,225), Muted=C(186,174,148), Accent=C(205,163,79)},
}
local function accentInk(color)
    local function linear(v) return v<=.04045 and v/12.92 or ((v+.055)/1.055)^2.4 end
    local light=.2126*linear(color.R)+.7152*linear(color.G)+.0722*linear(color.B)
    return 1.05/(light+.05)>=4.5 and C(255,255,255) or C(10,14,20)
end
for _, theme in pairs(themes) do
    theme.White=C(255,255,255); theme.Black=C(0,0,0); theme.AccentText=accentInk(theme.Accent)
end
local function make(class, props, parent)
    local obj = Instance.new(class)
    for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do obj[key] = value end
    obj.Parent = parent
    return obj
end
local function corner(obj, radius) make("UICorner", {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,radius or 8)}, obj) end
local function pad(obj, x, y)
    make("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,x),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,x),PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,y or x),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,y or x)},obj)
end
local function list(obj, gap, horizontal)
    return make("UIListLayout", {Padding=UDim.new(0,gap or 8),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,FillDirection=horizontal and Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical},obj)
end
local function tween(obj, props)
    TweenService:Create(obj,TweenInfo.new(.17,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),props):Play()
end
local function copy(value) if typeof(value)=="table" then local t={} for k,v in pairs(value) do t[k]=copy(v) end return t end return value end
local function clamp(v,a,b) return math.max(a,math.min(b,v)) end
local function round(v,step) return math.floor(v/step+.5)*step end
local function options(o) if type(o)=="string" then return {Title=o} end return o or {} end
local function image(name)
    if type(name)=="number" then return "rbxassetid://"..tostring(name) end
    name = tostring(name or "layers")
    if name:match("^rbxassetid://") then return name end
    return Icons[name:gsub("^lucide%-","")] or Icons.layers or ""
end
function Library:CreateWindow(config)
    config = config or {}
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    assert(player or config.Parent, "SeniorUI must run on the client, or receive Parent")
    local w = {Connections={},Tabs={},Flags={},Controls={},Theme=copy(themes[config.Theme] or themes.Midnight),Destroyed=false,Visible=true,Minimized=false,Keybind=config.Keybind or Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,_bindings={},_searchables={},_popConnections={},_toasts={}}
    if config.Accent then w.Theme.Accent=config.Accent; w.Theme.AccentText=accentInk(config.Accent) end
    function w:Connect(signal, fn)
        local c=signal:Connect(fn); table.insert(self.Connections,c); return c
    end
    function w:Destroy(externallyDestroyed)
        if self.Destroyed then return end
        self.Destroyed=true
        if self.ClosePopup then self:ClosePopup() end
        for _,c in ipairs(self.Connections) do c:Disconnect() end
        self.Connections={}; self._bindings={}; self._capturing=false
        self._toasts={}; self._searchables={}
        if self.Gui and not externallyDestroyed then self.Gui:Destroy() end
    end
    function w:Bind(obj, property, token)
        obj[property]=self.Theme[token]
        table.insert(self._bindings,{obj,property,token})
        return obj
    end
    function w:Frame(parent, props, token)
        local f=make("Frame",props,parent)
        f.BorderSizePixel=0
        if token then self:Bind(f,"BackgroundColor3",token) else f.BackgroundTransparency=1 end
        return f
    end
    function w:Text(parent, text, props, token)
        local p={BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=tostring(text or ""),TextSize=14,Font=Enum.Font.BuilderSans,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,BorderSizePixel=0}
        for k,v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k]=v end
        return self:Bind(make("TextLabel",p,parent),"TextColor3",token or "Text")
    end
    function w:Button(parent, props, token)
        local p={Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0}
        for k,v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k]=v end
        local b=make("TextButton",p,parent)
        if token then self:Bind(b,"BackgroundColor3",token) else b.BackgroundTransparency=1 end
        return b
    end
    function w:Icon(parent, name, props, token)
        local p={BackgroundTransparency=1,Image=image(name),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(18,18),BorderSizePixel=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit}
        for k,v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k]=v end
        return self:Bind(make("ImageLabel",p,parent),"ImageColor3",token or "Muted")
    end
    function w:Stroke(obj)
        return self:Bind(make("UIStroke",{Thickness=1,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border},obj),"Color","Stroke")
    end
    function w:Call(fn,...)
        if not fn or self.Destroyed then return end
        local args=table.pack(...)
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok,err=pcall(fn,table.unpack(args,1,args.n))
            if not ok then warn("[SeniorUI callback] "..tostring(err)) end
        end)
    end
    local parent=config.Parent or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    -- Instance-based disposal survives reloading the whole library with a new
    -- loadstring. No getgenv/shared/executor globals are required.
    for _,previous in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
        if previous:IsA("ScreenGui") and previous.Name=="SeniorHubSources" then
            local dispose=previous:FindFirstChild("SeniorUIDispose")
            if dispose and dispose:IsA("BindableFunction") then
                -- Invoke waits for disposal even when SignalBehavior is Deferred.
                pcall(function() dispose:Invoke() end)
            elseif dispose and dispose:IsA("BindableEvent") then dispose:Fire() end
            previous:Destroy() -- also removes legacy UI versions without a hook
        end
    end
    local gui=make("ScreenGui",{Name="SeniorHubSources",ResetOnSpawn=false,IgnoreGuiInset=true,ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,DisplayOrder=config.DisplayOrder or 80},parent)
    w.Gui=gui
    local dispose=make("BindableFunction",{Name="SeniorUIDispose"},gui)
    dispose.OnInvoke=function() w:Destroy(); return true end
    w:Connect(gui.Destroying,function() w:Destroy(true) end)
    local root=w:Frame(gui,{Name="Window",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(760,510),ClipsDescendants=true},"Background")
    corner(root,14); w:Stroke(root); w.Root=root
    local scale=make("UIScale",{Scale=1},root)
    local width,height=config.Width or 760,config.Height or 510
    root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
    local function resize()
        local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
        local size=camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
        scale.Scale=math.min(config.Scale or 1,math.max(.1,(size.X-24)/width),math.max(.1,(size.Y-48)/height))
        if w.ClampRestore then w:ClampRestore() end
    end
    local camConnection
    local function bindCamera()
        if camConnection then camConnection:Disconnect() end
        if workspace.CurrentCamera then camConnection=w:Connect(workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"),resize) end
        resize()
    end
    w:Connect(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"),bindCamera); bindCamera()
    local rail=w:Frame(root,{Name="Sidebar",Size=UDim2.new(0,64,1,0)},"Sidebar")
    -- Roblox ClipsDescendants is rectangular: round the sidebar itself, then
    -- square only its right edge. No child fills the outer rounded left corners.
    corner(rail,14)
    w:Frame(rail,{Name="SidebarRightFill",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-14,1,0)},"Sidebar")
    w:Frame(rail,{Position=UDim2.new(1,-1,0,0),Size=UDim2.new(0,1,1,0)},"Stroke")
    w:Icon(rail,config.Logo or 92834373646022,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,17),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(36,36)},"White")
    local nav=make("ScrollingFrame",{Name="Tabs",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,78),Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-146),ClipsDescendants=true,BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=0,CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y},rail)
    list(nav,9)
    local profile=w:Button(rail,{Name="PlayerProfile",Position=UDim2.new(0,15,1,-49),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(34,34)},"Panel"); corner(profile,17)
    local avatar=make("ImageLabel",{Name="PlayerAvatar",BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(30,30),Image=player and ("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="..tostring(player.UserId).."&w=150&h=150") or "",ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop},profile)
    w:Bind(avatar,"ImageColor3","White")
    make("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)},avatar)
    w.ProfileButton=profile; w.Avatar=avatar
    if player then
        local attempts=0
        local function loadAvatar()
            if w.Destroyed then return end
            attempts=attempts+1
            local ok,content,ready=pcall(function()
                return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(player.UserId,Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
            end)
            if w.Destroyed then return end
            if ok and type(content)=="string" and content~="" then avatar.Image=content end
            if (not ok or not ready) and attempts<5 then task.delay(1,loadAvatar) end
        end
        task.spawn(loadAvatar)
    end
    w:Connect(profile.Activated,function()
        w:Notify({Title=player and player.DisplayName or "Senior Hub",Content=player and ("@"..player.Name) or ("SeniorUI "..Library.Version),Icon="user"})
    end)
    local header=w:Frame(root,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(64,0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-64,0,74)})
    local drag=w:Button(header,{Size=UDim2.new(1,-86,1,0)})
    w:Text(header,config.Title or "Senior Hub â¢ Sources",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(22,15),Size=UDim2.new(1,-120,0,20),TextSize=17,Font=Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold})
    local breadcrumb=w:Text(header,config.Subtitle or "Your space. Your controls.",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(22,39),Size=UDim2.new(1,-120,0,16),TextSize=13},"Muted")
    local function headerButton(icon,x)
        local b=w:Button(header,{Position=UDim2.new(1,x,0,21),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(28,28)},"Panel"); corner(b,7)
        w:Icon(b,icon,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16)})
        return b
    end
    local mini=headerButton("minus",-78); mini.Name="Minimize"
    local close=headerButton("x",-43); close.Name="Hide"
    w:Frame(header,{Position=UDim2.new(0,18,1,-1),Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,1)},"Stroke")
    local searchbox=w:Frame(root,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(84,86),Size=UDim2.new(1,-104,0,32)},"Panel"); corner(searchbox,7); w:Stroke(searchbox)
    w:Icon(searchbox,"search",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,8),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16)})
    local search=w:Bind(make("TextBox",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(34,0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-42,1,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",PlaceholderText="Search components in this tab...",TextSize=13,Font=Enum.Font.BuilderSans,ClearTextOnFocus=false,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left},searchbox),"TextColor3","Text")
    w:Bind(search,"PlaceholderColor3","Muted")
    local pages=w:Frame(root,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(84,134),Size=UDim2.new(1,-104,1,-179)})
    local footer=w:Frame(root,{Position=UDim2.new(0,84,1,-34),Size=UDim2.new(1,-104,0,24)})
    local dot=w:Frame(footer,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,9),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(5,5)},"Accent"); corner(dot,3)
    w:Text(footer,"SENIOR / SOURCES",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(13,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(160,24),TextSize=10,Font=Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium},"Muted")
    local keyText=w:Text(footer,w.Keybind.Name.." to toggle",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.fromScale(1,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(210,24),TextSize=12,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right},"Muted")
    local restore=w:Button(gui,{Name="Restore",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,160),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(46,46),Visible=false},"Sidebar"); corner(restore,12); w:Stroke(restore)
    w:Icon(restore,config.Logo or 92834373646022,{Name="RestoreLogo",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(30,30)},"White")
    w.Restore=restore
    function w:ClampRestore(x,y)
        local view=gui.AbsoluteSize
        local size=restore.AbsoluteSize
        local pos=restore.Position
        x=x or (pos.X.Scale*view.X+pos.X.Offset)
        y=y or (pos.Y.Scale*view.Y+pos.Y.Offset)
        restore.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(clamp(x,8,math.max(8,view.X-size.X-8)),clamp(y,8,math.max(8,view.Y-size.Y-8)))
    end
    w:ClampRestore()
    function w:ClosePopup()
        for _,c in ipairs(self._popConnections) do c:Disconnect() end
        self._popConnections={}
        if self.Popup then self.Popup:Destroy(); self.Popup=nil end
    end
    function w:PopupAt(anchor, popupWidth, popupHeight)
        self:ClosePopup()
        local overlay=self:Button(gui,{Name="PopupOverlay",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=200})
        local view=gui.AbsoluteSize
        local p=anchor.AbsolutePosition
        local sz=anchor.AbsoluteSize
        local x=clamp(p.X+sz.X-popupWidth,8,math.max(8,view.X-popupWidth-8))
        local y=p.Y+sz.Y+6
        if y+popupHeight>view.Y-8 then y=math.max(8,p.Y-popupHeight-6) end
        local f=self:Frame(overlay,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(popupWidth,math.min(popupHeight,math.max(60,view.Y-16))),ZIndex=201,ClipsDescendants=true},"Sidebar")
        corner(f,9); self:Stroke(f)
        self.Popup=overlay
        self:Connect(overlay.Activated,function() self:ClosePopup() end)
        -- Intercept empty space inside the popup, instead of closing it.
        self:Button(f,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=201})
        return f
    end
    function w:Toggle(state)
        if self.Destroyed then return end
        if state==nil then state=not self.Visible end
        self.Visible=state
        root.Visible=state; restore.Visible=not state
        if state and self.Minimized then self:SetMinimized(false) end
        if not state then self:ClampRestore() end
        self:ClosePopup()
    end
    function w:SetMinimized(state)
        if self.Destroyed then return end
        if state==nil then state=not self.Minimized end
        self.Minimized=state; self:ClosePopup()
        -- Minimize keeps the header and the original brand logo. Hide the
        -- anchored bottom profile and tabs BEFORE shrinking the sidebar;
        -- otherwise its footer moves up and overlaps the logo at the top.
        nav.Visible=not state; profile.Visible=not state
        pages.Visible=not state; searchbox.Visible=not state; footer.Visible=not state
        tween(root,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,state and 74 or height)})
    end
    function w:SetKeybind(key)
        assert(typeof(key)=="EnumItem" and key.EnumType==Enum.KeyCode,"Expected Enum.KeyCode")
        self.Keybind=key; keyText.Text=key.Name.." to toggle"
    end
    function w:SetTheme(name)
        assert(themes[name],"Unknown theme: "..tostring(name))
        self.Theme=copy(themes[name]); self:RefreshTheme()
    end
    function w:RefreshTheme()
        local alive={}
        for _,b in ipairs(self._bindings) do
            if b[1].Parent then b[1][b[2]]=self.Theme[b[3]]; table.insert(alive,b) end
        end
        self._bindings=alive
        for _,c in ipairs(self.Controls) do if c.Refresh then c:Refresh() end end
        for _,t in ipairs(self.Tabs) do t:Refresh() end
    end
    function w:SetAccent(color) self.Theme.Accent=color; self.Theme.AccentText=accentInk(color); self:RefreshTheme() end
    w:Connect(mini.Activated,function() w:SetMinimized() end)
    w:Connect(close.Activated,function() w:Toggle(false) end)
    local logoDragging,logoStart,logoPosition,logoTouch,logoMoved
    local suppressLogoClickUntil=0
    w:Connect(restore.Activated,function()
        if logoMoved or os.clock()<suppressLogoClickUntil then return end
        w:Toggle(true)
    end)
    w:Connect(restore.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            logoDragging=true; logoTouch=input; logoStart=input.Position
            logoPosition=restore.Position; logoMoved=false
        end
    end)
    w:Connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(input)
        if not logoDragging or (input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input~=logoTouch) then return end
        local delta=input.Position-logoStart
        if delta.X*delta.X+delta.Y*delta.Y>=36 then logoMoved=true end
        if logoMoved then
            local view=gui.AbsoluteSize
            w:ClampRestore(logoPosition.X.Scale*view.X+logoPosition.X.Offset+delta.X,logoPosition.Y.Scale*view.Y+logoPosition.Y.Offset+delta.Y)
        end
    end)
    w:Connect(UIS.InputEnded,function(input)
        if input==logoTouch or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            if logoDragging and logoMoved then suppressLogoClickUntil=os.clock()+.25 end
            logoDragging=false
        end
    end)
    local dragging,dragStart,windowStart,dragTouch
    w:Connect(drag.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging=true; dragStart=input.Position; windowStart=root.Position; dragTouch=input; w:ClosePopup()
        end
    end)
    w:Connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input==dragTouch) then
            local d=input.Position-dragStart
            local view=gui.AbsoluteSize; local actual=root.AbsoluteSize
            local x=windowStart.X.Scale*view.X+windowStart.X.Offset+d.X
            local y=windowStart.Y.Scale*view.Y+windowStart.Y.Offset+d.Y
            root.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(clamp(x,actual.X/2,math.max(actual.X/2,view.X-actual.X/2)),clamp(y,actual.Y/2,math.max(actual.Y/2,view.Y-actual.Y/2)))
        end
    end)
    w:Connect(UIS.InputEnded,function(input)
        if input==dragTouch or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging=false end
    end)
    w:Connect(UIS.InputBegan,function(input,processed)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and w.Keybind~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and not processed and not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() and not w._capturing and input.KeyCode==w.Keybind then w:Toggle() end
    end)
    function w:Filter(query)
        query=string.lower(query or "")
        for _,item in ipairs(self._searchables) do
            item.Frame.Visible=(query=="" or string.find(item.Search,query,1,true)~=nil)
        end
    end
    w:Connect(search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),function() w:Filter(search.Text) end)
    function w:Notify(o)
        if self.Destroyed then return end
        o=options(o)
        local toastWidth=math.max(120,math.min(tonumber(config.NotificationWidth) or 230,gui.AbsoluteSize.X-24))
        local holder=self:Frame(gui,{Name="Notification",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,1),Position=UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-12),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(toastWidth,52),ZIndex=300,ClipsDescendants=true},"Sidebar")
        corner(holder,8); self:Stroke(holder)
        self:Icon(holder,o.Icon or "bell",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(14,14),ZIndex=301},"Accent")
        self:Text(holder,o.Title or "Senior Hub",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(32,6),Size=UDim2.new(1,-42,0,16),TextSize=13,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,Font=Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium,ZIndex=301})
        self:Text(holder,o.Content or "",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(32,24),Size=UDim2.new(1,-42,0,22),TextSize=10,TextWrapped=true,TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=301},"Muted")
        local bar=self:Frame(holder,{Position=UDim2.new(0,8,1,-2),Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,1),ZIndex=301},"Accent")
        table.insert(self._toasts,holder)
        local function reflow()
            for i,f in ipairs(self._toasts) do tween(f,{Position=UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-12-(#self._toasts-i)*60)}) end
        end
        if #self._toasts>3 then local old=table.remove(self._toasts,1); old:Destroy() end
        reflow()
        local duration=math.max(.5,tonumber(o.Duration) or 4)
        TweenService:Create(bar,TweenInfo.new(duration,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,1)}):Play()
        task.delay(duration,function()
            if self.Destroyed then return end
            local i=table.find(self._toasts,holder)
            if i then table.remove(self._toasts,i); holder:Destroy(); reflow() end
        end)
    end
    function w:ExportConfig()
        local data={Version=1,Values={}}
        for flag,control in pairs(self.Flags) do
            local value=control:Get()
            if typeof(value)=="Color3" then value={Type="Color3",Hex=value:ToHex()} end
            if typeof(value)=="EnumItem" then value={Type="KeyCode",Name=value.Name} end
            data.Values[flag]=value
        end
        return HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
    end
    function w:ImportConfig(json,fireCallbacks)
        local ok,data=pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode,HttpService,json)
        if not ok or type(data)~="table" or type(data.Values)~="table" or data.Version~=1 then return false,"Invalid SeniorUI config" end
        -- Validate every flag before applying: a malformed value never partially imports.
        local pending={}
        for flag,value in pairs(data.Values) do
            local control=self.Flags[flag]
            if control then
                if type(value)=="table" and value.Type=="Color3" then
                    if type(value.Hex)~="string" or not value.Hex:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return false,"Invalid color: "..flag end
                    value=Color3.fromHex(value.Hex)
                elseif type(value)=="table" and value.Type=="KeyCode" then
                    local valid,key=pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[value.Name] end)
                    if not valid or not key then return false,"Invalid key: "..flag end
                    value=key
                end
                local valid,result=pcall(control.Normalize,control,value)
                if not valid then return false,"Invalid value for "..flag..": "..tostring(result) end
                table.insert(pending,{control,result})
            end
        end
        for _,entry in ipairs(pending) do entry[1]:Set(entry[2],fireCallbacks~=true) end
        return true
    end
    function w:CreateTab(tabConfig)
        tabConfig=options(tabConfig)
        local tab={Window=self,Title=tabConfig.Title or "Tab",Sections={}}
        local navButton=self:Button(nav,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(44,42),LayoutOrder=#self.Tabs+1},"Sidebar"); corner(navButton,9)
        local marker=self:Frame(navButton,{Name="ActiveIndicator",Visible=false,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,13),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(2,16)},"Accent"); corner(marker,2)
        local navIcon=self:Icon(navButton,tabConfig.Icon or "layers",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,11),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(20,20)})
        local page=make("ScrollingFrame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=3,CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,Visible=false,ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y},pages)
        self:Bind(page,"ScrollBarImageColor3","Stroke")
        local columns={}
        for i=1,2 do
            columns[i]=self:Frame(page,{Position=UDim2.new((i-1)*.5,i==2 and 7 or 0,0,0),Size=UDim2.new(.5,-9,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y})
            list(columns[i],14); pad(columns[i],0,1)
        end
        tab.Page=page; tab.Button=navButton; tab.Indicator=marker
        function tab:Refresh()
            local active=w.ActiveTab==self
            marker.Visible=active
            navButton.BackgroundColor3=active and w.Theme.Hover or w.Theme.Sidebar
            navIcon.ImageColor3=active and w.Theme.Accent or w.Theme.Muted
        end
        function tab:Select()
            if w.ActiveTab then w.ActiveTab.Page.Visible=false end
            w.ActiveTab=self; page.Visible=true
            breadcrumb.Text=self.Title.."  /  "..(tabConfig.Description or "Customize your experience")
            search.Text=""; w:Filter(""); w:ClosePopup()
            for _,t in ipairs(w.Tabs) do t:Refresh() end
        end
        self:Connect(navButton.Activated,function() tab:Select() end)
        local tooltip=self:Text(navButton,tab.Title,{Visible=false,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,30),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(44,12),TextSize=7,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center})
        tab.Tooltip=tooltip
        self:Connect(navButton.MouseEnter,function() tooltip.Visible=true end)
        self:Connect(navButton.MouseLeave,function() tooltip.Visible=false end)
        function tab:CreateSection(sectionConfig)
            sectionConfig=options(sectionConfig)
            local s={Window=w,Tab=self}
            local col=sectionConfig.Side=="Right" and 2 or 1
            local panel=w:Frame(columns[col],{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,LayoutOrder=#self.Sections+1},"Panel")
            corner(panel,9); w:Stroke(panel); pad(panel,12,10); list(panel,3)
            local title=w:Text(panel,sectionConfig.Title or "Section",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,26),Font=Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium,TextSize=13})
            local line=w:Frame(panel,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,1)},"Stroke")
            s.Panel=panel; s.Heading=title
            local order=2
            function s:Row(o,height)
                order=order+1
                local row=w:Frame(panel,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,height or 30),LayoutOrder=order})
                local label=w:Text(row,o.Title or "Control",{Size=UDim2.new(1,-62,0,28),TextSize=13,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd})
                if o.Description then
                    row.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,(height or 30)+16)
                    w:Text(row,o.Description,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,26),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,14),TextSize=10,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd},"Muted")
                end
                table.insert(w._searchables,{Frame=row,Search=string.lower((o.Title or "").." "..(o.Description or ""))})
                return row,label
            end
            function s:Register(o,row,default,normalize,render)
                local control={Frame=row,Value=copy(default),Default=copy(default),Normalize=normalize}
                function control:Get() return copy(self.Value) end
                function control:Set(value,silent)
                    self.Value=copy(self:Normalize(value))
                    self:Refresh()
                    if not silent then w:Call(o.Callback,self:Get()) end
                    return self
                end
                function control:Refresh() render(self.Value) end
                function control:SetVisible(visible) row.Visible=visible end
                function control:Reset(silent) return self:Set(self.Default,silent) end
                if o.Flag then assert(not w.Flags[o.Flag],"Duplicate flag: "..o.Flag); w.Flags[o.Flag]=control end
                table.insert(w.Controls,control); control:Set(default,true)
                return control
            end
            function s:AddToggle(o)
                o=options(o)
                local row,label=self:Row(o)
                local hit=w:Button(row,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)})
                local track=w:Frame(row,{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,0,0,7),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(29,15)},"Hover"); corner(track,10)
                local knob=w:Frame(track,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(3,3),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(9,9)},"Muted"); corner(knob,8)
                local control=self:Register(o,row,o.Default==true,function(_,v) assert(type(v)=="boolean","Expected boolean"); return v end,function(v)
                    track.BackgroundColor3=v and w.Theme.Accent:Lerp(w.Theme.Panel,.70) or w.Theme.Hover
                    tween(knob,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(v and 17 or 3,3),BackgroundColor3=v and w.Theme.Accent or w.Theme.Muted})
                end)
                w:Connect(hit.Activated,function() control:Set(not control.Value) end)
                return control
            end
            function s:AddButton(o)
                o=options(o)
                local row,label=self:Row(o,34); label.Visible=false
                local b=w:Button(row,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,29)},o.Primary and "Accent" or "Hover"); corner(b,6)
                local text=w:Text(b,o.Title or "Button",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),TextSize=13,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center},o.Primary and "AccentText" or "Text")
                if o.Icon then w:Icon(b,o.Icon,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,7),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(15,15)},o.Primary and "AccentText" or "Muted") end
                w:Connect(b.Activated,function() w:Call(o.Callback) end)
                return {Frame=row,SetText=function(_,v) text.Text=tostring(v) end,SetVisible=function(_,v) row.Visible=v end}
            end
            function s:AddLabel(o)
                o=options(o)
                local row,label=self:Row(o,o.Height or 42)
                label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); label.TextWrapped=true; label.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
                label.TextSize=o.TextSize or 13
                return {Frame=row,SetText=function(_,v) label.Text=tostring(v) end,SetVisible=function(_,v) row.Visible=v end}
            end
            function s:AddSlider(o)
                o=options(o)
                if o.Range then return self:AddRangeSlider(o) end
                local lo,hi=tonumber(o.Min) or 0,tonumber(o.Max) or 100
                assert(hi>lo,"Slider Max must exceed Min")
                local step=tonumber(o.Step) or 1; assert(step>0,"Step must be positive")
                local row,label=self:Row(o,45)
                label.Size=UDim2.new(.58,0,0,22)
                local valueText=w:Text(row,"",{Position=UDim2.fromScale(.58,0),Size=UDim2.new(.42,0,0,22),TextSize=12,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right},"Muted")
                local track=w:Frame(row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,30),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,5)},"Hover"); corner(track,4)
                local fill=w:Frame(track,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1)},"Accent"); corner(fill,4)
                local knob=w:Frame(track,{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(9,9)},"Text"); corner(knob,6)
                local hit=w:Button(row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,22),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,21)})
                local control=self:Register(o,row,o.Default or lo,function(_,v)
                    assert(type(v)=="number" and v==v and math.abs(v)~=math.huge,"Expected finite number")
                    return clamp(lo+round(v-lo,step),lo,hi)
                end,function(v)
                    local alpha=(v-lo)/(hi-lo)
                    fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(alpha,1); knob.Position=UDim2.fromScale(alpha,.5)
                    valueText.Text=string.format("%.4g",v)..(o.Suffix or "")
                end)
                local sliding,touch=false,nil
                local function update(x) control:Set(lo+clamp((x-track.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(1,track.AbsoluteSize.X),0,1)*(hi-lo)) end
                w:Connect(hit.InputBegan,function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then sliding=true; touch=input; update(input.Position.X) end
                end)
                w:Connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(input)
                    if sliding and (input==touch or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then update(input.Position.X) end
                end)
                w:Connect(UIS.InputEnded,function(input) if input==touch or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then sliding=false end end)
                return control
            end
            function s:AddRangeSlider(o)
                o=options(o)
                local lo,hi=tonumber(o.Min) or 0,tonumber(o.Max) or 100
                local step=tonumber(o.Step) or 1
                local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)~=math.huge end
                assert(finite(lo) and finite(hi) and hi>lo,"Range Max must exceed finite Min")
                assert(finite(step) and step>0,"Range Step must be positive and finite")
                local function snap(v) return clamp(lo+round(v-lo,step),lo,hi) end
                local row,label=self:Row(o,49)
                label.Size=UDim2.new(.51,0,0,24)
                local valueText=w:Text(row,"",{Name="RangeValue",Position=UDim2.fromScale(.51,0),Size=UDim2.new(.49,0,0,24),TextSize=12,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right},"Muted")
                local track=w:Frame(row,{Name="RangeTrack",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,33),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,5)},"Hover"); corner(track,4)
                local fill=w:Frame(track,{Name="RangeFill",Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1)},"Accent"); corner(fill,4)
                local knobs={}
                for i=1,2 do
                    knobs[i]=w:Frame(track,{Name=i==1 and "LowerHandle" or "UpperHandle",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(11,11)},"Text")
                    corner(knobs[i],6)
                end
                local hit=w:Button(row,{Name="RangeInput",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,24),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,25)})
                local control=self:Register(o,row,o.Default or {lo,hi},function(_,v)
                    assert(type(v)=="table" and finite(v[1]) and finite(v[2]),"Expected {minimum, maximum} numeric pair")
                    local a,b=snap(v[1]),snap(v[2])
                    if a>b then a,b=b,a end
                    return {a,b}
                end,function(v)
                    local a,b=(v[1]-lo)/(hi-lo),(v[2]-lo)/(hi-lo)
                    fill.Position=UDim2.fromScale(a,0); fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(b-a,1)
                    knobs[1].Position=UDim2.fromScale(a,.5); knobs[2].Position=UDim2.fromScale(b,.5)
                    local suffix=o.Suffix or ""
                    valueText.Text=string.format("%.4g",v[1])..suffix.." â "..string.format("%.4g",v[2])..suffix
                end)
                local active,touch,lastHandle
                local function at(x)
                    return snap(lo+clamp((x-track.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(1,track.AbsoluteSize.X),0,1)*(hi-lo))
                end
                local function update(x)
                    local pair=control:Get(); local nextValue=at(x)
                    if active==1 then pair[1]=math.min(nextValue,pair[2]) else pair[2]=math.max(nextValue,pair[1]) end
                    if pair[1]~=control.Value[1] or pair[2]~=control.Value[2] then control:Set(pair) end
                end
                w:Connect(hit.InputBegan,function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                    local v=at(input.Position.X); local pair=control.Value
                    if pair[1]==pair[2] then
                        active=v<pair[1] and 1 or (v>pair[2] and 2 or (lastHandle==1 and 2 or 1))
                    else active=math.abs(v-pair[1])<=math.abs(v-pair[2]) and 1 or 2 end
                    touch=input; lastHandle=active; update(input.Position.X)
                end)
                w:Connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(input)
                    if active and (input==touch or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then update(input.Position.X) end
                end)
                w:Connect(UIS.InputEnded,function(input)
                    if input==touch or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then active=nil; touch=nil end
                end)
                return control
            end
            function s:AddDropdown(o)
                o=options(o)
                local values=copy(o.Options or {}); assert(#values>0,"Dropdown requires options")
                local row,label=self:Row(o,59)
                local b=w:Button(row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,27),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,27)},"Hover"); corner(b,6)
                local selected=w:Text(b,"",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(9,0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-35,1,0),TextSize=12,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd})
                w:Icon(b,"chevron-down",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,7),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(13,13)})
                local default=o.Default
                if default==nil then default=o.Multi and {} or values[1] end
                local control=self:Register(o,row,default,function(_,v)
                    if o.Multi then
                        assert(type(v)=="table","Expected array")
                        local result={}
                        for _,entry in ipairs(v) do assert(table.find(values,entry),"Unknown option"); if not table.find(result,entry) then table.insert(result,entry) end end
                        return result
                    end
                    assert(table.find(values,v),"Unknown option: "..tostring(v)); return v
                end,function(v) selected.Text=o.Multi and (#v>0 and table.concat(v,", ") or "None selected") or tostring(v) end)
                w:Connect(b.Activated,function()
                    local f=w:PopupAt(b,math.max(190,b.AbsoluteSize.X),math.min(#values,7)*29+12)
                    local scroll=make("ScrollingFrame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6),Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-12),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=2,AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),ZIndex=202},f)
                    list(scroll,1)
                    for _,entry in ipairs(values) do
                        local item=w:Button(scroll,{Size=UDim2.new(1,-3,0,28),ZIndex=203},"Panel"); corner(item,5)
                        w:Text(item,tostring(entry),{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(9,0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-35,1,0),TextSize=13,ZIndex=204})
                        local check=w:Icon(item,"check",{Position=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,7),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(14,14),ZIndex=204,Visible=o.Multi and table.find(control.Value,entry)~=nil or control.Value==entry},"Accent")
                        w:Connect(item.Activated,function()
                            if o.Multi then
                                local new=control:Get(); local i=table.find(new,entry)
                                if i then table.remove(new,i) else table.insert(new,entry) end
                                control:Set(new); check.Visible=not i
                            else control:Set(entry); w:ClosePopup() end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
                function control:SetOptions(newOptions)
                    assert(type(newOptions)=="table" and #newOptions>0,"Expected non-empty options")
                    values=copy(newOptions)
                    if o.Multi then
                        local valid={}; for _,v in ipairs(self.Value) do if table.find(values,v) then table.insert(valid,v) end end
                        self:Set(valid,true)
                    elseif not table.find(values,self.Value) then self:Set(values[1],true) end
                    w:ClosePopup()
                end
                return control
            end
            function s:AddTextbox(o)
                o=options(o)
                local row,label=self:Row(o,59)
                local box=w:Bind(make("TextBox",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,27),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,27),Text="",PlaceholderText=o.Placeholder or "Enter text...",ClearTextOnFocus=false,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Font=Enum.Font.BuilderSans,TextSize=12,BorderSizePixel=0},row),"BackgroundColor3","Hover")
                w:Bind(box,"TextColor3","Text"); w:Bind(box,"PlaceholderColor3","Muted"); corner(box,6); pad(box,8,0)
                local control=self:Register(o,row,o.Default or "",function(_,v)
                    assert(type(v)=="string","Expected string"); return v:sub(1,o.MaxLength or 2048)
                end,function(v) if box.Text~=v then box.Text=v end end)
                w:Connect(box.FocusLost,function(enter) control:Set(box.Text); w:Call(o.OnEnter,control.Value,enter) end)
                if o.Live then w:Connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),function() control:Set(box.Text) end) end
                return control
            end
            function s:AddKeybind(o)
                o=options(o)
                local row,label=self:Row(o)
                local b=w:Button(row,{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.fromScale(1,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(96,26)},"Hover"); corner(b,6)
                label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-101,0,28)
                local text=w:Text(b,"",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),TextSize=12,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center})
                local control=self:Register(o,row,o.Default or Enum.KeyCode.F,function(_,v)
                    assert(typeof(v)=="EnumItem" and v.EnumType==Enum.KeyCode,"Expected Enum.KeyCode"); return v
                end,function(v) text.Text=v==Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and "None" or v.Name end)
                w:Connect(b.Activated,function()
                    if w._capturing then return end
                    w._capturing=control; text.Text="Press a key..."
                end)
                w:Connect(UIS.InputBegan,function(input,processed)
                    if w._capturing==control then
                        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                            if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
                                control:Set(Enum.KeyCode.Unknown)
                            elseif input.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.Escape then control:Set(input.KeyCode) else control:Refresh() end
                            -- Keep capture active until other listeners process this input.
                            task.defer(function() if w._capturing==control then w._capturing=false end end)
                        end
                    elseif input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and control.Value~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and not processed and not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() and not w._capturing and input.KeyCode==control.Value then w:Call(o.OnPressed,control.Value) end
                end)
                return control
            end
            function s:AddColorPicker(o)
                o=options(o)
                local row,label=self:Row(o)
                local swatch=w:Button(row,{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,0,0,5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(27,18)},"Accent"); corner(swatch,6); w:Stroke(swatch)
                local control=self:Register(o,row,o.Default or w.Theme.Accent,function(_,v) assert(typeof(v)=="Color3","Expected Color3"); return v end,function(v) swatch.BackgroundColor3=v end)
                w:Connect(swatch.Activated,function()
                    local f=w:PopupAt(swatch,230,242)
                    w:Text(f,o.Title or "Color",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,8),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(200,20),TextSize=13,ZIndex=204})
                    local hue,sat,val=control.Value:ToHSV()
                    local sv=w:Frame(f,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,35),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(178,151),ZIndex=203})
                    sv.BackgroundTransparency=0
                    corner(sv,3)
                    local white=w:Frame(sv,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=204},"White")
                    make("UIGradient",{Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})},white)
                    local black=w:Frame(sv,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=205},"Black")
                    make("UIGradient",{Rotation=90,Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})},black)
                    local cursor=w:Frame(sv,{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),ZIndex=207}); corner(cursor,8)
                    make("UIStroke",{Color=C(255,255,255),Thickness=1.5},cursor)
                    local hit=w:Button(sv,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=208})
                    local huebar=w:Frame(f,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(201,35),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(15,151),ZIndex=203},"White"); corner(huebar,3)
                    local points={}; for i=0,6 do table.insert(points,ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i/6,Color3.fromHSV(i/6,1,1))) end
                    make("UIGradient",{Rotation=90,Color=ColorSequence.new(points)},huebar)
                    local hueCursor=w:Frame(huebar,{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,hue),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,3),ZIndex=205},"Text")
                    local hueHit=w:Button(huebar,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=208})
                    local hex=w:Bind(make("TextBox",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,199),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(204,29),Text="#"..control.Value:ToHex(),Font=Enum.Font.Code,TextSize=14,ClearTextOnFocus=false,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=204},f),"BackgroundColor3","Hover")
                    corner(hex,6); w:Bind(hex,"TextColor3","Text")
                    local function redraw()
                        sv.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromHSV(hue,1,1)
                        cursor.Position=UDim2.fromScale(sat,1-val); hueCursor.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,hue)
                        control:Set(Color3.fromHSV(hue,sat,val)); hex.Text="#"..control.Value:ToHex()
                    end
                    local mode,touch
                    local function update(input)
                        if mode=="sv" then
                            sat=clamp((input.Position.X-sv.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(1,sv.AbsoluteSize.X),0,1)
                            val=1-clamp((input.Position.Y-sv.AbsolutePosition.Y)/math.max(1,sv.AbsoluteSize.Y),0,1)
                        else hue=clamp((input.Position.Y-huebar.AbsolutePosition.Y)/math.max(1,huebar.AbsoluteSize.Y),0,1) end
                        redraw()
                    end
                    local function begin(input,m)
                        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then mode=m; touch=input; update(input) end
                    end
                    w:Connect(hit.InputBegan,function(i) begin(i,"sv") end)
                    w:Connect(hueHit.InputBegan,function(i) begin(i,"hue") end)
                    table.insert(w._popConnections,UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i) if mode and (i==touch or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then update(i) end end))
                    table.insert(w._popConnections,UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i==touch or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then mode=nil end end))
                    w:Connect(hex.FocusLost,function()
                        local value=hex.Text:gsub("#","")
                        if value:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then hue,sat,val=Color3.fromHex(value):ToHSV(); redraw() else hex.Text="#"..control.Value:ToHex() end
                    end)
                    sv.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromHSV(hue,1,1); cursor.Position=UDim2.fromScale(sat,1-val)
                end)
                return control
            end
            function s:AddDivider(o)
                o=options(o)
                local row,label=self:Row(o,12); label.Visible=false
                return w:Frame(row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,5),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,1)},"Stroke")
            end
            table.insert(self.Sections,s)
            return s
        end
        table.insert(self.Tabs,tab)
        if #self.Tabs==1 then tab:Select() else tab:Refresh() end
        return tab
    end
    return w
end
Library.Themes=themes
Library.Icons=Icons
return Library

end)()

local FovSettings = {}

function FovSettings.initialize(configuration)
	local settings = configuration.sheriff.fov
	if type(settings) ~= "table" then
		settings = {}
		configuration.sheriff.fov = settings
	end

	settings.on = settings.on or false
	settings.size = settings.size or 220
	settings.r, settings.g, settings.b = settings.r or 120, settings.g or 220, settings.b or 255
	settings.lr, settings.lg, settings.lb = settings.lr or 255, settings.lg or 255, settings.lb or 255
	settings.style, settings.tr, settings.fa = settings.style or "Glow", settings.tr or 20, settings.fa or 12
	if settings.fill == nil then settings.fill = false end
	if settings.anim == nil then settings.anim = true end

	return settings
end

function FovSettings.changeSize(context, value)
	context.settings.size = context.environment.math.floor(value)
end

function FovSettings.changeFillStrength(context, value)
	context.settings.fa = context.environment.math.floor(value)
	context.redraw()
end

function FovSettings.changeTransparency(context, value)
	context.settings.tr = context.environment.math.floor(value)
	context.redraw()

	if not context.picker or not context.picker.SetAlpha then
		return
	end

	context.picker.SetAlpha(1 - context.settings.tr / 100)
end

function FovSettings.changeAnimation(context, isEnabled)
	context.settings.anim = not not isEnabled
end

function FovSettings.changeLockColor(context, color)
	local floor = context.environment.math.floor
	context.settings.lr = floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5)
	context.settings.lg = floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5)
	context.settings.lb = floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)

	context.redraw()
end

function FovSettings.changeFilled(context, isEnabled)
	local isFilled = true

	if not isEnabled then
		isFilled = context.disabledValue()
	end

	context.settings.fill = isFilled
	context.redraw()
end

function FovSettings.formatSize(environment, value)
	local numeric = environment.tonumber(value)

	if numeric and numeric >= 1500 then
		return "в€ћ"
	end

	numeric = environment.tonumber(value) or 0
	return environment.tostring(environment.math.floor(numeric))
end

function FovSettings.changeColor(context, selection)
	local color = selection.color
	local floor = context.environment.math.floor
	context.settings.r = floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5)
	context.settings.g = floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5)
	context.settings.b = floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)

	FovSettings._syncTransparency(context, selection.alpha)
	context.redraw()
end

function FovSettings._syncTransparency(context, alpha)
	if not context.environment.tonumber(alpha) then
		return
	end

	local transparency = context.environment.math.floor((1 - alpha) * 100 + 0.5)

	if transparency == context.settings.tr then
		return
	end

	context.settings.tr = transparency

	if not context.slider or not context.slider.Set then
		return
	end

	context.slider.Set(transparency)
end

local Layout = {}

function Layout.resolve(routes, section, subsection, item)
	local route = routes[section .. "/" .. tostring(item)]

	if not route and subsection then
		route = routes[section .. "/" .. tostring(subsection) .. ":*"]
	end

	if not route then
		route = routes[section .. "/*"]
	end

	if not route then
		return section, nil
	end

	if route[2] ~= "@sub" then
		subsection = route[2]
	end

	return route[1], subsection, route[3]
end

function Layout.createTabs(window, layout)
	local tabs = {}
	local currentGroup

	for _, definition in ipairs(layout.FeatureLayout.tabs) do
		if definition.group ~= currentGroup then
			currentGroup = definition.group
			window:TabGroup(currentGroup)
		end

		local tab = window:Tab({Name = definition.name, Icon = definition.icon, Desc = definition.desc, Badge = definition.badge})
		tabs[definition.name] = tab

		if definition.subs then
			tab:SubTabs(definition.subs)
		end
	end

	return tabs
end

local SeniorWindow = {}

function SeniorWindow.create(environment, nova, layout, parent)
    local w = SeniorLibrary:CreateWindow({Title="Senior Hub • Sources", Subtitle="Murder Mystery 2",
        Logo=92834373646022, Theme="Midnight", Accent=Color3.fromRGB(239,77,105),
        Width=760, Height=510, Keybind=Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, Parent=parent})
    w.Groups = {}
    w.Key = w.Keybind
    w.Scale = w.Root:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
    w.OverlayScale = w.Scale.Scale
    w.IsTouch = environment.game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled
    w.State = {data={}}
    w.State.get = function(key, default)
        local value=w.State.data[key]
        if value==nil then return default end
        return value
    end
    w.State.save = function() end
    w.UserScale=1
    w.AutoFit=true
    local oldDestroy=w.Destroy
    function w:Destroy(external)
        if self.Destroyed then return end
        if self.OnDestroy then
            local callback=self.OnDestroy; self.OnDestroy=nil
            local ok,err=pcall(callback)
            if not ok then warn("[Senior Hub • Sources] "..tostring(err)) end
        end
        oldDestroy(self,external)
    end
    local oldKey=w.SetKeybind
    local keyListeners={}
    function w:SetKeybind(key)
        oldKey(self,key); self.Key=self.Keybind
        self.State.data.menuKey=self.Key.Name
        for _,fn in ipairs(keyListeners) do pcall(fn,self.Key) end
    end
    w.SetKey=w.SetKeybind
    function w:OnKeyChanged(fn) table.insert(keyListeners,fn) end
    function w:OnScreenScale(fn)
        fn(self.Scale.Scale)
        return self:Connect(self.Scale:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"),function()
            self.OverlayScale=self.Scale.Scale; fn(self.Scale.Scale)
        end)
    end
    function w:PointerOverUI()
        if not self.Visible then return false end
        local p=environment.game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetMouseLocation()
        local a,b=self.Root.AbsolutePosition,self.Root.AbsoluteSize
        return p.X>=a.X and p.Y>=a.Y and p.X<=a.X+b.X and p.Y<=a.Y+b.Y
    end
    function w:TabGroup() end
    function w:SelectTab(tab) tab:Select() end
    function w:SetKeybindList(value) self.State.data.keybindList=value==true end
    local hud=self
    local badge=w:Text(w.Gui,"Senior Hub • Sources",{Name="SeniorStatus",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16),
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(320,24),TextSize=13,Visible=false})
    function w:SetWatermark(value) badge.Visible=value==true end
    function w:SetWatermarkTitle(title) badge.Text="Senior Hub • Sources"..(title and "  |  "..tostring(title) or "") end
    function w:SetScale(value)
        self.UserScale=math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 1,.6,1.4)
        local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport=camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
        self.Scale.Scale=math.min(self.UserScale,math.max(.1,(viewport.X-24)/760),math.max(.1,(viewport.Y-48)/510))
        self.State.data.scale=self.UserScale
    end
    function w:SyncAppearance() end
    function w:IsHalloween() return false end
    local oldAccent=w.SetAccent
    function w:SetAccent(color)
        oldAccent(self,color)
        self.State.data.accent=color:ToHex()
        if nova.Theme and nova.Theme.set then nova.Theme.set("Accent",color) end
    end
    function w:SetBase(name)
        local aliases={Dark="Midnight",Black="Obsidian"}
        self:SetTheme(aliases[name] or name)
        self.State.data.base=aliases[name] or name
    end
    function w:SetPanelColor(color)
        self.Theme.Panel=color; self:RefreshTheme(); self.State.data.panel=color:ToHex()
    end
    local oldNotify=w.Notify
    function w:Notify(options)
        options=options or {}
        return oldNotify(self,{Title=options.Title or "Senior Hub • Sources",Content=options.Content or options.Text or options.Description or "",
            Duration=options.Duration,Icon=options.Icon or (options.Kind=="error" and "info" or "circle-check")})
    end

    local function decorate(control)
        control.Row=control.Frame
        control.Base=control.Frame
        control.Title=control.Frame and control.Frame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
        if control.Set then
            function control:SetSilent(value) return self:Set(value,true) end
        end
        function control:SetParentHidden(hidden) self:SetVisible(not hidden) end
        if not control.SetText and control.Title then
            function control:SetText(text) self.Title.Text=tostring(text) end
        end
        return control
    end
    local function adaptSection(s,tab,config)
        local panel=s.Panel
        s.Card,s.Wrap,s.Content,s.Head=panel,panel,panel,panel
        s.TitleLabel=s.Heading
        s.Side=config.Side=="Right" and 2 or 1
        s.Page={Load={0,0}}
        s.Sub=config.Sub
        s.Hidden=false
        function s:SetVisible(value)
            self.Hidden=value==false
            self.Card.Visible=not self.Hidden and (not self.Sub or self.Sub==tab.CurrentSub)
        end
        function s:Container(options)
            options=options or {}
            local row=self:Row({Title=""},0)
            row:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel"):Destroy()
            row.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            local list=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
            list.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            list.Padding=UDim.new(0,options.Gap or 8)
            list.Parent=row
            return row
        end
        function s:Input(options)
            return decorate(self:AddTextbox({Title=options.Text,Default=tostring(options.Default or ""),
                Placeholder=options.Placeholder,Live=options.Live,MaxLength=options.MaxLength or 512,Callback=options.Callback}))
        end
        function s:Label(options)
            local c=decorate(self:AddLabel({Title=options.Text or "",Height=options.Height or 44}))
            c.Label=c.Title
            return c
        end
        function s:Button(options)
            local confirmedAt=0
            local c
            c=decorate(self:AddButton({Title=options.Text,Icon=options.Icon,Primary=options.Primary,Callback=function()
                if options.DoubleClick or options.Confirm then
                    local now=os.clock()
                    if now-confirmedAt>3 then
                        confirmedAt=now
                        c:SetText(options.ConfirmText or "Click again to confirm")
                        task.delay(3,function() if c.Frame.Parent then c:SetText(options.Text) end end)
                        return
                    end
                    confirmedAt=0; c:SetText(options.Text)
                end
                if options.Callback then options.Callback() end
            end}))
            return c
        end
        function s:Toggle(options)
            local c=decorate(self:AddToggle({Title=options.Text,Description=options.Desc,Default=options.Default==true,Callback=options.Callback}))
            if options.Bind then
                c.Bind=decorate(self:AddKeybind({Title=options.Text.." key",Default=options.Keybind or Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
                    Callback=options.OnBind,OnPressed=function() if options.KeyToggle then c:Set(not c:Get()) end end}))
            end
            return c
        end
        function s:Slider(options)
            return decorate(self:AddSlider({Title=options.Text,Min=options.Min,Max=options.Max,Default=options.Default,
                Step=10^(-(options.Decimals or 0)),Suffix=options.Suffix,Callback=function(value)
                    if options.Callback then options.Callback(value) end
                    if options.Released then options.Released(value) end
                end}))
        end
        function s:Keybind(options)
            return decorate(self:AddKeybind({Title=options.Text,Default=options.Default or Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
                Callback=options.Callback,OnPressed=options.OnPressed}))
        end
        function s:Colorpicker(options)
            local alpha=tonumber(options.DefaultAlpha) or 1
            local c=decorate(self:AddColorPicker({Title=options.Text,Default=options.Default,Callback=function(color)
                if options.Callback then options.Callback(color,alpha) end
            end}))
            local colorSet=c.Set
            function c:Set(color,opacity,silent)
                if type(opacity)=="number" then alpha=math.clamp(opacity,0,1) end
                return colorSet(self,color,silent==true or opacity==true)
            end
            function c:SetSilent(color,opacity) return self:Set(color,opacity,true) end
            if options.Alpha then
                local a=self:AddSlider({Title=options.Text.." opacity",Min=0,Max=1,Step=.01,Default=alpha,Callback=function(value)
                    alpha=value; if options.Callback then options.Callback(c:Get(),alpha) end
                end})
                local baseVisible=c.SetVisible
                function c:SetVisible(value) baseVisible(self,value); a:SetVisible(value) end
            end
            return c
        end
        function s:Dropdown(options)
            local labels,byLabel,byCode={},{},{}
            local function map(values)
                labels,byLabel,byCode={},{},{}
                for _,item in ipairs(values or {}) do
                    local code=type(item)=="table" and item.code or item
                    local label=tostring(type(item)=="table" and (item.label or code) or item)
                    if byLabel[label]~=nil then label=label.." ("..tostring(code)..")" end
                    table.insert(labels,label); byLabel[label]=code; byCode[code]=label
                end
                if #labels==0 then labels={"—"} end
            end
            map(options.Options)
            local function encode(value)
                if not options.Multi then return byCode[value] or labels[1] end
                local result={}
                for k,v in pairs(type(value)=="table" and value or {}) do
                    local code=type(k)=="number" and v or (v and k or nil)
                    if byCode[code] then table.insert(result,byCode[code]) end
                end
                return result
            end
            local function decode(value)
                if not options.Multi then return byLabel[value] end
                local result={}
                for _,label in ipairs(value) do
                    local code=byLabel[label]; if code~=nil then result[code]=true end
                end
                return result
            end
            local native=self:AddDropdown({Title=options.Text,Multi=options.Multi,Options=labels,Default=encode(options.Default),Callback=function(value)
                if options.Callback then options.Callback(decode(value)) end
            end})
            local c=decorate({Frame=native.Frame})
            function c:Get() return decode(native:Get()) end
            function c:Set(value,silent) native:Set(encode(value),silent==true) end
            function c:SetSilent(value) self:Set(value,true) end
            function c:SetOptions(values)
                local selected=self:Get()
                map(values); native:SetOptions(labels); self:Set(selected,true)
            end
            function c:SetVisible(value) native:SetVisible(value) end
            return c
        end
        s:SetVisible(true)
        return s
    end
    local tabsByName={}
    function w:Tab(options)
        if tabsByName[options.Name] then return tabsByName[options.Name] end
        local tabIcons={
            Sheriff="crosshair", Murderer="swords", Player="user-round", Visuals="eye",
            Farm="coins", Teleport="map-pin", Troll="party-popper", Animations="person-standing",
            Music="music", Mobile="smartphone", Settings="settings", Server="server",
        }
        local tab=self:CreateTab({Title=options.Name,Icon=tabIcons[options.Name] or options.Icon or "layers",Description=options.Desc})
        tabsByName[options.Name]=tab
        tab.Label=tab.Tooltip
        tab.Name=options.Name
        tab.SubButtons={}
        tab.Load={0,0}
        function tab:SelectSub(key)
            self.CurrentSub=key
            for _,s in ipairs(self.Sections) do
                if s.Card then s.Card.Visible=not s.Hidden and (not s.Sub or s.Sub==key) end
            end
            if self.SubSelector then self.SubSelector:Set(self.SubLabels[key] or key,true) end
        end
        function tab:SubTabs(definitions)
            self.SubDefs=definitions; self.SubLabels={}
            local labels,keys={},{}
            for _,definition in ipairs(definitions) do
                self.SubButtons[definition.key]=true
                local label=definition.label or definition.key
                self.SubLabels[definition.key]=label; keys[label]=definition.key
                table.insert(labels,label)
            end
            self.CurrentSub=definitions[1] and definitions[1].key
            if #labels>0 then
                local nav=self:CreateSection({Title="Navigation",Side="Left"})
                nav.Panel.LayoutOrder=-10000
                self.SubSelector=nav:AddDropdown({Title="Page",Options=labels,Default=labels[1],Callback=function(label) self:SelectSub(keys[label]) end})
            end
        end
        function tab:Section(config)
            config=config or {}
            local side=config.Side
            if not side then side=self.Load[1]<=self.Load[2] and "Left" or "Right" end
            local column=side=="Right" and 2 or 1
            self.Load[column]+=1
            local section=self:CreateSection({Title=config.Title,Side=side})
            return adaptSection(section,self,{Side=side,Sub=config.Sub})
        end
        return tab
    end
    -- Addon panels retain their utility services without creating another window.
    table.insert(nova.Windows,w)
    local tabs=Layout.createTabs(w,layout)
    w:Notify({Title="Senior Hub • Sources",Content="RightShift untuk membuka atau menyembunyikan menu.",Icon="sparkles",Duration=5})
    return w,tabs
end

local SeniorFeatures = {}

local function emptySeniorFeatures()
	local tab = {_curSub = nil, _subSelectFn = nil}
		local function noop() end
		local handle = {Set = noop, Get = noop, Refresh = noop}
		tab.SubTabs, tab.Sub, tab.Group, tab.Header, tab.Container, tab.Button, tab.Grid, tab.Invite = noop, noop, noop, noop, noop, noop, noop, noop
		tab.Columns = function() return {Left = nil, Right = nil} end
		tab.Section = function() return {Capture = noop, SetOpen = noop, IsOpen = noop, SetToggle = noop} end
		tab.Note = function() return {Text = ""} end
		tab.Toggle, tab.Keybind, tab.ToggleKey, tab.Slider, tab.Dropdown, tab.Colorpicker = function() return handle end, function() return handle end,
			function() return handle end, function() return handle end, function() return handle end, function() return handle end
		tab.IconList = function() return {Rebuild = noop, Selected = {}} end
		tab.ShopList = function() return {Selected = {}, RefreshSelection = noop, Refresh = noop} end
		tab.PlayerList = function() return {GetSelectedId = noop, GetSelected = noop, SetSelected = noop, Refresh = noop} end
	return tab
end

function SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, name, icon, context)
	local tab = {_curSub = nil, _subSelectFn = nil}
	local window, nova, translator, layout = hub.W, hub.Renderer, context.translator, context.layout
	if hub.dead or not window then return emptySeniorFeatures() end

	local function findTab(target)
		if hub.FeatureTabs[target] then return hub.FeatureTabs[target] end
		local ok, native = environment.pcall(function() return window:Tab({Name = target, Icon = context.icons[icon] or icon or "circle"}) end)
		if not ok or not native then return nil end
		environment.pcall(function() translator.bind(native.Label, target) end)
		hub.FeatureTabs[target] = native
		return native
	end
	local native = findTab(layout.resolveFeature(name, nil, "*"))
	if not native then return emptySeniorFeatures() end
	tab.Native = native
	hub.tabs[name] = {name = name, tab = native}
	table.insert(hub._tabList, hub.tabs[name])
	local section, capture, columns, side, subDefinitions = nil, nil, false, 1, {}
	local columnsBySub = {}
	local function translate(text) return translator.tr(text) end
	local function bind(object, text, extra)
		if environment.typeof(object) ~= "Instance" or text == nil then return end
		environment.pcall(function() translator.bind(object, text, extra) end)
	end
	local function configKey(text)
		local key = tostring(name) .. "/" .. tostring(tab._curSub or "-") .. "/" .. tostring(text)
		local count = (hub._ckeys[key] or 0) + 1
		hub._ckeys[key] = count
		return count > 1 and key .. "#" .. count or key
	end
	local function saved(key, kind)
		if not key then return nil end
		local value = context.config[key]
		if type(value) == kind or kind == "string" and type(value) == "number" then return value end
		return nil
	end
	local function store(key, value) if key then context.config[key] = value end end
	local function sideFor(requested)
		if columns then
			if requested == "Right" then side = 2 end
			if requested == "Left" then side = 1 end
			return side == 2 and "Right" or "Left"
		end
		if requested == "Right" or requested == "Left" then return requested end
		return nil
	end
	local function targetFor(title)
		local sub = #subDefinitions > 0 and (tab._navSub or subDefinitions[1].key) or tab._navSub
		local target, targetSub, targetTitle = layout.resolveFeature(name, sub, tostring(title or "General"))
		local destination = findTab(target) or native
		if targetSub and (not destination.SubButtons or not destination.SubButtons[targetSub]) then targetSub = nil end
		targetSub = targetSub or (destination.SubDefs and destination.SubDefs[1].key)
		return target, targetSub, targetTitle or tostring(title or "General"), destination
	end
	local function createSection(title, requestedSide, pinned)
		if capture then capture.detached = true end
		local target, sub, mapped, destination = targetFor(title)
		local result
		environment.pcall(function()
			result = destination:Section({Title = translate(mapped), Icon = layout.SectionIcons[mapped], Sub = sub, Side = pinned and sideFor(requestedSide) or nil})
		end)
		if not result then return nil end
		bind(result.TitleLabel, mapped)
		result._pulseCount, result._pulseText, result._pulseTarget = 0, mapped, target .. "/" .. tostring(sub)
		section = result
		return result
	end
	local function currentSection()
		if not section then createSection("General") end
		return section
	end
	local function indent()
		if capture and capture.drawer then return 0 end
		return capture and not capture.detached and (capture.depth or 1) or 0
	end
	local function track(handle)
		if handle == nil then return nil end
		if section then section._pulseCount = (section._pulseCount or 0) + 1 end
		if capture and not capture.detached then table.insert(capture, handle) end
		return handle
	end
	local function setVisible(item, visible)
		if type(item) == "table" then
			if item.SetParentHidden then environment.pcall(item.SetParentHidden, item, not visible) end
			return
		end
		if environment.typeof(item) == "Instance" and item:IsA("GuiObject") then item.Visible = visible end
	end
	local function setChildrenVisible(children, visible)
		if type(children) ~= "table" then return end
		for _, child in ipairs(children) do
			setVisible(child, visible)
			if type(child) == "table" and child._pulseKids then
				local childVisible = true
				if child._pulseState then
					local ok, value = environment.pcall(child._pulseState)
					childVisible = ok and value == true
				end
				setChildrenVisible(child._pulseKids, visible and childVisible)
			end
		end
	end
	local function collect(callback, drawer)
		if not callback then return nil end
		local previous, oldSection, oldSide = capture, section, side
		if drawer then
			capture, section = {depth = 0, drawer = true}, drawer
			section._pulseCount = 0
		else
			capture = {depth = previous and not previous.detached and (previous.depth or 1) + 1 or 1}
		end
		local ok, message = environment.pcall(callback)
		if not ok then environment.warn("[SeniorHubSources] " .. tostring(message)) end
		local children = capture
		capture, section, side = previous, oldSection, oldSide
		if not drawer then children.detached = nil end
		return children
	end
	local function bindHandle(handle, text)
		if type(handle) == "table" and handle.Title then bind(handle.Title, text) end
	end
	local function matchesTarget(candidate, title)
		local currentSub = #subDefinitions > 0 and (tab._navSub or subDefinitions[1].key) or tab._navSub
		local target, sub = layout.resolveFeature(name, currentSub, title)
		local destination = hub.FeatureTabs[target] or native
		if sub and (not destination.SubButtons or not destination.SubButtons[sub]) then sub = nil end
		sub = sub or (destination.SubDefs and destination.SubDefs[1].key)
		return candidate._pulseTarget == target .. "/" .. tostring(sub)
	end
	local function reuse(candidate, title)
		if type(candidate) ~= "table" or not candidate.TitleLabel then return false end
		if not matchesTarget(candidate, title) then
			environment.pcall(function()
				local sections = candidate.Tab.Sections
				for index = #sections, 1, -1 do if sections[index] == candidate then table.remove(sections, index) end end
				candidate.Page.Load[candidate.Side] = math.max(0, candidate.Page.Load[candidate.Side] - 1)
				local object = candidate.Wrap or candidate.Card
				object:Destroy()
			end)
			if section == candidate then section = nil end
			return false
		end
		environment.pcall(function()
			local image = layout.SectionIcons[title]
			if image and candidate.HeadIcon then nova.Icons.apply(candidate.HeadIcon, image) end
		end)
		candidate._pulseText = title
		environment.pcall(function()
			for index = #translator.reg, 1, -1 do if translator.reg[index].inst == candidate.TitleLabel then table.remove(translator.reg, index) end end
		end)
		bind(candidate.TitleLabel, title)
		return true
	end

	function tab.SubTabs(_, definitions)
		subDefinitions = {}
		for _, definition in ipairs(definitions or {}) do
			if type(definition) == "table" and definition.key then table.insert(subDefinitions, definition) end
		end
		tab._subSelectFn = function(sub)
			local target, targetSub = layout.resolveFeature(name, sub, "*")
			local destination = hub.FeatureTabs[target]
			if not destination then return end
			environment.pcall(function() window:SelectTab(destination) end)
			if targetSub then environment.pcall(function() destination:SelectSub(targetSub) end) end
		end
	end
	function tab.LastSection() return section end
	function tab.Sub(_, sub)
		tab._curSub, tab._navSub = sub, sub
		section, side = nil, 1
		columns = columnsBySub[sub] == true
	end
	function tab.Columns()
		columns = true
		columnsBySub[tab._navSub or "-"] = true
		side = 1
		return {Left = nil, Right = nil}
	end
	function tab.Group(_, options)
		options = options or {}
		local requestedSide, title = options.Side or "Left", tostring(options.Title or options.Text or "Section")
		local key = tostring(tab._navSub or "root") .. "/" .. requestedSide .. "/" .. title
		tab._groups = tab._groups or {}
		local group = tab._groups[key]
		if group then
			section, side, tab._curSub = group.section, requestedSide == "Right" and 2 or 1, title
			return group.handle
		end
		createSection(title, requestedSide, options.Pin == true)
		tab._curSub = title
		local current = section
		local handle = {card = current and current.Card or nil, header = current and current.Head or nil,
			title = current and current.TitleLabel or nil, elements = current and current.Content or nil,
			SetCollapsed = function(collapsed) if current then current:SetVisible(not collapsed) end end}
		tab._groups[key] = {section = current, handle = handle}
		return handle
	end
	function tab.Header(_, title, requestedSide)
		local canReuse = section and not capture and (section._pulseCount or 0) == 0
			and (requestedSide == nil or sideFor(requestedSide) == nil or (sideFor(requestedSide) == "Right") == (section.Side == 2))
		if canReuse and reuse(section, title) then return section.Card end
		local result = createSection(title, requestedSide)
		return result and result.Card or nil
	end
	function tab.Note(_, options)
		options = options or {}
		local current = currentSection()
		if not current then return {Text = ""} end
		local handle
		environment.pcall(function() handle = current:Label({Text = translate(options.Text or ""), Indent = indent()}) end)
		if not handle then return {Text = ""} end
		bind(handle.Label, options.Text)
		track(handle)
		return handle.Label
	end
	function tab.Container()
		local current = currentSection()
		local result = current and current.Container and current:Container({Gap = 8, Pad = 2}) or nil
		track(result)
		return result
	end
	function tab.Toggle(_, options)
		local key = not options.NoSave and configKey(options.Text) or nil
		if key then context.defaults[key] = options.Default and true or false end
		local previous = saved(key, "boolean")
		if previous ~= nil then options.Default = previous end
		local value = options.Default and true or false
		local current, nativeHandle = currentSection(), nil
		environment.pcall(function()
			nativeHandle = current:Toggle({Text = translate(options.Text), Desc = options.Desc and translate(options.Desc) or nil, Default = value,
				Tooltip = options.Tooltip and translate(options.Tooltip) or nil, Indent = indent(), Locked = options.Locked, Drawer = options.Settings ~= nil,
				Callback = function(nextValue)
					value = nextValue and true or false
					store(key, value)
					if options.Callback then options.Callback(value) end
				end})
		end)
		bindHandle(nativeHandle, options.Text)
		if nativeHandle and nativeHandle.DescLabel and options.Desc then bind(nativeHandle.DescLabel, options.Desc) end
		track(nativeHandle)
		local handle = {Row = nativeHandle and nativeHandle.Row or nil}
		handle.Get = function() return value end
		handle.Set = function(nextValue)
			value = nextValue and true or false
			store(key, value)
			if nativeHandle then environment.pcall(nativeHandle.SetSilent, nativeHandle, value) end
			if options.Callback then options.Callback(value) end
		end
		handle.SetSilent = function(nextValue)
			value = nextValue and true or false
			store(key, value)
			if nativeHandle then environment.pcall(nativeHandle.SetSilent, nativeHandle, value) end
		end
		if key then context.setters[key] = function(nextValue) handle.Set(nextValue and true or false) end end
		if options.Settings then
			if nativeHandle and nativeHandle.Drawer then
				collect(options.Settings, nativeHandle.Drawer)
			else
				local children = collect(options.Settings)
				setChildrenVisible(children, value)
			end
		end
		environment.pcall(function() if options.Callback then options.Callback(value) end end)
		return handle
	end
