		table.insert(boxes, {id = id, name = tostring(description and (description.ItemName or description.Name) or id),
			price = item.Price, order = tonumber(item.LayoutOrder) or 999})
	end
	if #boxes == 0 then
		for id, item in database.Shop and database.Shop.Weapons or {} do
			local description = database.MysteryBox and database.MysteryBox[id]
			if not description or type(item) ~= "table" or type(item.Price) ~= "table" or item.Price.Robux ~= nil then continue end
			table.insert(boxes, {id = id, name = tostring(description.ItemName or description.Name or id), price = item.Price, order = 999})
		end
	end
	table.sort(boxes, function(first, second)
		if first.order ~= second.order then return first.order < second.order end
		return first.name < second.name
	end)
	return boxes
end

function BoxFarm.balance(context, state, currency)
	local _, profile = BoxFarm.data(context, state)
	if not profile then return 0 end
	local value
	pcall(function() value = profile[currency] end)
	if type(value) ~= "number" then pcall(function() value = profile.Materials.Owned[currency] end) end
	if type(value) ~= "number" then pcall(function() value = profile.Weapons.Owned[currency] end) end
	return tonumber(value) or 0
end

function BoxFarm.currency(context, state, box)
	if not box then return nil end
	local selected = context.configuration.boxes.cur
	if selected ~= "Auto" then
		local price = box.price[selected]
		if price and BoxFarm.balance(context, state, selected) >= price then return selected, price end
		return nil, price, selected
	end
	local first
	for _, currency in BOX_CURRENCIES do
		local price = box.price[currency]
		if not price then continue end
		first = first or currency
		if BoxFarm.balance(context, state, currency) >= price then return currency, price end
	end
	return nil, nil, first
end

function BoxFarm.find(context, state, id)
	for _, box in BoxFarm.catalog(context, state) do if box.id == id then return box end end
	return nil
end

function BoxFarm.open(context, state)
	local settings = context.configuration.boxes
	local box = BoxFarm.find(context, state, settings.id)
	if not box then state.state = "Off"; return false end
	local currency = BoxFarm.currency(context, state, box)
	if not currency then state.state = "Not enough"; return false end
	state.state = "Opening"
	local remotes = context.storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local shop = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Shop")
	local open = shop and shop:FindFirstChild("OpenCrate")
	if not open then state.state = "Off"; return false end
	local ok, reward = pcall(function() return open:InvokeServer(box.id, "MysteryBox", currency) end)
	if not ok or not reward then state.state = "Not enough"; return false end
	state.opened, state.last = state.opened + 1, reward
	local database = BoxFarm.data(context, state)
	local weapon = database and database.Weapons and database.Weapons[reward]
	state.lastName, state.lastRarity = tostring(weapon and (weapon.ItemName or weapon.Name) or reward), weapon and weapon.Rarity or nil
	if settings.anim then
		pcall(function()
			local controller = shop:FindFirstChild("BoxController")
			if controller then controller:Fire({{MysteryBoxId = box.id, RewardedItemId = reward}}) end
		end)
	end
	local rare = {Legendary = true, Godly = true, Ancient = true, Unique = true, Vintage = true, Chroma = true}
	if state.lastRarity and rare[tostring(state.lastRarity)] then
		pcall(function()
			local nova = context.environment.getgenv().__seniorWindow
			if nova and nova.Notify then nova:Notify({Title = tostring(state.lastRarity) .. ": " .. state.lastName, Kind = "success"}) end
		end)
	end
	return true
end

function BoxFarm.install(context)
	local settings, environment = context.configuration, context.environment
	settings.boxes = type(settings.boxes) == "table" and settings.boxes or {}
	if type(settings.boxes.id) ~= "string" then settings.boxes.id = "Halloween2026Box" end
	if type(settings.boxes.cur) ~= "string" then settings.boxes.cur = "Auto" end
	if tonumber(settings.boxes.delay) == nil then settings.boxes.delay = 1 end
	local state = {on = false, opened = 0, state = "Off", busy = false}
	state.openOnce = function() return BoxFarm.open(context, state) end
	environment.getgenv().__pulseBoxes = state
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		while context.isAlive() do
			if state.on and not state.busy then
				state.busy = true
				local ok, opened = pcall(BoxFarm.open, context, state)
				state.busy = false
				environment.task.wait(ok and opened and math.clamp(tonumber(settings.boxes.delay) or 1, 0.5, 10) or 2.5)
				continue
			end
			if not state.on and not state.busy then state.state = "Off" end
			environment.task.wait(0.3)
		end
	end)
	return state, function() state.on = false; environment.getgenv().__pulseBoxUI = nil end
end

function BoxFarm.controls(context, state)
	local section, settings, environment = context.section, context.configuration.boxes, context.environment
	section:Sub("Boxes")
	section:Header("Stats")
	local grid, cards = section:Grid({Columns = 2, Height = 66, MinWidth = 150}), {}
	for _, options in {{"Opened", "Accent", "package-open"}, {"Status", "Success", "activity"},
		{"Balance", "Warning", "wallet"}, {"Last Drop", "Info", "gift"}} do
		pcall(function() cards[options[1]] = grid:Card({Name = context.translation.tr(options[1]), Value = "-", Tone = options[2], Icon = options[3]}) end)
	end
	section:Header("Boxes")
	local options = {}
	for _, box in BoxFarm.catalog(context, state) do table.insert(options, {code = box.id, label = box.name}) end
	if #options == 0 then options[1] = {code = "Halloween2026Box", label = "Halloween Box '26"} end
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Box", Options = options, Default = settings.id, Callback = function(value) if type(value) == "string" then settings.id = value end end})
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Pay With", Options = {{code = "Auto", label = "Auto"}, {code = "Candies2026", label = "Candies"},
		{code = "HalloweenKey2026", label = "Halloween Key"}, {code = "Coins", label = "Coins"},
		{code = "Key", label = "Key"}, {code = "Gems", label = "Gems"}}, Default = settings.cur,
		Callback = function(value) if type(value) == "string" then settings.cur = value end end})
	section:Slider({Text = "Open Delay", Min = 0.5, Max = 5, Default = math.clamp(tonumber(settings.delay) or 1, 0.5, 5), Decimals = 1, Suffix = " s",
		Callback = function(value) settings.delay = value end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Show Animation", Default = settings.anim == true, Callback = function(value) settings.anim = not not value end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Auto Open", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.on = not not value end})
	section:Button({Text = "Open Once", Callback = function()
		if state.busy then return end
		environment.task.spawn(function() state.busy = true; pcall(BoxFarm.open, context, state); state.busy = false end)
	end})
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		while context.isAlive() do
			environment.task.wait(0.5)
			pcall(function()
				local box = BoxFarm.find(context, state, settings.id)
				local currency, _, fallback = BoxFarm.currency(context, state, box)
				currency = currency or fallback
				local balance = currency and tostring(math.floor(BoxFarm.balance(context, state, currency))) .. " "
					.. context.translation.tr(BOX_LABELS[currency] or currency) or "-"
				local values = {Opened = tostring(state.opened), Status = context.translation.tr(state.state), Balance = balance, ["Last Drop"] = state.lastName}
				for name, card in cards do if card and values[name] then card:Set(values[name]) end end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

local FlingFeature = {}

function FlingFeature.installTool(context)
	local environment, player = context.environment, context.player
	local enabled, respawn = false, nil
	local function remove()
		for _, container in {player:FindFirstChild("Backpack"), player.Character} do
			if not container then continue end
			for _, tool in container:GetChildren() do
				if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name == "Jerk Off R15" then tool:Destroy() end
			end
		end
	end
	local function create()
		if not enabled then return end
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") or player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 5)
		if not backpack then return end
		remove()
		local tool = environment.Instance.new("Tool")
		tool.Name, tool.RequiresHandle = "Jerk Off R15", false
		local animation
		context.connect(tool.Equipped, function()
			local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid then return end
			local asset = environment.Instance.new("Animation")
			asset.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://698251653"
			animation = humanoid:LoadAnimation(asset)
			animation.Looped = false
			animation:Play()
			animation.TimePosition = 0.58
			animation:AdjustSpeed(0.4)
			environment.task.spawn(function()
				while animation and animation.IsPlaying do
					if animation.TimePosition >= 0.63 then animation.TimePosition = 0.58 end
					environment.task.wait()
				end
			end)
		end)
		context.connect(tool.Unequipped, function()
			if animation then animation:Stop(); animation = nil end
		end)
		tool.Parent = backpack
	end
	local function setEnabled(value)
		enabled = value
		if enabled then
			create()
			respawn = respawn or context.connect(player.CharacterAdded, function()
				environment.task.wait(0.5)
				create()
			end)
			return
		end
		if respawn then respawn:Disconnect(); respawn = nil end
		remove()
	end
	context.section:Toggle({Text = "Jerk Off Tool (R15)", Default = false, Callback = setEnabled})
	return function() setEnabled(false) end
end

function FlingFeature.down(context, state, target, duration, options)
	options = options or {}
	if state.busy then return false, "busy" end
	if not target or not target.Parent then return false, "no-target" end
	local targetHumanoid = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not targetHumanoid or not targetRoot or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then return false, "dead" end
	local character = context.player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false, "me" end
	local environment, workspace, run = context.environment, context.workspace, context.runService
	local vector, frame, globals = environment.Vector3, environment.CFrame, environment.getgenv()
	local now = environment.os.clock
	state.busy = true
	duration = tonumber(duration) or 0.8
	globals.__pulseManualFling, globals.__pulseTouchFlinging = true, true
	globals.__pulseInvisPause = now() + duration + 1.5
	if state.fpdh == nil then state.fpdh = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight end
	local home, camera = options.home or root.CFrame, workspace.CurrentCamera
	local subject, seated, platform = camera and camera.CameraSubject, true, false
	pcall(function() seated = humanoid:GetStateEnabled(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated) end)
	pcall(function() platform = humanoid.PlatformStand end)
	pcall(function() workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0 / 0 end)
	pcall(function() humanoid:SetStateEnabled(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false) end)
	if options.cam ~= false then pcall(function() if camera then camera.CameraSubject = targetHumanoid end end) end
	local parts = {}
	pcall(function()
		for _, part in target:GetDescendants() do if part:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, {part, part.CanCollide}) end end
	end)
	local function disableCollision()
		for _, entry in parts do
			local part = entry[1]
			if part.Parent and part.CanCollide then pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end) end
		end
	end
	disableCollision()
	local downward, startY = tonumber(rawget(globals, "__pulseFlingDownV")) or 120000, targetRoot.Position.Y
	local aim = rawget(globals, "__pulseAimX")
	local pingOk, ping = pcall(function() return context.player:GetNetworkPing() end)
	local lead = tonumber(rawget(globals, "__pulseFlingLead")) or math.clamp((aim and tonumber(aim.L) or 0.16)
		+ (pingOk and tonumber(ping) or 0.08) * 2 + 0.05, 0.15, 0.6)
	local speeds = {1.4, 0.5, 2.3, 0.9}
	local moveOk, moving = pcall(function() return targetHumanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude * targetHumanoid.WalkSpeed end)
	local velocity, spoofCount = targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity, 0
	if velocity.Magnitude > 1500 then velocity, spoofCount = vector.zero, 1 end
	local initialSpeed = vector.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
	if moveOk and moving > 2 or initialSpeed > 3 or spoofCount > 0 then duration = math.max(duration, 1.2) end
	local targetPlayer = context.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
	local userId = targetPlayer and targetPlayer.UserId
	state.leadMem = state.leadMem or {}
	local multiplier = 1
	local positions, candidates, offsets = {}, {}, {0, 0.3, 0.55, 0.8}
	local started, frames, done, result, minimumVelocity, minimumY = now(), 0, false, "timeout", 0, startY
	local lastTarget, teleported, lastSelf, firstPosition, filtered, filteredAt = targetRoot.Position, false, nil, nil, nil, nil
	local predicted, predictedAt, teleportAt = nil, nil, nil
	local params = environment.RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character, target}
	pcall(function() params.RespectCanCollide = true end)
	local stepped = run.Stepped:Connect(function()
		if done then return end
		pcall(function() root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = vector.zero, vector.zero end)
		disableCollision()
	end)
	local heartbeat = run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if done then return end
		frames += 1
		if not target.Parent or not targetRoot.Parent or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then done, result = true, "gone"; return end
		if not root.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then done, result = true, "me"; return end
		local position, actualVelocity, time = targetRoot.Position, targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity, now()
		if actualVelocity.Magnitude > 1500 then spoofCount += 1 end
		local observed
		if (position - lastTarget).Magnitude > 60 then
			if spoofCount == 0 then done, result = true, "tp-target"; return end
			teleportAt = teleportAt or time
			if time - teleportAt > 0.35 then
				if position.Y < startY - 25 then done, result = true, "down"; return end
				if (position - lastTarget).Magnitude > 300 then done, result = true, "tp-target"; return end
				lastTarget, teleportAt, observed = position, nil, position
			end
			if not observed then observed = lastTarget end
		end
		if not observed then lastTarget, teleportAt, observed = position, nil, position end
		table.insert(positions, {time, observed})
		while #positions > 2 and time - positions[1][1] > 0.25 do table.remove(positions, 1) end
		local measured = actualVelocity
		if spoofCount > 0 then
			local elapsed = time - positions[1][1]
			measured = elapsed > 0.06 and (observed - positions[1][2]) / elapsed or vector.zero
		end
		if lastSelf and (root.Position - lastSelf).Magnitude > 30 then done, result, teleported = true, "tp-me", true; return end
		minimumVelocity, minimumY = math.min(minimumVelocity, measured.Y), math.min(minimumY, observed.Y)
		if observed.Y < startY - 25 then done, result = true, "down"; return end
		if measured.Y < -250 then done, result = true, "falling"; return end
		if now() - started > duration then done = true; return end
		if firstPosition and (root.Position - firstPosition).Magnitude > 60 and (observed - firstPosition).Magnitude > 55 then done, result = true, "far"; return end
		local horizontal = vector.new(measured.X, 0, measured.Z)
		local movementOk, direction, speed = pcall(function() return targetHumanoid.MoveDirection, targetHumanoid.WalkSpeed end)
		local movement = horizontal
		if movementOk and direction and direction.Magnitude > 0.1 then
			local desired = vector.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z).Unit * math.clamp(tonumber(speed) or 16, 0, 60)
			movement = horizontal.Magnitude > 40 and horizontal or desired:Lerp(horizontal, 0.25)
		end
		local movingNow = movement.Magnitude > 2
		local timeNow, targetPosition, height = now(), observed, nil
		if movingNow then
			if filtered and filteredAt then
				local limit = 30 * math.clamp(timeNow - filteredAt, 1 / 240, 0.05)
				local delta = vector.new(observed.X - filtered.X, 0, observed.Z - filtered.Z)
				if delta.Magnitude > limit then delta = delta.Unit * limit end
				filtered = vector.new(filtered.X + delta.X, observed.Y, filtered.Z + delta.Z)
			end
			if not filtered then filtered = observed end
			local cycle = frames % 8
			multiplier = offsets[cycle % 4 + 1]
			local delta = movement * multiplier
			if delta.Magnitude > 25 then delta = delta.Unit * 25 end
			if delta.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				local ok, hit = pcall(function() return workspace:Raycast(filtered, delta, params) end)
				if ok and hit then delta = delta.Unit * math.max(0, hit.Distance - 1.5) end
			end
			table.insert(candidates, {timeNow, multiplier})
			while #candidates > 0 and timeNow - candidates[1][1] > 1.2 do table.remove(candidates, 1) end
			targetPosition, height = filtered + delta, cycle < 4 and 1.4 or -0.6
		end
		if not movingNow then height = speeds[frames % #speeds + 1] end
		pcall(function()
			humanoid.PlatformStand = true
			local position = vector.new(targetPosition.X, math.max(targetPosition.Y, startY - 3) + height, targetPosition.Z)
			if predicted and predictedAt and not movingNow then
				local limit = (tonumber(rawget(globals, "__pulseFlingMaxSpeed")) or 20) * math.clamp(timeNow - predictedAt, 1 / 240, 0.05)
				local delta = vector.new(position.X - predicted.X, 0, position.Z - predicted.Z)
				if delta.Magnitude > limit then
					local reduced = predicted + delta.Unit * limit
					position = vector.new(reduced.X, position.Y, reduced.Z)
				end
			end
			local grounded = workspace:Raycast(position, vector.new(0, -15, 0), params) ~= nil
			if not grounded then
				local fallback = vector.new(lastTarget.X, math.max(lastTarget.Y, startY - 3) + height, lastTarget.Z)
				if (movingNow or not predicted or vector.new(fallback.X - predicted.X, 0, fallback.Z - predicted.Z).Magnitude
					<= (tonumber(rawget(globals, "__pulseFlingMaxSpeed")) or 20) * 0.05)
					and workspace:Raycast(fallback, vector.new(0, -15, 0), params) then position, grounded = fallback, true end
			end
			if movingNow then
				local direction = movement.Unit
				root.CFrame = frame.lookAt(position, position + vector.new(-direction.Z, 0, direction.X))
			end
			if not movingNow then root.CFrame = frame.new(position) end
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = vector.zero
			if grounded and movingNow then
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vector.new(movement.X, -downward, movement.Z)
				local spin = tonumber(rawget(globals, "__pulseFlingSpin")) or 60000
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = vector.new(spin, spin, spin)
			end
			if grounded and not movingNow then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vector.new(0, -downward, 0) end
			if not grounded then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vector.zero end
			lastSelf, predicted, predictedAt, filteredAt = root.Position, position, timeNow, timeNow
			firstPosition = firstPosition or position
		end)
	end)
	while not done and now() - started < duration + 0.5 do run.Heartbeat:Wait() end
	done = true
	pcall(function() heartbeat:Disconnect() end)
	pcall(function() stepped:Disconnect() end)
	local function ground(position)
		local ok, hit = pcall(function()
			local filter = environment.RaycastParams.new()
			filter.FilterType, filter.FilterDescendantsInstances = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character, target}
			return workspace:Raycast(position + vector.new(0, 2, 0), vector.new(0, -90, 0), filter) ~= nil
		end)
		return ok and hit
	end
	local ok, position = pcall(function() return root.Position end)
	local restore = not teleported and not (ok and (position - home.Position).Magnitude > 35 and ground(position))
		and (ground(home.Position) or not (ok and ground(position)))
	local restoreAt, stable = now(), 0
	while restore and now() - restoreAt < 1.5 do
		if not root.Parent then break end
		pcall(function() root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, root.AssemblyAngularVelocity, root.CFrame = vector.zero, vector.zero, home end)
		run.Heartbeat:Wait()
		local valid, distance = pcall(function() return (root.Position - home.Position).Magnitude end)
		if valid and distance > 20 then break end
		stable = valid and distance < 3 and stable + 1 or 0
		if stable >= 3 then break end
	end
	pcall(function() root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = vector.zero, vector.zero end)
	pcall(function() humanoid.PlatformStand = platform end)
	pcall(function() if humanoid.Health > 0 then humanoid:ChangeState(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end end)
	pcall(function() humanoid:SetStateEnabled(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, seated) end)
	pcall(function() if camera and subject then camera.CameraSubject = subject end end)
	for _, entry in parts do
		if entry[1].Parent and entry[1].CanCollide ~= entry[2] then pcall(function() entry[1].CanCollide = entry[2] end) end
	end
	if state.fpdh ~= nil then
		local height = state.fpdh
		state.fpdh = nil
		pcall(function() workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = height end)
	end
	globals.__pulseInvisPause = now() + 0.2
	if userId and (result == "down" or result == "falling") and initialSpeed > 3 then
		local best, distance = nil, math.huge
		for index = #candidates, 1, -1 do
			local difference = math.abs(candidates[index][1] - (now() - lead))
			if difference < distance then best, distance = candidates[index][2], difference end
		end
		if best then state.leadMem[userId] = best end
	end
	globals.__pulseFlingLast = string.format("down res=%s frames=%d dy=%.1f vmin=%.0f V=%d", result, frames, minimumY - startY, minimumVelocity, downward)
	globals.__pulseFlingLog = type(globals.__pulseFlingLog) == "table" and globals.__pulseFlingLog or {}
	table.insert(globals.__pulseFlingLog, string.format("%s %s spd=%.0f lead=%.2f mult=%.2f mem=%s res=%s fr=%d t=%.2f dy=%.1f vmin=%.0f spoof=%d",
		environment.os.date("%H:%M:%S"), tostring(target.Name), initialSpeed, lead, multiplier, tostring(userId and state.leadMem[userId]),
		result, frames, now() - started, minimumY - startY, minimumVelocity, spoofCount))
	while #globals.__pulseFlingLog > 10 do table.remove(globals.__pulseFlingLog, 1) end
	globals.__pulseManualFling, globals.__pulseTouchFlinging, state.busy = false, false, false
	return result == "down" or result == "falling" or result == "gone", result
end

function FlingFeature.persist(context, state, player, options)
	options = type(options) == "table" and options or {}
	if not player or player == context.player or not player.Parent then return false, "bad" end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return false, "no-target" end
	state.token += 1
	local token, startY, duration, started = state.token, root.Position.Y, tonumber(options.time) or 10, context.environment.os.clock()
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local result, attempts, low = "timeout", 0, nil
	state.target = player
	local function validTarget()
		local current = player.Character
		local humanoid = current and current:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local currentRoot = current and current:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not player.Parent or not current or not humanoid or not currentRoot or humanoid.Health <= 0 or current ~= character then return nil, "gone" end
		local roles = context.roles()
		local role = roles and roles[player.Name]
		if type(role) == "table" and (role.Dead == true or role.Killed == true) then return nil, "dead" end
		if currentRoot.Position.Y < startY - 25 then
			low = low or environment.os.clock()
			if environment.os.clock() - low >= 0.25 then return nil, "down" end
		end
		if currentRoot.Position.Y >= startY - 25 then low = nil end
		return current
	end
	while environment.os.clock() - started < duration do
		if token ~= state.token then result = "cancel"; break end
		if not context.isAlive() then result = "unload"; break end
		if type(options.stop) == "function" then
			local ok, stop = pcall(options.stop)
			if ok and stop then result = "stop"; break end
		end
		local target, reason = validTarget()
		if not target then result = reason; break end
		local own = context.player.Character
		local humanoid = own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then result = "me"; break end
		if state.active or state.busy then environment.task.wait(0.05); continue end
		attempts, state.active, globals.__pulseManualFling = attempts + 1, true, true
		local ok, error = pcall(FlingFeature.down, context, state, target, tonumber(options.dur) or 0.8)
		if not ok then globals.__pulseFlingLast = "down err " .. tostring(error) end
		globals.__pulseManualFling, globals.__pulseTouchFlinging, state.active = false, false, false
		local finished = environment.os.clock()
		while environment.os.clock() - finished < 0.3 do
			environment.task.wait(0.05)
			if not validTarget() then break end
		end
	end
	if token == state.token then state.target = nil end
	globals.__pulseFlingLog = type(globals.__pulseFlingLog) == "table" and globals.__pulseFlingLog or {}
	table.insert(globals.__pulseFlingLog, string.format("%s persist %s tries=%d t=%.1f res=%s",
		environment.os.date("%H:%M:%S"), player.Name, attempts, environment.os.clock() - started, result))
	while #globals.__pulseFlingLog > 10 do table.remove(globals.__pulseFlingLog, 1) end
	return result == "gone" or result == "dead" or result == "down", result
end

function FlingFeature.player(context, state, player)
	if state.active or state.busy or not player or player == context.player or not player.Parent then return end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	state.active, context.environment.getgenv().__pulseManualFling = true, true
	context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		local ok, error = pcall(FlingFeature.down, context, state, character, 0.8)
		local globals = context.environment.getgenv()
		if not ok then globals.__pulseFlingLast = "down err " .. tostring(error) end
		globals.__pulseManualFling, globals.__pulseTouchFlinging, state.active = false, false, false
	end)
end

function FlingFeature.installTouch(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local enabled, busy, bound = false, false, nil
	local function bind(character)
		if not character or character == bound then return end
		bound = character
		for _, part in character:GetChildren() do
			if not part:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
			context.connect(part.Touched, function(hit)
				if not enabled or busy then return end
				local target = hit and hit:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
				local player = target and context.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
				local fling = rawget(environment.getgenv(), "__pulseFlingDown")
				if not player or player == context.player or type(fling) ~= "function" then return end
				busy = true
				environment.task.spawn(function()
					pcall(fling, target, 0.4, {cam = false})
					busy = false
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
	bind(context.player.Character)
	context.connect(context.player.CharacterAdded, function(character)
		environment.task.wait(0.4)
		bind(character)
	end)
	context.touchSection:Toggle({Text = "Touch Fling", Default = false, Callback = function(value) enabled = value end})
end

function FlingFeature.hump(context, state, target)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	if state.humping then
		state.humping = false
		return
	end

	local character = context.player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not humanoid or not root or not targetRoot or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

	state.humping = true
	globals.__pulseTouchFlinging, globals.__pulseManualFling, globals.__pulseFlingTargetChar = true, true, target

	local seated, animation = true, nil
	pcall(function() seated = humanoid:GetStateEnabled(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated) end)
	pcall(function() humanoid:SetStateEnabled(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false) end)

	pcall(function()
		local asset = environment.Instance.new("Animation")
		asset.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://698251653"
		animation = humanoid:LoadAnimation(asset)
		animation.Looped = false
		animation:Play()
		animation.TimePosition = 0.58
		animation:AdjustSpeed(0.5)
	end)

	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local started = environment.tick()

		while state.humping and state.humpEnabled and target.Parent and targetRoot.Parent and root.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 do
			if state.humpDuration > 0 and environment.tick() - started >= state.humpDuration then break end

			pcall(function()
				if animation and animation.IsPlaying and animation.TimePosition >= 0.63 then animation.TimePosition = 0.58 end

				local offset = 1.6 + 0.35 * math.sin(environment.tick() * 16)
				local position = (targetRoot.CFrame * environment.CFrame.new(0, 0, offset)).Position
				root.CFrame = environment.CFrame.new(position, targetRoot.Position)
			end)
			context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end

		if animation then pcall(function() animation:Stop(0.1) end) end
		pcall(function() humanoid:SetStateEnabled(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, seated) end)
		pcall(function() if humanoid.Health > 0 then humanoid:ChangeState(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end end)

		globals.__pulseTouchFlinging, globals.__pulseManualFling, globals.__pulseFlingTargetChar = false, false, nil
		state.humping = false
	end)
end

function FlingFeature.stopOrbit(state)
	state.orbitToken += 1
	state.orbitTarget = nil
end

function FlingFeature.orbit(context, state, target)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()

	state.orbitToken += 1
	state.orbitTarget = target
	local token = state.orbitToken

	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local character = context.player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not character or not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

		globals.__pulseTouchFlinging, globals.__pulseManualFling = true, true
		local home, height, seated = root.CFrame, context.workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight, true
		pcall(function() seated = humanoid:GetStateEnabled(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated) end)

		local velocity
		pcall(function()
			context.workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0 / 0
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
			velocity = environment.Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			velocity.Velocity = environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			velocity.MaxForce = environment.Vector3.new(9000000000, 9000000000, 9000000000)
			velocity:SetAttribute("PulseMine", true)
			velocity.Parent = root
		end)

		local angle = 0
		while token == state.orbitToken and state.orbitEnabled do
			local targetPart = target:FindFirstChild("Head") or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local targetHumanoid = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if not targetPart or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 or not root.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then break end

			angle += 0.5
			local center = targetPart.Position + environment.Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0)
			local position = center + environment.Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 1.1, 0, math.sin(angle) * 1.1)

			pcall(function()
				root.CFrame = environment.CFrame.new(position, center)
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = environment.Vector3.zero
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(0, -(tonumber(rawget(globals, "__pulseFlingDownV")) or 120000), 0)
			end)
			context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end

		pcall(function() if velocity then velocity:Destroy() end end)
		pcall(function() humanoid:SetStateEnabled(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, seated) end)

		for _ = 1, 6 do
			if not root.Parent then break end
			pcall(function()
				root.CFrame = home
				for _, part in character:GetChildren() do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.AssemblyLinearVelocity, part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = environment.Vector3.zero, environment.Vector3.zero end
				end
				if humanoid.Health > 0 then humanoid:ChangeState(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
			end)
			context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end

		pcall(function() context.workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = height end)
		globals.__pulseTouchFlinging, globals.__pulseManualFling = false, false
	end)
end

function FlingFeature.installClick(context)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local enabled, highlight, params, filtered = false, nil, nil, nil
	local state = {humpEnabled = false, humping = false, humpDuration = 0, orbitEnabled = false, orbitTarget = nil, orbitToken = 0}
	local function targetAt(x, y)
		local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return nil end
		local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(x, y)
		if not params then
			params = environment.RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		end
		if filtered ~= context.player.Character then
			filtered = context.player.Character
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {filtered}
		end
		local hit = context.workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 5000, params)
		local character = hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
		local player = character and context.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if player and player ~= context.player and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then return character end
		return nil
	end
	local function getHighlight()
		if highlight and highlight.Parent then return highlight end
		highlight = environment.Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name = "PulseClickFlingHL"
		highlight.DepthMode = environment.Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		highlight.FillColor = environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
		highlight.FillTransparency = 0.55
		highlight.OutlineColor = environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 110)
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
		pcall(function() highlight.Parent = context.coreGui end)
		if highlight.Parent ~= context.coreGui then pcall(function() highlight.Parent = context.workspace end) end
		return highlight
	end
	local function mark(character)
		local part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not part then return end
		local billboard = environment.Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		billboard.Name, billboard.Size, billboard.AlwaysOnTop, billboard.Adornee = "PulseFlingHit", environment.UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), true, part
		pcall(function() billboard.Parent = context.coreGui end)
		if billboard.Parent ~= context.coreGui then pcall(function() billboard.Parent = context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end) end
		pcall(function() globals.__pulseBBMirror.add(billboard) end)
		local circle = environment.Instance.new("Frame")
		circle.Size, circle.BackgroundColor3 = environment.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		circle.BackgroundTransparency, circle.BorderSizePixel, circle.Parent = 0.15, 0, billboard
		environment.Instance.new("UICorner", circle).CornerRadius = environment.UDim.new(1, 0)
		local stroke = environment.Instance.new("UIStroke", circle)
		stroke.Color, stroke.Thickness = environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 210), 2
		local easing = environment.TweenInfo.new(0.35, environment.Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, environment.Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		context.tweenService:Create(billboard, easing, {Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(130, 130)}):Play()
		context.tweenService:Create(circle, environment.TweenInfo.new(0.35), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		context.tweenService:Create(stroke, environment.TweenInfo.new(0.35), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		context.debris:AddItem(billboard, 0.45)
	end
	context.connect(context.runService.RenderStepped, function()
		if not (enabled or state.humpEnabled or state.orbitEnabled) or not context.inputService.MouseEnabled then
			if highlight then highlight.Adornee = nil end
			return
		end
		local position = context.inputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local character = targetAt(position.X, position.Y)
		local current = getHighlight()
		current.Adornee = character
		if character then current.FillTransparency = 0.42 + 0.32 * math.abs(0.5 - environment.tick() % 1) end
	end)
	context.connect(context.inputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
		if not (enabled or state.humpEnabled) or processed then return end
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		if kind ~= environment.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= environment.Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		local position = kind == environment.Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.Position or context.inputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local character = targetAt(position.X, position.Y)
		if not character then return end
		mark(character)
		if state.humpEnabled then FlingFeature.hump(context, state, character); return end
		environment.task.spawn(function()
			local fling = rawget(globals, "__pulseFlingChar")
			if type(fling) == "function" then pcall(fling, character, 0.9) end
		end)
	end)
	context.connect(context.inputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
		if not state.orbitEnabled or processed then return end
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		if kind ~= environment.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= environment.Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		local position = kind == environment.Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.Position or context.inputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local character = targetAt(position.X, position.Y)
		if not character or character == state.orbitTarget then FlingFeature.stopOrbit(state); return end
		FlingFeature.orbit(context, state, character)
	end)
	context.touchSection:Toggle({Text = "Click Fling", Default = false, Callback = function(value)
		enabled = value and true or false
		if not enabled and highlight then pcall(function() highlight.Adornee = nil end) end
	end})
	context.touchSection:Toggle({Text = "Click Hump", Default = false, Callback = function(value)
		state.humpEnabled = value and true or false
		if state.humpEnabled then return end
		state.humping = false
		if highlight then pcall(function() highlight.Adornee = nil end) end
	end, Settings = function()
		context.touchSection:Slider({Text = "Hump Duration (0 = hold)", Min = 0, Max = 30, Default = 0, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "s",
			Callback = function(value) state.humpDuration = tonumber(value) or 0 end})
	end})
	context.touchSection:Toggle({Text = "Orbit", Default = false, Callback = function(value)
		state.orbitEnabled = value and true or false
		if state.orbitEnabled then return end
		FlingFeature.stopOrbit(state)
		if highlight then pcall(function() highlight.Adornee = nil end) end
	end})
	return function()
		enabled, state.humpEnabled, state.humping, state.orbitEnabled = false, false, false, false
		FlingFeature.stopOrbit(state)
		if highlight then highlight:Destroy() end
	end
end

function FlingFeature.install(context)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local state = {busy = false, active = false, token = 0, target = nil}
	globals.__pulseFlingDown = function(target, duration, options) return FlingFeature.down(context, state, target, duration, options) end
	globals.__pulseFlingChar = function(target, duration)
		if not target then return end
		local fling = rawget(globals, "__pulseFlingDown")
		if type(fling) ~= "function" then return end
		local started = environment.os.clock()
		while globals.__pulseManualFling and environment.os.clock() - started < 3 do environment.task.wait(0.05) end
		pcall(fling, target, duration or 0.8)
	end
	globals.__pulseFlingPlayer = function(player) return FlingFeature.player(context, state, player) end
	globals.__pulseFlingPersist = function(player, options) return FlingFeature.persist(context, state, player, options) end
	globals.__pulseFlingCancel = function() state.token += 1 end
	FlingFeature.installTouch(context)
	local stopClick = FlingFeature.installClick(context)
	local section = context.section
	section:Header("Fling Players")
	section:PlayerList({ExcludeLocal = true, Momentary = true, ActionIcon = "zap", OnSelect = function(player)
		if state.target == player then state.token += 1; return end
		environment.task.spawn(FlingFeature.persist, context, state, player, {time = 10})
	end})
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local origins, characters, finished, attempts = {}, {}, {}, {}
		local round, roundAt = false, 0
		while context.isAlive() do
			local roles = context.roles()
			local active = false
			for _, role in roles do
				if type(role) ~= "table" or not role.Role then continue end
				local name = tostring(role.Role):lower()
				if name:find("murder") or name:find("sheriff") then active = true; break end
			end
			if active and not round then roundAt = environment.tick() end
			round = active
			local own = context.player.Character
			local humanoid = own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local ownRoot = own and own:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local canFling = context.configuration.autoFlingSheriff and active and humanoid and ownRoot and humanoid.Health > 0
				and environment.tick() - roundAt >= 2 and not state.active
			if canFling then
				for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
					local role = roles[player.Name]
					if player == context.player or type(role) ~= "table" or role.Dead == true or role.Killed == true
						or not role.Role or not tostring(role.Role):lower():find("sheriff") then continue end
					local character = player.Character
					local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not root then break end
					local id = player.UserId
					if characters[id] ~= character then characters[id], origins[id], finished[id], attempts[id] = character, root.Position, nil, 0 end
					if (root.Position - (origins[id] or root.Position)).Magnitude >= 5000 then finished[id] = true end
					if not finished[id] and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 60 then
						if (attempts[id] or 0) >= 3 then finished[id] = true end
						if not finished[id] then attempts[id] = (attempts[id] or 0) + 1; pcall(FlingFeature.player, context, state, player) end
					end
					break
				end
			end
			if not context.configuration.autoFlingSheriff and next(origins) then origins, characters, finished, attempts = {}, {}, {}, {} end
			environment.task.wait(0.3)
		end
	end)
	local function stop()
		state.token += 1
		stopClick()
		globals.__pulseFlingDown, globals.__pulseFlingChar, globals.__pulseFlingPlayer = nil, nil, nil
		globals.__pulseFlingPersist, globals.__pulseFlingCancel = nil, nil
	end
	return state, stop
end

local EspText = {}
local ESP_ROLE_SHORT = {Murderer = "M", Sheriff = "S", Hero = "H", Innocent = "I"}

function EspText.create()
	return {upper = {}, upperCount = 0, distances = {}, distanceCount = 0,
		names = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
end

function EspText.upper(state, value)
	if state.upperCount > 3000 then state.upper, state.upperCount = {}, 0 end
	local cached = state.upper[value]
	if cached then return cached end

	local result = string.upper(value)
	if string.find(result, "[\208\209]") then
		local characters = {}
		for _, code in utf8.codes(result) do
			if code >= 1072 and code <= 1103 then code -= 32 end
			if code == 1105 then code = 1025 end
			table.insert(characters, utf8.char(code))
		end
		result = table.concat(characters)
	end
	state.upper[value] = result
	state.upperCount += 1
	return result
end

function EspText.case(state, value, mode)
	if mode == "UPPER" then return EspText.upper(state, value) end
	if mode == "lower" then return string.lower(value) end
	return value
end

function EspText.role(state, role, mode, translate)
	local label = translate(role)
	if mode == "Short" then return ESP_ROLE_SHORT[role] or label:sub(1, 1) end
	if mode == "Upper" then return EspText.upper(state, label) end
	return label
end

function EspText.distance(state, distance, unit)
	local value = math.max(tonumber(distance) or 0, 0)
	local key = math.floor(value + 0.5)
	if unit == "Meters" then
		local meters = value * 0.28
		key = meters < 10 and -(math.floor(meters * 10 + 0.5) + 1) or math.floor(meters + 0.5) + 1000000
	end
	if state.distanceCount > 4000 then state.distances, state.distanceCount = {}, 0 end
	if state.distances[key] then return state.distances[key] end

	local text = tostring(math.floor(value + 0.5)) .. " st"
	if unit == "Meters" then
		local meters = value * 0.28
		text = meters < 10 and string.format("%.1f m", meters) or tostring(math.floor(meters + 0.5)) .. " m"
	end
	state.distances[key] = text
	state.distanceCount += 1
	return text
end

function EspText.clean(value)
	if type(value) ~= "string" then return "" end
	return (value:gsub("[%z\1-\31\127]", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end

function EspText.name(state, player, mode)
	local name, display = player.Name, player.DisplayName
	local cached = state.names[player]
	if cached and cached.name == name and cached.display == display and cached.mode == mode then
		return cached.main, cached.second
	end

	local username, displayName = EspText.clean(name), EspText.clean(display)
	if username == "" then username = displayName end
	if username == "" then username = "Player" end
	if displayName == "" then displayName = username end
	local main, second = username, ""
	if mode == "Display name" then main = displayName end
	if mode == "Both" then
		main = displayName
		if displayName ~= username then second = "@" .. username end
	end
	state.names[player] = {name = name, display = display, mode = mode, main = main, second = second}
	return main, second
end

local EspColor = {}
local ESP_ROLE_COLORS = {Murderer = "murdererColour", Sheriff = "sheriffColour", Hero = "heroColour", Innocent = "innocentColour"}

function EspColor.create(environment, settings)
	return {environment = environment, settings = settings, white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		black = environment.Color3.new(0, 0, 0)}
end

function EspColor.key(color)
	return math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5) * 65536 + math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5) * 256 + math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)
end

function EspColor.tone(state, color)
	local settings = state.settings
	local brightness, saturation = (settings.brightness or 100) / 100, (settings.saturation or 100) / 100
	if brightness == 1 and saturation == 1 then return color end
	if not state.tones or state.brightness ~= brightness or state.saturation ~= saturation then
		state.tones, state.brightness, state.saturation, state.count = {}, brightness, saturation, 0
	end

	local cache, key = state.tones, EspColor.key(color)
	if cache[key] then return cache[key] end
	local hue, sat, value = color:ToHSV()
	local adjusted = value * brightness
	local result = state.environment.Color3.fromHSV(hue, math.clamp(sat * saturation, 0, 1), math.clamp(adjusted, 0, 1))
	if adjusted > 1 then result = result:Lerp(state.white, math.clamp((adjusted - 1) * 0.6, 0, 0.6)) end
	state.count += 1
	if state.count > 4096 then state.tones = nil end
	cache[key] = result
	return result
end

function EspColor.ink(state, source, custom, color)
	if source == "Custom" then return EspColor.tone(state, custom or state.white) end
	if source == "White" then return EspColor.tone(state, state.white) end
	if source == "Light" then return color:Lerp(state.white, 0.45) end
	if source == "Dark" then return color:Lerp(state.black, 0.5) end
	return color
end

function EspColor.roleBase(state, role)
	return state.settings[ESP_ROLE_COLORS[role] or "noRoleColour"]
end

function EspColor.role(state, role)
	return EspColor.tone(state, EspColor.roleBase(state, role))
end

function EspColor.select(state, role, isVisible, distance)
	local settings, environment = state.settings, state.environment
	local color = EspColor.roleBase(state, role)
	if settings.colorMode == "Rainbow" then
		local hue = environment.os.clock() * 0.09 * (settings.rainbowSpeed or 1) % 1
		color = environment.Color3.fromHSV(hue, math.clamp((settings.rainbowSat or 65) / 100, 0, 1), 1)
	end
	if settings.colorMode == "Custom" then color = settings.customColour end
	if settings.colorMode == "Distance" then
		color = settings.nearColour:Lerp(settings.farColour, math.clamp((distance or 0) / math.max(settings.maxDist, 1), 0, 1))
	end
	if settings.colorMode == "Visibility" then color = isVisible and settings.seenColour or settings.hiddenColour end
	if settings.visCheck and settings.dimHidden and not isVisible and settings.hiddenStyle == "Grey" then color = settings.hiddenColour end
	return EspColor.tone(state, color)
end

function EspColor.cham(state, color)
	local brightness = (state.settings.chamsBright or 100) / 100
	if brightness > 1 then return color:Lerp(state.white, math.clamp((brightness - 1) * 0.6, 0, 0.6)) end
	if brightness < 1 then return color:Lerp(state.black, math.clamp(1 - brightness, 0, 0.85)) end
	return color
end

function EspColor.health(state, ratio)
	return state.settings.healthLow:Lerp(state.settings.healthHigh, math.clamp(ratio, 0, 1))
end

local EspBox = {}

function EspBox.create(context, parent, playerId)
	local environment = context.environment
	local function create(class, properties, owner)
		local object = environment.Instance.new(class)
		for key, value in properties do object[key] = value end
		object.Parent = owner
		return object
	end
	local function frame(owner, name, level)
		return create("Frame", {Name = name, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Active = false, Visible = false, ZIndex = level}, owner)
	end
	local function stroke(owner, thickness)
		return create("UIStroke", {Thickness = thickness, Color = environment.Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			ApplyStrokeMode = environment.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Transparency = 1}, owner)
	end
	local layer = frame(parent, "Player_" .. tostring(playerId), 2)
	layer.Size = environment.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	local box, glow, outer = frame(layer, "Box", 3), frame(layer, "Glow", 2), frame(layer, "BoxOutline", 2)
	local edge = stroke(box, 1.5)
	local result = {layer = layer, box = box, edge = edge, glow = glow, outer = outer,
		fillGradient = create("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90}, box),
		edgeGradient = create("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90}, edge),
		round = create("UICorner", {CornerRadius = environment.UDim.new(0, 0)}, box),
		glowStroke = stroke(glow, 6), glowRound = create("UICorner", {}, glow),
		outerStroke = stroke(outer, 3.5), outerRound = create("UICorner", {}, outer),
		corners = {}, cornerGlow = {}, cornerEdge = {}}
	result.make = create
	result.frame = frame
	result.stroke = stroke
	EspBox.grow(context, result, 8)
	return result
end

function EspBox.grow(context, box, count)
	for index = #box.corners + 1, count do
		local function line(name, level)
			local frame = box.frame(box.layer, name, level)
			frame.AnchorPoint = context.environment.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			return {frame = frame, stroke = box.stroke(frame, 1)}
		end
		box.corners[index] = line("Corner" .. index, 4)
		box.cornerGlow[index] = line("CornerGlow" .. index, 2)
		box.cornerEdge[index] = box.frame(box.layer, "CornerEdge" .. index, 3)
	end
end

function EspBox.hideSegments(box, first)
	for index = first, #box.corners do
		box.corners[index].frame.Visible = false
		box.cornerGlow[index].frame.Visible = false
		box.cornerEdge[index].Visible = false
	end
end

function EspBox.sequence(context, first, second)
	local state, settings = context.colors, context.settings
	local isRoleFade = settings.boxGradStyle == "Role Fade"
	local key = isRoleFade and -EspColor.key(first) - 1 or EspColor.key(first) * 16777216 + EspColor.key(second)
	context.boxSequences = context.boxSequences or {}
	if context.boxSequences[key] then return context.boxSequences[key] end

	local colorSequence = context.environment.ColorSequence
	local result = isRoleFade and colorSequence.new(first:Lerp(state.white, 0.25), first) or colorSequence.new(first, second)
	context.boxSequenceCount = (context.boxSequenceCount or 0) + 1
	if context.boxSequenceCount > 512 then context.boxSequences, context.boxSequenceCount = {}, 0 end
	context.boxSequences[key] = result
	return result
end

function EspBox.animation(context, player)
	local settings = context.settings
	if settings.boxAnim ~= "Pulse" and settings.boxAnim ~= "Breathe" then return 1, 0 end
	local time = context.environment.os.clock() * (settings.boxAnimSpeed or 1) + (player and player.UserId % 89 * 0.37 or 0)
	if settings.boxAnim == "Pulse" then return 0.7 + 0.3 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(time * 4.2)), 0 end
	return 1, 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(time * 2.6)
end

function EspBox.inner(context, box)
	if box.inner then return box.inner end
	box.inner = box.frame(box.layer, "BoxInner", 3)
	box.innerStroke = box.stroke(box.inner, 1)
	box.innerRound = box.make("UICorner", {}, box.inner)
	box.innerGrad = box.make("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90}, box.innerStroke)
	return box.inner
end

function EspBox.quantize(value)
	return math.floor(value * 200 + 0.5) / 200
end

function EspBox.fill(context, box, base, gradient, opacity)
	local environment, settings = context.environment, context.settings
	local color = EspColor.ink(context.colors, settings.fillColMode, settings.fillCol, base)
	local second = settings.gradient and gradient or color
	local key = (settings.gradient and 1 or 2) * 1000000000000000 + EspColor.key(color) * 16777216 + EspColor.key(second)
	if box.fillKey ~= key or box.fillGS ~= settings.boxGradStyle then
		box.fillKey, box.fillGS = key, settings.boxGradStyle
		box.fillGradient.Color = settings.gradient and EspBox.sequence(context, color, second) or environment.ColorSequence.new(color)
	end
	local style = settings.fillStyle or "Solid"
	if box.fillStyleOn == style then return end
	box.fillStyleOn = style
	local sequence = environment.NumberSequence
	local fills = {Solid = function() return sequence.new(0) end,
		["Fade Down"] = function() return sequence.new(0, 1) end,
		["Fade Up"] = function() return sequence.new(1, 0) end}
	box.fillGradient.Transparency = (fills[style] or fills.Solid)()
	box.fillGradient.Rotation = 90
end

function EspBox.edge(context, box, base, gradient, opacity, thickness, rotation)
	local environment, settings = context.environment, context.settings
	local key = EspColor.key(base) * 16777216 + EspColor.key(gradient)
	if box.edgeKey ~= key or box.edgeGS ~= settings.boxGradStyle or box.edgeG ~= settings.gradient then
		box.edgeKey, box.edgeGS, box.edgeG = key, settings.boxGradStyle, settings.gradient
		box.edgeGradient.Color = settings.gradient and EspBox.sequence(context, base, gradient) or environment.ColorSequence.new(base)
		if box.innerGrad then box.innerGrad.Color = box.edgeGradient.Color end
	end
	local fade = settings.gradient and settings.boxGradStyle == "Role Fade"
	if box.edgeFade ~= fade then
		box.edgeFade = fade
		box.edgeGradient.Transparency = fade and environment.NumberSequence.new(0, 0.7) or environment.NumberSequence.new(0)
	end
	box.edgeGradient.Rotation = rotation
	box.edge.Color = context.colors.white
	box.edge.Thickness = math.clamp(thickness, 0.5, 8)
	box.edge.Transparency = EspBox.quantize(1 - opacity)
end

function EspBox.innerStyle(context, box, rect, style, opacity, thickness, rotation, hasOutline)
	local environment, settings = context.environment, context.settings
	local offset, stroke = 0, box.innerStroke
	if style == "Double" then
		EspBox.inner(context, box)
		stroke = box.innerStroke
		box.innerGrad.Color = box.edgeGradient.Color
		offset = math.floor(thickness + 2.5)
		box.innerRound.CornerRadius = environment.UDim.new(0, math.max(0, math.clamp(settings.boxRound, 0, 20) - offset))
		stroke.Color = context.colors.white
		stroke.Thickness = math.max(1, thickness * 0.6)
		stroke.Transparency = EspBox.quantize(1 - opacity * 0.45)
		box.innerGrad.Rotation = rotation
	end
	if style ~= "Double" and hasOutline then
		EspBox.inner(context, box)
		stroke = box.innerStroke
		box.innerGrad.Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(context.colors.white)
		offset = math.max(1, math.floor((settings.outlineSize or 1) * 0.5 + 0.5))
		local radius = style == "Rounded" and math.max(0, math.clamp(settings.boxRound, 0, 20) - offset) or 0
		box.innerRound.CornerRadius = environment.UDim.new(0, radius)
		stroke.Color = settings.outlineCol or context.colors.black
		stroke.Thickness = offset
		stroke.Transparency = EspBox.quantize(1 - opacity * math.clamp((settings.outlineAlpha or 65) / 100, 0, 1))
	end
	box.inner.Position = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(rect.x + offset, rect.y + offset)
	box.inner.Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(2, rect.w - offset * 2), math.max(2, rect.h - offset * 2))
	box.inner.Visible = true
end

function EspBox.segments(context, box, rectangle, thickness, style)
	local x, y, width, height = rectangle.x, rectangle.y, rectangle.w, rectangle.h
	local line = math.max(1, math.floor(thickness + 0.5))
	local length = math.min(math.max(math.min(width, height) * math.clamp(context.settings.cornerSize, 5, 50) / 100, 4), math.min(width, height) * 0.45)
	length = math.max(line + 1, math.floor(length + 0.5))
	local segments
	if style == "Corners" then
		segments = {{x, y, length, line}, {x, y, line, length}, {x + width - length, y, length, line},
			{x + width - line, y, line, length}, {x, y + height - line, length, line}, {x, y + height - length, line, length},
			{x + width - length, y + height - line, length, line}, {x + width - line, y + height - length, line, length}}
	end
	if style == "Brackets" then
		local endWidth = math.max(line + 1, math.floor(math.min(length, width * 0.3) + 0.5))
		segments = {{x, y, line, height}, {x, y, endWidth, line}, {x, y + height - line, endWidth, line},
			{x + width - line, y, line, height}, {x + width - endWidth, y, endWidth, line},
			{x + width - endWidth, y + height - line, endWidth, line}}
	end
	box.segs = box.segs or {}
	for index, values in segments do
		local entry = box.segs[index] or {}
		entry[1], entry[2], entry[3], entry[4] = values[1], values[2], values[3], values[4]
		box.segs[index] = entry
	end
	EspBox.grow(context, box, #segments)
	EspBox.hideSegments(box, #segments + 1)
end

function EspBox.draw(context, box, rectangle, color, alpha, player, focus)
	local environment, settings = context.environment, context.settings
	local style = settings.boxStyle or "Corners"
	if box.role == "Murderer" and settings.murdBox and settings.murdBox ~= "Same" then style = settings.murdBox end
	local isVisible = settings.box == true and not box.boxOff
	local segmented = style == "Corners" or style == "Brackets"
	local full = isVisible and not segmented
	local glow = settings.boxGlow == true or focus == true
	local innerOutline = full and style ~= "Double" and settings.outline == true and settings.outlineInner == true
	if not isVisible or not segmented then EspBox.hideSegments(box, 1) end
	if box.inner and not (full and (style == "Double" or innerOutline)) then box.inner.Visible = false end
	box.box.Visible, box.glow.Visible, box.outer.Visible = isVisible, full and glow, full and settings.outline
	if not isVisible then return end

	local animation, expansion = EspBox.animation(context, player)
	local extra = expansion > 0 and math.floor(expansion * 2 + 0.5) or 0
	local padding = math.floor(tonumber(settings.boxPad) or 0)
	local rect = {x = rectangle.x - extra, y = rectangle.y - extra, w = rectangle.w + extra * 2, h = rectangle.h + extra * 2}
	if padding ~= 0 then
		rect = {x = rect.x - padding, y = rect.y - padding, w = math.max(4, rect.w + padding * 2), h = math.max(4, rect.h + padding * 2)}
	end
	local opacity = alpha * animation
	local base = EspColor.ink(context.colors, settings.boxColMode, settings.boxCol, color)
	local gradient = settings.gradient and EspColor.tone(context.colors, settings.gradientColour) or base
	local thickness = (tonumber(settings.boxThickness) or 1) * (settings.lineScale or 100) / 100 * (context.lineWidthFactor or 1)
	if focus then thickness *= (settings.focusScale or 160) / 100 end
	local position, size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(rect.x, rect.y), environment.UDim2.fromOffset(rect.w, rect.h)
	box.box.Position, box.box.Size = position, size
	local radius = (style == "Rounded" or style == "Double") and math.clamp(settings.boxRound, 0, 20) or 0
	local corner = environment.UDim.new(0, radius)
	box.round.CornerRadius, box.glowRound.CornerRadius, box.outerRound.CornerRadius = corner, corner, corner
	local rotation = math.floor(settings.boxGradAngle or 90) % 360
	if full and settings.outline then
		box.outer.Position, box.outer.Size = position, size
		box.outerStroke.Color = settings.outlineCol or context.colors.black
		box.outerStroke.Thickness = thickness + (settings.outlineSize or 2)
		box.outerStroke.Transparency = EspBox.quantize(1 - opacity * math.clamp((settings.outlineAlpha or 65) / 100, 0, 1))
	end
	box.box.BackgroundColor3 = context.colors.white
	box.box.BackgroundTransparency = settings.boxFill and EspBox.quantize(1 - math.clamp(settings.boxFillAlpha / 100, 0, 1) * opacity) or 1
	if settings.boxFill then EspBox.fill(context, box, base, gradient, opacity) end
	if full then EspBox.edge(context, box, base, gradient, opacity, thickness, rotation) end
	if not full then box.edge.Transparency = 1 end
	if full and glow then EspBox.glow(context, box, position, size, base, opacity, thickness, focus) end
	if full and (style == "Double" or innerOutline) then EspBox.innerStyle(context, box, rect, style, opacity, thickness, rotation, innerOutline) end
	if segmented then EspBox.segments(context, box, rect, thickness, style) end
end

function EspBox.glow(context, box, position, size, base, opacity, thickness, focus)
	local settings = context.settings
	local pulse = settings.pulse and 0.72 + math.sin(context.environment.os.clock() * settings.pulseSpeed * math.pi * 2) * 0.28 or 1
	if focus and not settings.pulse then pulse = 0.75 + math.sin(context.environment.os.clock() * 5) * 0.25 end
	local strength = math.clamp(settings.glowStrength / 100, 0, 0.6)
	if focus and not settings.boxGlow then strength = 0.3 end
	box.glow.Position, box.glow.Size = position, size
	box.glowStroke.Color = EspColor.ink(context.colors, settings.glowColMode, settings.glowCol, base)
	box.glowStroke.Thickness = thickness + (settings.glowSize or 5) * (settings.lineScale or 100) / 100 * (context.lineWidthFactor or 1)
	box.glowStroke.Transparency = EspBox.quantize(1 - opacity * strength * pulse)
end

local EspRole = {}
local ESP_ROLE_MAP = {
	Zombie = "Murderer", Vampire = "Murderer", Freezer = "Murderer",
	Survivor = "Innocent", Hunter = "Innocent", Villager = "Innocent", Runner = "Innocent",
}
local ESP_UNDEAD = {Zombie = true, Vampire = true, Freezer = true}
local ESP_ROLE_FIELDS = {Murderer = "murderer", Sheriff = "sheriff", Hero = "hero", Innocent = "innocent"}

function EspRole.create(clock)
	return {clock = clock, heroes = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), weapons = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
		parts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
end

function EspRole.of(state, player, roles)
	if type(player) == "table" then return player.FakeRole end

	local data = roles and roles[player.Name]
	local role = data and data.Role
	if data and (data.Dead == true or data.Killed == true) and not ESP_UNDEAD[role] then role = nil end
	role = ESP_ROLE_MAP[role] or role
	if role == "Innocent" and EspRole.hasHeroGun(state, player) then role = "Hero" end
	if not ESP_ROLE_FIELDS[role] then return nil end
	return role
end

function EspRole.hasHeroGun(state, player)
	local now, hero = state.clock(), state.heroes[player]
	if not hero then
		hero = {at = -1, hasGun = false}
		state.heroes[player] = hero
	end
	if now - hero.at > 0.12 then
		hero.at = now
		local character, backpack = player.Character, player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
		hero.hasGun = not not (character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun"))
	end
	return hero.hasGun
end

function EspRole.shown(settings, role)
	return settings[ESP_ROLE_FIELDS[role] or "noRole"]
end

function EspRole.weaponScan(player, role)
	local character, backpack = player.Character, player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
	if character and character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then return "Knife", true end
	if character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then return "Gun", true end
	if backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife") then return "Knife", false end
	if backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") then return "Gun", false end
	if role == "Murderer" then return "Knife", false end
	if role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" then return "Gun", false end
	return nil, false
end

function EspRole.weaponOf(state, player, role)
	local now, cached, character = state.clock(), state.weapons[player], player.Character
	if cached and now - cached.at < 0.15 and cached.role == role and cached.character == character then
		return cached.name, cached.equipped
	end

	local name, equipped = EspRole.weaponScan(player, role)
	state.weapons[player] = {at = now, role = role, character = character, name = name, equipped = equipped}
	return name, equipped
end

function EspRole.partsOf(state, character)
	local now, parts = state.clock(), state.parts[character]
	if parts and parts.root and parts.hum then
		if now - parts.at < 1 and parts.root.Parent == character and parts.hum.Parent == character then return parts end
	end
	if parts and (not parts.root or not parts.hum) and now - parts.at < 0.25 then return parts end
	parts = parts or {}
	parts.at = now
	parts.hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	parts.root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	parts.head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") or parts.root
	state.parts[character] = parts
	return parts
end

local EspProjection = {}

function EspProjection.create(environment)
	return {environment = environment, bounds = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), partKinds = {}}
end

function EspProjection.bounds(state, character, root)
	local now, bounds = state.environment.os.clock(), state.bounds[character]
	if bounds and now - bounds.at <= 0.15 then return bounds.top, bounds.bottom end

	local top, bottom
	for _, part in character:GetChildren() do
		local isPart = state.partKinds[part.ClassName]
		if isPart == nil then
			isPart = part:IsA("BasePart")
			state.partKinds[part.ClassName] = isPart
		end
		if not isPart then continue end
		local half, position = part.Size.Y * 0.5, part.Position.Y
		local high, low = position + half, position - half
		top = top and math.max(top, high) or high
		bottom = bottom and math.min(bottom, low) or low
	end

	local y = root.Position.Y
	bounds = {at = now, top = (top or y + 3) - y, bottom = (bottom or y - 3) - y}
	state.bounds[character] = bounds
	return bounds.top, bounds.bottom
end

function EspProjection.point(state, camera, position)
	local projection = state.projection
	if projection and projection.enabled then
		local point = projection.frame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		local depth = -point.Z
		if depth > 0.08 then
			return state.environment.Vector3.new(projection.centerX + point.X / depth * projection.focal,
				projection.centerY - point.Y / depth * projection.focal, depth)
		end
	end
	return camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
end

function EspProjection.project(state, character, root, camera, boxWidth)
	local top, bottom = EspProjection.bounds(state, character, root)
	local position = root.Position
	local vector = state.environment.Vector3
	local upper = EspProjection.point(state, camera, vector.new(position.X, position.Y + top + 0.12, position.Z))
	local lower = EspProjection.point(state, camera, vector.new(position.X, position.Y + bottom - 0.08, position.Z))
	if upper.Z <= 0.08 or lower.Z <= 0.08 then return nil end

	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	local height = math.abs(lower.Y - upper.Y)
	if height < 2 or height > viewport.Y * 4 then return nil end
	local width = height * math.clamp((boxWidth or 50) / 100, 0.2, 1)
	local x, y = (upper.X + lower.X) * 0.5 - width * 0.5, math.min(upper.Y, lower.Y)
	if x + width < 0 or x > viewport.X or y + height < 0 or y > viewport.Y then return nil end
	if width < 12 then x, width = x - (12 - width) * 0.5, 12 end
	if height < 22 then y, height = y - (22 - height) * 0.5, 22 end
	return {x = x, y = y, w = width, h = height}
end

function EspProjection.smooth(record, rectangle, viewport, smooth, delta, center)
	local factor = math.clamp(smooth, 0, 95) / 100
	local alpha = factor > 0 and 1 - factor ^ (math.clamp(delta or 1 / 60, 0.001, 0.1) * 60) or 1
	center = center or {X = rectangle.x + rectangle.w * 0.5, Y = rectangle.y + rectangle.h * 0.5}
	local relative = {x = rectangle.x - center.X, y = rectangle.y - center.Y, w = rectangle.w, h = rectangle.h}
	local previous = record.rect and record.rel
	if previous then
		local difference = math.abs(relative.x - previous.x) + math.abs(relative.y - previous.y)
			+ math.abs(relative.w - previous.w) + math.abs(relative.h - previous.h)
		if difference < math.max(viewport.X, viewport.Y) * 0.35 then
			for _, key in {"x", "y", "w", "h"} do relative[key] = previous[key] + (relative[key] - previous[key]) * alpha end
		end
	end

	record.rel = relative
	record.rect = {x = center.X + relative.x, y = center.Y + relative.y, w = relative.w, h = relative.h}
	local value = record.rect
	return {x = math.floor(value.x + 0.5), y = math.floor(value.y + 0.5),
		w = math.max(1, math.floor(value.w + 0.5)), h = math.max(1, math.floor(value.h + 0.5))}
end

function EspProjection.inView(state, camera, position)
	if (position - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude <= 12 then return true end
	local point, viewport = EspProjection.point(state, camera, position), camera.ViewportSize
	local marginX, marginY = viewport.X * 0.35, viewport.Y * 0.35
	return not (point.Z < -6 or point.X < -marginX or point.X > viewport.X + marginX
		or point.Y < -marginY or point.Y > viewport.Y + marginY), point
end

function EspProjection.alpha(settings, distance, isVisible)
	local alpha = settings.visCheck and settings.dimHidden and not isVisible and settings.hiddenStyle ~= "Grey" and 0.72 or 1
	if settings.fade then
		local start = settings.maxDist * math.clamp(settings.fadeFrom, 10, 95) / 100
		if distance > start then alpha *= math.clamp(1 - (distance - start) / math.max(settings.maxDist - start, 1), 0.45, 1) end
	end
	return alpha * math.clamp((settings.opacity or 100) / 100, 0.05, 1)
end

function EspProjection.visible(context, origin, target, character)
	local environment, workspace = context.environment, context.workspace
	local parameters = environment.RaycastParams.new()
	parameters.FilterType = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignored = {character, workspace.CurrentCamera}
	if context.player.Character then table.insert(ignored, context.player.Character) end
	parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	parameters.IgnoreWater = true
	local direction = target.Position - origin
	if direction.Magnitude < 0.05 then return true end

	for _ = 1, 6 do
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, parameters)
		if not hit then return true end
		if hit.Instance.Transparency < 0.3 then return false end
		table.insert(ignored, hit.Instance)
		parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	end
	return false
end

local EspLabel = {}
local ESP_FONT_ENUM = {
	Fredoka = "FredokaOne", ["Luckiest Guy"] = "LuckiestGuy", Bangers = "Bangers", Cartoon = "Cartoon", Arcade = "Arcade",
	["Sci-Fi"] = "SciFi", Michroma = "Michroma", Jura = "Jura", Sarpanch = "Sarpanch", Oswald = "Oswald", Ubuntu = "Ubuntu",
	Nunito = "Nunito", Roboto = "Roboto", ["Roboto Condensed"] = "RobotoCondensed", Titillium = "TitilliumWeb",
	["Builder Sans"] = "BuilderSans", Arimo = "Arimo", Highway = "Highway", ["Denk One"] = "DenkOne", Creepster = "Creepster",
	["Permanent Marker"] = "PermanentMarker", Kalam = "Kalam", ["Indie Flower"] = "IndieFlower", ["Patrick Hand"] = "PatrickHand",
	Amatic = "AmaticSC", ["Special Elite"] = "SpecialElite", ["Grenze Gotisch"] = "GrenzeGotisch", Bodoni = "Bodoni",
	Merriweather = "Merriweather", Garamond = "Garamond", Antique = "Antique", Fantasy = "Fantasy", Montserrat = "Montserrat",
	Code = "RobotoMono", ["Source Sans"] = "SourceSans",
}

function EspLabel.root(state)
	if state.labelGui and state.labelGui.Parent then return state.labelGui end
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local holder = context.coreGui
	if not holder or not holder.Parent then holder = context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end
	if not holder then return nil end
	local gui = environment.Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.ResetOnSpawn = "PulseESP2Text", true, false
	gui.DisplayOrder, gui.ZIndexBehavior = 10, environment.Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	gui.Parent = holder
	state.labelGui, state.labels = gui, {}
	return gui
end

function EspLabel.create(state, player)
	local gui = EspLabel.root(state)
	if not gui then return nil end
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local function create(class, properties, parent)
		local object = environment.Instance.new(class)
		for key, value in properties do object[key] = value end
		object.Parent = parent
		return object
	end
	local function frame(name)
		return create("Frame", {Name = name, BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Active = false, Visible = false}, gui)
	end
	local function label(parent, name)
		local enum = environment.Enum
		return create("TextLabel", {Name = name, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false,
			RichText = false, TextScaled = false, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			TextXAlignment = enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextYAlignment = enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
			TextStrokeColor3 = environment.Color3.fromRGB(5, 8, 13), Text = "", ZIndex = 3}, parent)
	end
	local top, bottom = frame("Name_" .. tostring(player.UserId)), frame("Info_" .. tostring(player.UserId))
	local weaponShadow = create("ImageLabel", {Name = "WeaponShadow", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScaleType = environment.Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ImageColor3 = state.colors.black, Visible = false, ZIndex = 2}, bottom)
	local weapon = create("ImageLabel", {Name = "Weapon", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScaleType = environment.Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3}, bottom)
	local result = {top = top, bottom = bottom, name = label(top, "Name"), handle = label(top, "Username"),
		role = label(bottom, "Role"), distance = label(bottom, "Distance"), weaponText = label(bottom, "wtext"),
		weapon = weapon, weaponShadow = weaponShadow,
		measures = {}, createLabel = label}
	state.labels[player] = result
	return result
end

function EspLabel.font(state, name, weight)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local enum, font = environment.Enum, environment.Font
	state.fontFaces = state.fontFaces or {}
	state.fontFaces[name] = state.fontFaces[name] or {}
	local key = weight or enum.FontWeight.Medium
	if state.fontFaces[name][key] then return state.fontFaces[name][key] end

	local families = {Gotham = "GothamSSm", GothamSSm = "GothamSSm", Code = "RobotoMono",
		["Source Sans"] = "SourceSansPro", Montserrat = "Montserrat"}
	local family, result = families[name], nil
	if not family and ESP_FONT_ENUM[name] then
		local ok, face = pcall(function() return font.fromEnum(enum.Font[ESP_FONT_ENUM[name]]) end)
		if ok and face then
			result = face
			if weight then
				local made, weighted = pcall(font.new, face.Family, weight)
				if made and weighted then result = weighted end
			end
		end
	end
	if not result and (family or not ESP_FONT_ENUM[name]) then
		local ok, face = pcall(font.new, "rbxasset://fonts/families/" .. (family or "GothamSSm") .. ".json", key)
		if ok then result = face end
	end
	result = result or font.fromEnum(enum.Font.GothamMedium)
	state.fontFaces[name][key] = result
	return result
end

function EspLabel.metricFont(state, name)
	local enum = state.context.environment.Enum
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		local id = ESP_FONT_ENUM[name]
		return id and enum.Font[id]
	end)
	return ok and value or enum.Font.GothamMedium
end

function EspLabel.measure(state, labels, key, text, size, font, limit)
	local cached = labels.measures[key]
	if cached and cached.text == text and cached.size == size and cached.font == font and cached.limit == limit then
		return cached.width, cached.height
	end
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return context.textService:GetTextSize(text, size, font, environment.Vector2.new(100000, 100000))
	end)
	local width = ok and math.ceil(result.X) or math.min(limit, #text * size * 0.55)
	local height = ok and math.ceil(result.Y) or size + 3
	width, height = math.min(math.max(width + 2, 1), limit), math.max(height + 2, size + 3)
	labels.measures[key] = {text = text, size = size, font = font, limit = limit, width = width, height = height}
	return width, height
end

function EspLabel.position(state, frame, rect, width, height, y)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local viewport = state.viewport
	local center = rect.x + rect.w * 0.5
	local x = math.clamp(center - width * 0.5, 4, math.max(4, viewport.X - 4 - width))
	y = math.clamp(y, 4, math.max(4, viewport.Y - 4 - height))
	frame.Position = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(x + 0.5), math.floor(y + 0.5))
	frame.Size, frame.Visible = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(width, height), true
	return y
end

function EspLabel.text(state, label, options)
	local environment, settings = state.context.environment, state.settings
	label.Visible = options.text ~= ""
	if options.text == "" then return end
	label.Text, label.FontFace, label.TextSize = options.text, options.font, options.size
	label.TextColor3, label.TextTransparency = options.color, 1 - options.opacity
	local outline = settings.textOutline == false and 1 or EspBox.quantize(1 - options.opacity * math.clamp((tonumber(settings.textOutlineAlpha) or 60) / 100, 0, 1))
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = outline
	label.Position = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(options.x, options.y)
	label.Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(options.width, options.height)
end

function EspLabel.name(state, labels, player, rectangle, infoY, style)
	local settings, environment = state.settings, state.context.environment
	if not settings.name then labels.top.Visible = false; return infoY end
	local main, handle = EspText.name(state.text, player, settings.nameMode)
	main = EspText.case(state.text, main, settings.nameCase)
	if handle ~= "" then handle = EspText.case(state.text, handle, settings.nameCase) end
	local available = math.max(1, style.limit - 4)
	local nameWidth, nameHeight = EspLabel.measure(state, labels, "name", main, style.nameSize, style.metricFont, available)
	local handleWidth, handleHeight = 0, 0
	if handle ~= "" then handleWidth, handleHeight = EspLabel.measure(state, labels, "handle", handle, style.infoSize, style.metricFont, available) end
	local width, height = math.min(style.limit, math.max(nameWidth, handleWidth) + 4), nameHeight + handleHeight
	local y = rectangle.y - (tonumber(settings.nameOffset) or 3) - height
	if settings.namePos == "Below" then y = infoY end
