		EspFeature.colorpicker(state, "gradientColour", "Second Color")
		EspFeature.dropdown(state, "boxGradStyle", "Box Gradient Style", {"Two Color", "Role Fade"})
		EspFeature.slider(state, {field = "boxGradAngle", text = "Box Gradient Angle", min = 0, max = 360, decimals = 0, suffix = "В°"})

function EspFeature.colorControls(state)
	local section, environment = state.context.section, state.context.environment
	section:Group({Title = "ESP Colors", Side = "Left"})
	EspFeature.dropdown(state, "colorMode", "Color Mode", {"Role", "Rainbow", "Custom", "Distance", "Visibility"})
	local palettes = {
		Classic = {{255, 64, 64}, {80, 150, 255}, {255, 210, 60}, {90, 230, 130}, {176, 182, 204}},
		Soft = {{255, 107, 107}, {116, 170, 255}, {255, 205, 112}, {125, 222, 170}, {190, 196, 212}},
		Muted = {{224, 102, 102}, {110, 150, 210}, {214, 180, 106}, {120, 190, 150}, {168, 172, 184}},
		Pastel = {{255, 150, 160}, {160, 196, 255}, {255, 226, 160}, {170, 234, 196}, {210, 212, 224}},
		Mono = {{255, 92, 92}, {232, 232, 236}, {232, 232, 236}, {190, 192, 200}, {150, 152, 160}},
		Ocean = {{255, 110, 120}, {90, 170, 255}, {120, 220, 230}, {150, 205, 255}, {170, 185, 205}},
	}
	local options, ready = {}, false
	for _, name in {"Classic", "Soft", "Muted", "Pastel", "Mono", "Ocean"} do table.insert(options, {code = name, label = name}) end
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Role Palette", NoSave = true, Options = options, Default = "Classic", Callback = function(name)
		if not ready or not palettes[name] then return end
		for index, field in {"murdererColour", "sheriffColour", "heroColour", "innocentColour", "noRoleColour"} do
			local rgb = palettes[name][index]
			local color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3])
			state.settings[field] = color
			local handle = state.colorHandles[field]
			if handle and handle.Set then pcall(handle.Set, color) end
		end
	end})
	ready = true
	for _, option in {{"murdererColour", "Murderer Color"}, {"sheriffColour", "Sheriff Color"},
		{"heroColour", "Hero Color"}, {"innocentColour", "Innocent Color"}, {"noRoleColour", "No Role Color"},
		{"nameColour", "Name Color"}, {"infoColour", "Detail Color"}, {"customColour", "Custom Color"},
		{"nearColour", "Near Color"}, {"farColour", "Far Color"}, {"seenColour", "Seen Color"}, {"hiddenColour", "Hidden Color"}} do
		EspFeature.colorpicker(state, option[1], option[2])
	end
end

local MurderFeature = {}
local KNIFE_TARGET_PARTS = {"HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "LowerTorso", "Head"}

function MurderFeature.install(context)
	local state = {context = context, killAll = false, killGun = false, aura = false, radius = 20}
	local globals = context.environment.getgenv()
	globals.__pulseSetKillAll = function(enabled) state.killAll = not not enabled end
	globals.__pulseGetKillAll = function() return state.killAll end
	globals.__pulseKillPass = function() return MurderFeature.killPass(state) end

	local section = context.section
	section:Group({Title = "Murder", Side = "Right"})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Kill Aura", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled)
		state.aura = not not enabled
		globals.__pulseKillAuraOn = state.aura
	end, Settings = function()
		section:Slider({Text = "Aura Radius", Min = 5, Max = 200, Default = 20, Decimals = 0, Suffix = " studs",
			Callback = function(value) state.radius = value end})
	end})
	section:ToggleKey({Text = "Kill All", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled) state.killAll = not not enabled end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Kill Gun Players", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled) state.killGun = not not enabled end})
	section:Header("Kill Player")
	section:PlayerList({ExcludeLocal = true, Momentary = true, ActionIcon = "skull", OnSelect = function(player)
		if player then MurderFeature.killPlayer(state, player) end
	end})

	context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		while context.isAlive() do
			local delay = MurderFeature.step(state)
			context.environment.task.wait(delay)
		end
	end)
	return state
end

function MurderFeature.findKnife(state, container)
	if not container then return nil end
	local knife = container:FindFirstChild("Knife")
	if knife then return knife end

	for _, tool in container:GetChildren() do
		if tool:IsA("Tool") and state.context.collection:HasTag(tool, "Weapon_Knife") then return tool end
	end
	return nil
end

function MurderFeature.isMurderer(state, roles)
	local context, globals = state.context, state.context.environment.getgenv()
	local duel = globals.__pulseDuel
	if duel and duel.on then
		return MurderFeature.findKnife(state, context.player.Character) ~= nil
			or MurderFeature.findKnife(state, context.player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")) ~= nil
	end

	local role = roles[context.player.Name]
	return role ~= nil and role.Role ~= nil and tostring(role.Role):lower():find("murder") ~= nil
end

function MurderFeature.ready(state, roles)
	local context = state.context
	local character = context.player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not MurderFeature.isMurderer(state, roles) or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	if MurderFeature.findKnife(state, character) then return true end

	local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(state, context.player:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
	if knife and knife:IsA("Tool") then
		knife.Parent = character
		return true
	end
	return MurderFeature.findKnife(state, character) ~= nil
end

function MurderFeature.validTarget(state, player, roles)
	local context = state.context
	if player == context.player then return false end

	local duel = context.environment.getgenv().__pulseDuel
	if duel and duel.on then
		return duel.foes[player.Name] and duel.alive(player) ~= nil or false
	end

	local role = roles[player.Name]
	if not role or role.Dead == true or role.Killed == true then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

function MurderFeature.hasGun(player)
	local character, backpack = player.Character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	return character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil or false
end

function MurderFeature.hit(state, root)
	if not root or not root.Parent then return end
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(state, character)
	if not knife then return end

	local handle = knife:FindFirstChild("Handle") or knife:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	local touch = state.context.environment.firetouchinterest
	if handle and touch then
		for _, name in KNIFE_TARGET_PARTS do
			local part = root.Parent:FindFirstChild(name)
			if not part then continue end
			pcall(function()
				touch(handle, part, 0)
				touch(handle, part, 1)
				touch(part, handle, 0)
				touch(part, handle, 1)
			end)
		end
	end
	pcall(function() knife:Activate() end)
end

function MurderFeature.killPlayer(state, player)
	local context, roles = state.context, state.context.roles()
	if not MurderFeature.ready(state, roles) then return end
	player = context.players:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not player or not MurderFeature.validTarget(state, player, roles) then return end
	local character = player.Character

	context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		for _ = 1, 6 do
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local localCharacter = context.player.Character
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not localCharacter or not localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then break end
			MurderFeature.hit(state, root)
		end
	end)
end

function MurderFeature.killPass(state)
	local context, roles = state.context, state.context.roles()
	if not MurderFeature.ready(state, roles) then return false end

	local armed, others = {}, {}
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if not MurderFeature.validTarget(state, player, roles) then continue end
		local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end
		local targets = MurderFeature.hasGun(player) and armed or others
		table.insert(targets, root)
	end
	for _, root in armed do MurderFeature.hit(state, root) end
	for _, root in others do MurderFeature.hit(state, root) end
	return #armed + #others > 0
end

function MurderFeature.step(state)
	if not (state.killAll or state.killGun or state.aura) then return 0.2 end
	local context, roles = state.context, state.context.roles()
	if not MurderFeature.ready(state, roles) then return 0.2 end

	local character = context.player.Character
	local localRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local targets = {}
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if not MurderFeature.validTarget(state, player, roles) then continue end
		local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end
		local role = roles[player.Name]
		local armed = MurderFeature.hasGun(player) or type(role) == "table" and tostring(role.Role) == "Sheriff"
		local inside = state.aura and localRoot and (root.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude <= state.radius
		if state.killAll or state.killGun and armed or inside then targets[root] = true end
	end
	for root in targets do MurderFeature.hit(state, root) end
	return nil
end

local KnifeAim = {}

function KnifeAim.create(context, murder)
	return {
		context = context, murder = murder, on = false, mode = "Smart", fov = 360, maxDist = 250,
		wall = true, predict = true, lead = 100, sticky = true, show = true, auto = false, autoRange = 70,
		autoMin = 55, speed = 96, throws = 0, speedN = 0, lastMs = 0, curScore = 0, lastThrow = 0,
		hist = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), hcache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
	}
end

function KnifeAim.origin(state)
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(state.murder, character)
	local handle = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if handle then return handle.Position end

	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root and root.Position or nil
end

function KnifeAim.blocked(state, origin, position)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local params = environment.RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType, params.RespectCanCollide, params.IgnoreWater = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, true
	local characters = {}
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if player.Character then table.insert(characters, player.Character) end
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = characters

	local ok, result = pcall(function() return context.workspace:Raycast(origin, position - origin, params) end)
	return ok and result ~= nil
end

function KnifeAim.candidates(state, origin, roles)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	local direction = camera and camera.CFrame.LookVector or environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	local candidates = {}

	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if not MurderFeature.validTarget(state.murder, player, roles) then continue end
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end

		local delta = root.Position - origin
		local distance = delta.Magnitude
		if distance > state.maxDist or distance <= 0.5 then continue end

		local angle = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(direction:Dot(delta.Unit), -1, 1)))
		if state.fov < 360 and angle > state.fov * 0.5 then continue end

		local role = roles[player.Name]
		local name = role and role.Role and tostring(role.Role):lower() or ""
		local armed = name:find("sheriff") ~= nil or name:find("hero") ~= nil
		local score = -angle - distance * 0.12 + (armed and 14 or 0)
		if state.mode == "Crosshair" then score = -angle end
		if state.mode == "Nearest" then score = -distance end
		if state.mode == "Sheriff" then score = (armed and 1000 or 0) - angle - distance * 0.05 end
		if state.sticky and state.cur == character then score += state.mode == "Nearest" and 12 or 8 end
		table.insert(candidates, {c = character, plr = player, hrp = root, dist = distance, score = score})
	end

	table.sort(candidates, function(first, second) return first.score > second.score end)
	return candidates
end

function KnifeAim.sample(state, character)
	local context = state.context
	local aim = context.aim
	if aim and aim.alive then return AimTarget.sample(context, aim, character) end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid then return nil end

	return {t = context.environment.os.clock(), p = root.Position, cf = root.CFrame, md = humanoid.MoveDirection,
		ws = humanoid.WalkSpeed, st = humanoid:GetState(), air = humanoid.FloorMaterial == context.environment.Enum.Material.Air,
		jump = humanoid.Jump, hh = humanoid.HipHeight, jp = 50}
end

function KnifeAim.ping(context)
	local ok, value = pcall(function() return context.stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
	if ok and type(value) == "number" and value == value then return math.clamp(value / 1000, 0, 1) end
	return 0.08
end

function KnifeAim.record(state)
	local context = state.context
	if not (state.on or state.auto) then return end
	if not MurderFeature.isMurderer(state.murder, context.roles()) then return end

	local own = context.player.Character
	local root = own and own:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end

	local now = context.environment.os.clock()
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if player == context.player then continue end
		local character = player.Character
		local targetRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not targetRoot or (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > state.maxDist + 80 then continue end

		local history = state.hist[character]
		if not history then history = {}; state.hist[character] = history end
		local last = history[#history]
		if last and now - last.t > 0.4 then table.clear(history); last = nil end
		if last and now - last.t < 1 / 240 then continue end

		local sample = KnifeAim.sample(state, character)
		if not sample then continue end
		table.insert(history, sample)
		while #history > 2 and sample.t - history[1].t > 3 do table.remove(history, 1) end
	end
end

function KnifeAim.body(environment, character)
	local original = AimGeometry.bodyModel(environment, character, true)
	if not original then return nil end

	local padding = environment.Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	local body = {parts = {}, detached = {}, rot = original.rot, nCore = original.nCore, rad = original.rad + 0.55}
	for _, part in original.parts do
		table.insert(body.parts, {rel = part.rel, half = part.half + padding, core = part.core})
	end
	if original.bcf then body.bcf, body.bhalf = original.bcf, original.bhalf + padding end
	return body
end

function KnifeAim.hypotheses(state, character, history, horizon, force)
	local context, aim = state.context, state.context.aim
	local environment = context.environment
	local now, cached = environment.os.clock(), state.hcache[character]
	if cached and not force and now - cached.at < 0.22 and cached.horizon >= horizon - 0.05 then return cached end

	local factor, shift = aim.k, aim.shift
	aim.k = AimMotion.speedFactor(environment, aim, history)
	aim.shift = AimCalibration.lagOf(context, aim, character)
	local time = history[#history].t
	local ok, models = pcall(AimMotion.hypotheses, context, aim, history,
		{time = time, duration = horizon, parameters = AimTarget.moveParams(context)})

	if ok and type(models) == "table" and #models > 0 then
		pcall(function()
			local trust = AimMotion.directionTrust(environment, aim, history, time)
			local affected = {md = true, mdE = true, mdL = true, mdNJ = true, mdv = true, mdJe = true, mdJl = true}
			if trust < 0.98 then
				for _, model in models do if affected[model.kind] then model.w *= math.max(trust, 0.03) end end
			end

			local velocity = AimGeometry.kinVelocity(environment, history, time, 0.08) or environment.Vector3.zero
			if horizon < 1 and (AimMotion.mode(environment, history) == "nr" or velocity.Magnitude > 28) then
				local trajectory = AimMotion.arcTrajectory(environment, history, time, horizon)
				if trajectory then
					local maximum = 0
					for _, model in models do maximum = math.max(maximum, model.w) end
					table.insert(models, {kind = "arc3", w = math.max(maximum * 0.8, 0.15), traj = trajectory})
				end
			end

			local anomaly = AimMotion.anomaly(aim, history, time)
			if anomaly then
				local previous = aim.lastTrust
				aim.lastTrust = trust
				models = AimPlan.resolve(environment, aim, history, {time = time, duration = horizon, hypotheses = models, anomaly = anomaly})
				aim.lastTrust = previous
			end

			local total = 0
			for _, model in models do total += model.w end
			if total > 0 then for _, model in models do model.w /= total end end
		end)
	end
	aim.k, aim.shift = factor, shift
	if not ok or type(models) ~= "table" or #models == 0 then return nil end

	table.sort(models, function(first, second) return first.w > second.w end)
	local result = {at = now, tNow = time, hyps = models, horizon = horizon, body = KnifeAim.body(environment, character)}
	state.hcache[character] = result
	return result
end

function KnifeAim.predict(state, character, origin, detail)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return nil end

	local position, speed = root.Position, state.speed
	local history, aim = state.hist[character], context.aim
	if aim and not aim.alive then aim = nil end
	local lead = math.clamp(state.lead / 100, 0, 3)
	local function result(point, score)
		if state.wall and KnifeAim.blocked(state, origin, point) then return nil end
		return point, score, (point - origin).Magnitude / speed
	end

	if not state.predict then return result(position, 0.6) end
	if not (aim and aim.alive and history and #history >= 8) then
		local sample = history and history[#history] or KnifeAim.sample(state, character)
		if not sample then return nil end
		local movement = environment.Vector3.new(sample.md.X, 0, sample.md.Z) * sample.ws
		local latency = (aim and (aim.L or 0.15) or KnifeAim.ping(context) + 0.1) * lead
		local predicted = sample.p
		for _ = 1, 5 do predicted = sample.p + movement * (latency + (predicted - origin).Magnitude / speed) end
		return result(predicted, 0.35)
	end

	local horizon = math.clamp((position - origin).Magnitude / speed + 0.6, 0.7, 2.2)
	local cache = KnifeAim.hypotheses(state, character, history, horizon, detail >= 1)
	if not cache then return result(position, 0.3) end

	local elapsed = math.clamp(environment.os.clock() - cache.tNow, 0, 0.5)
	local mode = AimMotion.mode(environment, history)
	local taus = AimCalibration.taus(context, aim, mode, nil, 1)
	if detail < 1 and #taus >= 5 then taus = {taus[2], taus[math.ceil(#taus / 2)], taus[#taus - 1]} end
	local totalTau = 0
	for index = 1, #taus do totalTau += taus[index].w end
	if totalTau <= 0 then return result(position, 0.3) end

	local paths, total = {}, 0
	for index, hypothesis in cache.hyps do
		if index > (detail >= 1 and 8 or 4) then break end
		for index = 1, #taus do
			local tau = taus[index]
			local weight = hypothesis.w * tau.w / totalTau
			table.insert(paths, {w = weight, traj = hypothesis.traj, latency = tau.tau + elapsed})
			total += weight
		end
	end
	if total <= 0 then return result(position, 0.3) end

	local candidates, mean = {}, environment.Vector3.zero
	local function add(point, weight)
		for _, candidate in candidates do
			if (candidate.p - point).Magnitude < 0.7 then candidate.w += weight; return end
		end
		table.insert(candidates, {p = point, w = weight})
	end
	for _, path in paths do
		local point = AimMotion.trajectoryAt(path.traj, path.latency)
		for _ = 1, 4 do point = AimMotion.trajectoryAt(path.traj, path.latency + (point - origin).Magnitude / speed) end
		add(point, path.w)
		mean += point * path.w
	end
	table.sort(candidates, function(first, second) return first.w > second.w end)
	while #candidates > (detail >= 1 and 6 or 3) do table.remove(candidates) end
	add(mean / total, 0.001)

	local function score(point)
		local direction = point - origin
		local distance = direction.Magnitude
		if distance < 0.5 then return 0 end
		direction /= distance
		local hits = 0
		for _, path in paths do
			local time = distance / speed
			local target = AimMotion.trajectoryAt(path.traj, path.latency + time)
			for _ = 1, 2 do
				time = math.max(0, (target - origin):Dot(direction) / speed)
				target = AimMotion.trajectoryAt(path.traj, path.latency + time)
			end
			local hit
			if cache.body then
				hit = AimGeometry.hitsBody(environment, {body = cache.body, position = target, origin = origin,
					direction = direction, distance = (target - origin).Magnitude + 3}) ~= nil
			end
			if not cache.body then
				local offset = target - origin
				hit = (offset - direction * math.max(0, offset:Dot(direction))).Magnitude < 1.9
			end
			if hit then hits += path.w end
		end
		return hits / total
	end

	for _, candidate in candidates do candidate.s = score(candidate.p) end
	table.sort(candidates, function(first, second)
		if math.abs(first.s - second.s) > 0.02 then return first.s > second.s end
		return first.w > second.w
	end)
	local best
	for _, candidate in candidates do
		if not state.wall or not KnifeAim.blocked(state, origin, candidate.p) then best = candidate; break end
	end
	if not best then return nil end

	if detail >= 1 and best.s < 0.9 then
		local direction = best.p - origin
		if direction.Magnitude > 1 then
			direction = direction.Unit
			local side = direction:Cross(environment.Vector3.yAxis)
			side = side.Magnitude > 0.001 and side.Unit or environment.Vector3.xAxis
			local up = side:Cross(direction)
			for _, offset in {side * 0.7, -side * 0.7, up * 0.7, -up * 0.7} do
				local point = best.p + offset
				local chance = score(point)
				if chance > best.s + 0.03 and (not state.wall or not KnifeAim.blocked(state, origin, point)) then
					best = {p = point, s = chance, w = best.w}
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local point = lead ~= 1 and position + (best.p - position) * lead or best.p
	return point, best.s, (point - origin).Magnitude / speed
end

function KnifeAim.aim(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local character = context.player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not state.on or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not MurderFeature.isMurderer(state.murder, context.roles()) then return nil end

	local now = environment.os.clock()
	if state.cache and now - (state.cacheT or 0) < 0.035 then return state.cache end
	local origin = KnifeAim.origin(state)
	if not origin then return nil end

	local candidates, started = KnifeAim.candidates(state, origin, context.roles()), environment.os.clock()
	for index = 1, math.min(#candidates, 4) do
		local candidate = candidates[index]
		local point, score = KnifeAim.predict(state, candidate.c, origin, 1)
		if not point then continue end

		state.cur, state.curScore, state.curPoint = candidate.c, score, point
		state.cache, state.cacheT = point, now
		state.lastAim = {t = now, O = origin, P = point, c = candidate.c, sc = score}
		state.lastMs = (environment.os.clock() - started) * 1000
		return point
	end
	state.cur = nil
	return nil
end

function KnifeAim.marker(state, character, text)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local root = state.show and character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		if state.marker then state.marker.Enabled = false end
		return
	end

	if not state.marker or not state.marker.Parent then
		local marker = environment.Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		marker.Name, marker.Size = "PulseKnifeTarget", environment.UDim2.fromOffset(90, 26)
		marker.StudsOffsetWorldSpace, marker.AlwaysOnTop, marker.ResetOnSpawn = environment.Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0), true, false
		local label = environment.Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name, label.BackgroundTransparency, label.Size = "L", 1, environment.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.Font, label.TextSize, label.TextColor3 = environment.Enum.Font.GothamBold, 15, environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 70)
		label.TextStrokeTransparency, label.Parent = 0.35, marker
		pcall(function() marker.Parent = context.coreGui end)
		if marker.Parent ~= context.coreGui then pcall(function() marker.Parent = context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end) end
		pcall(function() environment.getgenv().__pulseBBMirror.add(marker) end)
		state.marker = marker
	end

	state.marker.Adornee, state.marker.Enabled = root, true
	local label = state.marker:FindFirstChild("L")
	if label then label.Text = text end
end

function KnifeAim.throw(state, point)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(state.murder, context.player.Character)
	local events = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Events")
	local remote = events and events:FindFirstChild("KnifeThrown")
	local handle = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if not remote or not handle then return false end

	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	pcall(function()
		local antiAim = rawget(globals, "__pulseAntiAim")
		if not antiAim or not antiAim.desyncAt or environment.os.clock() - antiAim.desyncAt >= 0.2 then return end
		globals.__pulseShotHold = math.max(tonumber(globals.__pulseShotHold) or 0, environment.os.clock() + 0.45)
		local started = environment.os.clock()
		while environment.os.clock() - started < (antiAim.fireDelay or 0.05) do context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
	end)

	state.lastThrow, state.throws = environment.os.clock(), state.throws + 1
	globals.__pulseKnifeBypass = true
	pcall(function() remote:FireServer(handle.CFrame, environment.CFrame.new(point)) end)
	return true
end

function KnifeAim.step(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local character = context.player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (state.on or state.auto) or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0
		or not MurderFeature.isMurderer(state.murder, context.roles()) then
		state.cur = nil
		KnifeAim.marker(state, nil)
		return
	end

	local origin = KnifeAim.origin(state)
	if not origin then return end
	local candidates = KnifeAim.candidates(state, origin, context.roles())
	local selected, point, score
	for index = 1, math.min(#candidates, 2) do
		local candidate = candidates[index]
		point, score = KnifeAim.predict(state, candidate.c, origin, 0.5)
		if point then selected = candidate; break end
	end
	if not selected then
		state.cur = nil
		KnifeAim.marker(state, nil)
		return
	end

	state.cur, state.curScore, state.curPoint = selected.c, score, point
	KnifeAim.marker(state, selected.c, math.floor(score * 100 + 0.5) .. "%")
	if not state.auto then return end

	local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(state.murder, character)
	local throwSpeed = knife and tonumber(knife:GetAttribute("ThrowSpeed")) or 0.7
	local cooldown = math.max(1.45, throwSpeed * 2 + 0.08)
	if environment.os.clock() - state.lastThrow < cooldown or selected.dist > state.autoRange or score < state.autoMin / 100 then return end
	if not knife then MurderFeature.ready(state.murder, context.roles()); return end

	local precise, chance = KnifeAim.predict(state, selected.c, origin, 1)
	if not precise or chance < state.autoMin / 100 then return end
	state.lastAim = {t = environment.os.clock(), O = origin, P = precise, c = selected.c, sc = chance}
	KnifeAim.throw(state, precise)
end

function KnifeAim.installHook(state)
	if state.hooked then return end
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	pcall(function()
		local services = context.storage:FindFirstChild("ClientServices")
		local module = services and services:FindFirstChild("WeaponService")
		local weapons = module and environment.require(module)
		if not weapons then return end

		local previous = globals.__pulseThrowWS
		local oldMouse = previous and previous.origMouse or weapons.GetMouseTargetCFrame
		local oldTarget = previous and previous.origTarget or weapons.GetTargetPosition
		local function mouse(self, ...)
			local ok, point = pcall(KnifeAim.aim, state)
			if ok and point then return environment.CFrame.new(point) end
			return oldMouse(self, ...)
		end
		local function target(self, ...)
			local ok, point = pcall(KnifeAim.aim, state)
			if ok and point then return environment.CFrame.new(point) end
			return oldTarget(self, ...)
		end
		weapons.GetMouseTargetCFrame, weapons.GetTargetPosition = mouse, target
		if weapons.GetMouseTargetCFrame == mouse and weapons.GetTargetPosition == target then
			globals.__pulseThrowWS = {mouse = mouse, tgt = target, origMouse = oldMouse, origTarget = oldTarget}
			state.hooked = true
		end
	end)
end

function KnifeAim.controls(state)
	local section = state.context.section
	section:Header("Knife Throw")
	section:Toggle({Text = "Knife Throw Aimbot", Default = false, Callback = function(value)
		state.on, state.cache = not not value, nil
		if state.on then KnifeAim.installHook(state) end
	end, Settings = function()
		section:Dropdown({Text = "Target Mode", Default = "Smart", Options = {
			{code = "Smart", label = "Smart"}, {code = "Crosshair", label = "Crosshair"},
			{code = "Nearest", label = "Nearest"}, {code = "Sheriff", label = "Sheriff First"},
		}, Callback = function(value) state.mode = value end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Max Distance", Min = 30, Max = 400, Default = 250, Decimals = 0, Suffix = " st",
			Callback = function(value) state.maxDist = value end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Aim FOV", Min = 10, Max = 360, Default = 360, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "В°",
			Callback = function(value) state.fov = value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Wall Check", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.wall, state.cache = not not value, nil end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Predict Movement", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.predict, state.cache = not not value, nil end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Lead %", Min = 0, Max = 150, Default = 100, Decimals = 0,
			Callback = function(value) state.lead, state.cache = value, nil end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Sticky Target", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.sticky = not not value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Target Marker", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.show = not not value end})
	end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Auto Throw", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.auto = not not value end,
		Settings = function()
			section:Slider({Text = "Auto Min Chance %", Min = 20, Max = 95, Default = 55, Decimals = 0,
				Callback = function(value) state.autoMin = value end})
			section:Slider({Text = "Auto Range", Min = 20, Max = 200, Default = 70, Decimals = 0, Suffix = " st",
				Callback = function(value) state.autoRange = value end})
		end})
end

function KnifeAim.install(context, murder)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local state = KnifeAim.create(context, murder)
	globals.__pulseKnifeAim, globals.__pulseKnifeBypass = state, true
	state.aim = function() return KnifeAim.aim(state) end
	state.solve = function(character, origin, detail) return KnifeAim.predict(state, character, origin, detail) end
	state.pick = function(origin, roles) return KnifeAim.candidates(state, origin, roles) end
	state.origin = function() return KnifeAim.origin(state) end

	local lastManual = 0
	globals.__pulseThrowKnife = function()
		if environment.os.clock() - lastManual < 0.2 or not MurderFeature.ready(murder, context.roles()) then return false end
		local enabled = state.on
		state.on, state.cache = true, nil
		local ok, point = pcall(KnifeAim.aim, state)
		state.on = enabled
		if not ok or not point then return false end
		lastManual = environment.os.clock()
		return KnifeAim.throw(state, point)
	end

	pcall(function()
		if environment.isfile("SeniorHubSources/mm2_knife.json") then
			local saved = context.http:JSONDecode(environment.readfile("SeniorHubSources/mm2_knife.json"))
			if type(saved) == "table" and tonumber(saved.speed) then state.speed = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.speed), 85, 108) end
		end
	end)
	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, function() pcall(KnifeAim.record, state) end)
	context.connect(context.workspace.DescendantAdded, function(part)
		if part.Name ~= "BladePosition" or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
		environment.task.spawn(function()
			local samples = {}
			for _ = 1, 30 do
				context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				if not part.Parent then break end
				table.insert(samples, {environment.os.clock(), part.Position})
			end
			if #samples < 12 then return end
			local moving = {}
			for index = 2, #samples do
				if (samples[index][2] - samples[index - 1][2]).Magnitude > 0.02 then table.insert(moving, index) end
			end
			if #moving < 5 then return end
			local first, last = samples[moving[2]], samples[moving[#moving]]
			local elapsed = last[1] - first[1]
			if elapsed < 0.15 then return end
			local speed = (last[2] - first[2]).Magnitude / elapsed
			if speed <= 85 or speed >= 108 then return end
			state.speed, state.speedN = state.speed * 0.9 + speed * 0.1, state.speedN + 1
			if state.speedN % 5 ~= 0 then return end
			pcall(function()
				if not environment.isfolder("SeniorHubSources") then environment.makefolder("SeniorHubSources") end
				environment.writefile("SeniorHubSources/mm2_knife.json", context.http:JSONEncode({speed = state.speed}))
			end)
		end)
	end)
	KnifeAim.controls(state)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		while context.isAlive() do
			environment.task.wait(0.12)
			pcall(KnifeAim.step, state)
		end
	end)
	return state, function()
		state.on, state.auto = false, false
		if state.marker then pcall(function() state.marker:Destroy() end) end
	end
end
