function CombatTracer.raycastParams(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	if not state.raycastParams then
		state.raycastParams = environment.RaycastParams.new()
		state.raycastParams.FilterType = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		pcall(function() state.raycastParams.RespectCanCollide = true end)
	end
	if environment.os.clock() - (state.raycastAt or -10) <= 1 then return state.raycastParams end

	state.raycastAt = environment.os.clock()
	local excluded = {}
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if player.Character then table.insert(excluded, player.Character) end
	end
	if context.workspace.CurrentCamera then table.insert(excluded, context.workspace.CurrentCamera) end
	state.raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	return state.raycastParams
end

function CombatTracer.obstacle(state, start, finish)
	local delta = finish - start
	if delta.Magnitude < 0.05 then return nil end

	local direction = delta.Unit
	for _ = 1, 5 do
		local hit = state.context.workspace:Raycast(start, finish - start, CombatTracer.raycastParams(state))
		if not hit then return nil end

		local transparency = 0
		pcall(function() transparency = hit.Instance.Transparency end)
		if transparency < 0.85 then return hit end
		start = hit.Position + direction * 0.05
		if (finish - start):Dot(direction) <= 0 then return nil end
	end
	return nil
end

function CombatTracer.simplify(state, points)
	if #points <= 2 then return points end
	local result, index = {points[1]}, 1
	while index < #points do
		local nextIndex = #points
		while nextIndex > index + 1 and CombatTracer.obstacle(state, points[index], points[nextIndex]) do nextIndex -= 1 end
		table.insert(result, points[nextIndex])
		index = nextIndex
	end
	return result
end

function CombatTracer.smooth(points)
	if #points <= 2 then return points end
	local result, length = {points[1]}, 0
	for index = 1, #points - 1 do length += (points[index + 1] - points[index]).Magnitude end

	local spacing = math.max(2.2, length / 44)
	for index = 1, #points - 1 do
		local before, start = points[math.max(1, index - 1)], points[index]
		local finish, after = points[index + 1], points[math.min(#points, index + 2)]
		local steps = math.clamp(math.floor((finish - start).Magnitude / spacing + 0.5), 2, 16)
		for step = 1, steps do
			local t = step / steps
			local point = (start * 2 + (finish - before) * t + (before * 2 - start * 5 + finish * 4 - after) * t ^ 2
				+ (start * 3 - before - finish * 3 + after) * t ^ 3) * 0.5
			table.insert(result, point)
		end
	end
	result[#result] = points[#points]
	return result
end

function CombatTracer.detour(state, start, finish)
	if not CombatTracer.obstacle(state, start, finish) then return {start, finish}, "direct" end
	local vector = state.context.environment.Vector3
	local delta, direction = finish - start, (finish - start).Unit
	local side = direction:Cross(vector.yAxis)
	side = side.Magnitude < 0.1 and vector.xAxis or side.Unit
	local up = side:Cross(direction).Unit
	local offsets = {up, side, -side, (up + side).Unit, (up - side).Unit, -up}
	local radii, positions = {3, 6, 10, 15, 22, 32}, {0.5, 0.35, 0.65, 0.2, 0.8}
	local best, bestLength

	for _, radius in radii do
		for _, fraction in positions do
			for _, offset in offsets do
				local point = start + delta * fraction + offset * radius
				local length = (point - start).Magnitude + (finish - point).Magnitude
				if bestLength and length >= bestLength then continue end
				if CombatTracer.obstacle(state, start, point) or CombatTracer.obstacle(state, point, finish) then continue end
				best, bestLength = point, length
			end
		end
		if best then return {start, best, finish}, "one" end
	end

	local firstHit = CombatTracer.obstacle(state, start, finish)
	local lastHit = CombatTracer.obstacle(state, finish, start)
	if not firstHit or not lastHit then return nil, "none" end

	local firstPoints, lastPoints = {}, {}
	for _, radius in radii do
		for _, offset in offsets do
			local first = firstHit.Position - direction * 1.5 + offset * radius
			local last = lastHit.Position + direction * 1.5 + offset * radius
			if not CombatTracer.obstacle(state, start, first) then table.insert(firstPoints, first) end
			if not CombatTracer.obstacle(state, last, finish) then table.insert(lastPoints, last) end
		end
	end

	local checked, pair = 0, nil
	for _, first in firstPoints do
		for _, last in lastPoints do
			local length = (first - start).Magnitude + (last - first).Magnitude + (finish - last).Magnitude
			if bestLength and length >= bestLength then continue end
			checked += 1
			if checked > 500 then break end
			if not CombatTracer.obstacle(state, first, last) then bestLength, pair = length, {first, last} end
		end
		if checked > 500 then break end
	end
	if pair then return {start, pair[1], pair[2], finish}, "two" end
	return nil, "none"
end

function CombatTracer.navigation(state, start, finish)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local ok, points = pcall(function()
		local path = context.pathfinding:CreatePath({AgentRadius = 1.5, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true,
			AgentCanClimb = true, WaypointSpacing = 6})
		path:ComputeAsync(start - environment.Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), finish - environment.Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
		if path.Status ~= environment.Enum.PathStatus.Success then return nil end

		local result = {start}
		for _, waypoint in path:GetWaypoints() do table.insert(result, waypoint.Position + environment.Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) end
		table.insert(result, finish)
		return result
	end)
	if not ok or type(points) ~= "table" then return nil end

	local length = 0
	for index = 1, #points - 1 do length += (points[index + 1] - points[index]).Magnitude end
	if length > (finish - start).Magnitude * 4 + 40 then return nil end
	return points
end

function CombatTracer.pathAt(path, distance)
	local points, lengths = path.pts, path.cum
	if distance <= 0 then return points[1], 1 end
	if distance >= path.L then return points[#points], #points - 1 end

	local low, high = 1, #lengths
	while high - low > 1 do
		local middle = (low + high) // 2
		if lengths[middle] <= distance then low = middle; continue end
		high = middle
	end
	local span = lengths[low + 1] - lengths[low]
	local fraction = span > 0 and (distance - lengths[low]) / span or 0
	return points[low]:Lerp(points[low + 1], fraction), low
end

function CombatTracer.create(context)
	local color = context.environment.Color3
	local state = {context = context, on = false, method = "Classic", style = "Energy",
		col = color.fromRGB(110, 190, 255), col2 = color.fromRGB(255, 90, 210), rainbow = false, width = 100,
		speed = 520, life = 1.2, impact = true, muzzle = true, others = false, live = {}, pool = {}, made = {}, log = {}}
	state.knife = {on = false, style = "Energy", col = color.fromRGB(255, 60, 90), col2 = color.fromRGB(255, 180, 70),
		rainbow = false, width = 100, life = 1.2, impact = true, flash = true, others = false, live = {}, log = {}}
	state.styles = TRACER_STYLE_NAMES
	return state
end

function CombatTracer.acquire(state)
	local environment, terrain = state.context.environment, state.context.workspace.Terrain
	local item = table.remove(state.pool)
	if item and item.b.Parent and item.a0.Parent and item.a1.Parent then return item end

	local first = environment.Instance.new("Attachment")
	first.Name, first.Parent = "PulseTracerA", terrain
	local second = environment.Instance.new("Attachment")
	second.Name, second.Parent = "PulseTracerB", terrain
	local beam = environment.Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Name, beam.Attachment0, beam.Attachment1 = "PulseTracer", first, second
	beam.FaceCamera, beam.LightEmission, beam.LightInfluence, beam.Enabled, beam.Parent = true, 1, 0, false, terrain
	item = {a0 = first, a1 = second, b = beam}
	table.insert(state.made, item)
	return item
end

function CombatTracer.release(state, item)
	item.b.Enabled = false
	if #state.pool < 160 then table.insert(state.pool, item); return end
	pcall(function() item.b:Destroy(); item.a0:Destroy(); item.a1:Destroy() end)
end

function CombatTracer.destroyPath(state, path)
	for _, row in path.rows do for _, item in row do CombatTracer.release(state, item) end end
	if path.head then pcall(function() path.head:Destroy() end) end
end

function CombatTracer.particle(state, parent, properties)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local particle = environment.Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	particle.Rate, particle.LightEmission, particle.LightInfluence = 0, 1, 0
	particle.Speed, particle.Rotation, particle.RotSpeed = environment.NumberRange.new(0), environment.NumberRange.new(0), environment.NumberRange.new(0)
	for key, value in properties do pcall(function() particle[key] = value end) end

	local stretch = state.context.configuration.ui and tonumber(state.context.configuration.ui.stretch) or 0
	if stretch > 0 then
		local squash = -math.log(math.max(0.1, 1 - stretch / 100 * 0.6), 2)
		pcall(function() particle.Squash = environment.NumberSequence.new(math.clamp(squash, -3, 3)) end)
		particle.Rotation, particle.RotSpeed = environment.NumberRange.new(0), environment.NumberRange.new(0)
	end
	particle.Parent = parent
	return particle
end

function CombatTracer.attachment(state, position)
	local attachment = state.context.environment.Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name, attachment.WorldPosition, attachment.Parent = "PulseTracerFx", position, state.context.workspace.Terrain
	return attachment
end

function CombatTracer.effect(state, position, color, impact)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local attachment = CombatTracer.attachment(state, position)
	local white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local colors = environment.ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(white, impact and 0.6 or 0.55), color)
	local sequence, keypoint = environment.NumberSequence, environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint
	local function size(first, last) return sequence.new({keypoint.new(0, first), keypoint.new(1, last)}) end
	local function transparency(first) return sequence.new({keypoint.new(0, first), keypoint.new(1, 1)}) end

	CombatTracer.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = TRACER_TEXTURES.star, Color = colors,
		Size = size(impact and 3.6 or 2.4, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(impact and 0.2 or 0.1),
		Brightness = 4, ZOffset = 1}):Emit(1)
	if impact then
		CombatTracer.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = TRACER_TEXTURES.ring, Color = colors, Size = size(0.4, 5.5),
			Transparency = transparency(0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.35), Brightness = 3}):Emit(1)
		CombatTracer.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = TRACER_TEXTURES.dot, Color = colors, Size = size(0.45, 0),
			Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(12, 30), SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(180, 180),
			Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, -45, 0), Drag = 3, Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.6), Brightness = 3}):Emit(18)
	end
	CombatTracer.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = TRACER_TEXTURES.soft, Color = colors,
		Size = size(impact and 2.6 or 1.8, impact and 0.6 or 0.4), Transparency = transparency(impact and 0.3 or 0.2),
		Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(impact and 0.25 or 0.14), Brightness = impact and 2 or 3}):Emit(1)

	local light = environment.Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness, light.Shadows, light.Parent = color, impact and 12 or 9, 3.5, false, attachment
	pcall(function()
		local easing = environment.TweenInfo.new(impact and 0.3 or 0.12, environment.Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, environment.Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		context.tweenService:Create(light, easing, {Brightness = 0}):Play()
	end)
	environment.task.delay(impact and 1.2 or 0.5, function() pcall(function() attachment:Destroy() end) end)
end

function CombatTracer.colors(state, options)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local rainbow = options.rainbow
	if rainbow == nil then rainbow = state.rainbow end
	if rainbow then
		local hue = environment.os.clock() * 0.18 % 1
		return environment.Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.7, 1), environment.Color3.fromHSV((hue + 0.18) % 1, 0.75, 1)
	end
	return options.col or state.col, options.col2 or state.col2
end

function CombatTracer.spawn(state, points, options)
	options = options or {}
	if #points < 2 then return nil end
	while #state.live >= 8 do CombatTracer.destroyPath(state, table.remove(state.live, 1)) end

	local lengths = {0}
	for index = 2, #points do lengths[index] = lengths[index - 1] + (points[index] - points[index - 1]).Magnitude end
	local length = lengths[#lengths]
	if length < 0.5 then return nil end

	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local style = TRACER_STYLES[options.style or state.style] or TRACER_STYLES.Energy
	local firstColor, secondColor = CombatTracer.colors(state, options)
	local stretch = context.configuration.ui and tonumber(context.configuration.ui.stretch) or 0
	local width = (options.width or state.width or 100) / 100 / math.max(0.3, 1 - math.max(0, stretch) / 100 * 0.6)
	local rows = {}
	for layerIndex, layer in style do
		local row = {}
		for index = 1, #points - 1 do
			local item = CombatTracer.acquire(state)
			local beam = item.b
			beam.Texture, beam.TextureSpeed, beam.Brightness = TRACER_TEXTURES[layer.tex], layer.spd, layer.br
			beam.TextureMode = layer.wrap and environment.Enum.TextureMode.Wrap or environment.Enum.TextureMode.Stretch
			beam.TextureLength = layer.wrap and layer.wrap * width or 1
			beam.Segments, beam.ZOffset = #points == 2 and 24 or 4, layerIndex * 0.05
			item.a0.WorldPosition, item.a1.WorldPosition, beam.Enabled = points[index], points[index + 1], false
			row[index] = item
		end
		rows[layerIndex] = row
	end

	local path = {pts = points, cum = lengths, L = length, t0 = environment.os.clock(), rows = rows, style = style,
		col = firstColor, col2 = secondColor, wk = width, speed = math.max(40, options.speed or state.speed or 520),
		life = math.max(0.2, options.life or state.life or 1.2), impact = options.impact, landed = false,
		tail = options.tail or math.clamp(length * 0.45, 8, 60), clearHead = options.clearHead}
	if options.muzzle then pcall(CombatTracer.effect, state, points[1], firstColor, false) end

	local head = CombatTracer.attachment(state, points[1])
	local white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	CombatTracer.particle(state, head, {Texture = TRACER_TEXTURES.dot, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(firstColor:Lerp(white, 0.5)),
		Size = environment.NumberSequence.new(2.8 * width), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(length / path.speed + 0.05),
		LockedToPart = true, Brightness = 5, ZOffset = 1}):Emit(1)
	CombatTracer.particle(state, head, {Texture = TRACER_TEXTURES.star, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(firstColor:Lerp(white, 0.35)),
		Size = environment.NumberSequence.new(3.4 * width), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(length / path.speed + 0.05),
		LockedToPart = true, Brightness = 4, ZOffset = 1.1}):Emit(1)
	path.trail = CombatTracer.particle(state, head, {Texture = TRACER_TEXTURES.dot,
		Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(firstColor:Lerp(white, 0.3), secondColor),
		Size = environment.NumberSequence.new({environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.32 * width), environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)}),
		Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(1.5, 5), SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(180, 180), Drag = 4,
		Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.42), Rate = 70, Brightness = 3})
	path.head = head
	table.insert(state.live, path)
	if options.cb then environment.task.spawn(options.cb, path) end
	return path
end

function CombatTracer.updatePath(state, path, now)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local elapsed = now - path.t0
	local headDistance = math.min(path.L, elapsed * path.speed)
	local tailDistance = elapsed * path.speed - path.tail
	local travelTime = path.L / path.speed
	if not path.landed and headDistance >= path.L then
		path.landed = true
		if path.trail then path.trail.Rate = 0 end
		if path.clearHead and path.head then
			for _, particle in path.head:GetChildren() do
				if particle:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and particle ~= path.trail then pcall(function() particle:Clear() end) end
			end
		end
		if path.impact then pcall(CombatTracer.effect, state, path.pts[#path.pts], path.col, true) end
	end

	local fade = 0.38
	if elapsed > travelTime then fade *= math.clamp(1 - (elapsed - travelTime) / path.life, 0, 1) ^ 1.5 end
	if elapsed > travelTime + path.life and tailDistance >= path.L then return false end

	local position = CombatTracer.pathAt(path, headDistance)
	path.head.WorldPosition = position
	local visibleLength = math.max(headDistance - tailDistance, 0.01)
	local function opacity(distance)
		local value = 0
		if distance >= tailDistance and distance <= headDistance + 0.001 then value = ((distance - tailDistance) / visibleLength) ^ 1.4 end
		return math.max(value, fade)
	end
	local white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	for layerIndex, row in path.rows do
		local layer = path.style[layerIndex]
		for index, item in row do
			local from, to = path.cum[index], path.cum[index + 1]
			local beam = item.b
			if from >= headDistance or fade <= 0.004 and to <= tailDistance then beam.Enabled = false; continue end

			local limit = math.min(to, headDistance)
			item.a1.WorldPosition = to > headDistance and position or path.pts[index + 1]
			local keys, count = {}, #path.pts == 2 and 9 or 2
			for key = 0, count - 1 do
				local fraction = key / (count - 1)
				local distance = from + (limit - from) * fraction
				table.insert(keys, environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(fraction, math.clamp(1 - opacity(distance) * layer.a, 0, 1)))
			end
			beam.Transparency = environment.NumberSequence.new(keys)
			beam.Width0 = 0.9 * layer.w * path.wk * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.max(opacity(from), 0))
			beam.Width1 = 0.9 * layer.w * path.wk * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.max(opacity(limit), 0))
			local first = path.col2:Lerp(path.col, from / path.L):Lerp(white, layer.mix)
			local second = path.col2:Lerp(path.col, limit / path.L):Lerp(white, layer.mix)
			beam.Color, beam.Enabled = environment.ColorSequence.new(first, second), true
		end
	end
	return true
end

function CombatTracer.update(state)
	local now = state.context.environment.os.clock()
	local index = 1
	while index <= #state.live do
		local path = state.live[index]
		if CombatTracer.updatePath(state, path, now) then index += 1; continue end
		CombatTracer.destroyPath(state, path)
		table.remove(state.live, index)
	end
end

function CombatTracer.build(state, start, finish, impact, muzzle, options)
	options = options or {}
	local delta = finish - start
	if delta.Magnitude > 700 then finish = start + delta.Unit * 700 end
	local renderOptions = {impact = impact, muzzle = muzzle, speed = options.speed, life = options.life, cb = options.cb}
	if state.method ~= "Path Finder" then return CombatTracer.spawn(state, {start, finish}, renderOptions) end

	local points = CombatTracer.detour(state, start, finish)
	if points then return CombatTracer.spawn(state, CombatTracer.smooth(CombatTracer.simplify(state, points)), renderOptions) end

	state.context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		local path = CombatTracer.navigation(state, start, finish)
		if path then path = CombatTracer.smooth(CombatTracer.simplify(state, path)) end
		CombatTracer.spawn(state, path or {start, finish}, renderOptions)
	end)
end

function CombatTracer.log(state, message)
	table.insert(state.log, string.format("%s %.2f %s", state.context.environment.os.date("%H:%M:%S"), state.context.environment.os.clock(), message))
	if #state.log > 60 then table.remove(state.log, 1) end
	pcall(state.context.environment.writefile, "SeniorHubSources/tracer_log.txt", table.concat(state.log, "\n"))
end

function CombatTracer.gunOrigin(state, character, tool, origin)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local attachment = root and root:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
	if attachment then return attachment.WorldPosition end
	if environment.typeof(tool) == "Instance" and tool:IsA("BasePart") then return tool.Position end
	if environment.typeof(origin) == "Vector3" then return origin end
	return nil
end

function CombatTracer.onGunFired(state, tool, origin, finish, hit)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	if not state.on or environment.typeof(finish) ~= "Vector3" then return end

	local character = environment.typeof(tool) == "Instance" and tool or nil
	while character and not (character:IsA("Model") and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do character = character.Parent end
	local own = character ~= nil and character == context.player.Character
	if not own and not state.others then return end

	local start = CombatTracer.gunOrigin(state, character, tool, origin)
	if not start then return end
	local now, name = environment.os.clock(), character and character.Name or "?"
	local distance, gap = (finish - start).Magnitude, state.lastShots[name] and now - state.lastShots[name] or 99
	local skip = distance < 5 and "short" or gap < 2.4 and "repeat" or nil
	local startDistance = environment.typeof(origin) == "Vector3" and math.floor((origin - start).Magnitude) or -1
	local hitName = environment.typeof(hit) == "Instance" and hit.Name or "-"
	CombatTracer.log(state, string.format("%s d=%d gap=%.2f s0=%d hit=%s%s", own and "ME" or "OTHER",
		math.floor(distance), math.min(gap, 99), startDistance, hitName, skip and " SKIP " .. skip or ""))
	if skip then return end

	state.lastShots[name] = now
	CombatTracer.build(state, start, finish, state.impact, state.muzzle)
end

function CombatTracer.knifeOptions(state, options)
	local knife = state.knife
	local result = {style = knife.style, col = knife.col, col2 = knife.col2, rainbow = knife.rainbow, width = knife.width,
		speed = 96, life = knife.life, clearHead = true, tail = 40}
	for key, value in options or {} do result[key] = value end
	return result
end

function CombatTracer.knifeOwner(state, projectile)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local link = projectile:FindFirstChild("HandleLink") or projectile:WaitForChild("HandleLink", 2)
	local handle = link and link.Value
	if environment.typeof(handle) ~= "Instance" then return nil, nil end

	local character = handle
	while character and not (character:IsA("Model") and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do character = character.Parent end
	if character then return state.context.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character), handle end

	local backpack = handle:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Backpack")
	local owner = backpack and backpack.Parent
	return owner and owner:IsA("Player") and owner or nil, handle
end

function CombatTracer.knifeWall(state, origin, direction, projectile)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local params = environment.RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	pcall(function() params.RespectCanCollide = true end)
	local excluded = {}
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do if player.Character then table.insert(excluded, player.Character) end end
	if context.workspace.CurrentCamera then table.insert(excluded, context.workspace.CurrentCamera) end
	table.insert(excluded, projectile)
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded

	local start, remaining = origin, 600
	for _ = 1, 6 do
		local hit = context.workspace:Raycast(start, direction * remaining, params)
		if not hit then return nil end
		local transparency = 0
		pcall(function() transparency = hit.Instance.Transparency end)
		if transparency < 0.85 then return hit.Position end

		remaining -= (hit.Position - start).Magnitude + 0.05
		start = hit.Position + direction * 0.05
		if remaining <= 0 then return nil end
	end
	return nil
end

function CombatTracer.knifeLog(state, message)
	local log = state.knife.log
	table.insert(log, string.format("%.2f %s", state.context.environment.os.clock(), message))
	if #log > 30 then table.remove(log, 1) end
end

function CombatTracer.onKnife(state, projectile)
	local knife, context = state.knife, state.context
	local environment = context.environment
	if not knife.on then return end
	local owner, handle = CombatTracer.knifeOwner(state, projectile)
	local own = owner == context.player
	if not own and not knife.others then return end

	local blade = projectile:FindFirstChild("BladePosition") or projectile:WaitForChild("BladePosition", 2)
	local visual = projectile:FindFirstChild("KnifeVisual") or projectile:WaitForChild("KnifeVisual", 0.5)
	local direction = visual and visual:GetAttribute("Direction")
	if environment.typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then direction = projectile:GetAttribute("Direction") end
	if environment.typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" or direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
	direction = direction.Unit

	local part = visual and visual:IsA("BasePart") and visual or blade and blade:IsA("BasePart") and blade
	if not part then return end
	local now, position = environment.os.clock(), part.Position
	local ahead = 0
	if environment.typeof(handle) == "Instance" and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
		ahead = math.clamp((position - handle.Position):Dot(direction), 0, 15)
	end
	local origin = position - direction * ahead
	local wall = CombatTracer.knifeWall(state, origin, direction, projectile)
	local path = CombatTracer.spawn(state, {origin, wall or origin + direction * 600},
		CombatTracer.knifeOptions(state, {impact = wall ~= nil and knife.impact, muzzle = knife.flash}))
	if not path then return end

	path.t0, path.kObj, path.kBlade = now - ahead / path.speed, projectile, blade
	path.kOrigin, path.kDir, path.kLast = origin, direction, 0
	table.insert(knife.live, path)
	CombatTracer.knifeLog(state, string.format("%s d0=%.1f wall=%s", own and "ME" or "OTHER", ahead,
		wall and math.floor((wall - origin).Magnitude) or "-"))
end

function CombatTracer.finishKnife(state, path, distance)
	if path.kDone then return end
	path.kDone = true
	distance = math.clamp(distance, 0.5, path.L)
	if distance < path.L - 1 then
		local finish = path.kOrigin + path.kDir * distance
		path.pts[#path.pts], path.cum[#path.cum], path.L, path.impact = finish, distance, distance, state.knife.impact
		if path.landed and state.knife.impact then pcall(CombatTracer.effect, state, finish, path.col, true) end
	end
	CombatTracer.knifeLog(state, string.format("END s=%.1f", distance))
end

function CombatTracer.updateKnives(state)
	local now, knife = state.context.environment.os.clock(), state.knife
	for index = #knife.live, 1, -1 do
		local path = knife.live[index]
		local ok = pcall(function()
			local blade = path.kBlade
			if blade and blade.Parent then path.kLast = math.max(path.kLast, (blade.Position - path.kOrigin):Dot(path.kDir)) end
			local exists = path.kObj.Parent ~= nil and (blade == nil or blade.Parent ~= nil)
			local elapsed = now - path.t0
			if not exists then CombatTracer.finishKnife(state, path, math.max(path.kLast + 0.6, 0.5)); return end
			if elapsed > 8 then CombatTracer.finishKnife(state, path, elapsed * path.speed); return end
			if path.landed and path.L < 599 and elapsed > path.L / path.speed + 0.4 then
				path.pts[#path.pts], path.cum[#path.cum], path.L = path.kOrigin + path.kDir * 600, 600, 600
				path.landed, path.impact = false, false
				if path.trail then path.trail.Rate = 70 end
				CombatTracer.knifeLog(state, "EXTEND")
			end
		end)
		if not ok or path.kDone then table.remove(knife.live, index) end
	end
end

function CombatTracer.hideInterface(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local saved = {guis = {}, core = {}, mouse = context.inputService.MouseIconEnabled, glass = {}, fx = {}}
	local playerGui = context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	local containers = {playerGui, context.coreGui}
	for _, container in containers do
		if not container then continue end
		for _, gui in container:GetChildren() do
			if not gui:IsA("LayerCollector") or not gui.Enabled then continue end
			if pcall(function() gui.Enabled = false end) then table.insert(saved.guis, gui) end
		end
	end
	for _, kind in environment.Enum.CoreGuiType:GetEnumItems() do
		if kind == environment.Enum.CoreGuiType.All then continue end
		local ok, enabled = pcall(function() return context.starterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(kind) end)
		if ok then saved.core[kind] = enabled end
	end
	pcall(function() context.starterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(environment.Enum.CoreGuiType.All, false) end)
	local ok, topbar = pcall(function() return context.starterGui:GetCore("TopbarEnabled") end)
	if ok and topbar ~= false then
		saved.topbar = true
		pcall(function() context.starterGui:SetCore("TopbarEnabled", false) end)
	end
	pcall(function() context.inputService.MouseIconEnabled = false end)

	return saved
end

function CombatTracer.restoreInterface(state, saved)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	for _, gui in saved.guis do pcall(function() if gui.Parent then gui.Enabled = true end end) end
	for kind, enabled in saved.core do pcall(function() context.starterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(kind, enabled) end) end
	if saved.topbar then pcall(function() context.starterGui:SetCore("TopbarEnabled", true) end) end
	pcall(function() context.inputService.MouseIconEnabled = saved.mouse end)
	for _, item in saved.glass do pcall(function() item[1].LocalTransparencyModifier = item[2] end) end
	for _, effect in saved.fx do pcall(function() if effect.Parent then effect.Enabled = true end end) end
end

function CombatTracer.previewTarget(state, origin, root, camera)
	local context, vector = state.context, state.context.environment.Vector3
	local nearest, distance
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if player == context.player then continue end
		local character = player.Character
		local target = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not target or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
		local current = (target.Position - origin).Magnitude
		if current > 12 and current < 260 and (not distance or current < distance) then nearest, distance = target.Position, current end
	end
	if nearest then return nearest end

	local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local direction = vector.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	direction = direction.Magnitude > 0.1 and direction.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
	local hit = context.workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * 140 + vector.new(0, 2, 0), CombatTracer.raycastParams(state))
	return hit and hit.Position or origin + direction * 140
end

function CombatTracer.preview(state, target, options)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	if state.previewing then return end
	local character = context.player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not root or not camera then return end

	state.previewing = true
	local origin = options and options.from or CombatTracer.gunOrigin(state, character, nil, nil)
		or (root.CFrame * environment.CFrame.new(1.4, 1.25, -3.45)).Position
	local finish = environment.typeof(target) == "Vector3" and target or CombatTracer.previewTarget(state, origin, root, camera)
	local saved, cameraType, cameraSubject = CombatTracer.hideInterface(state), camera.CameraType, camera.CameraSubject
	local path
	if options then
		local copied = table.clone(options)
		copied.cb = function(value) path = value end
		CombatTracer.spawn(state, {origin, finish}, copied)
	end
	if not options then
		CombatTracer.build(state, origin, finish, true, true, {speed = 80, life = 1.8, cb = function(value) path = value end})
	end
	local started = environment.os.clock()
	while not path and environment.os.clock() - started < 2 do environment.task.wait() end

	local function restore()
		pcall(function() context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseTracerCam") end)
		pcall(function()
			camera.CameraType = cameraType or environment.Enum.CameraType.Custom
			camera.CameraSubject = humanoid and humanoid.Parent and humanoid or cameraSubject
		end)
		CombatTracer.restoreInterface(state, saved)
		state.previewing = false
	end
	if not path then restore(); return end

	local cameraPosition, cameraTarget = camera.CFrame.Position, origin
	local direction = (finish - origin).Magnitude > 0.1 and (finish - origin).Unit or environment.Vector3.zAxis
	local endPosition = path.pts[#path.pts]
	camera.CameraType = environment.Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	local ok = pcall(function()
		context.runService:BindToRenderStep("PulseTracerCam", environment.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function(delta)
			if not state.previewing then return end
			local elapsed = environment.os.clock() - path.t0
			local progress = math.min(path.L, elapsed * path.speed)
			local desired, lookAt
			if progress < path.L then
				local position = CombatTracer.pathAt(path, progress)
				local ahead = CombatTracer.pathAt(path, math.min(path.L, progress + 4)) - position
				if ahead.Magnitude > 0.05 then direction = ahead.Unit end
				local side = direction:Cross(environment.Vector3.yAxis)
				side = side.Magnitude > 0.1 and side.Unit or environment.Vector3.xAxis
				desired, lookAt = position - direction * 5.5 + environment.Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0) + side * 5, position + direction * 2.5
			end
			if progress >= path.L then
				local back = environment.Vector3.new(-direction.X, 0, -direction.Z)
				back = back.Magnitude > 0.1 and back.Unit or environment.Vector3.xAxis
				desired = endPosition + environment.CFrame.fromAxisAngle(environment.Vector3.yAxis, (elapsed - path.L / path.speed) * 0.7)
					* (back * 9) + environment.Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
				lookAt = endPosition
			end
			local flying = progress < path.L
			cameraPosition = cameraPosition:Lerp(desired, 1 - math.exp(-(delta or 0.016) * (flying and 14 or 6)))
			cameraTarget = cameraTarget:Lerp(lookAt, 1 - math.exp(-(delta or 0.016) * (flying and 18 or 8)))
			camera.CFrame = environment.CFrame.lookAt(cameraPosition, cameraTarget)
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then restore(); return end

	started = environment.os.clock()
	while environment.os.clock() - started < math.min(path.L / path.speed + 1.5, 9) and state.previewing and context.isAlive() do
		environment.task.wait()
	end
	restore()
end

function CombatTracer.controls(state, section, knifeSection)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local styles = {}
	for _, name in TRACER_STYLE_NAMES do table.insert(styles, {code = name, label = name}) end
	section:Header("Bullet Tracers")
	section:Toggle({Text = "Bullet Tracers", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.on = not not value end, Settings = function()
		section:Dropdown({Text = "Tracer Method", Default = "Classic", Options = {{code = "Classic", label = "Classic"},
			{code = "Path Finder", label = "Path Finder"}}, Callback = function(value) state.method = value end})
		section:Dropdown({Text = "Tracer Style", Default = "Energy", Options = styles, Callback = function(value)
			if TRACER_STYLES[value] then state.style = value end
		end})
		section:Colorpicker({Text = "Tracer Color", Default = state.col, Callback = function(value) state.col = value end})
		section:Colorpicker({Text = "Tail Color", Default = state.col2, Callback = function(value) state.col2 = value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Rainbow Tracers", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.rainbow = not not value end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Tracer Width", Min = 40, Max = 250, Default = 100, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%",
			Callback = function(value) state.width = tonumber(value) or 100 end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Tracer Speed", Min = 150, Max = 1500, Default = 520, Decimals = 0, Suffix = " st/s",
			Callback = function(value) state.speed = tonumber(value) or 520 end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Tracer Duration", Min = 0.3, Max = 4, Default = 1.2, Decimals = 1, Suffix = " s",
			Callback = function(value) state.life = tonumber(value) or 1.2 end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Impact Effect", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.impact = not not value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Muzzle Flash", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.muzzle = not not value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Show Other Shots", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.others = not not value end})
		section:Button({Text = "Preview Tracer", Callback = function() environment.task.spawn(function() pcall(CombatTracer.preview, state) end) end})
	end})
	local knife = state.knife
	knifeSection:Header("Knife Throw")
	knifeSection:Toggle({Text = "Knife Tracers", Default = false, Callback = function(value) knife.on = not not value end, Settings = function()
		knifeSection:Dropdown({Text = "Knife Style", Default = "Energy", Options = styles, Callback = function(value) if value then knife.style = value end end})
		knifeSection:Colorpicker({Text = "Knife Tracer Color", Default = knife.col, Callback = function(value) knife.col = value end})
		knifeSection:Colorpicker({Text = "Knife Tail Color", Default = knife.col2, Callback = function(value) knife.col2 = value end})
		knifeSection:Toggle({Text = "Rainbow Knife Tracers", Default = false, Callback = function(value) knife.rainbow = not not value end})
		knifeSection:Slider({Text = "Knife Tracer Width", Min = 40, Max = 250, Default = 100, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%",
			Callback = function(value) knife.width = tonumber(value) or 100 end})
		knifeSection:Slider({Text = "Knife Tracer Duration", Min = 0.3, Max = 4, Default = 1.2, Decimals = 1, Suffix = " s",
			Callback = function(value) knife.life = tonumber(value) or 1.2 end})
		knifeSection:Toggle({Text = "Knife Impact Effect", Default = true, Callback = function(value) knife.impact = not not value end})
		knifeSection:Toggle({Text = "Throw Flash", Default = true, Callback = function(value) knife.flash = not not value end})
		knifeSection:Toggle({Text = "Show Other Knives", Default = false, Callback = function(value) knife.others = not not value end})
		knifeSection:Button({Text = "Preview Knife Tracer", Callback = function()
			environment.task.spawn(function() pcall(state.knifePreview) end)
		end})
	end})
end

function CombatTracer.install(context)
	local state = CombatTracer.create(context)
	state.lastShots = {}
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	globals.__pulseTracers = state
	state.knife.opts = function(options) return CombatTracer.knifeOptions(state, options) end
	state.build = function(...) return CombatTracer.build(state, ...) end
	state.find = function(...) return CombatTracer.detour(state, ...) end
	state.preview = function(...) return CombatTracer.preview(state, ...) end
	state.knifePreview = function()
		local character = context.player.Character
		local hand = character and (character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm"))
		return CombatTracer.preview(state, nil, CombatTracer.knifeOptions(state, {impact = state.knife.impact, muzzle = state.knife.flash,
			life = math.max(state.knife.life, 1.2), from = hand and hand.Position or nil}))
	end

	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, function() pcall(CombatTracer.update, state) end)
	context.connect(context.collection:GetInstanceAddedSignal("ThrowingKnife"), function(projectile)
		environment.task.spawn(function() pcall(CombatTracer.onKnife, state, projectile) end)
	end)
	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, function() if #state.knife.live > 0 then pcall(CombatTracer.updateKnives, state) end end)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local services = context.storage:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 30)
		local weapons = services and services:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 30)
		local fired = weapons and weapons:WaitForChild("GunFired", 30)
		if not fired or not fired:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not context.isAlive() then return end
		context.connect(fired.OnClientEvent, function(...)
			local arguments = {...}
			environment.task.spawn(function() pcall(CombatTracer.onGunFired, state, table.unpack(arguments)) end)
		end)
	end)
	CombatTracer.controls(state, context.section, context.knifeSection)
	return state, function()
		state.previewing = false
		pcall(function() context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseTracerCam") end)
		for _, path in state.live do if path.head then pcall(function() path.head:Destroy() end) end end
		for _, item in state.made do pcall(function() item.b:Destroy(); item.a0:Destroy(); item.a1:Destroy() end) end
		state.live, state.made, state.pool = {}, {}, {}
	end
end

local AntiAim = {}

function AntiAim.initialize(configuration)
	if type(configuration.fakepos) ~= "table" then configuration.fakepos = {} end
	local settings = configuration.fakepos
	local version = tonumber(settings.v) or 0
	if tonumber(settings.power) == nil or version < 3 then settings.power = 5 end
	if settings.vel == nil then settings.vel = true end
	if settings.md == nil then settings.md = true end
	if settings.side == nil or version < 4 then settings.side = true end
	if version < 5 then settings.mode, settings.dir, settings.smart, settings.power = "Desync", "Random", true, 10 end
	if settings.mode ~= "Desync" and settings.mode ~= "Prediction" then settings.mode = "Desync" end
	if type(settings.dir) ~= "string" then settings.dir = "Random" end
	if settings.smart == nil then settings.smart = true end
	settings.v, settings.on = 5, false
	return settings
end

function AntiAim.bindCharacter(state, character)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	state.character, state.active = character, false
	for _, connection in state.characterConnections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	state.characterConnections = {}

	if character then
		local function onTool(tool)
			if tool:IsA("Tool") then state.toolAt = environment.os.clock() end
		end
		table.insert(state.characterConnections, context.connect(character.ChildAdded, onTool))
		table.insert(state.characterConnections, context.connect(character.ChildRemoved, onTool))
	end
	state.savedVelocity, state.spoofVelocity, state.savedDirection, state.spoofDirection = nil, nil, nil, nil
	state.savedFrame, state.spoofFrame = nil, nil
	state.root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
	state.humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
end

function AntiAim.restore(state)
	state.active = false
	local root, humanoid = state.root, state.humanoid
	if state.savedFrame and state.spoofFrame and root and root.Parent then
		local current = root.CFrame
		if (current.Position - state.spoofFrame.Position).Magnitude < 0.01
			and current.LookVector:Dot(state.spoofFrame.LookVector) > 0.9999 then root.CFrame = state.savedFrame end
	end
	if state.spoofVelocity and state.savedVelocity and root and root.Parent then
		local current = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local spoofDistance, originalDistance = (current - state.spoofVelocity).Magnitude, (current - state.savedVelocity).Magnitude
		if spoofDistance < 0.05 then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = state.savedVelocity end
		if spoofDistance >= 0.05 and spoofDistance < originalDistance then
			local vector = state.context.environment.Vector3
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vector.new(state.savedVelocity.X, math.min(current.Y, state.savedVelocity.Y), state.savedVelocity.Z)
			state.leakFix = (state.leakFix or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	if state.spoofDirection and state.savedDirection and humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		if (humanoid.MoveDirection - state.spoofDirection).Magnitude < 0.05 then humanoid:Move(state.savedDirection, false) end
	end
	state.savedVelocity, state.spoofVelocity, state.savedDirection, state.spoofDirection = nil, nil, nil, nil
	state.savedFrame, state.spoofFrame = nil, nil
	state.restores += 1
end

function AntiAim.tryRestore(state)
	if not state.active then return end
	local ok = pcall(AntiAim.restore, state)
	if ok then return end
	state.active = false
	state.savedVelocity, state.spoofVelocity, state.savedDirection, state.spoofDirection = nil, nil, nil, nil
	state.savedFrame, state.spoofFrame = nil, nil
end

function AntiAim.ownedMover(state)
	local root = state.root
	if not root or not root.Parent then return false end
	for _, child in root:GetChildren() do
		if child.Name == "PulseFarmBV" or child.Name == "PulseFarmBG" or child:GetAttribute("PulseMine") then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function AntiAim.busy(state, now)
	local globals = state.context.environment.getgenv()
	if now < (tonumber(globals.__pulseShotHold) or 0) or now - (state.toolAt or 0) < 0.35 then return true end
	if globals.__pulseFlyActive or globals.__pulseManualFling or globals.__pulseTouchFlinging or globals.__pulseFlingTargetChar then return true end
	if state.context.configuration.autoFlingSheriff then return true end
	if globals.__pulseInvis and globals.__pulseInvis.active then return true end
	if (tonumber(globals.__pulseBombJumpUntil) or 0) > now then return true end
	local farm = globals.__pulseFarmAPI
	if farm and farm.getEnabled and farm.getEnabled() then return true end
	return state.hasMover
end

function AntiAim.threat(state, position)
	local context = state.context
	local roles = context.roles()
	if type(roles) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local own = roles[context.player.Name]
	local murderer = own ~= nil and tostring(own.Role) == "Murderer"
	local closest, distance

	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if player == context.player then continue end
		local role = roles[player.Name]
		if not role or role.Dead == true or role.Killed == true then continue end
		local name = tostring(role.Role)
		if murderer and name ~= "Sheriff" and name ~= "Hero" then continue end
		if not murderer and name ~= "Murderer" then continue end
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end
		local current = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
		if not distance or current < distance then closest, distance = root, current end
	end
	return closest
end

function AntiAim.spoofVector(state, now, power)
	local vector, settings = state.context.environment.Vector3, state.cfg
	local function random() return math.random() * 2 - 1 end
	if settings.dir == "Underground" then return vector.new(random() * power * 0.15, -power, random() * power * 0.15) end
	if settings.dir == "Sky" then return vector.new(random() * power * 0.15, power, random() * power * 0.15) end
	if settings.dir == "Spin" then
		state.angle = (state.angle + 0.9 + math.random() * 0.6) % (2 * math.pi)
		return vector.new(math.cos(state.angle) * power, random() * power * 0.35, math.sin(state.angle) * power)
	end
	if settings.dir == "Jitter" then
		if not state.jitterDirection or now >= state.jitterUntil then
			local direction = vector.new(random(), random() * 0.4, random())
			state.jitterDirection = direction.Magnitude > 0.1 and direction.Unit or vector.xAxis
			state.jitterUntil = now + 0.25 + math.random() * 0.25
		end
		state.flip = -state.flip
		return state.jitterDirection * (power * 1.6 * state.flip)
	end
	return vector.new((math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * power, random() * power,
		(math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * power)
end

function AntiAim.nearCoin(state, position, now)
	local context = state.context
	if now - state.coinAt > 1 or not (state.coinContainer and state.coinContainer.Parent) then
		state.coinAt, state.coinContainer = now, nil
		for _, child in context.workspace:GetChildren() do
			local container = child:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
			if container then state.coinContainer = container; break end
		end
		if state.coinContainer then state.coinParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {state.coinContainer} end
	end
	if not state.coinContainer then return false end
	return #context.workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, state.coinR or 14, state.coinParams) > 0
end

function AntiAim.shouldPause(state, character, position, now)
	if now - state.pauseAt < 0.08 then return state.pauseValue end
	state.pauseAt = now
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local knife, gun = character:FindFirstChild("Knife"), character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
	local pause = (knife or gun) and context.inputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(environment.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) or false
	if knife and not pause then
		local globals = environment.getgenv()
		pause = globals.__pulseKillAuraOn or globals.__pulseGetKillAll and globals.__pulseGetKillAll() or false
		if not pause then
			for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
				if player == context.player then continue end
				local target = player.Character
				local root = target and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local humanoid = target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and (root.Position - position).Magnitude < (state.stabR or 16) then
					pause = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not pause then
		local ok, near = pcall(AntiAim.nearCoin, state, position, now)
		pause = ok and near or false
	end
	state.pauseValue = pause
	return pause
end

function AntiAim.desync(state, character, position, now)
	local context, settings = state.context, state.cfg
	local role = context.roles()[context.player.Name]
	if not role or role.Dead == true or role.Killed == true then state.mode = "idle"; return end
	if settings.smart ~= false and AntiAim.shouldPause(state, character, position, now) then state.mode = "pause"; return end

	local vector = context.environment.Vector3
	local power = 32767 * math.clamp(tonumber(settings.power) or 10, 1, 10) / 10
	local spoof = AntiAim.spoofVector(state, now, power)
	state.active = true
	state.savedVelocity = state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	state.spoofVelocity = vector.new(math.clamp(spoof.X, -32767, 32767), math.clamp(spoof.Y, -32767, 32767),
		math.clamp(spoof.Z, -32767, 32767))
	state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = state.spoofVelocity
	if context.environment.sethiddenproperty then pcall(context.environment.sethiddenproperty, state.root, "NetworkIsSleeping", false) end

	if settings.md ~= false then
		if not state.direction or now >= state.directionUntil then
			local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
			state.direction = vector.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
			state.directionUntil = now + 0.15 + math.random() * 0.3
		end
		state.savedDirection, state.spoofDirection = state.humanoid.MoveDirection, state.direction
		state.humanoid:Move(state.spoofDirection, false)
	end
	state.mode, state.desyncAt, state.frames = "desync", now, state.frames + 1
end

function AntiAim.predict(state, position, now)
	local context, settings = state.context, state.cfg
	local environment, vector = context.environment, context.environment.Vector3
	state.mode = "prediction"
	if now >= state.threatAt then
		state.threatAt = now + 0.25
		local ok, threat = pcall(AntiAim.threat, state, position)
		state.threat = ok and threat or nil
		if not state.threat and environment.typeof(state.force) == "Instance" and state.force.Parent then state.threat = state.force end
	end
	if not state.threat or not state.threat.Parent then return end

	local delta = position - state.threat.Position
	delta = vector.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
	if delta.Magnitude < 0.5 then return end
	local direction = delta.Unit
	local side = vector.new(-direction.Z, 0, direction.X)
	local velocity, frame = state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, state.root.CFrame
	local horizontal = vector.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
	local lateral = horizontal:Dot(side)
	local facing = frame.LookVector:Dot(side) >= 0 and side or -side
	if math.abs(lateral) > 3 then
		state.side = lateral > 0 and -1 or 1
		state.sideUntil = now + 0.25 + math.random() * 0.35
	end
	if math.abs(lateral) <= 3 and settings.side ~= false and now >= state.sideUntil then state.side = facing:Dot(side) > 0 and 1 or -1 end
	if math.abs(lateral) <= 3 and settings.side == false and now >= state.sideUntil then
		state.side = math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1
		state.sideUntil = now + 0.6 + math.random() * 1.2
	end

	local spoofDirection = side * state.side
	local speed = math.max(10 + math.clamp(tonumber(settings.power) or 5, 1, 10) * 9, horizontal.Magnitude)
	state.active = true
	if settings.vel ~= false then
		state.savedVelocity = velocity
		state.spoofVelocity = vector.new(spoofDirection.X * speed, velocity.Y, spoofDirection.Z * speed)
		state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = state.spoofVelocity
	end
	if settings.md ~= false then
		state.savedDirection, state.spoofDirection = state.humanoid.MoveDirection, spoofDirection
		state.humanoid:Move(spoofDirection, false)
	end
	if settings.side ~= false then
		local fake = environment.CFrame.lookAt(frame.Position, frame.Position + facing)
		local muzzle = rawget(environment.getgenv(), "__pulseMuzzle")
		if muzzle and muzzle.poseClear and not muzzle.poseClear(fake) then
			local opposite = environment.CFrame.lookAt(frame.Position, frame.Position - facing)
			fake = muzzle.poseClear(opposite) and opposite or nil
			state.sideSkips = (state.sideSkips or 0) + (fake and 0 or 1)
		end
		if fake then
			state.savedFrame, state.spoofFrame = frame, fake
			state.root.CFrame = fake
			state.sideFrames, state.sideAt, state.fakeCF = (state.sideFrames or 0) + 1, now, fake
		end
	end
	state.frames += 1
end

function AntiAim.step(state)
	local context, settings = state.context, state.cfg
	if state.active or not settings.on then return end
	if settings.mode == "Prediction" and settings.vel == false and settings.md == false and settings.side == false then return end

	local character = context.player.Character
	if character ~= state.character then AntiAim.bindCharacter(state, character) end
	if not (state.root and state.root.Parent) then state.root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil end
	if not (state.humanoid and state.humanoid.Parent) then state.humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil end
	local root, humanoid = state.root, state.humanoid
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit or state.invalidStates[humanoid:GetState()] then return end

	local now = context.environment.os.clock()
	if now >= state.moverAt then state.moverAt, state.hasMover = now + 0.1, AntiAim.ownedMover(state) end
	if AntiAim.busy(state, now) then state.mode = "busy"; return end
	if settings.mode ~= "Prediction" then AntiAim.desync(state, character, root.Position, now); return end
	AntiAim.predict(state, root.Position, now)
end

function AntiAim.controls(state, section)
	local settings = state.cfg
	section:Header("Anti-Aim")
	section:Toggle({Text = "Anti Aim", Default = false, Callback = function(value) settings.on = not not value end, Settings = function()
		section:Dropdown({Text = "AA Mode", Default = settings.mode, Options = {{code = "Desync", label = "Desync"},
			{code = "Prediction", label = "Prediction"}}, Callback = function(value)
			if value == "Desync" or value == "Prediction" then settings.mode = value end
		end})
		section:Dropdown({Text = "Direction", Default = settings.dir, Options = {{code = "Random", label = "Random"},
			{code = "Jitter", label = "Jitter"}, {code = "Spin", label = "Spin"}, {code = "Underground", label = "Underground"},
			{code = "Sky", label = "Sky"}}, Callback = function(value) if type(value) == "string" then settings.dir = value end end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Spoof Strength", Min = 1, Max = 10, Default = settings.power, Decimals = 0,
			Callback = function(value) settings.power = value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Smart Pause", Default = settings.smart ~= false, Callback = function(value) settings.smart = not not value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Spoof Velocity", Default = settings.vel == true, Callback = function(value) settings.vel = not not value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Spoof Move Direction", Default = settings.md == true, Callback = function(value) settings.md = not not value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Side Profile", Default = settings.side == true, Callback = function(value) settings.side = not not value end})
	end})
end

function AntiAim.install(context)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local settings = AntiAim.initialize(context.configuration)
	local invalid = environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType
	local state = {context = context, cfg = settings, frames = 0, restores = 0, side = 1, sideUntil = 0, threatAt = 0,
		angle = 0, flip = 1, jitterUntil = 0, directionUntil = 0, pauseAt = 0, pauseValue = false, coinAt = -10,
		moverAt = 0, hasMover = false, active = false, characterConnections = {}, invalidStates = {}}
	for _, name in {"Dead", "Seated", "Climbing", "Physics", "PlatformStanding", "Ragdoll", "FallingDown", "Swimming", "GettingUp"} do
		state.invalidStates[invalid[name]] = true
	end
	state.coinParams = environment.OverlapParams.new()
	state.coinParams.FilterType = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	globals.__pulseFakePos = {active = false, off = environment.Vector3.zero}
	globals.__pulseAntiAim = state
	pcall(function() if tonumber(environment.getfflag("WorldStepMax")) < 0 then environment.setfflag("WorldStepMax", "30") end end)

	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, function()
		AntiAim.tryRestore(state)
		if settings.on then environment.task.defer(function()
			if not pcall(AntiAim.step, state) then AntiAim.tryRestore(state) end
		end) end
	end)
	context.connect(context.runService.PreSimulation, function() AntiAim.tryRestore(state) end)
	pcall(function() context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseFakePos") end)
	pcall(function() context.runService:BindToRenderStep("PulseFakePos", environment.Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, function() AntiAim.tryRestore(state) end) end)
	context.connect(context.player.CharacterAdded, function(character) AntiAim.bindCharacter(state, character) end)
	if context.player.Character then AntiAim.bindCharacter(state, context.player.Character) end
	AntiAim.controls(state, context.section)
	return state, function()
		AntiAim.tryRestore(state)
		settings.on = false
		for _, connection in state.characterConnections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
		pcall(function() context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseFakePos") end)
		globals.__pulseFakePos.active, globals.__pulseFakePos.off = false, environment.Vector3.zero
	end
end

local MuzzleGuard = {}

function MuzzleGuard.parts(state)
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local muzzle = root and root:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("Gun") or not root or not head or not muzzle or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end
	return character, root, head, muzzle, humanoid
end

function MuzzleGuard.lineClear(state, origin, finish)
	local context = state.context
	local delta = finish - origin
	local distance = delta.Magnitude
	if distance < 0.001 then return true end

	local hit = context.workspace:Raycast(origin, delta * ((distance + (state.ext or 0.6)) / distance), state.rayParams)
	if not hit then return true end
	local model = hit.Instance and hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	local aim = rawget(context.environment.getgenv(), "__pulseAimX")
	return model ~= nil and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil and aim ~= nil and aim.target == model
end

function MuzzleGuard.nearby(state, root)
	local context, vector = state.context, state.context.environment.Vector3
	table.clear(state.nearby)
	if state.nearOff then return end
	local aim = rawget(context.environment.getgenv(), "__pulseAimX")
	local target = aim and aim.target
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if player == context.player then continue end
		local character = player.Character
		if not character or character == target then continue end
		local other = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not other or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude >= 12 then continue end
		local velocity = other.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		table.insert(state.nearby, other.Position)
		table.insert(state.nearby, other.Position + vector.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z) * (state.nearLead or 0.25))
	end
	state.nearN = #state.nearby / 2
end

function MuzzleGuard.nearClear(state, origin, finish)
	local delta, vector = finish - origin, state.context.environment.Vector3
	local denominator = math.max(delta:Dot(delta), 1e-6)
	for _, position in state.nearby do
		for _, height in {1.5, 0, -1.5} do
			local point = position + vector.new(0, height, 0)
			local closest = origin + delta * math.clamp((point - origin):Dot(delta) / denominator, 0, 1)
			if (closest - point).Magnitude < (state.nearR or 2) then return false end
		end
	end
	return true
end

function MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, frame, head, muzzle, thorough)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local finish, origin = (frame * muzzle).Position, frame * head
	if not MuzzleGuard.lineClear(state, origin, finish) then return false end
	if not thorough then return true end

	local vector = environment.Vector3
	for _, offset in {vector.new(0.2, 0, 0), vector.new(-0.2, 0, 0), vector.new(0, 0.2, 0), vector.new(0, -0.2, 0)} do
		if not MuzzleGuard.lineClear(state, frame * (head + offset), finish) then return false end
	end
	if not MuzzleGuard.nearClear(state, origin, finish) then return false end
	if state.yawTol == false then return true end

	for _, angle in {math.rad(25), math.rad(-25)} do
		local rotated = frame * environment.CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)
		local from, to = rotated * head, (rotated * muzzle).Position
		if not MuzzleGuard.lineClear(state, from, to) or not MuzzleGuard.nearClear(state, from, to) then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function MuzzleGuard.findPose(state, current, head, muzzle)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local frame, vector = environment.CFrame, environment.Vector3
	local look = vector.new(current.LookVector.X, 0, current.LookVector.Z)
	if look.Magnitude < 0.05 then look = vector.new(0, 0, -1) end
	local yaw, position = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z), current.Position
	if state.lastYaw then
		local candidate = frame.new(position) * frame.Angles(0, yaw + state.lastYaw, 0)
		if MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, candidate, head, muzzle, true) then return candidate end
	end

	for index = 1, 23 do
		local offset = math.ceil(index / 2) * (index % 2 == 1 and 1 or -1) * math.pi / 12
		local candidate = frame.new(position) * frame.Angles(0, yaw + offset, 0)
		if not MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, candidate, head, muzzle, false) then continue end
		if MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, candidate, head, muzzle, true) then state.lastYaw = offset; return candidate end
	end

	for _, radius in {1, 2, 3} do
		for index = 0, 7 do
			local angle = index * math.pi / 4
			local point = position + vector.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * radius
			if context.workspace:Raycast(position, point - position, state.rayParams) then continue end
			if #context.workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(frame.new(point), vector.new(1.6, 4.2, 1.6), state.overlapParams) > 0 then continue end
			for rotation = 0, 11 do
				local candidate = frame.new(point) * frame.Angles(0, yaw + rotation * math.pi / 6, 0)
				if not MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, candidate, head, muzzle, false) then continue end
				if MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, candidate, head, muzzle, true) then return candidate end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function MuzzleGuard.reset(state)
	local hold = state.hold
	if hold.cf and hold.humanoid and hold.humanoid.Parent and hold.autoRotate ~= nil then
		pcall(function() hold.humanoid.AutoRotate = hold.autoRotate end)
	end
	hold.cf, hold.fixedPosition, hold.autoRotate, hold.humanoid, hold.root = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end

function MuzzleGuard.hold(state)
	local hold = state.hold
	if not hold.cf then return end
	local root = hold.root
	if not root or not root.Parent then MuzzleGuard.reset(state); return end

	local environment = state.context.environment
	local position = hold.fixedPosition or root.Position
	root.CFrame = environment.CFrame.new(position) * hold.cf.Rotation
	if hold.fixedPosition then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0) end
end

function MuzzleGuard.poseClear(state, frame)
	local character, root, head, muzzle = MuzzleGuard.parts(state)
	if not character or state.character ~= character then return true end
	local headPosition = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(head.Position)
	local pose = state.context.environment.CFrame.new(root.Position) * frame.Rotation
	return MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, pose, headPosition, muzzle.CFrame, true)
end

function MuzzleGuard.step(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local character, root, head, muzzle, humanoid = MuzzleGuard.parts(state)
	if not character or globals.__pulseManualFling or globals.__pulseTouchFlinging or globals.__pulseFlingTargetChar
		or globals.__pulseInvis and globals.__pulseInvis.active == true or globals.__pulseMuzzleOff then
		if state.hold.cf then MuzzleGuard.reset(state) end
		state.at, state.guarding = nil, false
		return
	end

	local now = environment.os.clock()
	if state.character ~= character then
		state.character = character
		state.rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances, state.overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}, {character}
		state.at = nil
		MuzzleGuard.reset(state)
	end
	local current = root.CFrame
	local headPosition, muzzleFrame = current:PointToObjectSpace(head.Position), muzzle.CFrame
	state.frames += 1
	MuzzleGuard.nearby(state, root)
	local clear = MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, current, headPosition, muzzleFrame, true)
	if not clear and not MuzzleGuard.lineClear(state, current * headPosition, (current * muzzleFrame).Position) then state.hardAt = now end

	if (state.wantUntil or 0) > now then
		if not clear and now >= (state.nextFind or 0) then
			local candidate = MuzzleGuard.findPose(state, current, headPosition, muzzleFrame)
			if not candidate then state.nextFind = now + (state.findGap or 0.1) end
			if candidate then
				local hold = state.hold
				if not hold.cf then hold.autoRotate, hold.humanoid = humanoid.AutoRotate, humanoid end
				humanoid.AutoRotate = false
				hold.cf, hold.root = candidate, root
				local delta = candidate.Position - current.Position
				hold.fixedPosition = environment.Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude > 0.3 and candidate.Position or nil
				root.CFrame = candidate
				state.guardFrames, clear = state.guardFrames + 1, true
			end
		end
		globals.__pulseShotHold = math.max(tonumber(globals.__pulseShotHold) or 0, now + 0.2)
	end
	if (state.wantUntil or 0) <= now and state.hold.cf then MuzzleGuard.reset(state) end
	state.guarding = state.hold.cf ~= nil

	local antiAim = state.aaWait ~= false and rawget(globals, "__pulseAntiAim")
	local spoofRecent = antiAim and antiAim.sideAt and now - antiAim.sideAt < 0.03
	if spoofRecent and clear and environment.typeof(antiAim.fakeCF) == "CFrame" and state.aaCheck ~= false then
		local pose = environment.CFrame.new(current.Position) * antiAim.fakeCF.Rotation
		if MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, pose, headPosition, muzzleFrame, true) then spoofRecent = false end
	end
	state.spoofRecent = not not spoofRecent
	if clear then
		if state.blocked or not state.at or spoofRecent then state.clearSince = now end
		state.blocked = false
	end
	if not clear then
		if not state.blocked then state.blockedAt = now end
		state.blocked, state.blockedFrames = true, state.blockedFrames + 1
	end
	state.at = now
end

function MuzzleGuard.install(context)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local state = {context = context, alive = true, clearSince = 0, blocked = false, guarding = false,
		frames = 0, guardFrames = 0, blockedFrames = 0, nearby = {}, hold = {}}
	state.rayParams = environment.RaycastParams.new()
	state.rayParams.FilterType = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	state.overlapParams = environment.OverlapParams.new()
	state.overlapParams.FilterType, state.overlapParams.RespectCanCollide = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true
	state.request = function(duration) state.wantUntil = math.max(state.wantUntil or 0, environment.os.clock() + (duration or 0.5)) end
	state.poseClear = function(frame) return MuzzleGuard.poseClear(state, frame) end
	globals.__pulseMuzzle = state

	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, function() pcall(MuzzleGuard.hold, state) end)
	context.connect(context.runService.PreSimulation, function()
		pcall(MuzzleGuard.hold, state)
		if not pcall(MuzzleGuard.step, state) then state.at = nil end
	end)
	pcall(function() context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseMuzzleHold") end)
	pcall(function() context.runService:BindToRenderStep("PulseMuzzleHold", environment.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1,
		function() pcall(MuzzleGuard.hold, state) end) end)
	return state, function()
		pcall(MuzzleGuard.reset, state)
		state.alive = false
		pcall(function() context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseMuzzleHold") end)
	end
end

local LOCAL_SOUNDS = {
	"agpa1", "agpa2", "amamam", "bratik-tozhe-tut", "ding", "disciplina", "ekh", "fotoparat", "gavknul-i-puknul", "hamam", "hihihihi", "korolia-ne-ubit", "mcbow", "musor", "neverlose", "odin-svinia", "ohaeshichki", "pump-shotgun", "reminder", "rizz", "sela-dala", "semya-v-arbuz", "skeet", "spasibo-khorosho", "stapler", "tiki", "yara", "zingtrio"

local CustomSounds = {}

function CustomSounds.options(catalog)
	local options = {}
	for _, entry in catalog do table.insert(options, {code = entry[1], label = entry[1]}) end
	for _, name in LOCAL_SOUNDS do table.insert(options, {code = "~" .. name, label = name}) end
	return options
end

function CustomSounds.asset(state, name)
	if state.assets[name] then return state.assets[name] end
	local environment = state.context.environment
	if type(environment.writefile) ~= "function" or type(environment.getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return "" end
	if not table.find(LOCAL_SOUNDS, name) then return "" end

	pcall(function()
		if type(environment.isfolder) == "function" and not environment.isfolder("SeniorHubSources") then environment.makefolder("SeniorHubSources") end
		if type(environment.isfolder) == "function" and not environment.isfolder("SeniorHubSources/mm2sounds") then environment.makefolder("SeniorHubSources/mm2sounds") end
	end)
	local path = "SeniorHubSources/mm2sounds/" .. name .. ".ogg"
	if not (type(environment.isfile) == "function" and environment.isfile(path)) then
		local data = rawget(environment.getgenv(), "__pulseData")
		local encoded = data and data.take and data.take("snd_" .. name)
		if encoded then pcall(function() environment.writefile(path, buffer.tostring(OfflineFiles._decodeBuffer(encoded))) end) end
	end
	local ok, asset = pcall(environment.getcustomasset, path)
	if not ok or type(asset) ~= "string" or #asset == 0 then return "" end
	state.assets[name] = asset
	return asset
end

function CustomSounds.resolve(state, catalog, selection)
	for _, entry in catalog do
		if entry[1] == selection then return entry[2] end
	end
	if type(selection) == "string" and selection:sub(1, 1) == "~" then return CustomSounds.asset(state, selection:sub(2)) end
	return ""
end

function CustomSounds.play(state, asset)
	if not asset or asset == "" then return end
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local sound = environment.Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = asset
	sound.Volume = (tonumber(state.settings.sndVol) or 60) / 100 * 3
	sound.PlayOnRemove, sound.Parent = false, context.soundService
	pcall(function() sound:Play() end)
	environment.task.delay(8, function() pcall(function() sound:Destroy() end) end)
	pcall(function() context.connect(sound.Ended, function() pcall(function() sound:Destroy() end) end) end)
end

function CustomSounds.shouldMute(state, sound)
	local name = string.lower(sound.Name)
	if state.settings.shotSnd ~= "Off" and (name == "gunshot" or name == "reload" or name == "gunkill") then return true end
	return state.settings.killSnd ~= "Off" and name == "gunkill"
end

function CustomSounds.watch(state, sound)
	if not sound:IsA("Sound") then return end
	if CustomSounds.shouldMute(state, sound) then
		if not state.muted[sound] then state.muted[sound] = {vol = sound.Volume} end
		if not state.watched[sound] then
			state.watched[sound] = true
			pcall(function()
				state.context.connect(sound:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Volume"), function()
					local saved = state.muted[sound]
					if saved and sound.Volume ~= 0 then saved.vol, sound.Volume = sound.Volume, 0 end
				end)
			end)
		end
		if sound.Volume ~= 0 then pcall(function() sound.Volume = 0 end) end
		return
	end

	local saved = state.muted[sound]
	if saved then
		state.muted[sound] = nil
		pcall(function() sound.Volume = saved.vol end)
	end
end

function CustomSounds.refresh(state)
	for sound, saved in state.muted do
		if not sound.Parent then state.muted[sound], state.watched[sound] = nil, nil; continue end
		if not CustomSounds.shouldMute(state, sound) then
			state.muted[sound] = nil
			pcall(function() sound.Volume = saved.vol end)
		end
	end
	for sound in state.watched do if not sound.Parent then state.watched[sound] = nil end end
	local gun = SheriffRuntime.gun(state.context)
	if not gun then return end

	if state.gun ~= gun then
		if state.gunConnection then pcall(function() state.gunConnection:Disconnect() end) end
		state.gun = gun
		state.gunConnection = state.context.connect(gun.DescendantAdded, function(sound)
			if sound:IsA("Sound") then CustomSounds.watch(state, sound) end
		end)
	end
	for _, sound in gun:GetDescendants() do if sound:IsA("Sound") then CustomSounds.watch(state, sound) end end
end

function CustomSounds.characterOf(environment, instance)
	local character = environment.typeof(instance) == "Instance" and instance or nil
	while character and not (character:IsA("Model") and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do character = character.Parent end
	return character
end

function CustomSounds.onFired(state, tool, origin, endpoint, hit)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	if CustomSounds.characterOf(environment, tool) ~= context.player.Character then return end
	local now, settings = environment.os.clock(), state.settings
	if settings.shotSnd ~= "Off" and now - state.lastShot > 0.15 then
		state.lastShot = now
		CustomSounds.play(state, CustomSounds.resolve(state, SHOT_SOUNDS, settings.shotSnd))
	end
	if settings.killSnd ~= "Off" and environment.typeof(hit) == "Instance" then
		local victim = CustomSounds.characterOf(environment, hit)
		if victim and victim ~= context.player.Character and context.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(victim) then
			environment.task.delay(0.06, function() CustomSounds.play(state, CustomSounds.resolve(state, KILL_SOUNDS, settings.killSnd)) end)
		end
	end
	pcall(CustomSounds.refresh, state)
end

function CustomSounds.install(context)
	local environment, settings = context.environment, context.configuration.sheriff
	settings.shotSnd, settings.killSnd = settings.shotSnd or "Off", settings.killSnd or "Off"
	if settings.sndVol == nil then settings.sndVol = 60 end
	local state = {context = context, settings = settings, assets = {}, muted = {}, watched = {}, lastShot = 0}
	environment.getgenv().__pulsePreviewSound = function(asset) return CustomSounds.play(state, asset) end

	local section = context.section
	section:Header("Custom Sounds")
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Shot Sound", Default = settings.shotSnd, TranslateOptions = false, Options = CustomSounds.options(SHOT_SOUNDS),
		Callback = function(value) settings.shotSnd = value; pcall(CustomSounds.refresh, state) end})
	section:Button({Text = "Preview Shot", Callback = function() CustomSounds.play(state, CustomSounds.resolve(state, SHOT_SOUNDS, settings.shotSnd)) end})
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Kill Sound", Default = settings.killSnd, TranslateOptions = false, Options = CustomSounds.options(KILL_SOUNDS),
		Callback = function(value) settings.killSnd = value; pcall(CustomSounds.refresh, state) end})
	section:Button({Text = "Preview Kill", Callback = function() CustomSounds.play(state, CustomSounds.resolve(state, KILL_SOUNDS, settings.killSnd)) end})
	section:Slider({Text = "Sound Volume", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = context.defaults.sheriff.sndVol or 60, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%",
		Callback = function(value)
			settings.sndVol = value
			if settings.shotSnd ~= "Off" or settings.killSnd ~= "Off" then pcall(CustomSounds.refresh, state) end
		end})

	environment.task.spawn(function()
		while context.isAlive() do
			environment.task.wait(0.25)
			if settings.shotSnd ~= "Off" or settings.killSnd ~= "Off" or next(state.muted) then pcall(CustomSounds.refresh, state) end
		end
	end)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local services = context.storage:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 30)
		local weapons = services and services:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 30)
		local fired = weapons and weapons:WaitForChild("GunFired", 30)
		if not fired or not fired:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not context.isAlive() then return end
		context.connect(fired.OnClientEvent, function(...) CustomSounds.onFired(state, ...) end)
	end)
	return state, function()
		for sound, saved in state.muted do pcall(function() sound.Volume = saved.vol end) end
		state.muted = {}
	end
end
