	local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(effect.chest), environment.Vector3.new(2.6, 5, 2))
	local emitter = GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.soft, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(white, white),
		Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0.25, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.3),
		Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5), Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, -3, 0),
		Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, LightEmission = 0.3, Brightness = 2}, 0)
	emitter.Rate, emitter.Enabled = 40, true
	GameEffects.Kill.smoke(state, effect.root - environment.Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), environment.Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255), 8, 3, 2.5)
	GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 0.95, function()
		emitter.Enabled = false
		for _, group in {ice, body, spikes} do for _, part in group do pcall(function() part:Destroy() end) end end
		GameEffects.Kill.fragments(state, effect.chest, 28, color, environment.Enum.Material.Ice, 0.4, 16, 1.8)
		local _, attachment = GameEffects.Kill.effectAttachment(state, effect.chest)
		GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = state.textures.soft, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(white, white),
			Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 1.2, 1, 3.5), Transparency = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0.3, 1, 1),
			Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.6, 1), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(6, 12), SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(180, 180),
			Drag = 3, LightEmission = 0.3, Brightness = 2}, 20)
		GameEffects.Kill.flash(state, effect.chest, color, 10, 4)
		GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.iceShatter, 1, 1.1)
		GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.iceCrack, 0.7, 1.3, nil, 1.5)
		GameEffects.Kill.shakeCamera(state, effect.chest, 0.7, 0.25)
	end)
	GameEffects.Kill.light(state, anchor, color, 4, 14, 1.2)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 2.4)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.whooshQuick, 0.9, 1.2)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.iceCrack, 1, 1, nil, 1.5)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.rainbow(state, effect)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local colors = {environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 70), environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40),
		environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 60), environment.Color3.fromRGB(80, 230, 100),
		environment.Color3.fromRGB(70, 150, 255), environment.Color3.fromRGB(170, 90, 255)}
	local white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local sequence = function(...) return GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, ...) end
	local colorSequence = function(first, second) return environment.ColorSequence.new(first, second or first) end
	local direction = GameEffects.Kill.direction(state, effect)
	local body = GameEffects.Kill.body(state, effect, direction * 26 + environment.Vector3.new(0, 60, 0), GameEffects.Kill.randomVector(state, 4), 3.2)
	GameEffects.Kill.hideEffectBody(state, effect.char)
	if body and body.torso then
		local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(body.torso.Position), environment.Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2))
		local trails = {}
		for index, color in colors do
			local first, second = environment.Instance.new("Attachment"), environment.Instance.new("Attachment")
			first.Position, first.Parent = environment.Vector3.new(0, (3.5 - index) * 0.36 + 0.18, 0), anchor
			second.Position, second.Parent = environment.Vector3.new(0, (3.5 - index) * 0.36 - 0.18, 0), anchor
			local trail = environment.Instance.new("Trail")
			trail.Attachment0, trail.Attachment1 = first, second
			trail.Color, trail.Transparency = colorSequence(color), sequence(0, 0.1, 1, 1)
			trail.Lifetime, trail.LightEmission, trail.FaceCamera, trail.Parent = 1.1, 0.6, true, anchor
			table.insert(trails, trail)
		end
		local emitter = GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.star, Color = colorSequence(white, colors[3]),
			Size = sequence(0, 0.5, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(1, 3),
			SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(180, 180), Brightness = 4}, 0)
		emitter.Rate, emitter.Enabled = 30, true
		GameEffects.Kill.animate(state, 1.7, function()
			if body.torso.Parent then anchor.CFrame = environment.CFrame.new(body.torso.Position) end
		end, function()
			emitter.Enabled = false
			for _, trail in trails do trail.Enabled = false end
			local _, attachment = GameEffects.Kill.effectAttachment(state, anchor.Position)
			GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = state.textures.star4, Color = colorSequence(white, colors[3]),
				Size = sequence(0, 0, 0.3, 2, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.5), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(6, 12),
				SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(180, 180), Drag = 3, Brightness = 6}, 14)
			GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 1.3)
			GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.chimes, 0.6, 1.5)
		end)
	end
	local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(effect.root), environment.Vector3.new(2, 1, 2))
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.soft, Color = colorSequence(white), Size = sequence(0, 1.5, 1, 4),
		Transparency = sequence(0, 0.1, 1, 1), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.6, 1), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(6, 12),
		SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(85, 85), Drag = 4, Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
		LightEmission = 0, LightInfluence = 0.8, Brightness = 1.3}, 16)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 1.5)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.slideWhistle, 0.6, 1.2)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.partyHorn2, 0.6, 1.1)
	for index = 0, 2 do
		GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 0.25 + index * 0.09, function() GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.chimes, 0.4, 1.2 + index * 0.25) end)
	end
end

function GameEffects.Kill.inferno(state, effect)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
	local ground = GameEffects.Kill.ground(state, effect.root, effect.ignore)
	local height = ground and ground.Y or effect.root.Y - 3
	local parts = GameEffects.Kill.ghost(state, effect.char, {material = environment.Enum.Material.Neon,
		color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 60), transparency = 0})
	GameEffects.Kill.hideEffectBody(state, effect.char)
	for _, part in parts do
		GameEffects.Kill.tween(state, part, 0.9, {Color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(28, 14, 8)}, environment.Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
	end
	GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 1, function()
		for _, part in parts do
			if not part.Parent then continue end
			local offset = math.max(0, part.Position.Y - (height + 0.3)) * 0.85
			GameEffects.Kill.tween(state, part, 0.55, {CFrame = part.CFrame - environment.Vector3.new(0, offset, 0), Size = part.Size * 0.55,
				Transparency = 1}, environment.Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, environment.Enum.EasingDirection.In)
			GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, part, 0.6)
		end
	end)

	local sequence = function(...) return GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, ...) end
	local colors = function(first, second) return environment.ColorSequence.new(first, second or first) end
	local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(effect.chest - environment.Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)), environment.Vector3.new(2.4, 4.4, 1.6))
	local flame = GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.flame,
		Color = environment.ColorSequence.new({environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 170)),
			environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 30)),
			environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, environment.Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 10))}),
		Size = sequence(0, 0.8, 0.3, 1.8, 1, 0.2), Transparency = sequence(0, 0.6, 0.15, 0.05, 0.8, 0.4, 1, 1),
		Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.8), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(2, 5), Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, 9, 0),
		SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(15, 15), Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(-15, 15), Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
		ShapeStyle = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume, Brightness = 3, ZOffset = 1}, 30)
	flame.Rate, flame.Enabled = 110, true
	GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 1.25, function() if flame.Parent then flame.Enabled = false end end)
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.fsparks, Color = colors(environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120), color),
		Size = sequence(0, 0.35, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(2, 6),
		Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(50, 50), Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
		Brightness = 4}, 30, 0.3)
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.square, Color = colors(environment.Color3.fromRGB(80, 75, 70), environment.Color3.fromRGB(30, 28, 26)),
		Size = sequence(0, 0.2, 1, 0.08), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(1, 1.6), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(0.5, 2),
		Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), Drag = 1, Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(0, 360), RotSpeed = environment.NumberRange.new(-200, 200),
		Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, LightEmission = 0, LightInfluence = 1, Brightness = 1}, 50, 1)
	local attachment = environment.Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = anchor
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = state.textures.core, Color = colors(environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 160), color),
		Size = sequence(0, 2, 1, 7), Transparency = sequence(0, 0, 1, 1), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.35),
		Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(0, 360), Brightness = 4}, 2)
	local floor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(effect.root.X, height + 0.1, effect.root.Z), environment.Vector3.new(1, 0.2, 1))
	GameEffects.Kill.groundRing(state, floor, state.textures.ringEdge, color, 2, 11, 0.55, 3)
	local light = environment.Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color, light.Range, light.Shadows, light.Brightness, light.Parent = color, 16, false, 0, anchor
	GameEffects.Kill.animate(state, 1.7, function(progress) light.Brightness = (1 - progress) * (4 + math.noise(progress * 22, 0.37) * 4) end)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.fireball, 0.45, 0.55, anchor)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.fireWhoosh, 0.6, 0.5, anchor)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 3)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, floor, 1.5)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.highlight(state, model, color, outline, transparency, outlineTransparency)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local highlight = environment.Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.FillColor, highlight.OutlineColor = color, outline or color
	highlight.FillTransparency, highlight.OutlineTransparency = transparency or 0.5, outlineTransparency or 0
	highlight.DepthMode = environment.Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	highlight.Adornee, highlight.Parent = model, model
	return highlight
end

function GameEffects.Kill.crystalPrison(state, effect)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local color, white = environment.Color3.fromRGB(170, 90, 255), environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local ground = GameEffects.Kill.ground(state, effect.root, effect.ignore)
	local height = ground and ground.Y or effect.root.Y - 3
	local body, model = GameEffects.Kill.staticBody(state, effect)
	GameEffects.Kill.hideEffectBody(state, effect.char)
	if model then GameEffects.Kill.highlight(state, model, color, environment.Color3.fromRGB(230, 200, 255), 0.45, 0) end

	local crystals = {}
	local top = effect.head + environment.Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)
	for index = 1, 9 do
		local angle, radius = index / 9 * 6.283 + math.random() * 0.3, 2.2 + math.random() * 0.6
		local start = environment.Vector3.new(effect.root.X + math.cos(angle) * radius, height - 0.2, effect.root.Z + math.sin(angle) * radius)
		local finish = top + environment.Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 0.4, math.random() * 0.8, math.sin(angle) * 0.4)
		local parts, direction, length = GameEffects.Kill.spike(state, start, finish, 0.45, 0.6 + math.random() * 0.25,
			color:Lerp(white, math.random() * 0.3), environment.Enum.Material.Glass)
		for _, part in parts do
			part.Transparency, part.Reflectance = 0.2, 0.3
			local frame = part.CFrame
			part.CFrame = frame - direction * (length + 0.3)
			GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, index * 0.035, function()
				if part.Parent then GameEffects.Kill.tween(state, part, 0.3, {CFrame = frame}, environment.Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end
			end)
			table.insert(crystals, part)
		end
	end

	local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(effect.chest), environment.Vector3.new(4, 5, 4))
	local emitter = GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.star4, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(white, color),
		Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0, 0.5, 0.9, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5),
		Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(0, 90), Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, Brightness = 5, ZOffset = 1}, 0)
	emitter.Rate, emitter.Enabled = 14, true
	GameEffects.Kill.light(state, anchor, color, 5, 16, 1.4)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 3)
	GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 1.15, function()
		emitter.Enabled = false
		for _, part in crystals do pcall(function() part:Destroy() end) end
		for _, part in body do pcall(function() part:Destroy() end) end
		GameEffects.Kill.fragments(state, effect.chest, 26, color, environment.Enum.Material.Glass, 0.45, 18, 1.6)
		GameEffects.Kill.flash(state, effect.chest, color, 12, 5)
		GameEffects.Kill.sparks(state, effect.chest, color, 30, 30, state.textures.shards)
		GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.glassSmash2, 1, 0.8)
		GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.iceFreeze, 0.6, 0.7, nil, 1.6)
		GameEffects.Kill.shakeCamera(state, effect.chest, 0.9, 0.3)
	end)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.iceFreeze, 0.8, 0.6, nil, 1.6)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.synthSpark, 0.4, 1.6)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.spike(state, start, finish, width, depth, color, material)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local offset = finish - start
	local length, direction = offset.Magnitude, offset.Unit
	local reference = math.abs(direction.Z) < 0.9 and environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or environment.Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
	local frame = environment.CFrame.fromMatrix(start, direction:Cross(reference).Unit, direction)
	local parts = {}
	for index = 0, 3 do
		local part = environment.Instance.new("WedgePart")
		part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
		part.Material, part.Color, part.Reflectance = material, color, 0.15
		part.Size = environment.Vector3.new(width, length, depth)
		part.CFrame = frame * environment.CFrame.Angles(0, index * math.pi / 2, 0) * environment.CFrame.new(0, length / 2, -depth / 2)
		part.Parent = GameEffects.Kill.folder(state)
		table.insert(parts, part)
	end
	return parts, direction, length
end

function GameEffects.Kill.fragments(state, position, count, color, material, size, speed, lifetime)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local parts = {}
	for _ = 1, count do
		local part = environment.Instance.new("Part")
		local scale = size * (0.5 + math.random())
		part.Size = environment.Vector3.new(scale, scale * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.6), scale * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.5))
		part.Material, part.Color = material or environment.Enum.Material.Slate, color
		part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch = false, false
		pcall(function() part.CollisionGroup = "Ragdolls" end)
		local offset = environment.Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, math.random() * 0.8, (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5)
		part.CFrame = environment.CFrame.new(position + offset) * environment.CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6)
		part.Parent = GameEffects.Kill.bodiesFolder(state)
		table.insert(parts, part)
		local duration = (lifetime or 2) + math.random() * 0.6
		GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, duration, function()
			if part.Parent then GameEffects.Kill.tween(state, part, 0.4, {Size = part.Size * 0.2, Transparency = 1}) end
		end)
		GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, part, duration + 0.5)
	end

	local function launch()
		for _, part in parts do
			if not part.Parent then continue end
			local direction = environment.Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0, math.random() - 0.5)
			direction = direction.Magnitude > 0.05 and direction.Unit or environment.Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * speed * (0.4 + math.random() * 0.6) + environment.Vector3.new(0, speed * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.6), 0)
			part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = GameEffects.Kill.randomVector(state, 8)
		end
	end
	launch()
	local connection
	connection = context.runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() connection:Disconnect(); launch() end)
	return parts
end

function GameEffects.Kill.flash(state, position, color, size, brightness)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local anchor, attachment = GameEffects.Kill.effectAttachment(state, position)
	local white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = state.textures.core, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(white, color),
		Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, size * 0.2, 1, size), Transparency = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0, 1, 1),
		Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.35), Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(0, 360), Brightness = brightness or 5, ZOffset = 1}, 2)
	GameEffects.Kill.light(state, anchor, color, 10, math.min(60, size * 3), 0.5)
	return anchor, attachment
end

function GameEffects.Kill.sparks(state, position, color, count, speed, texture)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local anchor, attachment = GameEffects.Kill.effectAttachment(state, position)
	local white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = texture or state.textures.fsparks, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(white, color),
		Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0.5, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.7),
		Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(speed * 0.5, speed), SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(180, 180), Drag = 3,
		Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, -25, 0), Orientation = environment.Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel, Brightness = 5}, count)
	return anchor, attachment
end

function GameEffects.Kill.track(state, signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(state.connections, connection)
	return connection
end

function GameEffects.Kill.observeCharacter(state, player, character)
	if state.hooked[character] then return end
	state.hooked[character] = true

	state.context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8)
		if not humanoid or not state.alive then return end

		local handled, connections = false, {}
		local function onDeath()
			if handled then return end
			handled = true
			GameEffects.Kill.onDeath(state, player, character)
		end

		table.insert(connections, humanoid.Died:Connect(onDeath))
		table.insert(connections, humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
			if health <= 0 then onDeath() end
		end))
		table.insert(connections, character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if parent then return end
			for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
			state.characterConnections[character], state.hooked[character] = nil, nil
		end))
		state.characterConnections[character] = connections
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.observePlayer(state, player)
	if player == state.context.player then return end
	if player.Character then GameEffects.Kill.observeCharacter(state, player, player.Character) end
	GameEffects.Kill.track(state, player.CharacterAdded, function(character)
		GameEffects.Kill.observeCharacter(state, player, character)
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.observeBlade(state, blade)
	if blade.Name ~= "ThrowingKnife" then return end
	local environment = state.context.environment

	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local part = blade:FindFirstChild("BladePosition") or blade:WaitForChild("BladePosition", 1)
		if not part and blade:IsA("BasePart") then part = blade end

		local started = environment.os.clock()
		while part and part.Parent and blade.Parent and state.alive and environment.os.clock() - started < 6 do
			GameEffects.Kill.recordBlade(state, part.Position)
			environment.task.wait(0.03)
		end
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.observe(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do GameEffects.Kill.observePlayer(state, player) end

	GameEffects.Kill.track(state, context.players.PlayerAdded, function(player) GameEffects.Kill.observePlayer(state, player) end)
	GameEffects.Kill.track(state, context.workspace.DescendantAdded, function(model) GameEffects.Kill.recordRagdoll(state, model) end)
	GameEffects.Kill.track(state, context.workspace.ChildAdded, function(blade) GameEffects.Kill.observeBlade(state, blade) end)

	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local services = context.storage:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 30)
		local weapons = services and services:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 30)
		local fired = weapons and weapons:WaitForChild("GunFired", 30)
		if not state.alive or not fired or not fired:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return end

		GameEffects.Kill.track(state, fired.OnClientEvent, function(shooter, _, position, hit)
			GameEffects.Kill.recordShot(state, shooter, position, hit)
		end)
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.stop(state)
	state.alive = false
	state.showing = false
	GameEffects.Kill.resetShake(state)

	for _, connection in state.connections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	for _, connections in state.characterConnections do
		for _, connection in connections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	end

	table.clear(state.connections)
	table.clear(state.characterConnections)
	if state.folder then pcall(function() state.folder:Destroy() end); state.folder = nil end
end

function GameEffects.Kill.preview(state, name, options, title, generation)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end

		if not state.dummyDescription then
			pcall(function() state.dummyDescription = context.players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(context.player.UserId) end)
		end
		if not state.dummyDescription then return end

		local ok, model = pcall(function()
			return context.players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(state.dummyDescription, environment.Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
		end)
		if not ok or not model then return end

		model.Name = "PulseKillPreview"
		local frame = camera.CFrame
		local direction = environment.Vector3.new(frame.LookVector.X, 0, frame.LookVector.Z)
		direction = direction.Magnitude > 0.01 and direction.Unit or environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		local character = context.player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local position = (root and root.Position or frame.Position) + direction * 9
		local localHumanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local ground
		if root then ground = root.Position.Y - root.Size.Y / 2 - (localHumanoid and localHumanoid.HipHeight or 2) end
		if not ground then
			local hit = GameEffects.Kill.ground(state, position, {a = character, b = camera})
			ground = hit and hit.Y or position.Y - 3
		end

		local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local previewRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		previewRoot.Anchored = true
		for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch = false, false, false end
		end
		if humanoid then humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = environment.Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end

		local center = environment.Vector3.new(position.X, ground + (humanoid and humanoid.HipHeight or 2) + previewRoot.Size.Y / 2, position.Z)
		model:PivotTo(environment.CFrame.lookAt(center, environment.Vector3.new(frame.Position.X, center.Y, frame.Position.Z)))
		model.Parent = GameEffects.Kill.folder(state)
		if title and context.window then
			pcall(function() context.window:Notify({Title = context.translation.tr(title), Text = context.translation.tr(name), Kind = "info", Duration = 2}) end)
		end

		environment.task.wait(0.45)
		if generation and (state.showGen ~= generation or not state.showing) then pcall(function() model:Destroy() end); return end

		character = context.player.Character
		local killer = character and (character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
		GameEffects.Kill.play(state, name, options, model, killer)
		environment.task.wait(2.6 / state.speed)
		pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.clearShow(state)
	for _, folder in {state.folder, state.bodies} do
		if not folder then continue end
		for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do pcall(function() child:Destroy() end) end
	end
	pcall(GameEffects.Kill.resetShake, state)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.showLabel(state, showing)
	local button, environment = state.showButton, state.context.environment
	if environment.typeof(button) ~= "Instance" then return end

	local start = state.context.translation.tr("Show All Effects")
	local stop = state.context.translation.tr("Stop Showing")
	local text = showing and stop or start
	local objects = button:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(objects, button)
	for _, object in objects do
		if not object:IsA("TextLabel") and not object:IsA("TextButton") then continue end
		if object.Text == start or object.Text == stop then object.Text = text end
	end
end

function GameEffects.Kill.previewAll(state)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	state.showGen += 1
	local generation = state.showGen
	if state.showing then
		state.showing = false
		GameEffects.Kill.clearShow(state)
		environment.task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 16 do
				environment.task.wait(0.2)
				if state.showing or state.showGen ~= generation then break end
				GameEffects.Kill.clearShow(state)
			end
		end)
		GameEffects.Kill.showLabel(state, false)
		return
	end

	state.showing = true
	GameEffects.Kill.showLabel(state, true)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local function active() return state.alive and state.showing and state.showGen == generation end
		for _, group in {{GameEffects.Kill.knifeEffects, "Knife Kill"}, {GameEffects.Kill.gunEffects, "Gun Kill"}} do
			for _, name in group[1] do
				if not active() then break end
				GameEffects.Kill.preview(state, name, group[1], group[2], generation)
				local started = environment.os.clock()
				while active() and environment.os.clock() - started < 3.2 / state.speed do environment.task.wait(0.05) end
			end
		end
		if state.showGen == generation then
			state.showing = false
			GameEffects.Kill.showLabel(state, false)
		end
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.options(names)
	local options = {}
	for _, name in names do
		table.insert(options, {code = name, label = name:gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2")})
	end
	table.insert(options, {code = "Random", label = "Random"})
	return options
end

function GameEffects.Kill.install(context)
	local environment, section = context.environment, context.section
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	if type(globals.__pulseKillFXStop) == "function" then pcall(globals.__pulseKillFXStop) end

	local state = GameEffects.Kill.create(context)
	state.showGen = 0
	state.stop = function() GameEffects.Kill.stop(state) end
	globals.__pulseKillFX, globals.__pulseKillFXStop = state, state.stop
	GameEffects.Kill.observe(state)

	section:Group({Title = "Kill Effects", Side = "Right"})
	section._curSub = "KillFX"
	section:Toggle({Text = "Kill Effects", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.on = value == true end})
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Knife Kill", Default = "Slash", Options = GameEffects.Kill.options(GameEffects.Kill.knifeEffects), Callback = function(value)
		if value then state.knife = value end
	end})
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Gun Kill", Default = "Headshot", Options = GameEffects.Kill.options(GameEffects.Kill.gunEffects), Callback = function(value)
		if value then state.gun = value end
	end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Screen Shake", Default = true, Callback = function(value)
		state.shake = value == true
		if not state.shake then GameEffects.Kill.resetShake(state) end
	end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Only My Kills", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.mine = value == true end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Kill Sounds", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.sound = value == true end, Settings = function()
		section:Slider({Text = "Kill Volume", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = 60, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%", Callback = function(value) state.volume = value end})
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Preview Knife Kill", Callback = function() GameEffects.Kill.preview(state, state.knife, GameEffects.Kill.knifeEffects, "Knife Kill") end})
	section:Button({Text = "Preview Gun Kill", Callback = function() GameEffects.Kill.preview(state, state.gun, GameEffects.Kill.gunEffects, "Gun Kill") end})
	state.showButton = section:Button({Text = "Show All Effects", Callback = function() GameEffects.Kill.previewAll(state) end})
	return state.stop
end

local AuraEngine = {}
local AURA_CLASSES = {P = "ParticleEmitter", B = "Beam", T = "Trail", L = "PointLight", S = "SpotLight", U = "SurfaceLight", A = "Attachment",
	FI = "Fire", SM = "Smoke", SP = "Sparkles", F = "Folder", PT = "Part", SH = "SpecialMesh", HL = "Highlight", MD = "Model"}
local AURA_HAT_EFFECTS = {P = true, B = true, T = true, L = true, S = true, U = true}

function AuraEngine.decode(environment, value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local kind = value[1]
	if kind == 1 then return environment.Color3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]) end
	if kind == 2 then return environment.Vector3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]) end
	if kind == 3 then return environment.Vector2.new(value[2], value[3]) end
	if kind == 4 then return environment.NumberRange.new(value[2], value[3]) end
	if kind == 5 then
		local points = {}
		for index = 2, #value, 3 do table.insert(points, environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(value[index], value[index + 1], value[index + 2])) end
		return environment.NumberSequence.new(points)
	end
	if kind == 6 then
		local points = {}
		for index = 2, #value, 4 do
			table.insert(points, environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(value[index], environment.Color3.new(value[index + 1], value[index + 2], value[index + 3])))
		end
		return environment.ColorSequence.new(points)
	end
	if kind == 7 then return environment.CFrame.new(table.unpack(value, 2, 13)) end
	if kind == 8 then
		local name = tostring(value[2]):gsub("^Enum%.", "")
		local ok, item = pcall(function() return environment.Enum[name][value[3]] end)
		return ok and item or nil
	end
	return nil
end

function AuraEngine.sequence(environment, sequence, scale, fade)
	local points = {}
	for _, point in sequence.Keypoints do
		local value = fade and 1 - (1 - point.Value) * scale or point.Value * scale
		table.insert(points, environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point.Time, value, point.Envelope * scale))
	end
	return environment.NumberSequence.new(points)
end

function AuraEngine.recolor(environment, sequence, tint)
	if environment.typeof(sequence) ~= "ColorSequence" then return environment.ColorSequence.new(tint) end
	local points = {}
	for _, point in sequence.Keypoints do
		local original = point.Value
		local high, low = math.max(original.R, original.G, original.B), math.min(original.R, original.G, original.B)
		local brightness = 0.3 + 0.7 * high
		local color = environment.Color3.new(tint.R * brightness, tint.G * brightness, tint.B * brightness)
		if low > 0.72 then color = color:Lerp(environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), (low - 0.72) / 0.28 * 0.75) end
		table.insert(points, environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(point.Time, color))
	end
	return environment.ColorSequence.new(points)
end

function AuraEngine.tune(environment, object, options)
	local size, density, bright, alpha = options.size or 1, options.density or 1, options.bright or 1, options.alpha or 1
	pcall(function()
		if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			if size ~= 1 then
				object.Size = AuraEngine.sequence(environment, object.Size, size, false)
				object.Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(object.Speed.Min * size, object.Speed.Max * size)
				object.Acceleration *= size
			end
			if density ~= 1 then object.Rate *= density end
			if bright ~= 1 then object.Brightness *= bright end
			if alpha ~= 1 then object.Transparency = AuraEngine.sequence(environment, object.Transparency, alpha, true) end
			return
		end
		if object:IsA("Beam") then
			if size ~= 1 then
				object.Width0, object.Width1 = object.Width0 * size, object.Width1 * size
				object.CurveSize0, object.CurveSize1 = object.CurveSize0 * size, object.CurveSize1 * size
			end
			if bright ~= 1 then object.Brightness *= bright end
			if alpha ~= 1 then object.Transparency = AuraEngine.sequence(environment, object.Transparency, alpha, true) end
			return
		end
		if object:IsA("Trail") then
			if bright ~= 1 then object.Brightness *= bright end
			if alpha ~= 1 then object.Transparency = AuraEngine.sequence(environment, object.Transparency, alpha, true) end
			return
		end
		if object:IsA("Light") then
			if size ~= 1 then object.Range *= size end
			if bright ~= 1 then object.Brightness *= bright end
		end
	end)
end

function AuraEngine.build(environment, data, parent, build)
	if data.g and build.off[data.g] then return nil end
	local class = AURA_CLASSES[data.c]
	if not class then return nil end
	local object = environment.Instance.new(class)
	object.Name = data.n or class
	for property, value in data.p or {} do pcall(function() object[property] = AuraEngine.decode(environment, value) end) end
	if data.c == "A" then
		local position = object.Position
		if build.hatHost then
			object.Position = position * ((build.hatK or 1) * build.size)
		else
			local fit = build.fit
			if build.mapA then
				object.Position = build.mapA(position)
			else
				if fit then position = environment.Vector3.new(position.X * fit.x, fit.f + (position.Y + 3) * fit.y, position.Z * fit.z) end
				object.Position = position * build.size + build.liftV
			end
		end
	end
	if data.c == "PT" then
		object.Anchored, object.CanCollide, object.CanQuery, object.CanTouch, object.Massless, object.CastShadow = false, false, false, false, true, false
		local scale = (build.hatK or 1) * build.size
		object.Size *= scale
		local frame = AuraEngine.decode(environment, data.r) or environment.CFrame.new()
		frame = environment.CFrame.new((frame.Position - environment.Vector3.new(0, build.hatCrown or 0, 0)) * scale) * frame.Rotation
		if build.hatHost then
			object.CFrame = build.hatHost.CFrame * frame
			local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.C0, weld.Parent = build.hatHost, object, frame, object
		end
		local alpha = build.options.alpha or 1
		if alpha ~= 1 then object.Transparency = 1 - (1 - object.Transparency) * alpha end
	end
	if data.c == "SH" then
		local scale = (build.hatK or 1) * build.size
		object.Scale, object.Offset = object.Scale * scale, object.Offset * scale
	end
	if data.c == "HL" then
		local alpha, bright = build.options.alpha or 1, build.options.bright or 1
		object.FillTransparency = 1 - math.clamp((1 - object.FillTransparency) * alpha * bright, 0, 1)
		object.OutlineTransparency = 1 - math.clamp((1 - object.OutlineTransparency) * alpha, 0, 1)
	end
	if data.c == "FI" and build.hatHost then object.Size = math.clamp(object.Size * (build.hatK or 1) * build.size, 2, 30) end
	if data.c == "P" then object.LockedToPart = true end
	if data.c == "T" then object.Lifetime = math.min(object.Lifetime, 0.3) end
	if data.i then build.ids[data.i] = object end
	if data.a or data.b then table.insert(build.links, {object, data.a, data.b}) end
	if data.g then AuraEngine.tune(environment, object, build.options) end
	if not data.g and build.hatTune and AURA_HAT_EFFECTS[data.c] then AuraEngine.tune(environment, object, build.hatTune) end
	object:SetAttribute("PulseVFX", true)
	object:SetAttribute("PulseVFXKey", build.key)
	for _, child in data.k or {} do AuraEngine.build(environment, child, object, build) end
	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end

function AuraEngine.link(build)
	for _, link in build.links do
		pcall(function()
			if link[2] and build.ids[link[2]] then link[1].Attachment0 = build.ids[link[2]] end
			if link[3] and build.ids[link[3]] then link[1].Attachment1 = build.ids[link[3]] end
		end)
	end
end

local AURA_R15 = {HumanoidRootPart = true, Head = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true, LeftUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, LeftHand = true,
	RightUpperArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, RightHand = true, LeftUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, LeftFoot = true, RightUpperLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true, RightFoot = true}
local AURA_R6 = {HumanoidRootPart = true, Head = true, Torso = true, ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true, ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true}
local AURA_LIMBS = {["Left Arm"] = "LeftUpperArm", ["Right Arm"] = "RightUpperArm", ["Left Leg"] = "LeftUpperLeg", ["Right Leg"] = "RightUpperLeg"}

function AuraEngine.fit(environment, character, root)
	local head, foot, torso = character:FindFirstChild("Head"), character:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot"), character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	if not head or not foot or not torso or not head:IsA("BasePart") or not foot:IsA("BasePart") or not torso:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
	local rest, links = {[root] = environment.CFrame.new()}, {}
	for _, joint in character:GetDescendants() do
		if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 then
			table.insert(links, {joint.Part0, joint.Part1, joint.C0, joint.C1})
			continue
		end
		if not joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or not joint.Attachment0 or not joint.Attachment1 then continue end
		local first, second = joint.Attachment0, joint.Attachment1
		if first.Parent and second.Parent and first.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and second.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(links, {first.Parent, second.Parent, first.CFrame, second.CFrame})
		end
	end
	local changed = true
	while changed do
		changed = false
		for _, link in links do
			if not rest[link[1]] or rest[link[2]] then continue end
			rest[link[2]] = rest[link[1]] * link[3] * link[4]:Inverse()
			changed = true
		end
	end
	if not rest[head] or not rest[foot] then return nil end
	local floor = rest[foot].Position.Y - foot.Size.Y / 2
	local height = (rest[head].Position.Y - floor) / 4.5
	if floor > -1 or height < 0.4 or height > 2 then return nil end
	return {x = math.clamp(torso.Size.X / 2, 0.45, 1.8), y = height, z = math.clamp(torso.Size.Z, 0.45, 1.8), f = floor, rest = rest}
end

function AuraEngine.put(state, character, root, key, options)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local data = state.data[key]
	if not data then return end
	options = options or {}
	if data.hat then return AuraEngine.putHat(state, character, data, key, options) end
	local scale, lift = options.size or 1, options.lift or 0
	local isR15 = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil
	local fit = isR15 and AuraEngine.fit(environment, character, root) or nil
	local build = {key = key, options = options, off = options.off or {}, size = scale, ids = {}, links = {}, liftV = environment.Vector3.zero}
	local rigScale, mapPosition
	if data.rig and fit then
		local torso, head = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local torsoRest, headRest = torso and fit.rest[torso], head and fit.rest[head]
		if torsoRest and headRest and headRest.Position.Y > torsoRest.Position.Y + 0.2 then
			local rig = data.rig
			local y = (headRest.Position.Y - torsoRest.Position.Y) / (rig.hy - rig.ty)
			local x, z = math.clamp(torso.Size.X / rig.tx, 0.3, 2.5), math.clamp(torso.Size.Z / rig.tz, 0.3, 2.5)
			local originY = torsoRest.Position.Y
			rigScale = environment.Vector3.new(x, y, z)
			mapPosition = function(position) return environment.Vector3.new(position.X * x, originY + (position.Y - rig.ty) * y, position.Z * z) end
		end
	end
	for _, hostData in data.h or {} do
		build.mapA = nil
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(hostData.n)
		local allowed = isR15 and AURA_R15[hostData.n] or not isR15 and AURA_R6[hostData.n]
		local host
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and allowed then
			build.liftV = part.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(environment.Vector3.new(0, lift, 0))
			build.fit = part == root and fit or nil
			if mapPosition then
				local localLift = build.liftV
				if part == root then
					build.mapA = function(position) return mapPosition(position) * scale + localLift end
				else
					local reference = AuraEngine.decode(environment, hostData.s) or part.Size
					local ratios = environment.Vector3.new(part.Size.X / math.max(reference.X, 0.01), part.Size.Y / math.max(reference.Y, 0.01), part.Size.Z / math.max(reference.Z, 0.01))
					build.mapA = function(position) return environment.Vector3.new(position.X * ratios.X, position.Y * ratios.Y, position.Z * ratios.Z) * scale + localLift end
				end
			end
			host = part
		else
			build.liftV, build.fit = environment.Vector3.zero, nil
			local original = AuraEngine.decode(environment, hostData.cf) or environment.CFrame.new()
			local position = original.Position
			if mapPosition then position = mapPosition(position) end
			if not mapPosition and fit then position = environment.Vector3.new(position.X * fit.x, fit.f + (position.Y + 3) * fit.y, position.Z * fit.z) end
			local frame = environment.CFrame.new(position * scale + environment.Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)) * original.Rotation
			if mapPosition then
				build.mapA = function(localPosition)
					return frame:PointToObjectSpace(mapPosition(original:PointToWorldSpace(localPosition)) * scale + environment.Vector3.new(0, lift, 0))
				end
			end
			host = environment.Instance.new("Part")
			host.Name = "PulseAuraHost"
			host.Size = (AuraEngine.decode(environment, hostData.s) or environment.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)) * scale
			if rigScale then host.Size = environment.Vector3.new(host.Size.X * rigScale.X, host.Size.Y * rigScale.Y, host.Size.Z * rigScale.Z) end
			host.Transparency, host.CanCollide, host.CanQuery, host.CanTouch, host.CastShadow, host.Massless = 1, false, false, false, false, true
			local limb = fit and AURA_LIMBS[hostData.n] and character:FindFirstChild(AURA_LIMBS[hostData.n])
			local anchor, offset = root, frame
			if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") and fit.rest[limb] then anchor, offset = limb, fit.rest[limb]:Inverse() * frame end
			host.CFrame = anchor.CFrame * offset
			local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.C0, weld.Parent = anchor, host, offset, host
			host:SetAttribute("PulseVFX", true)
			host:SetAttribute("PulseVFXKey", key)
			host.Parent = character
		end
		for _, child in hostData.k or {} do AuraEngine.build(environment, child, host, build) end
	end
	AuraEngine.link(build)
end

local AURA_HAT_DEFAULTS = { ph_wire = { "Spin", "Wave" }, ph_galaxy = { "Float" }, ph_galaxyflame = { "Float" }, ph_phantom = { "Float" }, ph_glass = { "Spin" },
                ph_rainbowedge = { "Spin" }, ph_reddevil = { "Float" }, ph_evilrainbow = { "Float" }, ph_amethyst = { "Float" }, ph_molten = { "Float" },
                ph_toonblue = { "Float" }, ph_toonneon = { "Float" }, ph_goldflame = { "Float" }, ph_raidenglass = { "Spin" }, ph_pinkgold = { "Sway" },
                ph_pastel = { "Sway" }, ph_immember = { "Spin" }, ph_immtoxic = { "Spin" }, ph_lantred = { "Spin" }, ph_lantgreen = { "Spin" }, ph_jade = { "Sway" },
                ph_cyberoni = { "Float" }, ph_cyberronin = { "Float" }, ph_crane = { "Spin" }, ph_redglow = { "Spin" }, ph_bells = { "Sway" }, ph_bluekasa = { "Spin" } }
local AURA_HAT_FIT = { ph_amethyst = 0.773, ph_bamboo = 0.701, ph_bells = 0.711, ph_bluekasa = 0.793, ph_crane = 0.704, ph_cyberoni = 0.694, ph_cyberronin = 0.708,
                ph_dragon = 0.723, ph_evilrainbow = 0.773, ph_galaxy = 0.682, ph_galaxyflame = 0.682, ph_glass = 0.731, ph_goldflame = 1.017, ph_goldiron = 0.578,
                ph_immblack = 0.745, ph_immember = 0.745, ph_immpurple = 0.745, ph_immred = 0.745, ph_immtoxic = 0.745, ph_jade = 0.78, ph_lantgreen = 0.729,
                ph_lantred = 0.729, ph_molten = 0.773, ph_mossy = 1.024, ph_panda = 0.93, ph_pastel = 0.724, ph_phantom = 0.581, ph_pinkgold = 0.93, ph_purple = 0.719,
                ph_raidenglass = 0.902, ph_rainbowedge = 0.705, ph_reddevil = 0.705, ph_redglow = 0.797, ph_redronin = 0.723, ph_ronin = 0.776, ph_shadowkasa = 0.748,
                ph_toonblue = 0.701, ph_toonneon = 0.812, ph_veil = 0.794, ph_wire = 0.579 }
local AuraHat = {}

function AuraHat.accessoryKind(environment, accessory)
	local kind
	pcall(function()
		if accessory.AccessoryType == environment.Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then kind = "hair" end
		if accessory.AccessoryType == environment.Enum.AccessoryType.Hat then kind = "hat" end
	end)
	if kind then return kind end
	local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if handle and handle:FindFirstChild("HairAttachment") then return "hair" end
	if handle and handle:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment") then return "hat" end
	return nil
end

function AuraHat.hiddenParts(environment, character, hide)
	local result = {}
	for _, accessory in character:GetChildren() do
		if not accessory:IsA("Accessory") then continue end
		local kind = AuraHat.accessoryKind(environment, accessory)
		if not (kind == "hat" and hide.hat or kind == "hair" and hide.hair) then continue end
		for _, object in accessory:GetDescendants() do if object:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(result, object) end end
	end
	return result
end

function AuraHat.hairLift(environment, character, head, crown)
	local top
	for _, accessory in character:GetChildren() do
		if not accessory:IsA("Accessory") or AuraHat.accessoryKind(environment, accessory) ~= "hair" then continue end
		local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		if not handle or not handle:IsA("MeshPart") or handle.Transparency >= 0.95 then continue end
		local frame, size = head.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(handle.CFrame), handle.Size
		if math.abs(frame.X) >= head.Size.X or math.abs(frame.Z) >= head.Size.Z then continue end
		local height = frame.Y + math.abs(frame.XVector.Y) * size.X / 2 + math.abs(frame.YVector.Y) * size.Y / 2 + math.abs(frame.ZVector.Y) * size.Z / 2
		if not top or height > top then top = height end
	end
	return top and math.clamp((top - crown.Y) * 0.7, 0, 0.9) or 0
end

function AuraHat.collect(state, hat, roots)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local objects = {}
	for _, root in roots do
		table.insert(objects, root)
		for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do table.insert(objects, object) end
	end
	for _, object in objects do
		local record
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then record = {object = object, kind = "part", color = object.Color, transparency = object.Transparency} end
		if object:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
			local material = object.Parent and object.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and object.Parent.Material
			record = {object = object, kind = "mesh", color = object.VertexColor, multiplier = material == environment.Enum.Material.ForceField and 0 or (material == environment.Enum.Material.Neon and 0.9 or 1.3)}
		end
		if object:IsA("Highlight") then record = {object = object, kind = "highlight", color = object.OutlineColor, second = object.FillColor, transparency = object.FillTransparency, outline = object.OutlineTransparency} end
		if object:IsA("Fire") then record = {object = object, kind = "fire", color = object.Color, second = object.SecondaryColor} end
		if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail") then record = {object = object, kind = "sequence", color = object.Color} end
		if object:IsA("Light") then record = {object = object, kind = "light", color = object.Color} end
		if not record then continue end
		local part = object:IsA("BasePart") and object or object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
		local position = part and hat.root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(part.Position) or environment.Vector3.zero
		record.phase = math.atan2(position.Z, position.X) / (2 * math.pi) % 1
		table.insert(hat.colors, record)
	end
end

function AuraHat.restore(hat)
	for _, record in hat.colors do
		pcall(function()
			local object = record.object
			if record.kind == "part" then object.Color, object.Transparency = record.color, record.transparency; return end
			if record.kind == "mesh" then object.VertexColor = record.color; return end
			if record.kind == "highlight" then
				object.OutlineColor, object.FillColor, object.FillTransparency, object.OutlineTransparency = record.color, record.second, record.transparency, record.outline
				return
			end
			if record.kind == "fire" then object.Color, object.SecondaryColor = record.color, record.second; return end
			object.Color = record.color
		end)
	end
end

function AuraHat.paint(state, hat, phase, wave)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	for _, record in hat.colors do
		local object = record.object
		local color = environment.Color3.fromHSV((phase + (wave and record.phase or 0)) % 1, 0.78, 1)
		if record.kind == "part" then object.Color = color; continue end
		if record.kind == "mesh" then
			if record.multiplier > 0 then object.VertexColor = environment.Vector3.new(color.R, color.G, color.B) * record.multiplier end
			continue
		end
		if record.kind == "highlight" then object.OutlineColor, object.FillColor = color, color; continue end
		if record.kind == "fire" then object.Color, object.SecondaryColor = color, color:Lerp(environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35); continue end
		if record.kind == "sequence" then object.Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(color); continue end
		object.Color = color
	end
end

function AuraHat.pulse(hat, value)
	for _, record in hat.colors do
		if record.kind == "part" and record.transparency < 1 then record.object.Transparency = record.transparency + (1 - record.transparency) * 0.6 * value end
		if record.kind == "highlight" then record.object.FillTransparency = record.transparency + (1 - record.transparency) * 0.8 * value end
	end
end

function AuraHat.step(state)
	local environment, now = state.context.environment, state.context.environment.os.clock()
	local hats, hidden = {}, {}
	for _, hat in state.hats do
		if not hat.root.Parent or not hat.weld.Parent then continue end
		table.insert(hats, hat)
		local elapsed, motion, scale, frame = (now - hat.started) * hat.speed, hat.motion, hat.scale, hat.base
		if motion == "Spin" then frame *= environment.CFrame.Angles(0, elapsed * 1.5, 0) end
		if motion == "Float" then frame *= environment.CFrame.new(0, (math.sin(elapsed * 2.2) + 1) * 0.08 * scale, 0) end
		if motion == "Spin + Float" then frame *= environment.CFrame.new(0, (math.sin(elapsed * 2.2) + 1) * 0.08 * scale, 0) * environment.CFrame.Angles(0, elapsed * 1.5, 0) end
		if motion == "Sway" then frame *= environment.CFrame.Angles(math.sin(elapsed * 1.7) * 0.1, 0, math.sin(elapsed * 1.3 + 1.1) * 0.1) end
		if motion == "Wobble" then frame *= environment.CFrame.fromAxisAngle(environment.Vector3.new(math.cos(elapsed * 2.6), 0, math.sin(elapsed * 2.6)), 0.13) end
		if motion == "Hover" then frame *= environment.CFrame.new(0, (0.45 + math.sin(elapsed * 1.8) * 0.1) * scale, 0) * environment.CFrame.Angles(0, elapsed * 0.9, 0) end
		if motion == "Bounce" then frame *= environment.CFrame.new(0, math.abs(math.sin(elapsed * 3.2)) * 0.2 * scale, 0) end
		if motion ~= "None" or not hat.still then hat.weld.C0, hat.still = frame, motion == "None" end
		if hat.fx ~= "None" and now - (hat.fxAt or 0) >= 0.025 then
			hat.fxAt = now
			if hat.fx == "Rainbow" or hat.fx == "Wave" then AuraHat.paint(state, hat, elapsed * 0.22 % 1, hat.fx == "Wave") end
			if hat.fx == "Pulse" then AuraHat.pulse(hat, 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(elapsed * 3.2)) end
		end
		if hat.hide then
			if now - (hat.hideAt or 0) > 0.5 then hat.hideAt, hat.hideList = now, AuraHat.hiddenParts(environment, hat.character, hat.hide) end
			for _, part in hat.hideList or {} do
				hidden[part] = true
				if part.LocalTransparencyModifier < 1 then part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end
			end
		end
	end
	state.hats = hats
	for part in state.hidden do if not hidden[part] then pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end) end end
	state.hidden = hidden
end

function AuraEngine.putHat(state, character, data, key, options)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head or not head:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	local size = options.size or 1
	local width = head:IsA("MeshPart") and (head.Size.X + head.Size.Z) / 2 or math.min(head.Size.X, head.Size.Z) * 1.2
	local fit = math.clamp(width / 1.196, 0.5, 2.5) * (AURA_HAT_FIT[key] or 1)
	local attachment = head:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment")
	local crown = attachment and attachment:IsA("Attachment") and attachment.CFrame or environment.CFrame.new(0, head.Size.Y / 2, 0)
	local hair = 0
	if not (options.mine and options.hideHair == true) then
		local ok, value = pcall(AuraHat.hairLift, environment, character, head, crown)
		if ok then hair = value end
	end
	local base = crown * environment.CFrame.new(0, (options.lift or 0) + hair, 0)
	local root = environment.Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name, root.Size, root.Transparency, root.Anchored = "PulseHatRoot", environment.Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05), 1, false
	root.CanCollide, root.CanQuery, root.CanTouch, root.Massless, root.CastShadow = false, false, false, true, false
	root.CFrame = head.CFrame * base
	local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.C0, weld.Parent = "PulseHatWeld", head, root, base, root
	root:SetAttribute("PulseVFX", true)
	root:SetAttribute("PulseVFXKey", key)
	root.Parent = character
	local build = {key = key, options = options, off = options.off or {}, size = size, ids = {}, links = {}, liftV = environment.Vector3.zero,
		hatHost = root, hatK = fit, hatCrown = data.crown or 0.6,
		hatTune = {size = fit * size, density = options.density or 1, bright = options.bright or 1, alpha = options.alpha or 1}}
	local roots = {}
	for _, host in data.h or {} do
		for _, child in host.k or {} do
			local built = AuraEngine.build(environment, child, character, build)
			if built then table.insert(roots, built) end
		end
	end
	AuraEngine.link(build)
	local defaults = AURA_HAT_DEFAULTS[key] or {}
	local hat = {character = character, root = root, weld = weld, base = base, scale = fit * size, key = key, started = environment.os.clock(), still = true,
		colors = {}, motion = options.motion or defaults[1] or "None", fx = options.cfx or defaults[2] or "None", speed = math.clamp(tonumber(options.aspd) or 1, 0.1, 3)}
	if options.mine and (options.hideHat ~= false or options.hideHair == true) then hat.hide = {hat = options.hideHat ~= false, hair = options.hideHair == true} end
	AuraHat.collect(state, hat, roots)
	table.insert(state.hats, hat)
end

local AuraTint = {}

function AuraTint.roots(state, character)
	local roots = {}
	if not character then return roots end
	table.insert(roots, character)
	local context, globals = state.context, state.context.environment.getgenv()
	local model
	if character == context.player.Character then
		if type(globals.__pulseSkinModel) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(globals.__pulseSkinModel)
			if ok then model = result end
		end
	else
		local player = context.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		local remote = rawget(globals, "__pulseRemoteSkin")
		if player and type(remote) == "table" and type(remote.liveModel) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(remote.liveModel, player)
			if ok then model = result end
		end
	end
	if model then table.insert(roots, model) end
	return roots
end

function AuraTint.applyObject(state, object, color, glow, remote)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local sequence = object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail")
	local light = object:IsA("PointLight") or object:IsA("SpotLight") or object:IsA("SurfaceLight")
	if sequence then
		if state.colors[object] == nil then state.colors[object] = object.Color end
		if state.emission[object] == nil then state.emission[object] = object.LightEmission end
		object.Color = color and AuraEngine.recolor(environment, state.colors[object], color) or state.colors[object]
		object.LightEmission = color and state.emission[object] * glow or state.emission[object]
		return
	end
	if light then
		if state.colors[object] == nil then state.colors[object] = object.Color end
		if state.secondary[object] == nil then state.secondary[object] = object.Brightness end
		object.Color, object.Brightness = color or state.colors[object], color and state.secondary[object] * glow or state.secondary[object]
		return
	end
	if remote then return end
	if object:IsA("BasePart") and object.Name ~= "PulseAuraHost" or object:IsA("Fire") then
		if state.colors[object] == nil then state.colors[object] = object.Color end
		object.Color = color or state.colors[object]
		return
	end
	if object:IsA("Highlight") then
		if state.colors[object] == nil then state.colors[object] = object.OutlineColor end
		if state.secondary[object] == nil then state.secondary[object] = object.FillColor end
		object.OutlineColor, object.FillColor = color or state.colors[object], color or state.secondary[object]
		return
	end
	if object:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
		local material = object.Parent and object.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and object.Parent.Material
		if material == environment.Enum.Material.ForceField then return end
		if state.colors[object] == nil then state.colors[object] = object.VertexColor end
		object.VertexColor = color and environment.Vector3.new(color.R, color.G, color.B) * (material == environment.Enum.Material.Neon and 1 or 1.6) or state.colors[object]
	end
end

function AuraTint.apply(state, character, remoteOptions)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	character = character or context.player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local remote = remoteOptions ~= nil
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local common = not remote and globals.__pulseFxTintOn and globals.__pulseFxColor and globals.__pulseFxColor() or nil
	local options = context.configuration.vfxCol or {}
	for _, root in AuraTint.roots(state, character) do
		for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do
			if not object:GetAttribute("PulseVFX") then continue end
			pcall(function()
				local key = object:GetAttribute("PulseVFXKey")
				local color, glow = common, 1
				if remote then
					local packed = remoteOptions[key]
					if type(packed) == "number" and packed > 1 then
						local brightness, rgb = math.floor(packed / 16777216), packed % 16777216
						color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(rgb / 65536) % 256, math.floor(rgb / 256) % 256, rgb % 256)
						if brightness > 0 then glow = brightness / 100 end
					end
				else
					local custom = key and options[key]
					if custom and custom.custom then
						color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(custom.r, custom.g, custom.b)
						glow = custom.glow and custom.glow / 100 or 1
					end
				end
				AuraTint.applyObject(state, object, color, glow, remote)
				for _, child in object:GetDescendants() do AuraTint.applyObject(state, child, color, glow, remote) end
			end)
		end
	end
end

function AuraTint.install(context)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local state = {context = context, colors = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), emission = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), secondary = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
	local apply = function() AuraTint.apply(state) end
	local applyFor = function(character, options) if character and type(options) == "table" then AuraTint.apply(state, character, options) end end
	globals.__pulseVFXTint, globals.__pulseVFXTintFor = apply, applyFor
	context.connect(context.player.CharacterAdded, function()
		environment.task.wait(0.8)
		pcall(apply)
	end)
	return state, function()
		for object in state.colors do pcall(AuraTint.applyObject, state, object, nil, 1, false) end
		if globals.__pulseVFXTint == apply then globals.__pulseVFXTint = nil end
		if globals.__pulseVFXTintFor == applyFor then globals.__pulseVFXTintFor = nil end
	end
end
