		context.connect(button.MouseLeave, function() tile.hover = false; state.paintSkies() end)
	end
	state.paintSkies = function()
		local api = env.getgenv().__pulseSkyAPI
		local active = api and api.active() or ""
		for _, tile in ipairs(tiles) do
			local selected = tile.key == active
			context.nova.paint(tile.stroke, "Color", (selected or tile.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
			tile.stroke.Transparency, tile.stroke.Thickness = selected and 0 or (tile.hover and 0.4 or 0.8), selected and 2 or 1
			tile.shade.BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0.62 or 0.4
		end
	end
	state.paintSkies()
	return true
end

function Weather.install(context)
	local env, section = context.environment, context.section
	local defaults = Weather.defaults(env)
	local textures, sounds, recipes, grades = weatherData(env)
	local state = {context = context, defaults = defaults, values = table.clone(defaults), textures = textures, sounds = sounds,
		recipes = recipes, grades = grades, skies = weatherSkies(env), controls = {}, nodes = {}, voices = {},
		invisible = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), phase = 0, envClock = 0, envDark = 0, visibility = 0,
		frameElapsed = 0, probeElapsed = 1, audioLevel = 0, coverBlend = 0, gradeLevel = 0, dirty = true, batch = true}
	local v = state.values
	local function changed(key, value)
		v[key] = value
		if not state.batch then Weather.changed(state) end
	end
	local function toggle(text, key, settings)
		state.controls[key] = section:Toggle({Text = text, Default = v[key], Settings = settings, Callback = function(value) changed(key, value) end})
	end
	local function slider(text, key, min, max, decimals, suffix)
		state.controls[key] = section:Slider({Text = text, Min = min, Max = max, Decimals = decimals or 0, Suffix = suffix,
			Default = v[key], Callback = function(value) changed(key, value) end})
	end
	local function dropdown(text, key, values)
		local options = {}
		for _, value in ipairs(values) do table.insert(options, {code = value, label = value}) end
		state.controls[key] = section:Dropdown({Text = text, Default = v[key], Options = options, Callback = function(value)
			if value ~= nil then changed(key, value) end
		end})
	end
	local function color(text, key)
		state.controls[key] = section:Colorpicker({Text = text, Default = v[key], Callback = function(value)
			if env.typeof(value) == "Color3" then changed(key, value) end
		end})
	end
	section:Sub("Weather")
	section:Columns()
	section:Group({Title = "Weather", Side = "Left"})
	toggle("Enabled", "on")
	dropdown("Weather type", "kind", WEATHER_ORDER)
	slider("Amount", "amount", 0, 100, 0, "%")
	slider("Visibility", "opacity", 20, 100, 0, "%")
	slider("Particle size", "scale", 0.5, 1.8, 2, "x")
	section:Group({Title = "Scenes", Side = "Right"})
	local scenesReady, scenesShown = pcall(Weather.sceneGallery, state)
	if not scenesReady or not scenesShown then
		local scenes = {{code = "", label = "Clear scene"}}
		for _, scene in ipairs(WEATHER_SCENES) do table.insert(scenes, {code = scene.name, label = scene.name}) end
		local sceneControl = section:Dropdown({Text = "Scene", Options = scenes, Default = "", NoSave = true, Callback = function(name)
			if state.batch then return end
			if name == "" then Weather.clearScene(state) else Weather.scene(state, name) end
		end})
		state.paintScenes = function() if sceneControl.SetSilent then sceneControl.SetSilent(v.scene) end end
	end
	section:Button({Text = "Reset all", Callback = function()
		Weather.clearScene(state)
		for key, value in pairs(state.defaults) do v[key] = value end
		Weather.changed(state)
		Weather.syncUI(state)
	end})
	section:Group({Title = "Wind", Side = "Left"})
	slider("Wind strength", "wind", 0, 18, 1)
	slider("Wind direction", "windAngle", 0, 360, 0, "В°")
	slider("Falling speed", "speed", 60, 150, 0, "%")
	toggle("Gentle gusts", "gusts")
	section:Group({Title = "Sky", Side = "Right"})
	toggle("Match lighting", "matchLight")
	local skiesReady, skiesShown = pcall(Weather.skyGallery, state)
	if not skiesReady or not skiesShown then
		local skies = {{code = "", label = "Default sky"}}
		for _, sky in ipairs(state.skies) do table.insert(skies, {code = sky.key, label = sky.name}) end
		local skyControl = section:Dropdown({Text = "Sky", Options = skies, Default = "", NoSave = true, Callback = function(key)
			if state.batch then return end
			if key == "" then Weather.setSky(state, nil); if v.matchLight then Weather.restoreLook(state) end
			else Weather.pickSky(state, key) end
			v.scene = ""
			if state.paintScenes then state.paintScenes() end
		end})
		state.paintSkies = function()
			local api = env.getgenv().__pulseSkyAPI
			if skyControl.SetSilent then skyControl.SetSilent(api and api.active() or "") end
		end
	end
	section:Group({Title = "Sound", Side = "Left"})
	toggle("Weather sound", "sound", function() slider("Weather volume", "soundVolume", 0, 100, 0, "%") end)
	toggle("Weather tint", "grade")
	section:Group({Title = "Detail", Side = "Right"})
	dropdown("Particle budget", "quality", {"Light", "Balanced", "High", "Ultra"})
	slider("Coverage", "radius", 12, 50, 0, " st")
	toggle("Pause indoors", "shelter")
	section:Group({Title = "Particle colors", Side = "Right"})
	for _, entry in ipairs({{"Snow color", "snowColour"}, {"Petal tint", "petalColour"}, {"Leaf tint", "leafColour"},
		{"Mist color", "mistColour"}, {"Ember color", "emberColour"}, {"Ash color", "ashColour"},
		{"Firefly color", "fireflyColour"}, {"Pollen color", "pollenColour"}}) do color(entry[1], entry[2]) end
	state.batch = false
	local api = env.getgenv().__pulseSkyAPI
	if api then for _, sky in ipairs(state.skies) do api.register(sky.key, sky.spec) end end
	local savedSky = context.configuration.visuals and context.configuration.visuals.sky
	if api and savedSky and savedSky ~= "" then env.task.defer(function()
		if context.isAlive() then api.activate(savedSky, true); state.paintSkies() end
	end) end
	context.visualWorld.context.applyWeatherExtra = function(name) Weather.applyExtra(state, name) end
	env.getgenv().__pulseWeather = state
	if context.runService.RenderStepped then context.connect(context.runService.RenderStepped, function(delta)
		if state.failureAt and os.clock() < state.failureAt then return end
		local ok, message = pcall(Weather.step, state, delta)
		if not ok then
			state.failureAt = os.clock() + 3
			Weather.stop(state)
			env.warn("[SeniorHubSources] weather step failed: " .. tostring(message))
		end
	end) end
	return state, function()
		Weather.stop(state)
		if env.getgenv().__pulseWeather == state then env.getgenv().__pulseWeather = nil end
	end
end

local SkyFx = {}
local SKY_FX_ORDER = {"stars", "meteors", "comets", "net", "runes", "dust"}
local SKY_FX_TEXTURES = {dot = "rbxassetid://16512006463", soft = "rbxassetid://1075864321", spark = "rbxassetid://14590086212",
	sharp = "rbxassetid://17391818367", runes = "rbxassetid://11910560348", glyphs = "rbxassetid://10713705343",
	const1 = "rbxassetid://14101033134", const2 = "rbxassetid://14101036795", beam = "rbxassetid://12781750620", rays = "rbxassetid://4553095322"}

function SkyFx.defaults(env)
	local rgb = env.Color3.fromRGB
	return {general = {bright = 100}, stars = {on = false, density = 60, size = 100, twinkle = 60, tint = "Natural"},
		meteors = {on = false, rate = 45, length = 100, color = rgb(190, 225, 255)},
		comets = {on = false, rate = 40, size = 100, color = rgb(120, 210, 255)},
		net = {on = false, nodes = 80, reach = 50, speed = 40, place = "Sky", color = rgb(150, 205, 255), figures = true, pulses = true, rainbow = false, cursor = true},
		runes = {on = false, amount = 50, size = 100, set = "Runes", color = rgb(130, 220, 255)},
		dust = {on = false, amount = 50, palette = "Gold"}}
end

function SkyFx.palettes(env)
	local rgb = env.Color3.fromRGB
	return {stars = {Natural = {rgb(232, 240, 255), rgb(170, 200, 255), rgb(255, 226, 190)},
		Cold = {rgb(205, 225, 255), rgb(140, 185, 255), rgb(190, 240, 255)},
		Warm = {rgb(255, 238, 214), rgb(255, 205, 150), rgb(255, 180, 140)},
		Pastel = {rgb(255, 205, 236), rgb(195, 255, 232), rgb(214, 196, 255)}},
		dust = {Gold = {rgb(255, 220, 130), rgb(255, 190, 90)}, Silver = {rgb(235, 242, 255), rgb(190, 210, 255)},
		Pink = {rgb(255, 170, 220), rgb(255, 120, 190)}, Aqua = {rgb(140, 255, 235), rgb(110, 200, 255)}}}
end

function SkyFx.create(state, class, parent, properties)
	local object = state.context.environment.Instance.new(class)
	for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do object[key] = value end
	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end

function SkyFx.part(state, parent, name)
	local env = state.context.environment
	return SkyFx.create(state, "Part", parent, {Name = name, Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanTouch = false,
		CanQuery = false, CastShadow = false, Transparency = 1, Locked = true, Size = env.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)})
end

function SkyFx.emitter(state, parent, texture, life, speed, brightness, locked)
	local env = state.context.environment
	return SkyFx.create(state, "ParticleEmitter", parent, {Enabled = false, Rate = 0, Texture = texture,
		LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = brightness, Lifetime = env.NumberRange.new(life[1], life[2] or life[1]),
		Speed = env.NumberRange.new(speed and speed[1] or 0, speed and (speed[2] or speed[1]) or 0),
		LockedToPart = locked == true, Orientation = env.Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera})
end

function SkyFx.sequence(state, points)
	local env, result = state.context.environment, {}
	for _, point in ipairs(points) do table.insert(result, env.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2], point[3] or 0)) end
	return env.NumberSequence.new(result)
end

function SkyFx.rainbow(state, offset)
	local env, result = state.context.environment, {}
	for index = 0, 6 do table.insert(result, env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(index / 6, env.Color3.fromHSV((offset + index / 6) % 1, 0.55, 1))) end
	return env.ColorSequence.new(result)
end

function SkyFx.particle(state, parent, texture, life, speed, brightness, locked, sphere)
	local emitter = SkyFx.emitter(state, parent, texture, life, speed, brightness, locked)
	local env = state.context.environment
	emitter.Shape = sphere and env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere or env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
	emitter.ShapeStyle = sphere and env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Surface or env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
	if sphere then
		emitter.ShapeInOut, emitter.EmissionDirection = env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward, env.Enum.NormalId.Top
		pcall(function() emitter.ShapePartial = 0.5 end)
	end
	return emitter
end

function SkyFx.buildParticles(state, name, folder)
	local env, texture = state.context.environment, SKY_FX_TEXTURES
	local part = SkyFx.part(state, folder, name)
	local fx = {folder = folder, part = part, dirty = true, filled = false}
	if name == "stars" then
		fx.small = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {4, 9}, nil, 2.6, true, true)
		fx.tint = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {4, 8}, nil, 2.8, true, true)
		fx.big = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.spark, {5, 10}, nil, 3, true, true)
		return fx
	end
	if name == "runes" then
		part.Size = env.Vector3.new(80, 22, 80)
		fx.main = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.runes, {6, 10}, {0.5, 1.5}, 2.6)
		fx.main.Drag, fx.main.EmissionDirection, fx.main.SpreadAngle = 0.3, env.Enum.NormalId.Top, env.Vector2.new(25, 25)
		fx.main.FlipbookLayout, fx.main.FlipbookMode = env.Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4, env.Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
		fx.main.FlipbookFramerate, fx.main.FlipbookStartRandom = env.NumberRange.new(0, 0), true
		fx.glow = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {3, 6}, {0.3, 1}, 2)
		fx.glow.EmissionDirection = env.Enum.NormalId.Top
		return fx
	end
	part.Size = env.Vector3.new(90, 30, 90)
	fx.main = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.spark, {4, 8}, {0.1, 0.5}, 2.6)
	fx.glow = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {3, 7}, {0.1, 0.4}, 2.2)
	fx.main.SpreadAngle, fx.glow.SpreadAngle = env.Vector2.new(180, 180), env.Vector2.new(180, 180)
	fx.main.Acceleration, fx.glow.Acceleration = env.Vector3.new(0, -0.15, 0), env.Vector3.new(0, -0.1, 0)
	return fx
end

function SkyFx.applyStars(state, fx)
	local env, cfg, radius = state.context.environment, state.cfg.stars, state.radius
	local brightness, size = state.cfg.general.bright / 100, cfg.size / 100
	fx.part.Size = env.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * math.min(radius * 2, 2040)
	local twinkle = 0.08 + 0.62 * cfg.twinkle / 100
	local transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.1, 0.04}, {0.22, twinkle}, {0.34, 0.04}, {0.46, twinkle * 0.8},
		{0.58, 0.04}, {0.7, twinkle}, {0.82, 0.08}, {1, 1}})
	fx.small.Transparency, fx.tint.Transparency = transparency, transparency
	fx.small.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, radius * 0.03 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}, {1, radius * 0.03 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}})
	fx.tint.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, radius * 0.036 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}, {1, radius * 0.036 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}})
	local large = radius * 0.055 * size
	fx.big.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0}, {0.14, large}, {0.3, large * 0.55}, {0.46, large}, {0.62, large * 0.6}, {0.8, large}, {1, 0}})
	fx.big.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.12, 0.05}, {0.88, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
	fx.small.Brightness, fx.tint.Brightness, fx.big.Brightness = 2.6 * brightness, 2.8 * brightness, 3 * brightness
	fx.small.Rate, fx.tint.Rate, fx.big.Rate = cfg.density * 1.25, cfg.density * 0.36, cfg.density * 0.07
	fx.small.Enabled, fx.tint.Enabled, fx.big.Enabled = cfg.density > 0, cfg.density > 0, cfg.density > 0
	if cfg.tint == "Rainbow" then
		fx.small.Color, fx.tint.Color, fx.big.Color = SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0), SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0.5), SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0.25)
	else
		local colors = state.palettes.stars[cfg.tint] or state.palettes.stars.Natural
		fx.small.Color, fx.tint.Color, fx.big.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(colors[1]), env.ColorSequence.new(colors[2], colors[3]), env.ColorSequence.new(colors[1])
	end
	if not fx.filled and cfg.density > 0 then
		fx.filled = true
		fx.small:Emit(math.floor(cfg.density * 3.6))
		fx.tint:Emit(math.floor(cfg.density))
		fx.big:Emit(math.floor(cfg.density * 0.2))
	end
end

function SkyFx.applyRunes(state, fx)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.runes
	local size, brightness = cfg.size / 100, state.cfg.general.bright / 100
	fx.main.Texture = cfg.set == "Glyphs" and SKY_FX_TEXTURES.glyphs or SKY_FX_TEXTURES.runes
	fx.main.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1.02 * size}, {0.15, 1.7 * size}, {0.85, 1.7 * size}, {1, 1.36 * size}})
	fx.main.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.15, 0.05}, {0.75, 0.15}, {1, 1}})
	fx.glow.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.5 * size}, {1, 0}})
	fx.glow.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.3}, {1, 1}})
	fx.main.Color, fx.glow.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
	fx.main.Brightness, fx.glow.Brightness = 2.6 * brightness, 2 * brightness
	fx.main.Rate, fx.glow.Rate = cfg.amount * 0.32, cfg.amount * 0.3
	fx.main.Enabled, fx.glow.Enabled = cfg.amount > 0, cfg.amount > 0
	if not fx.filled and cfg.amount > 0 then fx.filled = true; fx.main:Emit(math.floor(cfg.amount * 1.6)) end
end

function SkyFx.applyDust(state, fx)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.dust
	fx.main.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0}, {0.15, 0.75}, {0.3, 0.2625}, {0.45, 0.75}, {0.6, 0.3}, {0.78, 0.75}, {1, 0}})
	fx.main.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.12, 0}, {0.85, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
	fx.glow.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.38}, {1, 0.14}})
	fx.glow.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.15, 0.1}, {0.5, 0.5}, {0.75, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
	if cfg.palette == "Rainbow" then fx.main.Color, fx.glow.Color = SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0), SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0.4)
	else
		local colors = state.palettes.dust[cfg.palette] or state.palettes.dust.Gold
		fx.main.Color, fx.glow.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(colors[1]), env.ColorSequence.new(colors[2])
	end
	local brightness = state.cfg.general.bright / 100
	fx.main.Brightness, fx.glow.Brightness = 3.2 * brightness, 2.6 * brightness
	fx.main.Rate, fx.glow.Rate = cfg.amount * 0.9, cfg.amount * 1.1
	fx.main.Enabled, fx.glow.Enabled = cfg.amount > 0, cfg.amount > 0
	if not fx.filled and cfg.amount > 0 then
		fx.filled = true
		fx.main:Emit(math.floor(cfg.amount * 3))
		fx.glow:Emit(math.floor(cfg.amount * 3))
	end
end

function SkyFx.beam(state, parent, first, second, brightness)
	local env = state.context.environment
	return SkyFx.create(state, "Beam", parent, {Attachment0 = first, Attachment1 = second, FaceCamera = true, LightEmission = 1,
		LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = brightness, Segments = 1, Width0 = 0, Width1 = 1,
		Texture = SKY_FX_TEXTURES.beam, TextureMode = env.Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, Enabled = false})
end

function SkyFx.buildTrails(state, name, folder)
	local env = state.context.environment
	local anchor = SkyFx.part(state, folder, name .. "Anchor")
	anchor.CFrame = env.CFrame.new()
	local fx = {folder = folder, anchor = anchor, pool = {}, dirty = true, nextSpawn = state.time + (name == "meteors" and 0.5 or 1.2)}
	local count = name == "meteors" and 7 or 2
	for _ = 1, count do
		local first, second = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", anchor), SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", anchor)
		local trail = {first = first, second = second, beams = {}, active = false}
		if name == "comets" then trail.ion = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", anchor) end
		local beamCount = name == "meteors" and 2 or 5
		for index = 1, beamCount do
			local beam = SkyFx.beam(state, anchor, first, index > 3 and trail.ion or second, index == 1 and 3.2 or 1.4)
			if name == "comets" then beam.Segments = index <= 3 and 24 or 12 end
			table.insert(trail.beams, beam)
		end
		trail.head = SkyFx.part(state, folder, name .. "Head")
		trail.head.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
		trail.glow = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.soft, {name == "meteors" and 30 or 60}, nil, 1.4, true)
		trail.star = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, name == "meteors" and SKY_FX_TEXTURES.spark or SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot,
			{name == "meteors" and 30 or 60}, nil, 3, true)
		trail.dust = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot, {0.3, 0.8}, {0.2, 1}, 2.2)
		trail.dust.SpreadAngle = env.Vector2.new(180, 180)
		if name == "comets" then
			trail.flare = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.spark, {1.6, 2.4}, nil, 2.4, true)
			trail.dust2 = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot, {2, 4}, {0.2, 1.5}, 2)
			trail.dust2.SpreadAngle = env.Vector2.new(180, 180)
		end
		table.insert(fx.pool, trail)
	end
	return fx
end

function SkyFx.applyTrails(state, name, fx)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg[name]
	local scale = name == "comets" and cfg.size / 100 or 1
	for _, trail in ipairs(fx.pool) do
		for _, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do beam.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color) end
		local white = env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		if name == "meteors" then
			trail.beams[1].Color = env.ColorSequence.new({env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, cfg.color),
				env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, cfg.color:Lerp(white, 0.5)), env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, white)})
		else
			trail.beams[1].Color = env.ColorSequence.new({env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, white),
				env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.12, cfg.color:Lerp(white, 0.35)), env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, cfg.color)})
			trail.beams[2].Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color:Lerp(white, 0.3), cfg.color)
			trail.beams[4].Color = env.ColorSequence.new(white, env.Color3.fromRGB(120, 175, 255))
			trail.beams[5].Color = env.ColorSequence.new(env.Color3.fromRGB(120, 175, 255))
		end
		trail.glow.Color, trail.dust.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
		trail.glow.Size, trail.star.Size = env.NumberSequence.new(state.radius * 0.032 * scale), env.NumberSequence.new(state.radius * 0.03 * scale)
		trail.dust.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, state.radius * 0.007 * scale}, {1, 0}})
		trail.dust.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
		if name == "comets" then
			trail.flare.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, state.radius * 0.042 * scale}, {0.5, state.radius * 0.07 * scale}, {1, state.radius * 0.042 * scale}})
			trail.flare.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.3, 0.2}, {0.7, 0.2}, {1, 1}})
			trail.dust2.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, state.radius * 0.006 * scale}, {1, 0}})
			trail.dust2.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.2}, {1, 1}})
			trail.dust2.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
		end
	end
end

function SkyFx.direction(state, azimuth, elevation)
	local cos = math.cos(elevation)
	return state.context.environment.Vector3.new(cos * math.cos(azimuth), math.sin(elevation), cos * math.sin(azimuth))
end

function SkyFx.arc(first, second, t)
	local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(first:Dot(second), -1, 1))
	if angle < 0.0001 then return first end
	local sine = math.sin(angle)
	return first * (math.sin((1 - t) * angle) / sine) + second * (math.sin(t * angle) / sine)
end

function SkyFx.spawnTrail(state, name, fx, look)
	local trail
	for _, candidate in ipairs(fx.pool) do if not candidate.active then trail = candidate; break end end
	if not trail then return end
	local comet = name == "comets"
	local azimuth = math.atan2(look.Z, look.X) + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * (comet and 0.96 or 1.05)
	if not comet and math.random() >= 0.8 then azimuth = math.random() * math.pi * 2 end
	local elevation = math.rad(comet and 26 + math.random() * 26 or 30 + math.random() * 42)
	local direction = math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1
	trail.start = SkyFx.direction(state, azimuth, elevation)
	trail.finish = SkyFx.direction(state, azimuth + direction * math.rad(comet and 26 + math.random() * 18 or 16 + math.random() * 24),
		elevation + math.rad(comet and -12 + math.random() * 20 or -14 - math.random() * 14))
	trail.started, trail.duration, trail.active = state.time, comet and 18 + math.random() * 10 or 0.6 + math.random() * 0.7, true
	trail.tail = comet and 0.3 or 0.3 * state.cfg.meteors.length / 100 * (0.8 + math.random() * 0.45)
	for _, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do beam.Enabled = true end
	trail.glow:Emit(1)
	trail.star:Emit(1)
	trail.dust.Rate, trail.dust.Enabled = comet and 26 or 80, true
	if comet then
		trail.flare.Rate, trail.flare.Enabled = 1.4, true
		trail.dust2.Rate, trail.dust2.Enabled = 34, true
	end
end

function SkyFx.stepTrails(state, name, fx, position, look)
	local cfg = state.cfg[name]
	local comet = name == "comets"
	if state.time >= fx.nextSpawn then
		SkyFx.spawnTrail(state, name, fx, look)
		local delay = comet and 6 + 70 * (1 - cfg.rate / 100) ^ 2 or 0.3 + 9 * (1 - cfg.rate / 100) ^ 2
		fx.nextSpawn = state.time + delay * (comet and 0.5 + math.random() or 0.35 + 1.3 * math.random())
	end
	local brightness = state.cfg.general.bright / 100
	for _, trail in ipairs(fx.pool) do
		if not trail.active then continue end
		local progress = (state.time - trail.started) / trail.duration
		if progress >= 1 + (comet and 0 or trail.tail) then
			trail.active, trail.dust.Enabled = false, false
			if comet then trail.flare.Enabled, trail.dust2.Enabled = false, false end
			for _, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do beam.Enabled = false end
			trail.glow:Clear()
			trail.star:Clear()
			trail.head.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
			continue
		end
		local direction = SkyFx.arc(trail.start, trail.finish, math.min(progress, 1))
		local head = position + direction * state.radius
		local fade
		if comet then
			local ahead = SkyFx.arc(trail.start, trail.finish, math.min(progress + 0.01, 1)) - direction
			local tangent = ahead.Magnitude > 1e-6 and ahead.Unit or state.context.environment.Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			local side = tangent:Cross(direction).Unit
			local size = cfg.size / 100
			local dust = (direction - tangent * 0.3 * size + side * 0.04 * size).Unit
			local ion = (direction - tangent * 0.42 * size - side * 0.02 * size).Unit
			trail.first.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.fromMatrix(head, side, direction)
			trail.second.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.fromMatrix(position + dust * state.radius, side, dust)
			trail.ion.Position = position + ion * state.radius
			fade = math.clamp(math.min(progress * trail.duration / 2.5, (1 - progress) * trail.duration / 3), 0, 1)
			local widths = {{0.022, 0.08}, {0.04, 0.15}, {0.065, 0.24}, {0.012, 0.03}, {0.026, 0.07}}
			local alphas = {0.75, 0.45, 0.25, 0.7, 0.3}
			local levels = {1.4, 0.9, 0.6, 1.8, 0.8}
			for index, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do
				beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = state.radius * size * widths[index][1], state.radius * size * widths[index][2]
				beam.CurveSize0, beam.CurveSize1 = index <= 3 and state.radius * 0.05 * size or 0, 0
				beam.Brightness = levels[index] * brightness
				beam.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1 - alphas[index] * fade}, {1, 1}})
			end
			trail.flare.Brightness, trail.dust2.Brightness = 2.4 * brightness * fade, 2 * brightness * fade
		else
			local tail = position + SkyFx.arc(trail.start, trail.finish, math.clamp(progress - trail.tail, 0, 1)) * state.radius
			trail.first.Position, trail.second.Position = tail, head
			fade = math.clamp(math.min(progress / 0.12, (1 + trail.tail - progress) / (trail.tail + 0.2)), 0, 1)
			for index, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do
				beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = 0, state.radius * (index == 1 and 0.016 or 0.055)
				beam.Brightness = (index == 1 and 3.2 or 1.4) * brightness
				beam.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {1, 1 - fade * (index == 1 and 1 or 0.4)}})
			end
		end
		trail.head.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.new(head)
		trail.glow.Brightness, trail.star.Brightness = 1.4 * brightness * fade, 3 * brightness * fade
		if progress > 0.95 and not comet then trail.dust.Enabled = false end
	end
end

function SkyFx.buildNet(state, folder)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
	local fx = {folder = folder, nodes = {}, links = {}, dirty = true, count = math.clamp(math.floor(cfg.nodes), 8, 140), place = cfg.place, linkClock = 1}
	local look = state.camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local forward = math.atan2(look.Z, look.X)
	for index = 1, fx.count do
		local part = SkyFx.part(state, folder, "Node")
		local attachment = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", part)
		local emitter = SkyFx.emitter(state, part, index % 6 == 0 and SKY_FX_TEXTURES.spark or SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot, {12}, nil, 2.8, true)
		local node = {part = part, attachment = attachment, emitter = emitter, big = index % 6 == 0,
			azimuth = math.random() < 0.75 and forward + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 1.25 or math.random() * math.pi * 2,
			elevation = math.rad(14 + math.random() * 58),
			drift = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.022, vertical = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.014,
			relative = env.Vector3.new((math.random() * 2 - 1) * 44, -10 + math.random() * 24, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 44),
			velocity = env.Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.4, math.random() * 2 - 1),
			nextEmit = state.time + math.random() * 6, hue = math.random()}
		table.insert(fx.nodes, node)
	end
	fx.cursorAnchor = SkyFx.part(state, folder, "CursorAnchor")
	fx.cursorAnchor.CFrame = env.CFrame.new()
	fx.cursor = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", fx.cursorAnchor)
	for _ = 1, fx.count * 2 + 6 do
		local beam = SkyFx.beam(state, folder, nil, nil, 1.8)
		local pulse = SkyFx.beam(state, folder, nil, nil, 3)
		pulse.Texture, pulse.TextureMode = SKY_FX_TEXTURES.rays, env.Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
		table.insert(fx.links, {beam = beam, pulse = pulse})
	end
	fx.shell = SkyFx.part(state, folder, "Constellations")
	fx.figures = {SkyFx.particle(state, fx.shell, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.const1, {9, 13}, nil, 1.8, true, true),
		SkyFx.particle(state, fx.shell, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.const2, {9, 13}, nil, 1.8, true, true)}
	return fx
end

function SkyFx.applyNet(state, fx)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
	local sky, brightness = cfg.place ~= "Around me", state.cfg.general.bright / 100
	for _, node in ipairs(fx.nodes) do
		local size = sky and state.radius * (node.big and 0.06 or 0.036) or (node.big and 1.7 or 1)
		node.emitter.Size = env.NumberSequence.new(size)
		node.emitter.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color:Lerp(env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.45))
		node.emitter.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.15, 0}, {0.85, 0}, {1, 1}})
		node.emitter.Brightness = 2.8 * brightness
		if not node.seeded then node.seeded = true; node.emitter:Emit(1) end
	end
	for _, link in ipairs(fx.links) do
		local width = sky and state.radius * 0.0075 or 0.16
		link.beam.Width0, link.beam.Width1 = width, width
		link.pulse.Width0, link.pulse.Width1 = width * 1.9, width * 1.9
		link.pulse.TextureLength, link.pulse.TextureSpeed = sky and state.radius * 0.2 or 7, 0.35 + 0.6 * cfg.speed / 100
		link.beam.Color, link.pulse.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
		link.beam.Brightness, link.pulse.Brightness = 1.8 * brightness, 5 * brightness
	end
	fx.shell.Size = env.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * math.min(state.radius * 1.9, 2040)
	for _, emitter in ipairs(fx.figures) do
		emitter.Size, emitter.Color = env.NumberSequence.new(state.radius * 0.2), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color:Lerp(env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4))
		emitter.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.25, 0.3}, {0.75, 0.3}, {1, 1}})
		emitter.Brightness, emitter.Rate, emitter.Enabled = 1.8 * brightness, 0.06, sky and cfg.figures
	end
	fx.linkClock = 1
end

function SkyFx.linkNet(state, fx)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
	local sky = cfg.place ~= "Around me"
	local maxDistance = sky and 2 * state.radius * 0.92 * math.sin(math.rad(5 + 20 * cfg.reach / 100) / 2) or 10 + 24 * cfg.reach / 100
	local used, degrees = 0, {}
	local function connect(firstNode, attachment)
		if used >= #fx.links then return end
		used += 1
		local link = fx.links[used]
		link.beam.Attachment0, link.beam.Attachment1 = firstNode.attachment, attachment
		link.pulse.Attachment0, link.pulse.Attachment1 = firstNode.attachment, attachment
		link.beam.Enabled, link.pulse.Enabled = true, cfg.pulses
		local color = cfg.rainbow and env.Color3.fromHSV((firstNode.hue + state.time * 0.05) % 1, 0.6, 1) or cfg.color
		link.beam.Color, link.pulse.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(color), env.ColorSequence.new(color)
	end
	for first = 1, #fx.nodes do
		for second = first + 1, #fx.nodes do
			if (degrees[first] or 0) >= 4 then break end
			if (degrees[second] or 0) >= 4 then continue end
			local firstNode, secondNode = fx.nodes[first], fx.nodes[second]
			if (firstNode.position - secondNode.position).Magnitude > maxDistance then continue end
			degrees[first], degrees[second] = (degrees[first] or 0) + 1, (degrees[second] or 0) + 1
			connect(firstNode, secondNode.attachment)
		end
	end
	if fx.cursorPosition then
		local nearest = {}
		for _, node in ipairs(fx.nodes) do
			local distance = (node.position - fx.cursorPosition).Magnitude
			if distance <= maxDistance * 1.3 then table.insert(nearest, {node = node, distance = distance}) end
		end
		table.sort(nearest, function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end)
		for index = 1, math.min(6, #nearest) do connect(nearest[index].node, fx.cursor) end
	end
	for index = used + 1, #fx.links do fx.links[index].beam.Enabled, fx.links[index].pulse.Enabled = false, false end
end

function SkyFx.cursor(state, fx, position)
	if not state.cfg.net.cursor then return nil end
	local camera, input = state.camera, state.context.inputService
	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	local x, y = viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2
	if input and input.MouseEnabled then
		local mouse = input:GetMouseLocation()
		x, y = mouse.X, mouse.Y
	end
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(x, y)
	if state.cfg.net.place == "Around me" then return ray.Origin + ray.Direction.Unit * 26 end
	if ray.Direction.Y <= -0.05 then return nil end
	return position + ray.Direction.Unit * state.radius * 0.92
end

function SkyFx.stepNet(state, fx, position, playerPosition, delta)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
	local sky, speed = cfg.place ~= "Around me", cfg.speed / 100
	fx.shell.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(position)
	fx.cursorPosition = SkyFx.cursor(state, fx, position)
	if fx.cursorPosition then fx.cursor.Position = fx.cursorPosition end
	for _, node in ipairs(fx.nodes) do
		if sky then
			node.azimuth += node.drift * delta * speed
			node.elevation += node.vertical * delta * speed
			if node.elevation < math.rad(12) then node.vertical = math.abs(node.vertical) end
			if node.elevation > math.rad(74) then node.vertical = -math.abs(node.vertical) end
			node.position = position + SkyFx.direction(state, node.azimuth, node.elevation) * state.radius * 0.92
		else
			node.relative += node.velocity * delta * speed * 2.5
			local relative, velocity = node.relative, node.velocity
			if math.abs(relative.X) > 44 then velocity = env.Vector3.new(-math.sign(relative.X) * math.abs(velocity.X), velocity.Y, velocity.Z) end
			if relative.Y < -10 or relative.Y > 14 then velocity = env.Vector3.new(velocity.X, (relative.Y < 0 and 1 or -1) * math.abs(velocity.Y), velocity.Z) end
			if math.abs(relative.Z) > 44 then velocity = env.Vector3.new(velocity.X, velocity.Y, -math.sign(relative.Z) * math.abs(velocity.Z)) end
			node.velocity = velocity
			node.position = playerPosition + env.Vector3.new(0, 12, 0) + node.relative
		end
		node.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(node.position)
		if state.time >= node.nextEmit then node.emitter:Emit(1); node.nextEmit = state.time + 5 + math.random() * 3 end
	end
	fx.linkClock += delta
	if fx.linkClock >= 0.05 then fx.linkClock = 0; SkyFx.linkNet(state, fx) end
end

function SkyFx.drop(state, name)
	local effect = state.effects[name]
	state.effects[name] = nil
	if effect and effect.folder then pcall(function() effect.folder:Destroy() end) end
end

function SkyFx.clear(state)
	for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.drop(state, name) end
	if state.folder then pcall(function() state.folder:Destroy() end) end
	state.folder, state.camera = nil, nil
end

function SkyFx.dirty(state, name)
	if name == "general" then
		for _, effect in pairs(state.effects) do effect.dirty = true end
		return
	end
	if state.effects[name] then state.effects[name].dirty = true end
end

function SkyFx.set(state, name, key, value)
	local settings = state.cfg[name]
	if not settings then return end
	settings[key] = value
	SkyFx.dirty(state, name)
end

function SkyFx.setOn(state, name, enabled)
	local handle = state.controls[name]
	if handle and handle.Set then handle.Set(enabled); return end
	SkyFx.set(state, name, "on", enabled)
end

function SkyFx.scene(state, names)
	if not state.sceneSaved then
		state.sceneSaved = {}
		for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do state.sceneSaved[name] = state.cfg[name].on end
	end
	local selected = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(names or {}) do selected[name] = true end
	for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.setOn(state, name, selected[name] == true) end
	if state.paint then state.paint() end
end

function SkyFx.sceneEnd(state)
	local saved = state.sceneSaved
	state.sceneSaved = nil
	if not saved then return end
	for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.setOn(state, name, saved[name] == true) end
	if state.paint then state.paint() end
end

function SkyFx.build(state, name)
	local folder = SkyFx.create(state, "Folder", state.folder, {Name = name})
	local ok, effect = pcall(function()
		if name == "stars" or name == "runes" or name == "dust" then return SkyFx.buildParticles(state, name, folder) end
		if name == "net" then return SkyFx.buildNet(state, folder) end
		return SkyFx.buildTrails(state, name, folder)
	end)
	if ok then return effect end
	folder:Destroy()
	error(effect, 0)
end

function SkyFx.apply(state, name, effect)
	if name == "stars" then return SkyFx.applyStars(state, effect) end
	if name == "runes" then return SkyFx.applyRunes(state, effect) end
	if name == "dust" then return SkyFx.applyDust(state, effect) end
	if name == "net" then return SkyFx.applyNet(state, effect) end
	return SkyFx.applyTrails(state, name, effect)
end

function SkyFx.applySquash(state, name, effect)
	local env = state.context.environment
	local squash = env.NumberSequence.new(state.squash)
	for _, object in ipairs(effect.folder:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then pcall(function() object.Squash = squash end) end
	end
	local rotated = state.squash <= 0.05
	if name == "stars" then
		effect.big.Rotation = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-20, 20) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
		effect.big.RotSpeed = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-12, 12) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	end
	if name == "runes" then effect.main.Rotation = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-10, 10) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0) end
	if name == "dust" then
		effect.main.Rotation = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(0, 45) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
		effect.main.RotSpeed = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-30, 30) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	end
end

function SkyFx.stepEffect(state, name, effect, position, look, playerPosition, delta)
	local env = state.context.environment
	if name == "stars" then effect.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(position); return end
	if name == "runes" then effect.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(playerPosition + env.Vector3.new(0, 9, 0)); return end
	if name == "dust" then effect.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(playerPosition + env.Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)); return end
	if name == "net" then return SkyFx.stepNet(state, effect, position, playerPosition, delta) end
	return SkyFx.stepTrails(state, name, effect, position, look)
end

function SkyFx.step(state, delta)
	local context = state.context
	if not context.isAlive() then SkyFx.clear(state); return end
	local active = false
	for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do if state.cfg[name].on then active = true; break end end
	local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not active or not camera then if state.folder then SkyFx.clear(state) end; return end
	if not state.folder or state.camera ~= camera or state.folder.Parent ~= camera then
		SkyFx.clear(state)
		state.folder = SkyFx.create(state, "Folder", camera, {Name = "PulseSkyFX"})
		state.camera = camera
	end
	delta = math.clamp(tonumber(delta) or 1 / 60, 0, 0.1)
	state.time += delta
	state.environmentClock += delta
	if state.environmentClock >= 0.5 then
		state.environmentClock = 0
		local atmosphere = context.lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
		local radius = math.clamp(atmosphere and 72 / math.max(atmosphere.Density, 0.04) or context.lighting.FogEnd * 0.5, 110, 520)
		if math.abs(radius - state.radius) / state.radius > 0.08 then state.radius = radius; SkyFx.dirty(state, "general") end
		local stretch = context.configuration.ui and tonumber(context.configuration.ui.stretch) or 0
		local squash = stretch > 0 and math.floor(-math.log(math.max(0.1, 1 - stretch / 100 * 0.6), 2) * 100 + 0.5) / 100 or 0
		if math.abs(squash - state.squash) > 0.02 then state.squash = squash; SkyFx.dirty(state, "general") end
	end
	local frame, character = camera.CFrame, context.player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local playerPosition = root and root.Position or frame.Position
	for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do
		local cfg, effect = state.cfg[name], state.effects[name]
		if not cfg.on then if effect then SkyFx.drop(state, name) end; continue end
		if name == "net" and effect and (effect.count ~= math.clamp(math.floor(cfg.nodes), 8, 140) or effect.place ~= cfg.place) then
			SkyFx.drop(state, name)
			effect = nil
		end
		if not effect and state.time >= (state.failures[name] or 0) then
			local ok, result = pcall(SkyFx.build, state, name)
			if ok then effect = result; state.effects[name] = effect
			else state.failures[name] = state.time + 5; context.environment.warn("[SeniorHubSources] sky fx " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(result)) end
		end
		if not effect then continue end
		if effect.dirty then
			effect.dirty = false
			local ok, message = pcall(function()
				SkyFx.apply(state, name, effect)
				SkyFx.applySquash(state, name, effect)
			end)
			if not ok then context.environment.warn("[SeniorHubSources] sky fx " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(message)) end
		end
		local ok, message = pcall(SkyFx.stepEffect, state, name, effect, frame.Position, frame.LookVector, playerPosition, delta)
		if not ok then
			state.failures[name] = state.time + 5
			SkyFx.drop(state, name)
			context.environment.warn("[SeniorHubSources] sky fx " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(message))
		end
	end
end

function SkyFx.gallery(state)
	local context, env = state.context, state.context.environment
	local container = context.section:Container()
	if not container then return end
	local create = context.create
	local frame = create("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = env.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = env.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y}, container)
	create("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = env.UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 76), CellPadding = env.UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
		SortOrder = env.Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, frame)
	local labels = {"Stars", "Shooting Stars", "Comets", "Constellations", "Runes", "Stardust"}
	local colors = {{{70, 90, 150}, {12, 16, 40}}, {{150, 200, 255}, {14, 20, 46}}, {{110, 210, 255}, {16, 22, 50}},
		{{150, 205, 255}, {14, 18, 44}}, {{130, 220, 255}, {18, 30, 54}}, {{255, 214, 120}, {40, 28, 20}}}
	local ok, atlas = pcall(env.getcustomasset, "SeniorHubSources/sky_fx_v6.jpg")
	if not ok then atlas = nil end
	local tiles = {}
	for index, key in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do
		local button = create("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = index,
			BackgroundColor3 = env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}, frame)
		context.corner(button, 12)
		create("UIGradient", {Color = env.ColorSequence.new(env.Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(colors[index][1])),
			env.Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(colors[index][2]))), Rotation = 35}, button)
		local picture = create("ImageLabel", {Name = "Photo", Size = env.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ScaleType = env.Enum.ScaleType.Stretch, Visible = atlas ~= nil, Image = atlas or "", ZIndex = 2}, button)
		context.corner(picture, 12)
		picture.ImageRectOffset = env.Vector2.new((index - 1) % 4 * 256, math.floor((index - 1) / 4) * 128)
		picture.ImageRectSize = env.Vector2.new(256, 128)
		local shade = create("Frame", {AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = env.UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -5),
			Size = env.UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = env.Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3}, button)
		context.corner(shade, 7)
		local label = context.nova.label({Parent = shade, Text = context.translation.tr(labels[index]), Font = context.nova.Font.Semi(), Size = 12,
			Pos = env.UDim2.fromOffset(7, 0), Box = env.UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0), Truncate = true, Color = "Text", Z = 4})
		context.translation.bind(label, labels[index])
		local stroke = create("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.8, ApplyStrokeMode = env.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, button)
		context.nova.Theme.bind(stroke, "Color", "Glass")
		local tile = {key = key, stroke = stroke, hover = false}
		table.insert(tiles, tile)
		context.connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function() SkyFx.setOn(state, key, not state.cfg[key].on); state.paint() end)
		context.connect(button.MouseEnter, function() tile.hover = true; state.paint() end)
		context.connect(button.MouseLeave, function() tile.hover = false; state.paint() end)
	end
	state.paint = function()
		for _, tile in ipairs(tiles) do
			local selected = state.cfg[tile.key].on
			context.nova.paint(tile.stroke, "Color", (selected or tile.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
			tile.stroke.Transparency, tile.stroke.Thickness = selected and 0 or (tile.hover and 0.35 or 0.8), selected and 2 or 1
		end
	end
	state.paint()
end

function SkyFx.install(context)
	local env, section = context.environment, context.section
	local state = {context = context, cfg = SkyFx.defaults(env), palettes = SkyFx.palettes(env), controls = {}, effects = {}, failures = {},
		time = 0, environmentClock = 1, radius = 160, squash = 0}
	local function slider(text, group, key, min, max, suffix)
		section:Slider({Text = text, Min = min, Max = max, Decimals = 0, Suffix = suffix, Default = state.cfg[group][key],
			Callback = function(value) SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end})
	end
	local function dropdown(text, group, key, values)
		local options = {}
		for _, value in ipairs(values) do table.insert(options, {code = value, label = value}) end
		section:Dropdown({Text = text, Default = state.cfg[group][key], Options = options, Callback = function(value)
			if value then SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end
		end})
	end
	local function color(text, group, key)
		section:Colorpicker({Text = text, Default = state.cfg[group][key], Callback = function(value)
			if env.typeof(value) == "Color3" then SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end
		end})
	end
	local function toggle(text, key, children)
		state.controls[key] = section:Toggle({Text = text, Default = false, Settings = children, Callback = function(value)
			SkyFx.set(state, key, "on", value == true)
			if state.paint then state.paint() end
		end})
	end
	section:Sub("SkyFX")
	section:Columns()
	section:Group({Title = "Sky Effects", Side = "Left", Pin = true})
	pcall(SkyFx.gallery, state)
	section:Group({Title = "Sky Settings", Side = "Left", Pin = true})
	slider("Effect brightness", "general", "bright", 30, 200, "%")
	section:Button({Text = "Turn all off", Callback = function()
		for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.setOn(state, name, false) end
		if state.paint then state.paint() end
	end})
	section:Group({Title = "Night Sky", Side = "Right", Pin = true})
	toggle("Stars", "stars", function()
		slider("Star density", "stars", "density", 10, 100, "%")
		slider("Star size", "stars", "size", 50, 200, "%")
		slider("Twinkle", "stars", "twinkle", 0, 100, "%")
		dropdown("Star color", "stars", "tint", {"Natural", "Cold", "Warm", "Pastel", "Rainbow"})
	end)
	toggle("Shooting Stars", "meteors", function()
		slider("Meteor frequency", "meteors", "rate", 5, 100, "%")
		slider("Tail length", "meteors", "length", 40, 200, "%")
		color("Meteor color", "meteors", "color")
	end)
	toggle("Comets", "comets", function()
		slider("Comet frequency", "comets", "rate", 5, 100, "%")
		slider("Comet size", "comets", "size", 50, 200, "%")
		color("Comet color", "comets", "color")
	end)
	section:Group({Title = "Magic", Side = "Right", Pin = true})
	toggle("Constellations", "net", function()
		dropdown("Placement", "net", "place", {"Sky", "Around me"})
		slider("Node count", "net", "nodes", 20, 140)
		slider("Link distance", "net", "reach", 0, 100, "%")
		slider("Drift speed", "net", "speed", 0, 100, "%")
		color("Line color", "net", "color")
		for _, entry in ipairs({{"Energy pulses", "pulses", true}, {"Follow cursor", "cursor", true},
			{"Rainbow lines", "rainbow", false}, {"Star figures", "figures", true}}) do
			section:Toggle({Text = entry[1], Default = entry[3], Callback = function(value) SkyFx.set(state, "net", entry[2], value == true) end})
		end
	end)
	toggle("Runes", "runes", function()
		slider("Rune amount", "runes", "amount", 10, 100, "%")
		slider("Rune size", "runes", "size", 50, 200, "%")
		dropdown("Rune set", "runes", "set", {"Runes", "Glyphs"})
		color("Rune color", "runes", "color")
	end)
	toggle("Stardust", "dust", function()
		slider("Dust amount", "dust", "amount", 10, 100, "%")
		dropdown("Dust color", "dust", "palette", {"Gold", "Silver", "Pink", "Aqua", "Rainbow"})
	end)
	local api = {cfg = state.cfg, scene = function(names) SkyFx.scene(state, names) end, sceneEnd = function() SkyFx.sceneEnd(state) end,
		set = function(group, key, value) SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end}
	env.getgenv().__pulseSkyFx = api
	if state.paint then state.paint() end
	if context.runService.RenderStepped then context.connect(context.runService.RenderStepped, function(delta)
		local ok, message = pcall(SkyFx.step, state, delta)
		if not ok then env.warn("[SeniorHubSources] sky fx step: " .. tostring(message)) end
	end) end
	return state, function()
		SkyFx.clear(state)
		if env.getgenv().__pulseSkyFx == api then env.getgenv().__pulseSkyFx = nil end
	end
end

local AvatarSkins = {}
do -- Keep module-private locals out of the main chunk's register budget.

local AVATAR_PROPERTIES = {"BodyTypeScale", "DepthScale", "HeadScale", "HeightScale", "ProportionScale", "WidthScale",
	"Face", "Head", "LeftArm", "LeftLeg", "RightArm", "RightLeg", "Torso", "GraphicTShirt", "Pants", "Shirt"}
local AVATAR_COLORS = {"HeadColor", "LeftArmColor", "LeftLegColor", "RightArmColor", "RightLegColor", "TorsoColor"}
local AVATAR_PARTS = {Head = "Head", DynamicHead = "Head", Torso = "Torso", LeftArm = "LeftArm", RightArm = "RightArm",
	LeftLeg = "LeftLeg", RightLeg = "RightLeg"}
local AVATAR_ACCESSORIES = {HairAccessory = true, FaceAccessory = true, NeckAccessory = true, ShouldersAccessory = true,
	FrontAccessory = true, BackAccessory = true, WaistAccessory = true}

function AvatarSkins.serialize(description)
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local saved = {p = {}, c = {}, acc = {}}
		for _, key in AVATAR_PROPERTIES do saved.p[key] = description[key] end
		for _, key in AVATAR_COLORS do
			local color = description[key]
			saved.c[key] = {math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)}
		end
		for _, accessory in description:GetAccessories(true) do
			table.insert(saved.acc, {t = accessory.AccessoryType.Name, id = accessory.AssetId, l = accessory.IsLayered == true,
				o = accessory.Order, pf = accessory.Puffiness})
		end
		return saved
	end)
	if ok then return result end
	return nil
end

function AvatarSkins.deserialize(environment, saved)
	if type(saved) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local ok, description = pcall(function()
		local result = environment.Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
		for _, key in AVATAR_PROPERTIES do
			local value = type(saved.p) == "table" and saved.p[key]
			if type(value) == "number" then pcall(function() result[key] = value end) end
		end
		for _, key in AVATAR_COLORS do
			local color = type(saved.c) == "table" and saved.c[key]
			if type(color) ~= "table" then continue end
			pcall(function() result[key] = environment.Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(color[1]) or 0, tonumber(color[2]) or 0, tonumber(color[3]) or 0) end)
		end
		local accessories = {}
		for _, item in type(saved.acc) == "table" and saved.acc or {} do
			local valid, kind = pcall(function() return environment.Enum.AccessoryType[tostring(item.t)] end)
			if not valid or not kind or not tonumber(item.id) then continue end
			table.insert(accessories, {AccessoryType = kind, AssetId = tonumber(item.id), IsLayered = item.l == true,
				Order = tonumber(item.o), Puffiness = tonumber(item.pf)})
		end
		result:SetAccessories(accessories, true)
		return result
	end)
	if ok then return description end
	return nil
end

function AvatarSkins.bundle(context, id)
	local ok, description, name = pcall(function()
		local bundle = context.assetService:GetBundleDetailsAsync(id)
		for _, item in bundle.Items or {} do
			if item.Type == "UserOutfit" then return context.players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromOutfitId(item.Id), bundle.Name end
		end
	end)
	if ok and description then return description, name end

	ok, description = pcall(context.avatar.GetItemDetails, context.avatar, id, context.environment.Enum.AvatarItemType.Bundle)
	if not ok or type(description) ~= "table" then return nil, "Bundle not found (rate limit?)" end
	local bundle = description
	local items = bundle.BundledItems or bundle.Items
	if type(items) ~= "table" or #items == 0 then return nil, "Bundle is empty" end
	description = context.environment.Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
	local accessories, parts = {}, 0
	for _, item in items do
		local kind = tostring(item.AssetType)
		local part = AVATAR_PARTS[kind]
		if part then
			pcall(function() description[part] = item.Id end)
			parts += 1
			continue
		end
		if not AVATAR_ACCESSORIES[kind] then continue end
		accessories[kind] = accessories[kind] or {}
		table.insert(accessories[kind], tostring(item.Id))
	end
	for kind, values in accessories do pcall(function() description[kind] = table.concat(values, ",") end) end
	if parts == 0 and not next(accessories) then return nil, "This bundle has no body parts" end
	return description, bundle.Name or "ID " .. tostring(id)
end

function AvatarSkins.user(context, value)
	local id = tonumber(value) or context.players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(value)
	local name = tostring(value)
	pcall(function() name = context.players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(id) end)
	return context.players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(id), name, id
end

function AvatarSkins.joints(model)
	local result = {}
	for _, joint in model:GetDescendants() do
		if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 then
			result[joint.Part1.Name] = {joint = joint, parent = joint.Part0, part = joint.Part1, motor = true}
			continue
		end
		if not joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or not joint.Attachment0 or not joint.Attachment1 then continue end
		local first, second = joint.Attachment0, joint.Attachment1
		if first.Parent and second.Parent then result[second.Parent.Name] = {joint = joint, parent = first.Parent, part = second.Parent, a0 = first, a1 = second} end
	end
	return result
end

function AvatarSkins.frames(link)
	if link.motor then return link.joint.C0, link.joint.C1 end
	return link.a0.CFrame, link.a1.CFrame
end

function AvatarSkins.ground(environment, model, joints)
	local root, foot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), model:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot")
	if not root or not foot then return nil end
	local chain, part = {}, foot
	while part and part ~= root do
		local link = joints[part.Name]
		if not link or #chain >= 64 then return nil end
		table.insert(chain, 1, link)
		part = link.parent
	end
	local frame = environment.CFrame.new()
	for _, link in chain do
		local first, second = AvatarSkins.frames(link)
		frame = frame * first * second:Inverse()
	end
	return foot.Size.Y / 2 - frame.Position.Y
end

function AvatarSkins.ghost(part)
	part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery, part.Massless, part.CastShadow = false, false, false, true, true
	part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function() if part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end end)
end

function AvatarSkins.prepare(state, model)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local parts = {}
	for _, object in model:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("BaseScript") then object:Destroy(); continue end
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			AvatarSkins.ghost(object)
			if object.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then table.insert(parts, object) end
			continue
		end
		if object:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then object.IsKinematic = true end
		if object:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then object.Enabled = false end
	end
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then pcall(function()
		humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = environment.Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
		humanoid.HealthDisplayType = environment.Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
		humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine, humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false, false
	end) end
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then root.Anchored, root.Transparency = true, 1 end
	model.Name = "HubSkin"
	model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object) if object:IsA("BasePart") then AvatarSkins.ghost(object) end end)
	local joints = AvatarSkins.joints(model)
	return joints, AvatarSkins.ground(environment, model, joints), parts
end

function AvatarSkins.attach(state, character)
	state.character, state.links = character, nil
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local joints = AvatarSkins.joints(character)
	local ground = AvatarSkins.ground(environment, character, joints)
	if not ground or not state.ground or ground <= 0 then return false end
	local links, byPart = {}, {}
	for name, source in joints do
		local target = state.joints[name]
		if not target then continue end
		local source0, source1 = AvatarSkins.frames(source)
		local target0, target1 = AvatarSkins.frames(target)
		table.insert(links, {source = source, target = target, root = source.parent.Name == "HumanoidRootPart",
			restSource = source0 * source1:Inverse(), restTarget = target0 * target1:Inverse(), inverse = target0:Inverse(),
			target1 = target1, pivot0 = environment.CFrame.new(target0.Position), pivot1 = environment.CFrame.new(target1.Position):Inverse()})
		byPart[target.part.Name] = #links
	end
	if #links == 0 then return false end
	state.scale, state.lift = state.ground / ground, state.ground - ground
	state.chains, state.feet = {}, {}
	for name in byPart do
		local chain, part, depth = {}, name, 0
		while part and byPart[part] and depth < 32 do
			depth += 1
			local index = byPart[part]
			table.insert(chain, 1, index)
			local parent = links[index].target.parent
			part = parent.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and parent.Name or nil
			if not part then state.chains[name] = chain end
		end
	end
	for _, name in {"LeftFoot", "RightFoot"} do
		local source, target = character:FindFirstChild(name), state.model:FindFirstChild(name)
		if state.chains[name] and source and target and source:IsA("BasePart") and target:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(state.feet, {chain = state.chains[name], source = source.Size.Y / 2, target = target.Size.Y / 2})
		end
	end
	local hand = state.model:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
	local attachment = hand and hand:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")
	state.modelGrip = hand and environment.CFrame.new(0, -hand.Size.Y / 2, 0) or nil
	if attachment and attachment:IsA("Attachment") then state.modelGrip = attachment.CFrame end
	state.links = links
	AvatarSkins.notify(state)
	return true
end

function AvatarSkins.drive(state, character)
	local sourceRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local targetRoot = state.model and state.model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not state.links or not sourceRoot or not targetRoot then return false end
	local environment = state.context.environment
	for _, link in state.links do
		local first, second = AvatarSkins.frames(link.source)
		local relative = first * link.source.joint.Transform * second:Inverse()
		local target
		if link.root then
			target = environment.CFrame.new(link.restTarget.Position + (relative.Position - link.restSource.Position) * state.scale) * relative.Rotation
		else
			target = link.pivot0 * relative.Rotation * link.pivot1
		end
		link.relativeSource, link.relativeTarget = relative, target
		link.target.joint.Transform = link.inverse * target * link.target1
	end
	local lift = state.lift
	if #state.feet > 0 then
		local sourceLow, targetLow = math.huge, math.huge
		for _, foot in state.feet do
			local source, target = environment.CFrame.identity, environment.CFrame.identity
			for _, index in foot.chain do
				local link = state.links[index]
				source, target = source * link.relativeSource, target * link.relativeTarget
			end
			sourceLow, targetLow = math.min(sourceLow, source.Y - foot.source), math.min(targetLow, target.Y - foot.target)
		end
		if sourceLow < math.huge and targetLow < math.huge then lift = sourceLow - targetLow end
	end
	state.rootFrame, state.sourceFrame = sourceRoot.CFrame * environment.CFrame.new(0, lift, 0), sourceRoot.CFrame
	targetRoot.CFrame = state.rootFrame
	return true
end

function AvatarSkins.world(state, target, name)
	local chain = state.chains and state.chains[name]
	if not chain then return nil end
	local frame = target and state.rootFrame or state.sourceFrame
	for _, index in chain do
		local link = state.links[index]
		frame *= target and link.relativeTarget or link.relativeSource
	end
	return frame
end

function AvatarSkins.notify(state)
	local globals = state.context.environment.getgenv()
	local callback = rawget(globals, "__pulseSkinChanged")
	if type(callback) == "function" then state.context.environment.task.defer(function() pcall(callback, state.player) end) end
end

function AvatarSkins.restoreGrips(state, except)
	for joint, saved in state.grips do
		if joint == except then continue end
		pcall(function() if joint.Parent and saved.applied and joint.C0:FuzzyEq(saved.applied, 0.001) then joint.C0 = saved.original end end)
		state.grips[joint] = nil
	end
end

function AvatarSkins.grip(state, character)
	local hand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
	local joint = hand and hand:FindFirstChild("RightGrip")
	AvatarSkins.restoreGrips(state, joint)
	if not joint or not joint:IsA("JointInstance") or not state.modelGrip then return end
	local saved = state.grips[joint]
	if not saved or not saved.applied or not joint.C0:FuzzyEq(saved.applied, 0.001) then
		saved = {original = joint.C0}
		state.grips[joint] = saved
	end
	local source, target = AvatarSkins.world(state, false, "RightHand"), AvatarSkins.world(state, true, "RightHand")
	if not source or not target then return end
	saved.applied = source:Inverse() * target * state.modelGrip
	joint.C0 = saved.applied
end

function AvatarSkins.restoreMounts(state)
	for object, saved in state.mounts do
		pcall(function()
			if object.Parent and saved.applied and object[saved.property]:FuzzyEq(saved.applied, 0.0001) then object[saved.property] = saved.original end
		end)
		state.mounts[object] = nil
	end
	state.mountList, state.mountCharacter = nil, nil
end

function AvatarSkins.scanMounts(state, character)
	local torso = {LowerTorso = character:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso"), UpperTorso = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")}
	local function partName(part)
		for name, value in torso do if value == part then return name end end
	end
	local mounts, seen = {}, {}
	local displays = state.context.workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
	for _, display in displays and displays:GetChildren() or {} do
		local constraint = display:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
		local attachment = constraint and constraint.Attachment0
		local name = attachment and partName(attachment.Parent)
		if name and not seen[attachment] then
			seen[attachment] = true
			table.insert(mounts, {object = attachment, property = "CFrame", part = name})
		end
		local joint = display:FindFirstChild("PulseMount")
		name = joint and joint:IsA("JointInstance") and partName(joint.Part0)
		if name and not seen[joint] then
			seen[joint] = true
			table.insert(mounts, {object = joint, property = "C0", part = name, anchor = joint:GetAttribute("PulseAnchor")})
		end
	end
	state.mountList, state.mountCharacter, state.mountAt = mounts, character, state.context.environment.os.clock()
end

function AvatarSkins.mountOriginal(state, object)
	local saved = state.mounts[object]
	if saved and object.Parent and saved.applied and object[saved.property]:FuzzyEq(saved.applied, 0.0001) then return saved.original end
	return nil
end

function AvatarSkins.scaleOffset(value, original, replacement)
	local absolute = math.abs(value)
	local inside = math.min(absolute, original)
	local scaled = (original > 0.001 and inside * replacement / original or 0) + math.max(absolute - original, 0)
	return value < 0 and -scaled or scaled
end

function AvatarSkins.followMounts(state, character)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	if state.mountCharacter ~= character or environment.os.clock() - (state.mountAt or 0) > 0.5 then AvatarSkins.scanMounts(state, character) end
	for _, mount in state.mountList or {} do
		local object = mount.object
		local originalPart = character:FindFirstChild(mount.part)
		local modelPart = state.model:FindFirstChild(mount.part)
		local source, target = AvatarSkins.world(state, false, mount.part), AvatarSkins.world(state, true, mount.part)
		if not object.Parent or not originalPart or not modelPart or not source or not target then continue end
		local current, saved = object[mount.property], state.mounts[object]
		if not saved or not saved.applied or not current:FuzzyEq(saved.applied, 0.0001) then
			saved = {original = current, property = mount.property}
			state.mounts[object] = saved
		end
		local position = saved.original.Position
		local anchor = mount.anchor and originalPart:FindFirstChild(mount.anchor)
		if anchor and anchor:IsA("Attachment") then position = (AvatarSkins.mountOriginal(state, anchor) or anchor.CFrame).Position end
		local sourceSize, targetSize = originalPart.Size / 2, modelPart.Size / 2
		local scaled = environment.Vector3.new(AvatarSkins.scaleOffset(position.X, sourceSize.X, targetSize.X),
			AvatarSkins.scaleOffset(position.Y, sourceSize.Y, targetSize.Y), AvatarSkins.scaleOffset(position.Z, sourceSize.Z, targetSize.Z))
		saved.applied = source:Inverse() * target * environment.CFrame.new(scaled - position) * saved.original
		if not current:FuzzyEq(saved.applied, 0.0001) then object[mount.property] = saved.applied end
	end
end

function AvatarSkins.collectBody(state, character)
	local body = {}
	for _, child in character:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Tool") or child:GetAttribute("PulseVFX") then continue end
		if child:IsA("BasePart") or child:IsA("Decal") then table.insert(body, child) end
		for _, object in child:GetDescendants() do
			if (object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Decal")) and not object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then table.insert(body, object) end
		end
	end
	state.body, state.bodyAt, state.bodyDirty = body, state.context.environment.os.clock(), false
	if state.bodyCharacter == character then return end
	if state.bodyConnection then pcall(function() state.bodyConnection:Disconnect() end) end
	state.bodyCharacter = character
	state.bodyConnection = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function() state.bodyDirty = true end)
end

function AvatarSkins.hideBody(state, character)
	local age = state.context.environment.os.clock() - (state.bodyAt or 0)
	if state.bodyCharacter ~= character or not state.body or state.bodyDirty and age > 0.2 or age > 3 then AvatarSkins.collectBody(state, character) end
	for _, object in state.body do
		if not object.Parent or object.LocalTransparencyModifier == 1 then continue end
		object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
		state.hidden[object] = true
	end
end

function AvatarSkins.showBody(state)
	for object in state.hidden do pcall(function() if object.Parent then object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end end) end
	table.clear(state.hidden)
	state.body = nil
end

function AvatarSkins.firstPerson(state, character)
	local camera = state.context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local globals = state.context.environment.getgenv()
	local invis = rawget(globals, "__pulseInvis")
	local near = camera and head and (camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude < 1.4
	local transparency = near and 1 or type(invis) == "table" and invis.active == true and 0.5 or 0
	if transparency == state.near then return end
	state.near = transparency
	for _, part in state.modelParts do if part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier = transparency end end
end

function AvatarSkins.pose(state, map, targetJoints, root)
	if not state.links or not root then return false end
	local rootLink
	for _, link in state.links do
		local relative = link.restTarget
		if link.root then
			rootLink = link
		else
			local first, second = map(link.source.parent), map(link.source.part)
			if first and second and first.Parent and second.Parent then
				relative = link.pivot0 * (first.CFrame:Inverse() * second.CFrame).Rotation * link.pivot1
			end
		end
		local joint = link.target
		if targetJoints then joint = targetJoints[link.target.part.Name] end
		if joint then joint.joint.Transform = link.inverse * relative * link.target1 end
		if not targetJoints then link.relativeTarget = relative end
	end
	local source = rootLink and map(rootLink.source.part)
	if not source or not source.Parent then return false end
	root.CFrame = source.CFrame * rootLink.restTarget:Inverse()
	return true
end

function AvatarSkins.signature(character)
	local torso = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	local shirt, pants = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt"), character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
	return table.concat({torso and torso:IsA("MeshPart") and torso.MeshId or "", shirt and shirt.ShirtTemplate or "",
		pants and pants.PantsTemplate or ""}, "|")
end

function AvatarSkins.freeCorpse(corpse)
	if corpse.watch then pcall(function() corpse.watch:Disconnect() end) end
	if corpse.model then pcall(function() corpse.model:Destroy() end) end
	for _, object in corpse.hidden do pcall(function() if object.Parent then object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end end) end
end

function AvatarSkins.adoptCorpse(state, ragdoll)
	if state.corpses[ragdoll] or not state.model or not state.links then return end
	local model = state.model:Clone()
	model.Name = state.remote and "PulseRemoteSkinCorpse" or "PulseSkinCorpse"
	local corpse = {model = model, map = {}, hidden = {}, seen = {}, fade = -1, links = state.links,
		started = state.context.environment.os.clock(), parts = {}}
	for _, part in ragdoll:GetChildren() do if part:IsA("BasePart") then corpse.map[part.Name] = part end end
	corpse.joints = AvatarSkins.joints(model)
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if not part:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
		AvatarSkins.ghost(part)
		if part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then table.insert(corpse.parts, part) end
	end
	corpse.root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	model.Parent = state.context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	state.corpses[ragdoll] = corpse
end

function AvatarSkins.updateCorpses(state)
	local now = state.context.environment.os.clock()
	for ragdoll, corpse in state.corpses do
		if not ragdoll.Parent or not corpse.model.Parent then
			AvatarSkins.freeCorpse(corpse)
			state.corpses[ragdoll] = nil
			continue
		end
		if corpse.dirty ~= false or now - (corpse.scanAt or 0) > 1 then
			corpse.dirty, corpse.scanAt = false, now
			if not corpse.watch then corpse.watch = ragdoll.DescendantAdded:Connect(function() corpse.dirty = true end) end
			for _, object in ragdoll:GetDescendants() do
				if not object:IsA("BasePart") and not object:IsA("Decal") then continue end
				object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				if not corpse.seen[object] then corpse.seen[object] = true; table.insert(corpse.hidden, object) end
			end
		end
		local torso = corpse.map.LowerTorso
		if not corpse.done then
			AvatarSkins.pose({links = corpse.links}, function(part) return corpse.map[part.Name] end, corpse.joints, corpse.root)
			if torso and torso.Anchored and now - corpse.started > 5 then corpse.done = true end
		end
		local fade = 0
		for _, object in corpse.hidden do
			if object.Parent and object:IsA("BasePart") and object.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then fade = math.max(fade, object.Transparency) end
		end
		if fade == corpse.fade then continue end
		corpse.fade = fade
		for _, part in corpse.parts do if part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier = fade end end
	end
end

function AvatarSkins.watchRagdoll(state, object)
	if object.Name ~= "Raggy" or not object:IsA("Model") then return end
	local now, recent = state.context.environment.os.clock(), {}
	for _, entry in state.ragdolls do if now - entry.time < 6 then table.insert(recent, entry) end end
	table.insert(recent, {model = object, time = now})
	state.ragdolls = recent
end

function AvatarSkins.matchDeath(state)
	local death = state.death
	if not death or death.done then return end
	local now = state.context.environment.os.clock()
	if now - death.time > 4 then death.done = true; return end
	local recent = {}
	local candidates = state.registry and state.registry.ragdolls or state.ragdolls
	for _, entry in candidates do
		local ragdoll = entry.model
		if now - entry.time >= 6 or not ragdoll.Parent then continue end
		table.insert(recent, entry)
		if state.registry and entry.taken then continue end
		local root = ragdoll:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or ragdoll:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local ok, signature = pcall(AvatarSkins.signature, ragdoll)
		if not root or (root.Position - death.position).Magnitude >= 12 then continue end
		if death.signature ~= "||" and (not ok or signature ~= death.signature) then continue end
		death.done, death.corpse = true, ragdoll
		if state.registry then entry.taken = true end
		AvatarSkins.adoptCorpse(state, ragdoll)
		if state.registry then return end
	end
	if not state.registry then state.ragdolls = recent end
end

function AvatarSkins.deadPose(state, character, camera)
	AvatarSkins.restoreGrips(state)
	AvatarSkins.restoreMounts(state)
	local root = state.model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local replaced = state.death and state.death.corpse and state.corpses[state.death.corpse]
	local posed = not replaced and AvatarSkins.pose(state, function(part) return part end, nil, root)
	state.model.Parent = posed and camera or nil
	AvatarSkins.hideBody(state, character)
	local transparency = 0
	for _, object in state.body do
		if object.Parent and object:IsA("BasePart") and object.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then transparency = math.max(transparency, object.Transparency) end
	end
	if transparency == state.deadFade then return end
	state.deadFade, state.near = transparency, nil
	for _, part in state.modelParts do if part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier = transparency end end
end

function AvatarSkins.step(state)
	local model = state.model
	if not model then return end
	local character, camera = state.context.player.Character, state.context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	pcall(AvatarSkins.matchDeath, state)
	pcall(AvatarSkins.updateCorpses, state)
	if character and humanoid and character.Parent and humanoid.Health <= 0 and state.character == character and state.links then
		if not state.death or state.death.character ~= character then
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local ok, signature = pcall(AvatarSkins.signature, character)
			state.death = {character = character, time = state.context.environment.os.clock(),
				position = root and root.Position or state.context.environment.Vector3.zero, signature = ok and signature or "||"}
			pcall(AvatarSkins.matchDeath, state)
		end
		AvatarSkins.deadPose(state, character, camera)
		return
	end
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then
		model.Parent = nil
		AvatarSkins.showBody(state)
		AvatarSkins.restoreGrips(state)
		AvatarSkins.restoreMounts(state)
		state.character, state.links = nil, nil
		return
	end
	if state.deadFade then
		state.deadFade, state.near = nil, nil
		if state.remote then for _, part in state.modelParts do if part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end end end
	end
	local now = state.context.environment.os.clock()
	if state.character ~= character or not state.links and now - (state.attachAt or 0) > 0.5 then
		state.attachAt = now
		state.driven = false
		AvatarSkins.showBody(state)
		AvatarSkins.restoreGrips(state)
		AvatarSkins.restoreMounts(state)
		AvatarSkins.attach(state, character)
	end
	if not state.links then return end
	if model.Parent ~= camera then
		model.Parent = camera
		state.driven = false
		for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and (part.CanCollide or part.CanTouch or part.CanQuery) then
				part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery = false, false, false
			end
		end
	end
	if state.remote and state.driven and camera then
		local distance = (root.Position - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
		if distance > 12 then
			local point, size = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position), camera.ViewportSize
			if point.Z < -6 or point.X < -size.X * 0.35 or point.X > size.X * 1.35 or point.Y < -size.Y * 0.35 or point.Y > size.Y * 1.35 then return end
			if distance > 100 then
				state.tick = (state.tick or 0) + 1
				if state.tick % (distance > 250 and 3 or 2) ~= 0 then return end
			end
		end
	end
	if not AvatarSkins.drive(state, character) then return end
	state.driven = true
	AvatarSkins.hideBody(state, character)
	pcall(AvatarSkins.grip, state, character)
	pcall(AvatarSkins.followMounts, state, character)
	if not state.remote then AvatarSkins.firstPerson(state, character) end
end

function AvatarSkins.bind(state, enabled)
	if enabled == state.bound then return end
	state.bound = enabled
	local runService = state.context.runService
	if not enabled then
		pcall(runService.UnbindFromRenderStep, runService, "PulseSkinStep")
		if state.ragdollConnection then state.ragdollConnection:Disconnect(); state.ragdollConnection = nil end
		return
	end
	local priority = state.context.environment.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2
	runService:BindToRenderStep("PulseSkinStep", priority, function()
		if not state.alive then return end
		if not pcall(AvatarSkins.step, state) then state.links = nil end
	end)
	local added = state.context.workspace.DescendantAdded
	if added then state.ragdollConnection = added:Connect(function(object) AvatarSkins.watchRagdoll(state, object) end) end
end

function AvatarSkins.stop(state, suppressNotify)
	state.token += 1
	AvatarSkins.bind(state, false)
	AvatarSkins.showBody(state)
	AvatarSkins.restoreGrips(state)
	AvatarSkins.restoreMounts(state)
	for ragdoll, corpse in state.corpses do AvatarSkins.freeCorpse(corpse); state.corpses[ragdoll] = nil end
	state.death, state.ragdolls = nil, {}
	if state.bodyConnection then pcall(function() state.bodyConnection:Disconnect() end); state.bodyConnection = nil end
	state.bodyCharacter = nil
	local model = state.model
	state.model, state.character, state.links, state.joints, state.ground = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	state.baseDesc, state.public, state.near, state.legOn = nil, nil, nil, nil
	if model then pcall(function() model:Destroy() end); if not suppressNotify then AvatarSkins.notify(state) end end
end

function AvatarSkins.wear(state, description)
	if not state.alive then return false, "cancelled" end
	state.token += 1
	local token = state.token
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local ok, model = pcall(context.players.CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription, context.players, description, environment.Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
	if token ~= state.token or not state.alive then
		if ok and model then pcall(function() model:Destroy() end) end
		return false, "cancelled"
	end
	if not ok or not model then return false, "Couldn't build: " .. tostring(model) end
	local prepared, joints, ground, parts = pcall(AvatarSkins.prepare, state, model)
	if not prepared or not ground then
		pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
		return false, "Couldn't rig: " .. tostring(joints)
	end
	local previous = state.model
	AvatarSkins.showBody(state)
	AvatarSkins.restoreGrips(state)
	AvatarSkins.restoreMounts(state)
	state.model, state.joints, state.ground, state.modelParts = model, joints, ground, parts
	state.character, state.links, state.near = nil, nil, nil
	if previous then pcall(function() previous:Destroy() end) end
	AvatarSkins.bind(state, true)
	return true
end

function AvatarSkins.headless(model, enabled)
	local head = model and model:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end
	local objects = {head}
	for _, child in head:GetChildren() do if child:IsA("Decal") then table.insert(objects, child) end end
	for _, object in objects do pcall(function()
		local original = object:GetAttribute("PulseHL")
		if enabled then
			if original == nil then object:SetAttribute("PulseHL", object.Transparency) end
			object.Transparency = 1
			return
		end
		if original ~= nil then object.Transparency = original; object:SetAttribute("PulseHL", nil) end
	end) end
end

function AvatarSkins.cosmetics(state)
	local callback = rawget(state.context.environment.getgenv(), "__pulseCosMine")
