	if type(callback) ~= "function" then return false, false end
	local ok, leg, head = pcall(callback)
	return ok and leg == true, ok and head == true
end

function AvatarSkins.dress(state, description)
	state.baseDesc = description
	local leg, head = AvatarSkins.cosmetics(state)
	local modelDescription = description
	if leg then
		local ok, cloned = pcall(function() return description:Clone() end)
		if ok and cloned then
			modelDescription = cloned
			pcall(function() cloned.RightLeg = 139607718 end)
		else
			leg = false
		end
	end
	local ok, reason = AvatarSkins.wear(state, modelDescription)
	if ok then state.legOn = leg; AvatarSkins.headless(state.model, head) end
	return ok, reason
end

function AvatarSkins.applyBundle(state, value)
	local id = tonumber(value)
	if not id then return false, "Bad bundle id" end
	if not state.context.player.Character then return false, "No character" end
	local description, name = AvatarSkins.bundle(state.context, id)
	if not description then return false, tostring(name) end
	local ok, reason = AvatarSkins.dress(state, description)
	if not ok then return false, tostring(reason) end
	state.public = {b = id}
	state.config.skin = {kind = "bundle", id = tostring(id), name = name, desc = AvatarSkins.serialize(description)}
	state.save()
	return true, tostring(name)
end

function AvatarSkins.applyUser(state, value)
	local query = tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if query == "" then return false, "Enter a username" end
	if not state.context.player.Character then return false, "No character" end
	local ok, description, name, id = pcall(AvatarSkins.user, state.context, query)
	if not ok or not description then return false, "Player not found" end
	local dressed, reason = AvatarSkins.dress(state, description)
	if not dressed then return false, tostring(reason) end
	state.public = tonumber(id) and {u = tonumber(id)} or nil
	state.config.skin = {kind = "user", id = query, name = name, uid = tonumber(id), desc = AvatarSkins.serialize(description)}
	state.save()
	return true, tostring(name)
end

function AvatarSkins.applySaved(state, saved)
	if type(saved) ~= "table" then return false end
	local description = AvatarSkins.deserialize(state.context.environment, saved.desc)
	if description then
		local ok = AvatarSkins.dress(state, description)
		if ok then
			local id = tonumber(saved.kind == "bundle" and saved.id or saved.uid or saved.id)
			state.public = id and (saved.kind == "bundle" and {b = id} or {u = id}) or nil
			state.config.skin = saved
			state.save()
			return true
		end
	end
	if saved.kind == "user" then return AvatarSkins.applyUser(state, saved.id) end
	if saved.id then return AvatarSkins.applyBundle(state, saved.id) end
	return false
end

function AvatarSkins.install(context, config, save)
	local state = {context = context, config = config, save = save, token = 0, alive = true, bound = false,
		hidden = {}, grips = {}, mounts = {}, corpses = {}, ragdolls = {}}
	local globals = context.environment.getgenv()
	local model = function() return state.model and state.links and state.model.Parent and state.model or nil end
	local mine = function() return state.model and state.public or nil end
	local mountOriginal = function(object)
		local original = AvatarSkins.mountOriginal(state, object)
		if original then return original end
		local remote = rawget(globals, "__pulseRemoteSkin")
		for _, entry in remote and remote.list or {} do
			original = AvatarSkins.mountOriginal(entry, object)
			if original then return original end
		end
	end
	local cosmetics = function()
		context.environment.task.spawn(function()
			if not state.alive or not state.model or not state.baseDesc then return end
			local leg, head = AvatarSkins.cosmetics(state)
			if leg ~= (state.legOn == true) then AvatarSkins.dress(state, state.baseDesc); return end
			AvatarSkins.headless(state.model, head)
		end)
	end
	globals.__pulseSkinModel, globals.__pulseSkinMine, globals.__pulseMountOrig, globals.__pulseSkinCos = model, mine, mountOriginal, cosmetics
	return state, function()
		state.alive = false
		AvatarSkins.stop(state)
		if globals.__pulseSkinModel == model then globals.__pulseSkinModel = nil end
		if globals.__pulseSkinMine == mine then globals.__pulseSkinMine = nil end
		if globals.__pulseMountOrig == mountOriginal then globals.__pulseMountOrig = nil end
		if globals.__pulseSkinCos == cosmetics then globals.__pulseSkinCos = nil end
	end
end

end -- AvatarSkins private scope

local RemoteAvatarSkins = {}

function RemoteAvatarSkins.bind(state)
	local enabled = next(state.list) ~= nil
	if enabled == state.bound then return end
	state.bound = enabled
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	if not enabled then
		pcall(context.runService.UnbindFromRenderStep, context.runService, "PulseRSkinStep")
		if state.ragdollConnection then state.ragdollConnection:Disconnect(); state.ragdollConnection = nil end
		state.ragdolls = {}
		return
	end
	local priority = environment.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 3
	context.runService:BindToRenderStep("PulseRSkinStep", priority, function()
		for _, entry in state.list do if not pcall(AvatarSkins.step, entry) then entry.links = nil end end
	end)
	state.ragdollConnection = context.workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object) AvatarSkins.watchRagdoll(state, object) end)
end

function RemoteAvatarSkins.clear(state, player)
	local entry = state.list[player]
	if not entry then return end
	state.list[player] = nil
	entry.alive = false
	entry.generation += 1
	AvatarSkins.stop(entry, true)
	RemoteAvatarSkins.bind(state)
	AvatarSkins.notify(entry)
end

function RemoteAvatarSkins.description(state, selection)
	local key = selection.u and "u" .. selection.u or "b" .. selection.b
	if state.descriptions[key] then return state.descriptions[key] end
	local description
	if selection.u then
		local ok, value = pcall(state.context.players.GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId, state.context.players, selection.u)
		if ok then description = value end
	else
		local ok, value = pcall(AvatarSkins.bundle, state.context, selection.b)
		if ok then description = value end
	end
	if description then state.descriptions[key] = description end
	return description
end

function RemoteAvatarSkins.build(state, player, entry, selection, leg)
	entry.token += 1
	local token = entry.token
	local description = RemoteAvatarSkins.description(state, selection)
	if token ~= entry.token or state.list[player] ~= entry then return end
	if not description then entry.failAt = state.context.environment.os.clock(); return end
	if leg then
		local ok, cloned = pcall(function() return description:Clone() end)
		if ok and cloned then
			description = cloned
			pcall(function() cloned.RightLeg = 139607718 end)
		end
	end
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local ok, model = pcall(context.players.CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription, context.players, description, environment.Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
	if token ~= entry.token or state.list[player] ~= entry then
		if ok and model then pcall(function() model:Destroy() end) end
		return
	end
	if not ok or not model then entry.failAt = environment.os.clock(); return end
	local prepared, joints, ground, parts = pcall(AvatarSkins.prepare, entry, model)
	if not prepared or not ground then
		pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
		entry.failAt = environment.os.clock()
		return
	end
	model.Name = "PulseRemoteSkin"
	AvatarSkins.showBody(entry)
	AvatarSkins.restoreGrips(entry)
	AvatarSkins.restoreMounts(entry)
	if entry.model then pcall(function() entry.model:Destroy() end) end
	entry.model, entry.joints, entry.ground, entry.modelParts = model, joints, ground, parts
	entry.character, entry.links = nil, nil
	AvatarSkins.headless(model, entry.headless)
	entry.headlessApplied = entry.headless
end

function RemoteAvatarSkins.set(state, player, payload, leg, headless)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	if environment.typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or player == context.player then return end
	local user = type(payload) == "table" and tonumber(payload.u) or nil
	local bundle = type(payload) == "table" and tonumber(payload.b) or nil
	if user and (user < 1 or user >= 10000000000000) then user = nil end
	if bundle and (bundle < 1 or bundle >= 10000000000000) then bundle = nil end
	if not user and not bundle then RemoteAvatarSkins.clear(state, player); return end
	local selection = user and {u = math.floor(user)} or {b = math.floor(bundle)}
	local key = (user and "u" .. selection.u or "b" .. selection.b) .. (leg and "|k" or "")
	local entry = state.list[player]
	if entry and entry.key == key then
		entry.headless = headless == true
		if entry.model and entry.headlessApplied ~= entry.headless then
			AvatarSkins.headless(entry.model, entry.headless)
			entry.headlessApplied = entry.headless
		end
		if entry.model or entry.busy or entry.failAt and environment.os.clock() - entry.failAt < 30 then return end
	end
	if entry then
		AvatarSkins.stop(entry, true)
	else
		local entryContext = table.clone(context)
		entryContext.player = player
		entry = {context = entryContext, player = player, remote = true, registry = state, alive = true, bound = false, token = 0,
			generation = 0, hidden = {}, grips = {}, mounts = {}, corpses = {}, ragdolls = {}}
		state.list[player] = entry
	end
	entry.key, entry.headless, entry.failAt = key, headless == true, nil
	entry.generation += 1
	local generation = entry.generation
	entry.busy = true
	RemoteAvatarSkins.bind(state)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		if entry.generation ~= generation or state.list[player] ~= entry then return end
		pcall(RemoteAvatarSkins.build, state, player, entry, selection, leg)
		if entry.generation == generation then entry.busy = false end
	end)
end

function RemoteAvatarSkins.install(context)
	local state = {context = context, list = {}, descriptions = {}, ragdolls = {}, bound = false}
	state.set = function(player, payload, leg, headless) RemoteAvatarSkins.set(state, player, payload, leg, headless) end
	state.clear = function(player) RemoteAvatarSkins.clear(state, player) end
	state.clearAll = function() for player in state.list do RemoteAvatarSkins.clear(state, player) end end
	state.modelOf = function(player) local entry = state.list[player]; return entry and entry.model or nil end
	state.liveModel = function(player)
		local entry = state.list[player]
		if not entry or not entry.model or not entry.links or not entry.model.Parent or entry.character ~= player.Character then return nil end
		return entry.model
	end
	local globals = context.environment.getgenv()
	globals.__pulseRemoteSkin = state
	local removing
	if context.players.PlayerRemoving then removing = context.connect(context.players.PlayerRemoving, state.clear) end
	return state, function()
		if removing then pcall(function() removing:Disconnect() end) end
		state.clearAll()
		if globals.__pulseRemoteSkin == state then globals.__pulseRemoteSkin = nil end
	end
end

local AnimationFeature = {}
do -- Keep module-private locals out of the main chunk's register budget.

local ANIMATION_SLOTS = {
	idle = "IdleAnimation", walk = "WalkAnimation", run = "RunAnimation", jump = "JumpAnimation",
	fall = "FallAnimation", climb = "ClimbAnimation", swim = "SwimAnimation", swimidle = "SwimAnimation",
}
local ANIMATION_TYPES = {IdleAnimation = true, WalkAnimation = true, RunAnimation = true, JumpAnimation = true,
	FallAnimation = true, ClimbAnimation = true, SwimAnimation = true}
local ANIMATION_ORDER = {"IdleAnimation", "WalkAnimation", "RunAnimation", "JumpAnimation", "FallAnimation", "ClimbAnimation", "SwimAnimation"}

function AnimationFeature.defaults(saved)
	saved = type(saved) == "table" and saved or {}
	return {
		favorites = type(saved.favorites) == "table" and saved.favorites or {}, lastBundle = saved.lastBundle,
		speed = tonumber(saved.speed) or 1, emoteSpeed = tonumber(saved.emoteSpeed) or 1,
		mix = type(saved.mix) == "table" and saved.mix or {}, mixSaves = type(saved.mixSaves) == "table" and saved.mixSaves or {},
		skinMix = type(saved.skinMix) == "table" and saved.skinMix or {}, skin = type(saved.skin) == "table" and saved.skin or nil,
		lastMode = saved.lastMode or "bundle", toggleKey = type(saved.toggleKey) == "string" and saved.toggleKey or "RightShift",
		autoLoad = saved.autoLoad ~= false, emoteHold = saved.emoteHold == true, animPreview = saved.animPreview ~= false,
	}
end

function AnimationFeature.load(context, path)
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		if not context.environment.isfile(path) then return nil end
		return context.http:JSONDecode(context.environment.readfile(path))
	end)
	if ok and type(value) == "table" then return value end
	return {}
end

function AnimationFeature.write(state, path, value)
	pcall(function()
		local environment = state.context.environment
		if not environment.isfolder("BundleAnimations") then environment.makefolder("BundleAnimations") end
		environment.writefile(path, state.context.http:JSONEncode(value))
	end)
end

function AnimationFeature.parseId(value)
	if not value then return nil end
	value = tostring(value)
	return tonumber(value:match("bundles/(%d+)") or value:match("(%d%d%d%d+)") or value:match("(%d+)"))
end

function AnimationFeature.assetAnimations(model, wanted)
	local result = {}
	local animate = model:FindFirstChild("Animate")
	if not animate then return result end
	for _, folder in animate:GetChildren() do
		local kind = ANIMATION_SLOTS[folder.Name:lower()]
		if not kind or wanted and not wanted[kind] then continue end
		for _, animation in folder:GetChildren() do
			if not animation:IsA("Animation") or animation.AnimationId == "" then continue end
			result[kind] = result[kind] or {}
			result[kind][animation.Name] = animation.AnimationId
		end
	end
	return result
end

function AnimationFeature.bundle(state, id, progress)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	id = tonumber(id)
	if not id then return nil end
	local cached = state.cache[tostring(id)]
	if type(cached) == "table" then return cached, state.details[id] end

	local ok, details = pcall(context.avatar.GetItemDetails, context.avatar, id, environment.Enum.AvatarItemType.Bundle)
	if not ok or type(details) ~= "table" or type(details.BundledItems) ~= "table" then return nil end
	state.details[id] = details
	local assets, wanted = {}, {}
	for _, item in details.BundledItems do
		local kind = tostring(item.AssetType)
		if not item.Id or not ANIMATION_TYPES[kind] then continue end
		table.insert(assets, {kind = kind, id = item.Id})
		wanted[kind] = true
	end

	local result
	local description = environment.Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
	for _, asset in assets do pcall(function() description[asset.kind] = tonumber(asset.id) end) end
	local created, model = pcall(context.players.CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription, context.players, description, environment.Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
	description:Destroy()
	if created and model then
		pcall(function() result = AnimationFeature.assetAnimations(model, wanted) end)
		pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
	end
	if result and next(result) and progress then pcall(progress, #assets, #assets) end
	if not result or not next(result) then
		result = {}
		for index, asset in assets do
			pcall(function()
				for _, model in environment.game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. asset.id) do
					for _, animation in model:GetDescendants() do
						if not animation:IsA("Animation") then continue end
						result[asset.kind] = result[asset.kind] or {}
						result[asset.kind][animation.Name] = animation.AnimationId
					end
				end
			end)
			if progress then pcall(progress, index, #assets) end
			environment.task.wait()
		end
	end
	if not next(result) then return nil, details end
	state.cache[tostring(id)] = result
	AnimationFeature.write(state, "BundleAnimations/anims_cache.json", state.cache)
	return result, details
end

function AnimationFeature.stop(state)
	state.token += 1
	local emote = state.gameEmote
	state.gameEmote = nil
	if emote then pcall(function() emote:Stop(0) end) end
	for _, connection in state.connections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	table.clear(state.connections)
	state.toolSync, state.resume = nil, nil
	for _, track in state.tracks do pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end) end
	table.clear(state.tracks)
	state.current = nil
	local backup = state.backup
	if not backup then return end
	for animation, id in backup.ids do pcall(function() if animation.Parent then animation.AnimationId = id end end) end
	pcall(function() if backup.animate.Parent then backup.animate.Disabled = backup.disabled end end)
	state.backup = nil
end

function AnimationFeature.backup(state, animate)
	if not animate then return end
	local backup = {animate = animate, disabled = animate.Disabled, ids = {}}
	state.backup = backup
	animate.Disabled = true
	for _, folder in animate:GetChildren() do
		if not ANIMATION_SLOTS[folder.Name:lower()] then continue end
		for _, animation in folder:GetChildren() do
			if not animation:IsA("Animation") then continue end
			local id = animation.AnimationId
			if id == "" then id = animation:GetAttribute("PulseOrigAnim") or "" else animation:SetAttribute("PulseOrigAnim", id) end
			backup.ids[animation] = id
			animation.AnimationId = ""
		end
	end
end

function AnimationFeature.track(state, animator, id, priority, looped)
	local digits = tostring(id or ""):match("%d+")
	if not digits or digits == "0" then return nil end
	local animation = state.context.environment.Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. digits
	local ok, track = pcall(animator.LoadAnimation, animator, animation)
	if not ok or not track then return nil end
	track.Looped, track.Priority = looped ~= false, priority
	return track
end

function AnimationFeature.choose(animations, kind, preferred)
	local choices = animations[kind]
	if type(choices) ~= "table" then return nil end
	if preferred and choices[preferred] then return choices[preferred] end
	for _, id in choices do return id end
end

function AnimationFeature.play(state, track, fade, speed)
	if not track then return end
	if state.current ~= track then
		if state.current then pcall(function() state.current:Stop(fade or 0.15) end) end
		state.current = track
		pcall(function() track:Play(fade or 0.15) end)
	end
	if not speed then return end
	state.baseSpeed = speed
	pcall(function() track:AdjustSpeed(speed * (state.speedMultiplier or state.config.speed)) end)
end

function AnimationFeature.refreshSpeed(state)
	if state.current then pcall(function() state.current:AdjustSpeed(state.baseSpeed * state.speedMultiplier) end) end
end

function AnimationFeature.setSpeed(state, value)
	state.speedMultiplier = tonumber(value) or 1
	AnimationFeature.refreshSpeed(state)
end

function AnimationFeature.stopGameEmote(state, fade)
	local track = state.gameEmote
	state.gameEmote = nil
	if track then pcall(function() track:Stop(fade or 0.2) end) end
end

function AnimationFeature.gameEmoteId(state, animate, animator, input)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local id
	if environment.typeof(input) == "Instance" and input:IsA("Animation") then id = input.AnimationId:match("%d+") end
	if type(input) == "string" and not tonumber(input) then
		local folder = animate and animate:FindFirstChild(input)
		local animation = folder and folder:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animation")
		return animation and animation.AnimationId:match("%d+") or nil
	end
	if not id and tonumber(input) then id = tostring(tonumber(input)) end
	if not id then return nil end
	if state.cache["e" .. id] then return state.cache["e" .. id] end

	local preview = AnimationFeature.track(state, animator, id, environment.Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4, false)
	if preview then
		for _ = 1, 8 do
			if preview.Length > 0 then
				state.cache["e" .. id] = id
				pcall(function() preview:Destroy() end)
				return id
			end
			environment.task.wait(0.05)
		end
		pcall(function() preview:Destroy() end)
	end
	return AnimationFeature.emoteId(state, id)
end

function AnimationFeature.playGameEmote(state, animate, animator, token, input)
	if token ~= state.token then return false end
	local id = AnimationFeature.gameEmoteId(state, animate, animator, input)
	if not id or token ~= state.token then return false end
	AnimationFeature.stopGameEmote(state, 0)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local animation = environment.Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
	local ok, track = pcall(animator.LoadAnimation, animator, animation)
	if not ok or not track then return false end
	track.Priority = environment.Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
	state.gameEmote = track
	if state.current then pcall(function() state.current:Stop(0.15) end) end
	state.current, state.pose = nil, "Emote"
	pcall(function() track:Play(0.1) end)
	track.Stopped:Once(function()
		if state.gameEmote ~= track then return end
		state.gameEmote = nil
		if token == state.token and state.resume then state.resume() end
	end)
	return true
end

function AnimationFeature.gameData(state)
	if state.gameSync ~= nil then return state.gameSync or nil end
	local context = state.context
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local database = context.storage:WaitForChild("Database", 5)
		return context.environment.require(database:WaitForChild("Sync", 5))
	end)
	state.gameSync = ok and type(result) == "table" and result or false
	return state.gameSync or nil
end

function AnimationFeature.gameCommand(state, character, humanoid, animate, play, token, command)
	if token ~= state.token or type(command) ~= "string" then return end
	if animate and animate.Parent and not animate.Disabled then return end
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local sync = AnimationFeature.gameData(state)
	local backpack = context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local toys = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Toys")
	local owned = toys and toys:FindFirstChild(command)
	if owned or sync and type(sync.Toys) == "table" and sync.Toys[command] ~= nil then
		local tool
		if owned then
			local remotes = context.storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
			local extras = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Extras")
			local replicate = extras and extras:FindFirstChild("ReplicateToy")
			if replicate then pcall(function() tool = replicate:InvokeServer(command) end) end
			environment.task.wait()
		else
			tool = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(command) or character:FindFirstChild(command)
		end
		if environment.typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") or token ~= state.token then return end
		if tool.Parent ~= character then pcall(function() tool.Parent = backpack end); environment.task.wait() end
		pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, tool)
		return
	end
	local emote = sync and type(sync.Emotes) == "table" and sync.Emotes[command]
	if type(emote) ~= "table" then return end
	if type(emote.Command) == "string" and animate and animate:FindFirstChild(emote.Command) then play(emote.Command); return end
	if emote.AnimationID then play(tostring(emote.AnimationID)) end
end

function AnimationFeature.bindGameEmotes(state, character, humanoid, animate, animator, token)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local function play(value) return AnimationFeature.playGameEmote(state, animate, animator, token, value) end
	local bindable = animate and animate:FindFirstChild("PlayEmote")
	if bindable and bindable:IsA("BindableFunction") then
		local previous
		pcall(function() previous = bindable.OnInvoke end)
		local assigned = pcall(function() bindable.OnInvoke = play end)
		if assigned then table.insert(state.connections, {Disconnect = function()
			pcall(function() if bindable.OnInvoke == play then bindable.OnInvoke = previous end end)
		end}) end
	end
	local remotes = context.storage and context.storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local misc = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Misc")
	local event = misc and misc:FindFirstChild("PlayEmote")
	if event and event:IsA("BindableEvent") then
		table.insert(state.connections, event.Event:Connect(function(command)
			environment.task.spawn(AnimationFeature.gameCommand, state, character, humanoid, animate, play, token, command)
		end))
	end
	if context.player and context.player.Chatted then table.insert(state.connections, context.player.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
		if type(message) ~= "string" or token ~= state.token then return end
		local command = message:match("^/e%s+(%S+)") or message:match("^/emote%s+(%S+)")
		if not command then return end
		local sync = AnimationFeature.gameData(state)
		local emote = sync and type(sync.Emotes) == "table" and sync.Emotes[command]
		if type(emote) == "table" and emote.AnimationID then environment.task.spawn(play, tostring(emote.AnimationID)); return end
		if animate and animate:FindFirstChild(command) then environment.task.spawn(play, command) end
	end)) end
end

function AnimationFeature.bindTools(state, character, humanoid, animate, animator, token)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local priority = environment.Enum.AnimationPriority
	local fallback = humanoid.RigType == environment.Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
		and {toolnone = "182393478", toolslash = "129967390", toollunge = "129967478"}
		or {toolnone = "507768375", toolslash = "522635514", toollunge = "522638767"}
	local function animationId(name)
		local folder = animate and animate:FindFirstChild(name)
		local animation = folder and folder:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animation")
		return animation and animation.AnimationId:match("%d+") or fallback[name]
	end
	local hold = AnimationFeature.track(state, animator, animationId("toolnone"), priority.Action, true)
	state.tracks.toolnone = hold
	local own = {}
	for _, track in state.tracks do own[track] = true end
	local tool, action, toolConnections = nil, nil, {}
	local function updateWeight()
		if not hold or token ~= state.token then return end
		local other = false
		for _, track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
			if own[track] or track == state.gameEmote or not track.IsPlaying or track.WeightTarget <= 0.05 then continue end
			if track.Priority ~= priority.Core and track.Priority.Value >= priority.Action.Value then other = true; break end
		end
		pcall(function() hold:AdjustWeight(other and 0.001 or 1, 0.12) end)
	end
	local function actionRequested(target)
		if token ~= state.token then return end
		local request = target:FindFirstChild("toolanim")
		if not request or not request:IsA("StringValue") then return end
		local value = request.Value
		pcall(function() request:Destroy() end)
		local name = value == "Slash" and "toolslash" or value == "Lunge" and "toollunge"
		if not name then return end
		if action then own[action] = nil; pcall(function() action:Stop(0) end) end
		action = AnimationFeature.track(state, animator, animationId(name), priority.Action2, false)
		if not action then return end
		own[action], state.tracks.toolAct = true, action
		pcall(function() action:Play(0.05) end)
	end
	local function disconnectTool()
		for _, connection in toolConnections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
		table.clear(toolConnections)
	end
	local function synchronize()
		if token ~= state.token then return end
		local current = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if current ~= tool then
			disconnectTool()
			tool = current
			if tool then
				actionRequested(tool)
				table.insert(toolConnections, tool.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
					if child.Name == "toolanim" then environment.task.defer(actionRequested, tool) end
				end))
			end
		end
		if not hold then return end
		if tool and not hold.IsPlaying then pcall(function() hold:Play(0.1) end); updateWeight(); return end
		if not tool and hold.IsPlaying then pcall(function() hold:Stop(0.1) end) end
	end
	state.toolSync = synchronize
	table.insert(state.connections, {Disconnect = disconnectTool})
	for _, signal in {character.ChildAdded, character.ChildRemoved} do
		if not signal then continue end
		table.insert(state.connections, signal:Connect(function(child)
			if child:IsA("Tool") then environment.task.defer(synchronize) end
		end))
	end
	if animator.AnimationPlayed then table.insert(state.connections, animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		if token ~= state.token or own[track] or not tool then return end
		if track.Priority == priority.Core or track.Priority.Value < priority.Action.Value then return end
		updateWeight()
		track.Stopped:Once(function()
			environment.task.delay(0.05, updateWeight)
			environment.task.delay(0.3, updateWeight)
		end)
	end)) end
	synchronize()
end

function AnimationFeature.applyTracks(state, character, animations)
	AnimationFeature.stop(state)
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then return false end
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local priority = environment.Enum.AnimationPriority
	local definitions = {
		{"idle", "IdleAnimation", "Animation1", priority.Idle}, {"walk", "WalkAnimation", nil, priority.Movement},
		{"run", "RunAnimation", nil, priority.Movement}, {"jump", "JumpAnimation", nil, priority.Movement, false},
		{"fall", "FallAnimation", nil, priority.Movement}, {"climb", "ClimbAnimation", nil, priority.Movement},
		{"swim", "SwimAnimation", "Swim", priority.Movement}, {"swimidle", "SwimAnimation", "SwimIdle", priority.Idle},
	}
	for _, definition in definitions do
		local id = AnimationFeature.choose(animations, definition[2], definition[3])
		state.tracks[definition[1]] = AnimationFeature.track(state, animator, id, definition[4], definition[5])
	end
	local tracks = state.tracks
	if not tracks.idle and not tracks.walk and not tracks.run then return false end
	local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
	if animate then pcall(AnimationFeature.backup, state, animate) end
	for _, track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end) end
	state.pose = "Standing"
	local token = state.token
	local function movementSpeed()
		local root = humanoid.RootPart
		if not root then return 0 end
		local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		return math.sqrt(velocity.X * velocity.X + velocity.Z * velocity.Z)
	end
	local function running(speed)
		if token ~= state.token then return end
		if speed > 0.5 then
			AnimationFeature.stopGameEmote(state, 0.1)
			state.pose = "Running"
			AnimationFeature.play(state, speed > 9 and tracks.run or tracks.walk or tracks.run, 0.15, speed / 16)
			return
		end
		if state.gameEmote or state.pose == "Jumping" or state.pose == "FreeFall" then return end
		state.pose = "Standing"
		AnimationFeature.play(state, tracks.idle, 0.2, 1)
	end
	local function connect(signal, callback)
		if signal then table.insert(state.connections, signal:Connect(callback)) end
	end
	state.resume = function() running(movementSpeed()) end
	AnimationFeature.bindGameEmotes(state, character, humanoid, animate, animator, token)
	AnimationFeature.bindTools(state, character, humanoid, animate, animator, token)
	connect(humanoid.Running, running)
	connect(humanoid.Jumping, function()
		if token ~= state.token then return end
		AnimationFeature.stopGameEmote(state, 0.1)
		state.pose = "Jumping"
		AnimationFeature.play(state, tracks.jump or tracks.fall, 0.1, 1)
	end)
	connect(humanoid.FreeFalling, function(active)
		if token ~= state.token then return end
		if active then
			AnimationFeature.stopGameEmote(state, 0.1)
			state.pose = "FreeFall"
			AnimationFeature.play(state, tracks.fall or tracks.jump, 0.25, 1)
			return
		end
		state.pose = "Landed"
		running(movementSpeed())
	end)
	connect(humanoid.Climbing, function(speed)
		if token ~= state.token then return end
		AnimationFeature.stopGameEmote(state, 0.1)
		state.pose = "Climbing"
		AnimationFeature.play(state, tracks.climb, 0.15, speed / 5)
	end)
	connect(humanoid.Swimming, function(speed)
		if token ~= state.token then return end
		state.pose = "Swimming"
		AnimationFeature.play(state, math.abs(speed or 0) > 1 and tracks.swim or tracks.swimidle or tracks.swim, 0.2, 1)
	end)
	connect(humanoid.Seated, function(active) if not active then running(0) end end)
	connect(humanoid.StateChanged, function(_, nextState)
		if token ~= state.token or state.pose ~= "Jumping" and state.pose ~= "FreeFall" then return end
		local states = environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType
		if nextState ~= states.Landed and nextState ~= states.Running and nextState ~= states.RunningNoPhysics then return end
		state.pose = "Landed"
		running(movementSpeed())
	end)
	AnimationFeature.play(state, tracks.idle, 0.2, 1)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		while state.alive and token == state.token do
			environment.task.wait(0.4)
			if token ~= state.token or not state.alive then return end
			if animate and animate.Parent then animate.Disabled = true end
			if state.current and state.current.Looped and not state.current.IsPlaying then pcall(function() state.current:Play(0.1) end) end
			if state.toolSync then pcall(state.toolSync) end
		end
	end)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		while state.alive and token == state.token do
			environment.task.wait(0.1)
			if token ~= state.token or not state.alive then return end
			if not state.gameEmote and state.pose ~= "Jumping" and state.pose ~= "FreeFall" then pcall(running, movementSpeed()) end
		end
	end)
	return true
end

function AnimationFeature.save(state)
	AnimationFeature.write(state, "BundleAnimations/config.json", state.config)
end

function AnimationFeature.enableAutoLoad(state)
	if state.config.autoLoad then return end
	state.config.autoLoad = true
	local setter = state.context.setters and state.context.setters["Free anims/bundles/Auto-load on respawn"]
	if setter then pcall(setter, true) end
end

function AnimationFeature.resetTracks(state)
	AnimationFeature.stop(state)
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	local animate = character and character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
	if not animate then return end
	pcall(function()
		animate.Disabled = true
		state.context.environment.task.wait(0.1)
		animate.Disabled = false
	end)
end

function AnimationFeature.applyBundle(state, value, progress)
	local id = AnimationFeature.parseId(value)
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return false, "No character" end
	local animations, details = AnimationFeature.bundle(state, id, progress)
	if not animations then return false, "Failed to load bundle animations (ID: " .. tostring(id) .. ")" end
	if not AnimationFeature.applyTracks(state, character, animations) then return false, "Couldn't apply (no Animator)" end
	state.config.lastBundle, state.config.lastMode = tostring(id), "bundle"
	AnimationFeature.enableAutoLoad(state)
	AnimationFeature.save(state)
	return true, "Applied (visible to all): " .. (details and details.Name or "ID " .. id)
end

function AnimationFeature.applyMix(state)
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return false, "No character" end
	local assigned = false
	for _, kind in ANIMATION_ORDER do if state.config.mix[kind] then assigned = true; break end end
	if not assigned then return false, "Assign at least one slot first (tap SET)" end
	local animations = AnimationFeature.assetAnimations(character)
	local cache = {}
	for _, kind in ANIMATION_ORDER do
		local slot = state.config.mix[kind]
		local id = slot and tonumber(slot.id)
		if not id then continue end
		if cache[id] == nil then cache[id] = AnimationFeature.bundle(state, id) or false end
		if cache[id] and cache[id][kind] then animations[kind] = cache[id][kind] end
	end
	if not AnimationFeature.applyTracks(state, character, animations) then return false, "Couldn't apply mix (no Animator)" end
	state.config.lastMode = "mix"
	AnimationFeature.enableAutoLoad(state)
	AnimationFeature.save(state)
	return true, "Applied mix (visible to all)"
end

function AnimationFeature.setMixSlot(state, kind, id, name)
	state.config.mix[kind] = {id = tostring(id), name = name}
	AnimationFeature.save(state)
end

function AnimationFeature.clearMixSlot(state, kind)
	state.config.mix[kind] = nil
	AnimationFeature.save(state)
end

function AnimationFeature.clearMix(state)
	state.config.mix = {}
	AnimationFeature.save(state)
	if state.config.lastMode == "mix" then state.reset() end
end

function AnimationFeature.copyMix(mix)
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in type(mix) == "table" and mix or {} do
		if type(value) == "table" then copy[key] = {id = value.id, name = value.name} end
	end
	return copy
end

function AnimationFeature.queueMix(state)
	state.mixGeneration = (state.mixGeneration or 0) + 1
	local generation = state.mixGeneration
	state.context.environment.task.delay(0.05, function()
		if not state.alive or state.mixGeneration ~= generation then return end
		if next(state.config.mix) then pcall(AnimationFeature.applyMix, state); return end
		if state.config.lastMode == "mix" then state.reset() end
	end)
end

function AnimationFeature.stopEmote(state)
	for _, connection in state.emoteConnections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	table.clear(state.emoteConnections)
	if state.emote then pcall(function() state.emote:Stop(0.2) end) end
	state.emote = nil
end

function AnimationFeature.emoteId(state, value)
	local id = tostring(value or ""):match("%d+")
	if not id then return nil end
	local key = "e" .. id
	if state.cache[key] then return state.cache[key] end

	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local character = context.player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animate = character and character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
	local resolved
	if humanoid and animate then
		local previous = animate:FindFirstChild("PlayEmote")
		local proxy = environment.Instance.new("BindableFunction")
		proxy.OnInvoke = function(animation)
			if environment.typeof(animation) == "Instance" and animation:IsA("Animation") then resolved = animation.AnimationId:match("%d+") end
			return false
		end
		if previous then previous.Name = "PlayEmote_PulseHold" end
		proxy.Name, proxy.Parent = "PlayEmote", animate
		pcall(humanoid.PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById, humanoid, tonumber(id))
		proxy:Destroy()
		if previous and previous.Parent then previous.Name = "PlayEmote" end
	end
	if not resolved then
		pcall(function()
			for _, model in environment.game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. id) do
				local objects = model:GetDescendants()
				table.insert(objects, model)
				for _, animation in objects do
					if not animation:IsA("Animation") then continue end
					resolved = animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")
					if resolved then return end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	if resolved then
		state.cache[key] = resolved
		AnimationFeature.write(state, "BundleAnimations/anims_cache.json", state.cache)
	end
	return resolved or id
end

function AnimationFeature.applyEmote(state, value, name)
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then return false, "No character" end
	local id = AnimationFeature.emoteId(state, value)
	if not id then return false, "Couldn't load emote" end
	AnimationFeature.stopEmote(state)
	local track = AnimationFeature.track(state, animator, id, state.context.environment.Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4, true)
	if not track then return false, "Couldn't load emote" end
	state.emote = track
	pcall(function() track:Play(0.15); track:AdjustSpeed(state.config.emoteSpeed) end)
	for _, signal in {humanoid.Running, humanoid.Jumping} do
		if not signal then continue end
		table.insert(state.emoteConnections, signal:Connect(function(value)
			if state.config.emoteHold then return end
			if value == true or type(value) == "number" and value > 0.5 then AnimationFeature.stopEmote(state) end
		end))
	end
	return true, "Playing emote: " .. (name or "ID " .. id)
end

function AnimationFeature.applyConfig(state, saved)
	local restored = AnimationFeature.defaults(saved)
	for key in state.config do state.config[key] = nil end
	for key, value in restored do state.config[key] = value end
	AnimationFeature.save(state)
	AnimationFeature.setSpeed(state, state.config.speed)
	AnimationFeature.stopEmote(state)
	state.generation += 1
	local generation = state.generation
	local lastMode, lastBundle = state.config.lastMode, state.config.lastBundle
	local skin = state.config.skin
	state.context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		if not state.alive or state.generation ~= generation then return end
		if state.skin then
			AvatarSkins.stop(state.skin)
			if type(skin) == "table" then pcall(AvatarSkins.applySaved, state.skin, skin) end
		end
		if not state.alive or state.generation ~= generation then return end
		if lastMode == "mix" and next(state.config.mix) then
			pcall(AnimationFeature.applyMix, state)
		else
			if lastBundle then pcall(AnimationFeature.applyBundle, state, lastBundle)
			else AnimationFeature.resetTracks(state) end
		end
		if not state.alive or state.generation ~= generation then return end
		state.config.lastMode, state.config.lastBundle, state.config.skin = lastMode, lastBundle, skin
		AnimationFeature.save(state)
		if state.uiRefresh then pcall(state.uiRefresh) end
		if state.favRefresh then pcall(state.favRefresh) end
	end)
end

function AnimationFeature.controls(state)
	local section, context, config = state.context.section, state.context, state.config
	section:Sub("bundles")
	section:Header("Animation options")
	local speed = section:Slider({Text = "Animation Speed", Min = 0.1, Max = 3, Default = config.speed, Decimals = 2, Callback = function(value)
		config.speed = value
		AnimationFeature.setSpeed(state, value)
		AnimationFeature.save(state)
	end})
	local autoLoad = section:Toggle({Text = "Auto-load on respawn", Default = config.autoLoad, Callback = function(value)
		config.autoLoad = not not value
		AnimationFeature.save(state)
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Reset to default animations", Callback = state.reset})
	AnimationFeature.catalog(state, "bundle")

	section:Header("Animation combo")
	local slots = {}
	for _, kind in ANIMATION_ORDER do table.insert(slots, {code = kind, label = kind:gsub("Animation$", "")}) end
	local selected, bundleId = ANIMATION_ORDER[1], ""
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Slot", Options = slots, Default = selected, NoSave = true, Callback = function(value) selected = value end})
	local native = section:LastSection()
	if native and native.Input then native:Input({Text = "Bundle ID", Live = true, Callback = function(value) bundleId = tostring(value or "") end}) end
	section:Button({Text = "Set slot", Callback = function()
		local id = AnimationFeature.parseId(bundleId)
		if not id then return end
		AnimationFeature.setMixSlot(state, selected, id, "ID " .. id)
		AnimationFeature.queueMix(state)
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Clear slot", Callback = function()
		AnimationFeature.clearMixSlot(state, selected)
		AnimationFeature.queueMix(state)
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Clear combo", Callback = function() AnimationFeature.clearMix(state) end})

	section:Sub("emotes")
	section:Header("Emote options")
	local emoteSpeed = section:Slider({Text = "Emote Speed", Min = 0.1, Max = 3, Default = config.emoteSpeed, Decimals = 2, Callback = function(value)
		config.emoteSpeed = value
		if state.emote then pcall(function() state.emote:AdjustSpeed(value) end) end
		AnimationFeature.save(state)
	end})
	local hold = section:Toggle({Text = "Hold (don't stop when moving)", Default = config.emoteHold, Callback = function(value)
		config.emoteHold = not not value
		AnimationFeature.save(state)
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Stop emote", Callback = state.stopEmote})
	AnimationFeature.catalog(state, "emote")

	section:Sub("skins")
	section:Header("Skin")
	local username = ""
	native = section:LastSection()
	if native and native.Input then native:Input({Text = "Username or user ID", Live = true,
		Callback = function(value) username = tostring(value or "") end}) end
	section:Button({Text = "Wear", Callback = function()
		context.environment.task.spawn(function()
			local ok, message = AvatarSkins.applyUser(state.skin, username)
			context.window:Notify({Title = context.translation.tr("Skin"), Text = message, Kind = ok and "success" or "danger"})
		end)
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Remove skin", Callback = state.resetSkin})
	AnimationFeature.presetControls(state)
	AnimationFeature.catalog(state, "skin")
	AnimationFeature.favoriteControls(state)
	state.uiRefresh = function()
		speed.SetSilent(config.speed)
		autoLoad.SetSilent(config.autoLoad)
		emoteSpeed.SetSilent(config.emoteSpeed)
		hold.SetSilent(config.emoteHold)
	end
end

function AnimationFeature.presetControls(state)
	local context, section = state.context, state.context.section
	local presets = {{code = "163620952", label = "Iysglimt"}, {code = "8990346215", label = "runeaid"},
		{code = "89003145", label = "7788s"}, {code = "1219722", label = "coldness"},
		{code = "1195061435", label = "reaizsym"}, {code = "887330563", label = "aurqzv"}}
	section:Header("Presets")
	local selected = presets[1].code
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Preset", Options = presets, Default = selected, NoSave = true, Callback = function(value) selected = value end})
	section:Button({Text = "Wear preset", Callback = function()
		local choice = selected
		local label
		for _, preset in presets do if preset.code == choice then label = preset.label:lower(); break end end
		local skin = state.config.skin
		local current = type(skin) == "table" and skin.kind == "user" and tostring(skin.id):lower() or nil
		if current and (current == choice or current == label) then state.resetSkin(); return end
		context.environment.task.spawn(function()
			local ok, message = AvatarSkins.applyUser(state.skin, choice)
			context.window:Notify({Title = context.translation.tr("Skin"), Text = message, Kind = ok and "success" or "danger"})
		end)
	end})
end

function AnimationFeature.favoriteControls(state)
	local context, section = state.context, state.context.section
	section:Sub("favorites")
	section:Header("Favorites")
	local selected
	local dropdown = section:Dropdown({Text = "Favorites", Options = {}, Default = "", NoSave = true,
		Callback = function(value) selected = value end})
	state.favRefresh = function()
		local options = {}
		for id, entry in state.config.favorites do
			local kind = type(entry) == "table" and entry.kind or "bundle"
			local name = type(entry) == "table" and entry.name or kind .. " " .. tostring(id)
			table.insert(options, {code = tostring(id), label = tostring(name) .. " (" .. tostring(kind) .. ")"})
		end
		table.sort(options, function(first, second) return first.label < second.label end)
		dropdown.SetOptions(options)
		selected = options[1] and options[1].code or nil
		if selected then dropdown.SetSilent(selected) end
	end
	section:Button({Text = "Apply", Callback = function()
		local entry = selected and state.config.favorites[selected]
		if not entry then return end
		local id = selected
		local kind = type(entry) == "table" and entry.kind or "bundle"
		local name = type(entry) == "table" and entry.name or nil
		context.environment.task.spawn(function()
			if kind == "emote" then AnimationFeature.applyEmote(state, id, name); return end
			if kind == "skin" then AvatarSkins.applyBundle(state.skin, id); return end
			AnimationFeature.applyBundle(state, id)
		end)
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Remove favorite", Callback = function()
		if not selected then return end
		state.config.favorites[selected] = nil
		AnimationFeature.save(state)
		state.favRefresh()
	end})
	state.favRefresh()
end

function AnimationFeature.search(state, kind, query)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local params = environment.CatalogSearchParams.new()
	if query ~= "" then params.SearchKeyword = query end
	if kind == "emote" then params.AssetTypes = {environment.Enum.AvatarAssetType.EmoteAnimation}
	else params.BundleTypes = {kind == "skin" and environment.Enum.BundleType.BodyParts or environment.Enum.BundleType.Animations} end
	pcall(function() params.SortType = environment.Enum.CatalogSortType.MostFavorited end)
	local pages = state.context.avatar:SearchCatalog(params)
	local result = {}
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		for _, item in pages:GetCurrentPage() do table.insert(result, {code = tostring(item.Id), label = item.Name or tostring(item.Id)}) end
		if pages.IsFinished then break end
		pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync()
	end
	return result
end

function AnimationFeature.catalog(state, kind)
	local context, section = state.context, state.context.section
	local text, selected, serial, names = "", nil, 0, {}
	section:Header(kind == "emote" and "Emote catalog" or kind == "skin" and "Skin catalog" or "Animation packs")
	local native = section:LastSection()
	if native and native.Input then native:Input({Text = "Search", Live = true, Callback = function(value) text = tostring(value or "") end}) end
	local dropdown = section:Dropdown({Text = kind == "emote" and "Emotes" or kind == "skin" and "Skins" or "Bundles", Options = {}, Default = "", NoSave = true,
		Callback = function(value) selected = value end})
	local function apply(value)
		if kind == "emote" then return AnimationFeature.applyEmote(state, value, names[tostring(value)]) end
		if kind == "skin" then return AvatarSkins.applyBundle(state.skin, AnimationFeature.parseId(value)) end
		return AnimationFeature.applyBundle(state, value)
	end
	local function notify(ok, message)
		context.window:Notify({Title = context.translation.tr(kind == "emote" and "Emote" or kind == "skin" and "Skin" or "Animation"), Text = message, Kind = ok and "success" or "danger"})
	end
	local function search()
		serial += 1
		local current = serial
		local query = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
		context.environment.task.spawn(function()
			local ok, results = pcall(AnimationFeature.search, state, kind, query)
			if not state.alive or current ~= serial then return end
			if not ok then notify(false, "Catalog error (rate limit?). Try again."); return end
			names = {}
			for _, result in results do names[result.code] = result.label end
			dropdown.SetOptions(results)
			selected = results[1] and results[1].code or nil
			if selected then dropdown.SetSilent(selected) end
		end)
	end
	section:Button({Text = "Search", Callback = function()
		local value = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
		if value:match("^%d+$") or value:find("bundles/", 1, true) or value:find("catalog/", 1, true) then
			context.environment.task.spawn(function() local ok, message = apply(value); notify(ok, message) end)
			return
		end
		search()
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Apply", Callback = function()
		if not selected then return end
		local id = selected
		context.environment.task.spawn(function() local ok, message = apply(id); notify(ok, message) end)
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Copy ID", Callback = function()
		if not selected then return end
		local copy = context.environment.setclipboard or context.environment.toclipboard
		if copy then pcall(copy, tostring(selected)) end
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Favorite", Callback = function()
		if not selected then return end
		local favorites = state.config.favorites
		if favorites[selected] then favorites[selected] = nil else favorites[selected] = {name = names[selected] or kind .. " " .. selected, kind = kind} end
		AnimationFeature.save(state)
		if state.favRefresh then state.favRefresh() end
	end})
	search()
end

function AnimationFeature.install(context)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	if globals.__pulseFA_cleanup then pcall(globals.__pulseFA_cleanup) end
	local state = {context = context, alive = true, token = 0, generation = 0, connections = {}, tracks = {}, emoteConnections = {}, details = {},
		config = AnimationFeature.defaults(AnimationFeature.load(context, "BundleAnimations/config.json")),
		cache = AnimationFeature.load(context, "BundleAnimations/anims_cache.json"), baseSpeed = 1}
	state.speedMultiplier = state.config.speed
	state.save = function() AnimationFeature.save(state) end
	local skin, stopSkin = AvatarSkins.install(context, state.config, state.save)
	state.skin = skin
	local remoteSkins, stopRemoteSkins = RemoteAvatarSkins.install(context)
	state.remoteSkins = remoteSkins
	state.applyBundle = function(id, progress) return AnimationFeature.applyBundle(state, id, progress) end
	state.applySkin = function(id) return AvatarSkins.applyBundle(skin, id) end
	state.applySkinUser = function(value) return AvatarSkins.applyUser(skin, value) end
	state.resetSkin = function()
		AvatarSkins.stop(skin)
		state.config.skin = nil
		AnimationFeature.save(state)
		return true, "Skin removed"
	end
	state.applyMix = function() return AnimationFeature.applyMix(state) end
	state.setMixSlot = function(kind, id, name) AnimationFeature.setMixSlot(state, kind, id, name) end
	state.clearMixSlot = function(kind) AnimationFeature.clearMixSlot(state, kind) end
	state.clearMix = function() AnimationFeature.clearMix(state) end
	state.copyMix = AnimationFeature.copyMix
	state.MIX_SLOTS = {}
	for _, kind in ANIMATION_ORDER do table.insert(state.MIX_SLOTS, {key = kind, label = kind:gsub("Animation$", "")}) end
	state.setSpeed = function(value) AnimationFeature.setSpeed(state, value) end
	state.refreshSpeed = function() AnimationFeature.refreshSpeed(state) end
	state.refreshEmoteSpeed = function() if state.emote then pcall(function() state.emote:AdjustSpeed(state.config.emoteSpeed) end) end end
	state.applyEmote = function(id, name) return AnimationFeature.applyEmote(state, id, name) end
	state.stopEmote = function() AnimationFeature.stopEmote(state) end
	state.applyConfig = function(saved) AnimationFeature.applyConfig(state, saved) end
	state.parseBundleId = AnimationFeature.parseId
	state.reset = function()
		AnimationFeature.resetTracks(state)
		state.config.lastBundle = nil
		AnimationFeature.save(state)
		return true, "Default animations restored"
	end
	local function restore()
		if not state.alive or not state.config.autoLoad then return end
		if state.config.lastMode == "mix" and next(state.config.mix) then AnimationFeature.applyMix(state); return end
		if state.config.lastBundle then AnimationFeature.applyBundle(state, state.config.lastBundle) end
	end
	local respawn = context.connect(context.player.CharacterAdded, function(character)
		character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		environment.task.wait(1)
		if state.alive and context.player.Character == character then pcall(restore) end
	end)
	environment.task.spawn(function() environment.task.wait(0.5); pcall(restore) end)
	if state.config.skin then environment.task.spawn(function()
		local saved = state.config.skin
		for _ = 1, 60 do
			if not state.alive or state.config.skin ~= saved then return end
			local character = context.player.Character
			if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then break end
			environment.task.wait(0.25)
		end
		if state.alive and state.config.skin == saved then pcall(AvatarSkins.applySaved, skin, saved) end
	end) end
	local stop = function()
		state.alive = false
		state.generation += 1
		pcall(function() respawn:Disconnect() end)
		stopRemoteSkins()
		stopSkin()
		AnimationFeature.stopEmote(state)
		AnimationFeature.stop(state)
		if globals.__pulseFA == state then globals.__pulseFA = nil end
	end
	globals.__pulseFA, globals.__pulseFA_cleanup = state, stop
	return state, stop
end

end -- AnimationFeature private scope

local SeniorApplication = {}

SeniorApplication.Mobile = {}

function SeniorApplication.Mobile.action(state, key)
	local context, settings = state.context, state.context.configuration
	local globals = context.environment.getgenv()
	if key == "fly" then settings.fly.on = not settings.fly.on; return end
	if key == "bhop" then settings.bhop = not settings.bhop; return end
	local toggles = {killall = "KillAll", invis = "Invis", noclip = "Noclip", speed = "Speed", sglitch = "SGlitch"}
	local name = toggles[key]
	if name then
		local get, set = globals["__pulseGet" .. name], globals["__pulseSet" .. name]
		if type(set) == "function" then pcall(set, not (type(get) == "function" and get())) end
		return
	end
	local actions = {shot = "__pulseShotMurder", knife = "__pulseThrowKnife", bombjump = "__pulseAutoBombJump"}
	if actions[key] then
		local action = globals[actions[key]]
		if type(action) == "function" then pcall(action) end
		return
	end
	if key ~= "flingM" and key ~= "flingS" then return end
	if state.flinging then
		state.cancelFling = true
		if type(globals.__pulseFlingCancel) == "function" then pcall(globals.__pulseFlingCancel) end
		return
	end
	state.flinging, state.cancelFling = key, false
	context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		pcall(function()
			local roles = context.roles()
			for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
				if state.cancelFling then break end
				if player == context.player then continue end
				local data = roles[player.Name]
				local role = data and data.Role
				local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
				local character = player.Character
				if role == "Innocent" and (character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")) then role = "Hero" end
				if not data or data.Dead == true or data.Killed == true then continue end
				if key == "flingM" and role ~= "Murderer" then continue end
				if key == "flingS" and role ~= "Sheriff" and role ~= "Hero" then continue end
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
				if type(globals.__pulseFlingPersist) == "function" then
					globals.__pulseFlingPersist(player, {time = 10})
					continue
				end
				if type(globals.__pulseFlingPlayer) == "function" then
					pcall(globals.__pulseFlingPlayer, player)
					while globals.__pulseManualFling and not state.cancelFling do context.environment.task.wait(0.1) end
					continue
				end
				if type(globals.__pulseFlingChar) == "function" then pcall(globals.__pulseFlingChar, character, 1); context.environment.task.wait(0.12) end
			end
		end)
		state.flinging = nil
	end)
end

SeniorApplication.Mobile.buttons = {
	{key = "fly", text = "Fly Button", label = "FLY", x = -1, y = 0},
	{key = "bhop", text = "Bhop Button", label = "BHOP", x = 0, y = 0},
	{key = "flingS", text = "Fling Sheriff Button", label = "FLING S", x = 0, y = 1},
	{key = "flingM", text = "Fling Murderer Button", label = "FLING M", x = 1, y = 0},
	{key = "shot", text = "Shot Murder Button", label = "SHOT", x = 0, y = -1},
	{key = "killall", text = "Kill All Murder Button", label = "KILL ALL", x = 2, y = -1},
	{key = "invis", text = "Invisible Button", label = "INVIS", x = -1, y = 1},
	{key = "knife", text = "Knife Throw Button", label = "KNIFE", x = 1, y = -1},
	{key = "bombjump", text = "Auto Bomb Jump Button", label = "BOMB", x = -1, y = 2},
	{key = "noclip", text = "No Clip Button", label = "NOCLIP", x = 1, y = 1},
	{key = "speed", text = "Speed Button", label = "SPEED", x = 2, y = 0},
	{key = "sglitch", text = "Speed Glitch Button", label = "GLITCH", x = 2, y = 1},
}

function SeniorApplication.Mobile.refresh(state)
	if state.painted then table.clear(state.painted) end
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local mobile, style = context.configuration.mobile, context.configuration.uis
	local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or environment.Vector2.new(800, 600)
	local small = math.min(viewport.X, viewport.Y) <= 500
	local jumpX = viewport.X - (small and 60 or 110)
	local jumpY = viewport.Y - (small and 55 or 150)
	local radius = small and 35 or 60
	for index, item in SeniorApplication.Mobile.buttons do
		local button = state.buttons[item.key]
		local size = math.floor(64 * math.clamp((tonumber(style.size[item.key]) or 100) / 100, 0.5, 2) + 0.5)
		local position = mobile.pos[item.key]
		local x = item.x >= 0 and jumpX - radius - 46 - item.x * 76 or jumpX
		local y = item.y >= 0 and jumpY - radius - 46 - item.y * 76 or jumpY
		x, y = math.floor(x - size / 2), math.floor(y - size / 2)
		if style.style == "Compact" then x, y = viewport.X - 20 - size, jumpY - radius - 14 - size - (index - 1) * (size + 8) end
		if type(position) == "table" and type(position.x) == "number" and type(position.y) == "number" then x, y = position.x, position.y end
		button.Position = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x, 0, math.max(0, viewport.X - size)), math.clamp(y, 0, math.max(0, viewport.Y - size)))
		button.Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
		button.Visible = mobile[item.key] == true
		button.BackgroundColor3 = style.style == "Glass" and environment.Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 220) or environment.Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 32)
		button.BackgroundTransparency = style.style == "Glass" and 0.65 or 0.15
		button.TextColor3 = environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		button.Text = item.label .. (style.lock[item.key] and " рџ”’" or "")
	end
end

function SeniorApplication.Mobile.button(state, item)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local inputService = context.inputService
	local button = context.create("TextButton", {Name = item.key, Text = item.label, AutoButtonColor = false,
		Font = environment.Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true}, state.gui)
	context.corner(button, 32)
	local current, origin, start, moved, doubleTap, lastTime, lastPosition
	context.connect(button.InputBegan, function(input)
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		if kind ~= environment.Enum.UserInputType.Touch and kind ~= environment.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		if current then return end
		current, origin, start, moved = input, input.Position, button.Position, false
		local point = environment.Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		doubleTap = context.configuration.uis.dtap == true and lastTime ~= nil and environment.os.clock() - lastTime < 0.33
			and (point - lastPosition).Magnitude < 48
		if item.key == "shot" and not doubleTap then SeniorApplication.Mobile.action(state, item.key) end
	end)
	context.connect(inputService.InputChanged, function(input)
		if not current or context.configuration.uis.lock[item.key] then return end
		if current.UserInputType == environment.Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input ~= current then return end
		if current.UserInputType ~= environment.Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= environment.Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
		local delta = input.Position - origin
		if math.abs(delta.X) > 10 or math.abs(delta.Y) > 10 then moved = true end
		if not moved then return end
		local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
		local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or environment.Vector2.new(800, 600)
		local x = math.clamp(start.X.Offset + delta.X, 0, math.max(0, viewport.X - button.AbsoluteSize.X))
		local y = math.clamp(start.Y.Offset + delta.Y, 0, math.max(0, viewport.Y - button.AbsoluteSize.Y))
		button.Position = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
		context.configuration.mobile.pos[item.key] = {x = x, y = y}
	end)
	context.connect(inputService.InputEnded, function(input)
		if not current then return end
		if current.UserInputType == environment.Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input ~= current then return end
		if current.UserInputType ~= environment.Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= environment.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		current = nil
		if moved then lastTime, lastPosition = nil, nil; return end
		if doubleTap then
			local locks = context.configuration.uis.lock
			locks[item.key] = not locks[item.key]
			lastTime, lastPosition = nil, nil
			SeniorApplication.Mobile.refresh(state)
			return
		end
		lastTime, lastPosition = environment.os.clock(), environment.Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		if item.key ~= "shot" then SeniorApplication.Mobile.action(state, item.key) end
	end)
	return button
end

function SeniorApplication.Mobile.paint(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local globals, settings = environment.getgenv(), context.configuration
	local active = {fly = settings.fly.on == true, bhop = settings.bhop == true}
	for key, name in {killall = "KillAll", invis = "Invis", noclip = "Noclip", speed = "Speed", sglitch = "SGlitch"} do
		local get = globals["__pulseGet" .. name]
		if type(get) ~= "function" then continue end
		local ok, value = pcall(get)
		active[key] = ok and value == true
	end
	local character = context.player.Character
	local backpack = context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	for _, item in SeniorApplication.Mobile.buttons do
		local button = state.buttons[item.key]
		local unavailable = (item.key == "shot" or item.key == "knife") and not (
			character and character:FindFirstChild(item.key == "shot" and "Gun" or "Knife")
			or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(item.key == "shot" and "Gun" or "Knife"))
		local selected = active[item.key] or state.flinging == item.key
		local signature = tostring(selected) .. tostring(unavailable) .. tostring(settings.uis.style)
		if state.painted[item.key] == signature then continue end
		state.painted[item.key] = signature
		button.BackgroundColor3 = selected and environment.Color3.fromRGB(66, 135, 245)
			or settings.uis.style == "Glass" and environment.Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 220) or environment.Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 32)
		button.TextTransparency = unavailable and 0.55 or 0
	end
end

function SeniorApplication.Mobile.hud(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local settings, section = context.configuration.mobile, context.section
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local function refresh()
		pcall(function()
			local window = globals.__seniorWindow
			if not window then return end
			window:SetWatermark(settings.pingfps == true or settings.roundtimer == true)
			if not settings.roundtimer then window:SetWatermarkTitle(nil) end
		end)
	end
	local function setPing(value)
		settings.pingfps = value == true
		refresh()
		local control = globals.__pulsePfSettings
		if control and control.Get and control.SetSilent and control.Get() ~= settings.pingfps then pcall(control.SetSilent, settings.pingfps) end
	end

	section:Header("HUD")
	local control = section:Toggle({Text = "Show Ping/Fps UI", Default = false, Callback = setPing})
	globals.__pulsePingFps = {get = function() return settings.pingfps == true end, set = function(value)
		if control and control.Set then control.Set(value); return end
		setPing(value)
	end}
	section:Toggle({Text = "Show Round Timer", Default = false, Callback = function(value)
		settings.roundtimer = value == true
		refresh()
	end})
	setPing(settings.pingfps == true)

	local elapsed = 0
	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, function(delta)
		if not settings.roundtimer then return end
		elapsed += delta
		if elapsed < 0.25 then return end
		elapsed = 0
		local title
		pcall(function()
			local part = context.workspace:FindFirstChild("RoundTimerPart")
			local time = part and part:GetAttribute("Time")
			if type(time) == "number" and time > 0 then title = string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(time / 60), math.floor(time % 60)) end
		end)
		local window = globals.__seniorWindow
		if window and window.SetWatermarkTitle then pcall(window.SetWatermarkTitle, window, title) end
	end)
end

function SeniorApplication.Mobile.install(context)
	local settings = context.configuration
	settings.mobile = type(settings.mobile) == "table" and settings.mobile or {}
	settings.mobile.pos = type(settings.mobile.pos) == "table" and settings.mobile.pos or {}
	settings.uis = type(settings.uis) == "table" and settings.uis or {}
	settings.uis.size = type(settings.uis.size) == "table" and settings.uis.size or {}
	settings.uis.lock = type(settings.uis.lock) == "table" and settings.uis.lock or {}
	if settings.uis.style ~= "Pulse" and settings.uis.style ~= "Glass" and settings.uis.style ~= "Compact" then settings.uis.style = "Pulse" end
	local state = {context = context, buttons = {}, painted = {}}
	local environment, section = context.environment, context.section
	state.gui = context.create("ScreenGui", {Name = "PulseMobileBtns", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
		ZIndexBehavior = environment.Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, DisplayOrder = 9999}, context.parent)
	section:Sub("UIS")
	section:Note({Text = "On-screen buttons (mobile). Hold & drag a button to move it, tap to use."})
	section:Header("Buttons Style")
	for _, item in SeniorApplication.Mobile.buttons do state.buttons[item.key] = SeniorApplication.Mobile.button(state, item) end
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Button Design", Default = settings.uis.style,
		Options = {{code = "Pulse", label = "Pulse"}, {code = "Glass", label = "Glass"}, {code = "Compact", label = "Compact"}}, Callback = function(value)
		settings.uis.style = value
		SeniorApplication.Mobile.refresh(state)
	end})
	for _, item in SeniorApplication.Mobile.buttons do
		section:Toggle({Text = item.text, Default = settings.mobile[item.key] == true, Callback = function(value)
			settings.mobile[item.key] = value
			SeniorApplication.Mobile.refresh(state)
		end, Settings = function()
			section:Slider({Text = item.text .. " Size", Min = 50, Max = 200, Default = tonumber(settings.uis.size[item.key]) or 100,
				Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%", Callback = function(value)
					settings.uis.size[item.key] = value
					SeniorApplication.Mobile.refresh(state)
				end})
		end})
	end
	section:Button({Text = "Reset UIS Position", Callback = function() table.clear(settings.mobile.pos); SeniorApplication.Mobile.refresh(state) end})
	section:Header("Lock")
	section:Toggle({Text = "Double Tap Lock", Default = settings.uis.dtap == true, Callback = function(value) settings.uis.dtap = value end})
	section:Button({Text = "Unlock All Buttons", Callback = function() table.clear(settings.uis.lock); SeniorApplication.Mobile.refresh(state) end})
	SeniorApplication.Mobile.hud(state)
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	globals.__pulseSyncUIS = function() SeniorApplication.Mobile.refresh(state) end
	globals.__pulseRefreshBtnStyles = globals.__pulseSyncUIS
	table.insert(context.applyHooks, globals.__pulseSyncUIS)
	SeniorApplication.Mobile.refresh(state)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		while context.isAlive() do
			pcall(SeniorApplication.Mobile.paint, state)
			environment.task.wait(0.25)
		end
	end)
	return state, function()
		state.cancelFling = true
		globals.__pulseSyncUIS, globals.__pulseRefreshBtnStyles, globals.__pulsePingFps = nil, nil, nil
		state.gui:Destroy()
	end
end

function SeniorApplication.installAppearance(context)
    local window,tab=context.window,context.hub.FeatureTabs.Settings
    local s=tab:Section({Title="Appearance",Side="Right",Sub="UI"})
    s:Dropdown({Text="Theme",Options={"Midnight","Obsidian","Ocean","Emerald","Rose","Gold","Light"},Default="Midnight",
        Callback=function(value) window:SetBase(value) end})
    s:Colorpicker({Text="Accent color",Default=Color3.fromRGB(239,77,105),Callback=function(color) window:SetAccent(color) end})
    s:Slider({Text="UI scale",Min=.6,Max=1.4,Decimals=2,Default=1,Suffix="x",Callback=function(value) window:SetScale(value) end})
    s:Button({Text="Minimize window",Icon="minus",Callback=function() window:SetMinimized(true) end})
    s:Button({Text="Hide window",Icon="eye",Callback=function() window:Toggle(false) end})
    s:Button({Text="Destroy interface",Icon="x",DoubleClick=true,Callback=function() window:Destroy() end})
end

function SeniorApplication.installMenu(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local settings, window = context.configuration, context.window
	local section, translation = context.section, context.translation
	local key = globals.__pulseBindFromName(settings.ui.menuKey)

	section:Header("Menu", "Left")
	if key and key.EnumType == environment.Enum.KeyCode then
		context.hub.MenuKey = key
		window:SetKey(key)
	end
	local keybind
	window:OnKeyChanged(function(value)
		context.hub.MenuKey = value
		settings.ui.menuKey = value.Name
		if keybind and keybind.Get and keybind.Get() ~= value then pcall(keybind.Set, value) end
	end)
	keybind = section:Keybind({Text = "Menu key", Default = window.Key, NoSave = true, Callback = function(value)
		if environment.typeof(value) ~= "EnumItem" or value.EnumType ~= environment.Enum.KeyCode then return end
		window:SetKey(value)
		context.hub.MenuKey = value
		settings.ui.menuKey = value.Name
	end})
	local pingFps = globals.__pulsePingFps
	globals.__pulsePfSettings = section:Toggle({Text = "Show FPS / Ping", NoSave = true, Default = pingFps and pingFps.get() or false, Callback = function(value)
		local current = globals.__pulsePingFps
		if current and current.get() ~= value then current.set(value) end
	end})
	globals.__pulseKbSettings = section:Toggle({Text = "Show Keybinds", NoSave = true,
		Default = window.State.get("keybindList", window.IsTouch == true) == true,
		Callback = function(value) pcall(window.SetKeybindList, window, value) end})
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Language", NoSave = true, Default = settings.ui.lang or "en",
		Options = {{code = "en", label = "English"}, {code = "ru", label = "Р СѓСЃСЃРєРёР№"}}, Callback = function(language)
			settings.ui.lang = language
			translation.setLang(language)
			for _, callback in ipairs(globals.__seniorLanguageHooks or {}) do pcall(callback) end
		end})
end

function SeniorApplication.installGeneral(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local settings = context.configuration
	local virtualUser = environment.game:GetService("VirtualUser")
	local lastFrame, baseFrame

	context.connect(context.player.Idled, function()
		if not settings.afk or not settings.afk.on then return end
		pcall(function()
			virtualUser:CaptureController()
			virtualUser:ClickButton2(environment.Vector2.new())
		end)
	end)
	context.section:Header("General", "Left")
	context.section:Toggle({Text = "Anti AFK", Default = context.defaults.afk.on,
		Callback = function(enabled) settings.afk.on = enabled end})
	context.section:Slider({Text = "Screen Stretch", Min = 0, Max = 100,
		Default = math.floor((context.defaults.ui.stretch or 0) + 0.5), Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%",
		Callback = function(value) settings.ui.stretch = value end})
	context.section:Toggle({Text = "Trolly NPC", Default = type(context.defaults.npc) ~= "table" or context.defaults.npc.on ~= false,
		Callback = function(enabled)
			if type(settings.npc) ~= "table" then settings.npc = {} end
			settings.npc.on = enabled
			local npc = environment.getgenv().__pulseNpc
			if npc then npc.setOn(enabled) end
		end})
	context.section:Toggle({Text = "Trolly Dances", Default = type(context.defaults.npc) ~= "table" or context.defaults.npc.dances ~= false,
		Callback = function(enabled)
			if type(settings.npc) ~= "table" then settings.npc = {} end
			settings.npc.dances = enabled
		end})
	context.section:Slider({Text = "Trolly Volume", Min = 0, Max = 100,
		Default = type(context.defaults.npc) == "table" and tonumber(context.defaults.npc.volume) or 100,
		Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%", Callback = function(value)
			if type(settings.npc) ~= "table" then settings.npc = {} end
			settings.npc.volume = value
			local npc = environment.getgenv().__pulseNpc
			if npc then npc.setVolume(value) end
		end})
	if context.window then
		context.section:Button({Text = "Unload hub", DoubleClick = true, Callback = function()
			environment.task.defer(function() context.window:Destroy() end)
		end})
	end
	context.connect(context.runService.RenderStepped, function()
		local stretch = settings.ui and settings.ui.stretch or 0
		if stretch <= 0 then
			lastFrame = nil
			return
		end

		local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end
		local scale, current = 1 - stretch / 100 * 0.6, camera.CFrame
		local base = lastFrame and current == lastFrame and baseFrame or current
		camera.CFrame = base * environment.CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0, 0, 1)
		lastFrame, baseFrame = camera.CFrame, base
	end)
end

function SeniorApplication.start(host, game, parent)
	local environment, diagnostics = OfflineEnvironment.create(host, game)
	local hostGlobal = type(host.getgenv) == "function" and host.getgenv() or host
	local previous = hostGlobal.SeniorHubSourcesApplication
	if previous and previous.window then pcall(function() previous.window:Destroy() end) end
	hostGlobal.SeniorLocalDiagnostics = diagnostics
	hostGlobal.SeniorLocalEnvironment = environment
	local ok, application = xpcall(function()
		return SeniorApplication.create(environment, parent, {["3.4"] = "offline"})
	end, function(message)
		return host.debug.traceback(tostring(message), 2)
	end)
	if not ok then
		table.insert(diagnostics.errors, application)
		host.warn("[Pulse offline] Startup error: " .. application)
		return nil, diagnostics
	end
	application.diagnostics = diagnostics
	hostGlobal.SeniorHubSourcesApplication = application
	hostGlobal.SeniorHubSourcesDiagnostics = diagnostics
	return application, diagnostics
end

function SeniorApplication.create(environment, parent, versions)
	local game = environment.game
	local players = game:GetService("Players")
	local inputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
	local settings = Configuration.load(environment, http, versions)
	if type(settings.ctrl) ~= "table" then settings.ctrl = {} end
	local defaults = Configuration.defaultView(settings, versions)
	local translation = Translation.create()
	translation.setLang(settings.ui.lang)
	InputBindings.install(environment, inputService)

	local nova = FeatureServices.create(environment)
	local layout = Layout.create()
	local window, tabs = SeniorWindow.create(environment, nova, layout, parent)
	environment.getgenv().__seniorWindow = window
	for _, group in ipairs(window.Groups) do translation.bind(group.Label, group.Key) end
	for name, tab in pairs(tabs) do translation.bind(tab.Label, name) end
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	globals.__pulseBinds = globals.__pulseBinds or {}
	globals.__pulseBakedCfg = Configuration.baked(http)
	local hub = {W = window, Renderer = nova, FeatureTabs = tabs, tabs = {}, _tabList = {}, _ckeys = {}}
	local connections = {}
	local context = {translator = translation, layout = layout, icons = {}, config = settings.ctrl,
		defaults = {}, setters = {}, applyHooks = {}, applyState = {}}
	local roles = RoleData.create({environment = environment, storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), players = players})
	local function connect(signal, callback)
		local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
		table.insert(connections, connection)
		return connection
	end
	local function create(className, properties, owner)
		local object = environment.Instance.new(className)
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do object[key] = value end
		object.Parent = owner
		return object
	end

	context.alive = function() return not hub.dead and not window.Destroyed end
	context.localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
	context.connect = connect

	local main = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Main", "home", context)
	main:Sub("General")
	local stopXray = Appearance.installXray({environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults,
		section = main, connect = connect, runService = runService, workspace = workspace, players = players})
