	main:Group({Title = "Movement", Side = "Right"})
	local stopNoclip = Movement.installNoclip({environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults,
		section = main, connect = connect, runService = runService, player = players.LocalPlayer})
	local stopCameraNoclip = Movement.installCameraNoclip({environment = environment, configuration = settings,
		defaults = defaults, section = main, player = players.LocalPlayer})
	Movement.install({environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults,
		section = main, connect = connect, inputService = inputService, player = players.LocalPlayer})
	local stopAntiCoin = Movement.installAntiCoin({environment = environment, section = main, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		workspace = workspace, storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), window = window, translation = translation,
		connect = connect, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	Movement.installBombJump({environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults,
		section = main, connect = connect, inputService = inputService, workspace = workspace, player = players.LocalPlayer})
	local stopFly = Movement.installFly({environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults,
		section = main, connect = connect, inputService = inputService, runService = runService,
		workspace = workspace, player = players.LocalPlayer})
	local stopSpin = Movement.installSpinAndBhop({environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults,
		section = main, connect = connect, runService = runService, workspace = workspace, player = players.LocalPlayer})
	local stopInvisibility = Movement.installInvisibility({environment = environment, configuration = settings,
		section = main, connect = connect, runService = runService, workspace = workspace, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		bindRender = function(name, priority, callback)
			RenderBindings.bind({environment = environment, isCurrent = function() return not window.Destroyed end}, name, priority, callback)
		end})
	main:Sub("ESP")
	local esp = EspFeature.create({environment = environment, section = main, configuration = settings,
		workspace = workspace, players = players, player = players.LocalPlayer, roles = roles, runService = runService,
		coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui"), textService = game:GetService("TextService"), nova = nova, inputService = inputService,
		translation = translation, connect = connect})
	EspFeature.mainControls(esp)
	local stopGunEsp, gunDrops = GunFeature.installEsp({environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults,
		section = main, connect = connect, runService = runService, workspace = workspace, coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui"),
		players = players, player = players.LocalPlayer})
	EspFeature.boxControls(esp)
	EspFeature.textControls(esp)
	EspFeature.chamsControls(esp)
	EspFeature.tracerControls(esp)
	EspFeature.colorControls(esp)
	EspFeature.lookControls(esp)
	local general = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Settings", "settings", context)
	general:Sub("UI")
	SeniorApplication.installMenu({environment = environment, configuration = settings,
		section = general, translation = translation, window = window, hub = hub})
	pcall(SeniorApplication.installAppearance, {window = window, nova = nova, hub = hub, translation = translation})
	SeniorApplication.installGeneral({environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults,
		section = general, connect = connect, player = players.LocalPlayer, runService = runService,
		workspace = workspace, window = window})
	context.stopTrolly = function() end
	local visuals = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Visuals", "eye", context)
	visuals:Sub("Random")
	visuals:Group({Title = "Effects", Side = "Left"})
	visuals._curSub = "Random"
	local _, stopGameEffects = GameEffects.install({environment = environment, section = visuals, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), runService = runService, connect = connect})
	context.stopKillEffects = GameEffects.Kill.install({environment = environment, section = visuals, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		players = players, roles = roles, workspace = workspace, storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), runService = runService,
		tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService"), window = window, translation = translation})
	local _, stopSelfChams = SelfChams.install({environment = environment, configuration = settings, section = visuals,
		player = players.LocalPlayer, workspace = workspace, runService = runService, connect = connect, applyHooks = context.applyHooks})
	local _, stopAuraTint = AuraTint.install({environment = environment, configuration = settings, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		players = players, connect = connect})
	local _, stopWalkTrail = WalkTrail.install({environment = environment, configuration = settings, section = visuals,
		player = players.LocalPlayer, workspace = workspace, runService = runService, connect = connect, applyHooks = context.applyHooks})
	local stopOptimizer = Optimizer.install({environment = environment, section = visuals, configuration = settings,
		workspace = workspace, lighting = game:GetService("Lighting"), players = players, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		inputService = inputService, runService = runService, connect = connect, applyHooks = context.applyHooks,
		isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local _, stopCursor = CustomCursor.install({environment = environment, section = visuals, configuration = settings,
		coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui"), player = players.LocalPlayer, inputService = inputService, runService = runService,
		window = window, create = create, corner = nova.U.corner, nova = nova, translation = translation, connect = connect,
		applyHooks = context.applyHooks, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local visualWorld, stopVisualWorld = VisualWorld.install({environment = environment, section = visuals, configuration = settings,
		workspace = workspace, lighting = game:GetService("Lighting"), players = players, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui"), materialService = game:GetService("MaterialService"), runService = runService,
		connect = connect, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local _, stopVisualSky = VisualSky.install({environment = environment, section = visuals, configuration = settings,
		lighting = game:GetService("Lighting"), workspace = workspace, visualWorld = visualWorld, applyHooks = context.applyHooks,
		create = create, corner = nova.U.corner, nova = nova, translation = translation, connect = connect,
		isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local _, stopTexturePack = TexturePack.install({environment = environment, section = visuals, configuration = settings,
		workspace = workspace, materialService = game:GetService("MaterialService"), runService = runService,
		create = create, corner = nova.U.corner, nova = nova, translation = translation,
		connect = connect, applyHooks = context.applyHooks, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local _, stopWeather = Weather.install({environment = environment, section = visuals, configuration = settings,
		visualWorld = visualWorld, lighting = game:GetService("Lighting"), workspace = workspace, players = players,
		player = players.LocalPlayer, runService = runService, connect = connect, create = create, corner = nova.U.corner,
		nova = nova, translation = translation, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local _, stopSkyFx = SkyFx.install({environment = environment, section = visuals, workspace = workspace,
		lighting = game:GetService("Lighting"), player = players.LocalPlayer, inputService = inputService, runService = runService,
		create = create, corner = nova.U.corner, nova = nova, translation = translation, connect = connect,

	visuals:Sub("WSkins")
	local weaponSkins, stopWeaponSkins = WeaponSkins.install({environment = environment, section = visuals, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		players = players, collection = game:GetService("CollectionService"), insertService = game:GetService("InsertService"),
		storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), workspace = workspace, http = http, runService = runService, connect = connect,
		setters = context.setters, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	visuals:Sub("Auras")
	visuals:Group({Title = "Auras"})
	visuals._curSub = "VFX"
	local _, stopAuras = AuraFeature.install({environment = environment, configuration = settings, section = visuals,
		player = players.LocalPlayer, players = players, runService = runService, connect = connect, applyHooks = context.applyHooks})
	local server = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Server", "globe-simplified", context)

	server:Group({Title = "Server", Side = "Left"})
	ServerIdentity.install({environment = environment, translation = translation, section = server, connect = connect,
		create = create, round = nova.U.corner, nova = nova,
		players = players, player = players.LocalPlayer, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})

		translation = translation, workspace = workspace, player = players.LocalPlayer, runService = runService,
		window = window, inputService = inputService, tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService"),

		applyHooks = context.applyHooks, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})

	local fun = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Troll Fun", "face-winking", context)
	fun:Sub("Troll")
	fun:Columns()
	fun:Group({Title = "Fun", Side = "Right"})
	local _, stopFunTools = Appearance.FunTools.install({environment = environment, configuration = settings, section = fun,
		storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), player = players.LocalPlayer, connect = connect,
		applyState = context.applyState, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	fun:Header("Fake Items")
	local stopFakeItems = Appearance.installFakeItems({environment = environment, section = fun,
		connect = connect, player = players.LocalPlayer})
	fun:Header("Movement")
	local stopSpeed = Movement.installSpeed({environment = environment, configuration = settings,
		section = fun, connect = connect, runService = runService, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local stopGlitch = Movement.installGlitch({environment = environment, section = fun, connect = connect,
		runService = runService, player = players.LocalPlayer})
	local stopGravity = Movement.installGravity({environment = environment, section = fun,
		workspace = workspace, player = players.LocalPlayer, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local stopWallHop = Movement.installWallHop({environment = environment, section = fun, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		players = players, workspace = workspace, inputService = inputService, runService = runService, connect = connect})
	fun:Group({Title = "Troll", Side = "Left"})
	local stopFlingTool = FlingFeature.installTool({environment = environment, section = fun, player = players.LocalPlayer, connect = connect})
	local flingTab = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Fling Players", "lightning-bolt", context)
	local _, stopFling = FlingFeature.install({environment = environment, configuration = settings, section = flingTab,
		workspace = workspace, players = players, player = players.LocalPlayer, roles = roles, runService = runService,
		touchSection = fun, inputService = inputService, coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui"),
		tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService"), debris = game:GetService("Debris"),
		connect = connect, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})

	local farm = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Auto Farm", "shopping-cart", context)
	farm:Sub("Coin")
	local farmContext = {environment = environment, configuration = settings, section = farm, translation = translation,
		workspace = workspace, players = players, player = players.LocalPlayer, roles = roles, drops = gunDrops,
		collection = game:GetService("CollectionService"), storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), http = http,
		guiService = game:GetService("GuiService"), coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui"), teleport = game:GetService("TeleportService"),
		runService = runService, connect = connect, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end}
	local _, _, farmApi, stopFarm = FarmRuntime.install(farmContext)
	FarmRuntime.controls(farmContext, farmApi)
	local roleFarm, stopRoleFarm = RoleFarm.install(farmContext)
	RoleFarm.controls(farmContext, roleFarm)
	local boxes, stopBoxes = BoxFarm.install(farmContext)
	BoxFarm.controls(farmContext, boxes)
	farmContext.window = window
	context.farmWebhook, context.stopFarmWebhook = FarmRuntime.Webhook.install(farmContext)

	local combat = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Combat", "swords", context)
	combat:Sub("Sheriff")
	GunFeature.installAuto({environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults, section = combat,
		player = players.LocalPlayer, roles = roles, drops = gunDrops, runService = runService,
		inputService = inputService, connect = connect, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local aimContext = {environment = environment, configuration = settings, section = combat, workspace = workspace, players = players,
		player = players.LocalPlayer, roles = roles, runService = runService, inputService = inputService, http = http,
		storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), collection = game:GetService("CollectionService"),
		guiService = game:GetService("GuiService"), connect = connect, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end}
	local _, stopAntiAim = AntiAim.install(aimContext)
	local _, stopMuzzleGuard = MuzzleGuard.install(aimContext)
	local aim = AimEngine.install(aimContext)
	aimContext.aim = aim
	SheriffRuntime.install(aimContext)
	SheriffSection.create({environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults, section = combat,
		translation = translation, connect = connect, inputService = inputService,
		resolverEnabled = function() return true end, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local fov = FovSettings.initialize(settings)
	local feature = FovFeature.install({
		environment = environment, section = combat, settings = fov, defaultOn = defaults.sheriff.fov.on,
		configuration = settings, nova = nova, translation = translation, create = create,
		connect = connect, round = nova.U.corner, coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui"),
		player = players.LocalPlayer, players = players, roles = roles, runService = runService,
	})
	local murder = MurderFeature.install({environment = environment, section = combat, roles = roles, players = players,
		player = players.LocalPlayer, collection = game:GetService("CollectionService"),
		isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	aimContext.section, aimContext.coreGui, aimContext.stats = combat, game:GetService("CoreGui"), game:GetService("Stats")
	local _, stopKnifeAim = KnifeAim.install(aimContext, murder)
	aimContext.knifeSection = combat
	aimContext.pathfinding, aimContext.tweenService = game:GetService("PathfindingService"), game:GetService("TweenService")
	aimContext.lighting, aimContext.starterGui = game:GetService("Lighting"), game:GetService("StarterGui")
	local _, stopTracers = CombatTracer.install(aimContext)
	aimContext.defaults, aimContext.soundService = defaults, game:GetService("SoundService")
	local _, stopCustomSounds = CustomSounds.install(aimContext)
	local _, stopTradeValues = TradeValues.install({environment = environment, section = combat, configuration = settings,
		player = players.LocalPlayer, storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), http = http, runService = runService,
		connect = connect, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local _, stopBoombox = Boombox.install({environment = environment, section = fun, configuration = settings,
		player = players.LocalPlayer, storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), workspace = workspace,
		marketplace = game:GetService("MarketplaceService"), runService = runService, window = window, translation = translation,
		create = create, corner = nova.U.corner, nova = nova, connect = connect, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local _, stopGameSounds = GameSounds.install({environment = environment, section = fun, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		soundService = game:GetService("SoundService"), tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService"),
		storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), connect = connect, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local mobile = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Mobile", "smartphone", context)
	local _, stopMobile = SeniorApplication.Mobile.install({environment = environment, configuration = settings, section = mobile,
		workspace = workspace, players = players, player = players.LocalPlayer, roles = roles, inputService = inputService,
		runService = runService, parent = parent or nova.U.hostGui(), create = create, corner = nova.U.corner, connect = connect,
		applyHooks = context.applyHooks, isAlive = function() return not window.Destroyed end})
	local teleportTab = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Teleport", "location-pin-map", context)
	TeleportFeature.install({environment = environment, workspace = workspace, players = players, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		roles = roles, window = window, translation = translation, section = teleportTab})
	local animations = SeniorFeatures.create(environment, hub, "Free anims", "person-running", context)
	local animationState, stopAnimations = AnimationFeature.install({environment = environment, http = http, section = animations,
		player = players.LocalPlayer, players = players, avatar = game:GetService("AvatarEditorService"),
		assetService = game:GetService("AssetService"), storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), workspace = workspace,
		runService = runService, window = window, translation = translation, connect = connect, setters = context.setters})
	AnimationFeature.controls(animationState)
	Configuration.install({environment = environment, http = http, section = general, settings = settings,
		setters = context.setters, applyHooks = context.applyHooks, applyState = context.applyState,
		window = window, translation = translation, weaponSkins = weaponSkins,
		preset = globals.__pulseBakedCfg, inputService = inputService,
		visSnap = function() return VisualWorld.snapshot(visualWorld) end, visApply = function(data) VisualWorld.applySnapshot(visualWorld, data) end})
	environment.getgenv().__pulseFovOK = function(character)
		return FovTarget.isInside({configuration = settings, workspace = workspace}, character)
	end
	globals.__pulseMM2SaveGen = (tonumber(globals.__pulseMM2SaveGen) or 0) + 1
	local generation = globals.__pulseMM2SaveGen
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		Configuration.saveWhileCurrent({environment = environment, generation = generation,
			settings = settings, json = http})
	end)
	window.OnDestroy = function()
		hub.dead = true
		pcall(context.stopTrolly)
		pcall(aim.stop)
		pcall(stopFarm)
		pcall(context.stopFarmWebhook)
		pcall(stopRoleFarm)
		pcall(stopBoxes)
		pcall(stopFling)
		pcall(stopFlingTool)
		pcall(stopKnifeAim)
		pcall(stopTracers)
		pcall(stopAntiAim)
		pcall(stopMuzzleGuard)
		pcall(stopCustomSounds)
		pcall(stopGameSounds)
		pcall(stopBoombox)
		pcall(stopTradeValues)
		pcall(stopAnimations)
		pcall(stopWeaponSkins)
		pcall(EspFeature.stop, esp)
		pcall(stopGameEffects)
		pcall(context.stopKillEffects)
		pcall(stopAuras)
		pcall(stopAuraTint)
		pcall(stopSelfChams)
		pcall(stopWalkTrail)
		pcall(stopVisualWorld)
		pcall(stopVisualSky)
		pcall(stopTexturePack)
		pcall(stopWeather)
		pcall(stopSkyFx)
		pcall(stopCursor)
		pcall(stopOptimizer)
		pcall(stopSpeed)
		pcall(stopFly)
		pcall(stopSpin)
		pcall(stopInvisibility)
		pcall(stopGunEsp)
		pcall(stopAntiCoin)
		pcall(stopGlitch)
		pcall(stopGravity)
		pcall(stopWallHop)
		pcall(stopNoclip)
		pcall(stopCameraNoclip)
		pcall(stopFakeItems)
		pcall(stopFunTools)
		pcall(stopMapVote)
		pcall(stopMobile)
		pcall(stopXray)
		for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
			pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
		end
		if feature.state.screen then pcall(function() feature.state.screen:Destroy() end) end
		if globals.__pulseMM2SaveGen == generation then globals.__pulseMM2SaveGen += 1 end
	end

	return {window = window, hub = hub, settings = settings, translation = translation,
		connections = connections, fov = feature}
end


if game then
	local _, diagnostics = SeniorApplication.start(getfenv(), game)
	return diagnostics
end
